[list][*]Black Market has been improved.[/*][/list]
[quote]Our priority is to prevent and fix errors related to the Black Market and newly applied features, and to ensure their stability.

Therefore, the Costume Combo Sales feature, originally scheduled to be implemented along with the Black Market improvement, has been postponed.

A separate notice will be made when the Costume Combo Sales feature is implemented in the future. We sincerely apologize for not being able to update according to the previously announced schedule.[/quote]

notes.title: [GM Note] Together, We Go Further! PD Leadership Update!
notes.content:
Hello, this is GM Cuckoo.

Today, I would like to share an important announcement with all Agents.

In order to provide long-term service for Closers and to strengthen our communication with all Agents, we are pleased to inform you of an update to our PD leadership.

PD Hyun-Jun Kang who is currently managing Closers will oversee the overall management. In addition, a new PD has joined the Closers project to further support and enhance the game's direction.

With both PDs now working together, Closers will continue to develop in a more positive direction, with increased communication and engagement with all Agents.

Accordingly, we have conducted an interview with each PD to address the questions you may have.

We are pleased to now share their responses with you.
Shall we begin?


[h3][color=#89CFF0][b]▶ Interview with PD Hyun-Jun Kang[/b][/color][/h3]

[b]Q. Over the past two years, you’ve overseen many updates as the dedicated PD of Closers. To what extent do you feel your initial goals have been achieved?[/b]

A. When I first assumed the role of PD for Closers, my top priority was “optimization.”
As the game had been live for many years, various efforts had been made to enhance the environment—such as transitioning to 64-bit, supporting 120 FPS, and upgrading to DirectX 11. However, these improvements had sometimes led to unintended issues, including frame drops and performance degradation.

With that in mind, I firmly believed that establishing a stable and seamless environment should come first.
I would say that approximately 85% of the goals I set have been achieved over the past two years.

Another objective was to revitalize the narrative flow among the teams.
To that end, we actively developed new characters and made considerable efforts to integrate them naturally into the existing teams—for example, characters such as Ria Yoon and Triss. I'm grateful that many Agents responded positively to these additions.


[b]Q. There have been various updates, including Break Challenge, new characters, raids, and QoL improvements. What were the guiding principles behind these decisions?[/b]

A. Rather than following a rigid structure, I focused on identifying what was most needed at each point in time.
During summer and winter, we prioritized large-scale content, while spring and fall were typically dedicated to system improvements and quality-of-life updates.

At each stage, we carefully examined what the Agents most needed and what areas required enhancement, allowing us to determine the proper priorities. Thanks to this approach, each seasonal update took on its own unique characteristics.


[b]Q. Among the updates that have been released thus far, is there anything you found regrettable?[/b]

A. In our efforts to enhance the enjoyment of farming, we implemented various initiatives—one of which was Break Challenge: Fly King.

At the time, we wanted to introduce an element of randomness to break away from the monotony of existing farming structures. Additionally, we sought to reinterpret existing raid bosses in new ways to offer a fresh combat experience.

However, in hindsight, we recognize that this approach may not have aligned with the expectations of our Agents. The random nature without guaranteed drops, and the lack of intuitive combat patterns, ultimately caused inconvenience. I feel bad that we were not able to fully deliver the enjoyment we had intended.


[b]Q. On a different note—could you tell us a bit about the newly joining PD?[/b]

A. The new PD has a wealth of experience operating a wide range of games, having worked with our company for many years. Most importantly, he has a genuine affection and passion for Closers.

With his diverse background, he brings a fresh perspective and new approaches. I firmly believe he will offer new enjoyment and improved experiences for our Agents. As I continue to oversee overall management, I will work closely with him and share insights to ensure consistent quality going forward.

I kindly ask for your warm support and encouragement for our newly joined PD.

 
[h3][color=#89CFF0][b]▶ Interview with PD Lee Hyun Soo[/b][/color][/h3]

[b]Q. You seem like a familiar face. Could you please introduce yourself briefly?[/b]

A. Greetings. My name is Lee Hyunsoo, and I have recently joined Closers as its sixth PD.
It has now been over seven years since I joined NADDIC Games. Although I officially became part of the Closers team around May of this year, I had already been observing the project and the work of previous PDs closely in the company.

While I am no longer active in broadcasting area, there may be some who recognize me from occasional appearances on game-related broadcasts. If, by unfortunate algorithmic recommendation, my face happened to reach your screen, I extend my apologies for any visual inconvenience caused.


[b]Q. How do you feel about stepping into the role of PD following PD Hyun Jun Kang?[/b]

A. I feel a great sense of responsibility.

“Sixth.”

The fact that the number has increased by one may seem trivial, but it carries significant weight. Of course, the number itself is not as important as the role it signifies. I hope to serve as a “Bridge”, maintaining the positive legacy built by the previous PDs while also steadily addressing areas for improvement. Rather than declaring a complete overhaul, I intend to take a thoughtful approach—focusing on consistent improvement and advancement based on the foundation that has already been established.


[b]Q. Have you been playing Closers since the beginning?[/b]

A. Closers is a title I have followed since its early development phase. Although circumstances led to it being serviced by another publisher at the time, I continued to observe its progress with interest. After joining NADDIC Games, I became even more closely involved with the project. There was a brief period when I had to step away due to other responsibilities, but I have since returned and am now fully dedicated to the project.


[b]Q. Which characters are you currently playing?[/b]

A. While I do play all characters, I currently focus primarily on five:
Yuri, Triss, Mistel, Lucy, and Ria.


[b]Q. Many Agents may feel uncertain due to the leadership change. Will this shift in PD result in any significant changes to update schedules or overall direction?[/b]
A. While the change may appear sudden from the perspective of our Agents, I have in fact been working alongside PD Kang prior to formally taking on the role, sharing in decision-making as part of the transition process. Both PD Kang and I have placed strong emphasis on striking a balance between continuity and change. 

Major scheduled updates will proceed as planned, without significant alterations. In between, we intend to introduce improvements to outdated systems where necessary. 

In particular, we are committed to responding promptly to ongoing concerns raised by our Agents—such as service stability and suggestions regarding update content. While we recognize that there may still be room for improvement, we are actively gathering feedback across various channels and will do our best to address it accordingly. We ask for your continued patience and support as we move forward.


[b]Q. Were there any aspects of Closers you personally hoped to improve upon once you became PD?[/b]

A. One of my medium- to long-term goals is to move beyond repetitive gameplay loops, such as “Xue/Triss/Gildal” or “Dogra/Magra/Integrated Farming Dungeon,” and instead create spaces and moments where Agents can truly enjoy staying within the game. In addition, as the service lifespan of Closers grows longer, we have seen a gradual decline in accessibility for new and returning Agents. I aim to explore ways to open up these entry points once again. Of course, no single solution can address everything. Therefore, I hope to experiment with various approaches and remain open to strong feedback if our direction ever diverges from expectations. Our Agents’ voices will serve as the foundation for growth and positive change.


[b]Q. There are a few updates that were previously announced but have yet to be implemented—for example, the Crew Leader Delegation system and bundled costume sales. What is the current status of these items?[/b]

A. These features have not been abandoned. They remain on our list of pending development tasks. We fully understand that many Agents are awaiting these updates and have expressed their opinions regarding them. Although their implementation has been delayed due to a focus on service stability, we will make every effort to resume development and apply them as soon as possible. 
Given that Closers is a title that has been developed over many years and by many hands, certain changes—even minor ones—can produce unexpected ripple effects. Some delays arise from the need to introduce new systems while also ensuring overall stability. That said, we recognize the importance of keeping our Agents informed and offering transparency about the status of such developments. We will work to not only deliver quality content, but also to communicate more frequently with you—sharing our thoughts and development progress more openly and regularly.


[b]Q. Do you have any unique strategies or approaches to further revitalize Closers?[/b]

A. First and foremost, we are preparing a space and time in which we can actively listen to the voices of our Agents. While we are still finalizing the schedule and format, we plan to hold a session where feedback can be heard in real time—or as close to it as possible. We will provide detailed information regarding the schedule and method in the near future.


[b]Q. Could you share your vision or any final message for the Agents of Closers?[/b]

A. This coming winter, Closers will celebrate its 11th anniversary, launching in Korea. While it may sound cliché, our development team—including PD Hyun Jun Kang as the overall manager—will continue to unite our efforts in order to ensure that Closers remains a game you can enjoy with satisfaction not only now, but all the way to its 20th anniversary and beyond.

Thank you for your continued support.

Today, we have shared interviews with PD Lee Hyun Soo, who has newly joined Closers, and PD Hyun-Jun Kang, who will continue to oversee overall management.

Lastly, both PDs have each written a special message for all Closers Agents.
 
Please click the link below to read their letters:
[list][*][url=https://www.closersonline.com/news/developer-s-letter-hyun-jun-kang-WHJnIe1493][b]PD Hyun-Jun Kang’s Developer's Letter[/b][/url][/*][*][url=https://www.closersonline.com/news/developer-s-letter-pd-lee-hyun-soo-4dsn331494][b]PD Lee Hyun Soo’s Developer's Letter[/b][/url][/*][/list]
To commemorate the appointment of the new PD, we are pleased to provide a special reward to all Agents.

We look forward to your continued interest and support as Closers strives to grow and communicate more closely with all Agents.

notes.title: Developer's Letter - PD Lee Hyun Soo
notes.content:
Dear Agents, 
Who have been supporting Closers over a decade,

I am Lee Hyun Soo, newly appointed as the PD of Closers. It is both an honor and a profound responsibility to assume this role at such a pivotal moment, as we lay the foundation for the next decade of Closers’ journey.

My commitment is not to represent the development team at NADDIC Games, but above all to safeguard the long-term satisfaction of our Agents.

I pledge to listen attentively to your voices and, in turn, to share our perspectives with you through diverse channels.

Together with the development team, I will strive to ensure that Closers continues to bring joy to your daily lives, and that these moments of enjoyment grow in both quality and duration, reaching even more Agents.

I will devote my utmost efforts so as not to become a nuisance to either the development team or to you, our Agents.

Rather than pursuing sweeping changes all at once, we will focus on steady, meaningful improvements over time, step by step.

I sincerely ask for your continued interest, your candid feedback, and your constructive criticism as we move forward together.

Thank you.

Lee Hyun Soo, 
6th PD of Closers

notes.title: Developer's Letter - Hyun-Jun Kang
notes.content:
Hello, Agents!

This is Hyun-Jun Kang, PD of Closers.

It feels like just yesterday that I first greeted you all, and now I find myself writing again with the latest leadership update, it brings back many memories.

Working on Closers alongside all of you has been a truly enjoyable and meaningful experience. 

More than anything, the support and affection you’ve shown have been a source of strength and growth for both myself and the team.

Moving forward, PD Lee Hyun Soo, who has recently joined the team, will be engaging with you more frequently as the new active PD.

I firmly believe that PD Lee’s fresh perspective and dedication will allow us to deliver even greater experiences to all of you.

I kindly ask that you extend to him the same encouragement and support that you have so generously given thus far.

For my part, while continuing to oversee overall responsibilities, I will remain committed to guiding Closers within its broader direction.

I will continue to stand by your side on this journey, and I sincerely ask for your ongoing trust and support for Closers.

Thank you sincerely, for everything so far, and I look forward to what we’ll continue building together.

Best regards,
Hyun-Jun Kang, PD of Closers

[list][*]Left click the Form Raid button to display the Raid theme select window.[/*][*]You can only enter the Raid when you are in a party.[/*][*]Only the party leader can initiate raid entry.[/*][*]If the entry requirements are not met, a message will appear stating you cannot enter the raid, along with the name of the required mission.[/*][/list]

[list][*]The leader can use the Dungeon Status Board to select a dungeon, check party information, and view active effects and dungeon details.[/*][*]The Raid Status Board can be closed using the [X] button on the right side of the status window or the [ESC] key. Chat and other functions are available in town.[/*][*]Leaving the squad will immediately remove you from the raid party and close the Raid Status Board.[/*][*]Only the leader can use the [Forfeit Raid] button. When the leader gives up the raid, then the raid will end immediately, but the party will remain intact.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Raid Status Board - Squad Info[/b][/color]

[list][*]Effect will be disappear from the dungeon where already cleared once. [/*][*]A buff icon will appear below the name of any dungeon that provides a buff.[/*][/list]

[list][*]Displays the buff obtained after clearing the specified buff dungeon.[/*][*]Shows the total values of all acquired buffs.[/*][*]Buff effects shown under ‘Active Effects’ apply only to the current dungeon in progress.[/*][/list]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/80cd3c27fe6029acb9b2be2bd060a6e979ac8456.png[/img]

Greetings Agents,

We will perform maintenance on the Closers World server according to the following schedule, based on your time zone:

[list][*] [b]UTC:[/b] September 10, 2025 from 5:00 AM to 10:00 AM
[*] [b]PDT:[/b] from September 9, 2025 at 10:00 PM to September 10, 2025 at 3:00 AM
[*] [b]GMT+7:[/b] September 10, 2025 from 12:00 PM to 5:00 PM[/list]
Please log out of the game before maintenance begins. During this period, you will not be able to access the game, and the website may not function properly.

To stay up to date with news and other information, please visit our website or follow us on social media.

Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you that a client patch has been deployed to address the recent Steam login issue. With this update, you should now be able to log in to your Steam account without further issues.

notes.title: [Developer Diary] Introduction to Sunny Day Adventure
notes.content: Hello, this is GM Cuckoo! I’m back with another Developer Diary! The theme of today’s diary is something all Agents have been looking forward to — 2025 new swimsuit, the Sunny Day Adventure Costume! ✧( •̀ᴗ•́ )و The 2025 Sunny Day Adventure swimsuit costume introduces new tech and lighting effects that make it truly special and more vivid than any of our previous swimsuit costumes. Let’s take a look at what techs were applied! [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/d15684b80ed52a3404b2d89887e4810bd0f393b3.png[/img] [color=#89CFF0][b]■ Sunny Day Adventure Costume! How is it different from previous costumes?[/b][/color] Unlike our previous swim wear costume releases, the Sunny Day Adventure costume is crafted with a more distinct and vibrant look. We’ve applied MAT CAP technology through our engine to create a fresh visual experience. On top of that, we adjusted the lighting to enhance the skin texture and smooth curves, making the appearance more natural and appealing. [table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/450100ffdd46ab53706b654d3b962143c7f841a1.gif[/img] [i]Your skin glistens as if you've been oiled! (ง *´▽`* )ว[/i][/td][/tr][/table] [color=#89CFF0][b]■ What is MAT CAP?[/b][/color] MAT CAP (Material Capture) is a technique that simulates how light reflects off skin or fabric, making it appear shiny or glossy, just like in real life! We first introduced this feature in December 2024 with the Holy Night Bunny (Glossy Version) and have since applied it to Teatime Hound and unique costumes like Herald of Netherworld. [table equalcells=1][tr][th] MAT CAP applied on Teatime Hound / Herald of Netherworld [/th][/tr][/table][table equalcells=1][tr][td][previewyoutube=S1TkQ6vRSoQ;full][/previewyoutube][/td][td][previewyoutube=SoTeynPHK6k;full][/previewyoutube][/td][/tr][tr][td] [i]MAT CAP applied on Teatime Hound[/i] [/td][td] [i]MAT CAP applied on Herald of Netherworld[/i] [/td][/tr][/table] This same feature has been applied to the Sunny Day Adventure costume, giving characters’ skin a more lively and radiant appearance. [color=#89CFF0][b]■ Lighting Adjustment Details[/b][/color] In Closers, both your character and NPCs cast shadows depending on the lighting direction and angle of the area you're in. However, because of the surface shape and orientation of the character model, shadows can vary quite a bit. [table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/535417dd67fb05e8a4866ff759f0331f8ed45dc0.jpg[/img][i]The shadows change depending on the area and lighting![/i] [/td][/tr][/table] Each area in Closers has a unique theme, time of day, and weather, all of which define the lighting environment of that area. [table][tr][th] Natural light (Daytime) [/th][th] Natural light (Sunset) [/th][th] Indoor Lighting Environment [/th][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/548f41e374e9d01a349220fa5f0021c45d09ffd3.jpg[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8f70d6f09391778636000a7a9a4f8cabcb8b62bc.jpg[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/5bc620bb5525294a7e73d5ff437fac7538abaa85.jpg[/img][/td][/tr][/table] Just like this, lighting direction and intensity are set differently for each area. These lighting settings directly affect how shadows appear on characters. Swimsuit costumes, which feature a lot of exposed skin, unintended shadows can make the skin appear darker than intended. To fix this, for the Sunny Day Adventure costume, we created new light settings based on the lighting data from each region, ensuring smoother skin highlights and more natural-looking curves. [color=#89CFF0][b]■ Optional Light Settings[/b][/color] Of course, some Agents may prefer the original shadows for added depth and realism. That’s why we’ve added a Light Setting Toggle (On/Off) option! [table][tr][th] Light Setting Off [/th][th] Light Setting On [/th][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/4ce9c5be813648a27ebbece270a6af4fcf29e458.jpg[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/c14a5a131f86164c7ecdb2df29f8f9c72ed3dd1f.jpg[/img][/td][/tr][/table][i]You can on/off from Character Info (Shortcut P) → Character Skin Change → Light! *⸜( •ᴗ• )⸝*[/i] Now you can choose the lighting style that best suits your preferences! [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/d15684b80ed52a3404b2d89887e4810bd0f393b3.png[/img] That wraps up our introduction to the new features in the Sunny Day Adventure costume! The gorgeous and stylish Sunny Day Adventure costume will be released for all 22 Closers, including Triss, in the upcoming update on August 27. Please continue to show lots of love and support for Closers! ♡

notes.title: [Developer Diary] Introducing the New Character 'Triss'
notes.content:
Hello, this is GM Cuckoo.

Today’s Developer Diary covers the 22nd character, available last August 6th!

We asked various departments about the birth and background of Wolfdog’s Triss, and gathered their responses.

Let’s dive into the behind-the-scenes stories!

[h3][b]Q. Can you introduce Triss’s initial concept?[/b][/h3]

[color=#89CFF0][b]Scenario Team:[/b][/color]
Triss is the younger sister of Levia, a playable character, and like her sister, she is a dimensional monster and a Closer. Many Agents may already be familiar with her origin, as you witnessed it firsthand. In a way, Triss was born thanks to your help.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/9f0c6e9be5ec219aab442ba407ed71bd6959e9c9.png[/img]
[i]In fact, Triss treasures the outfit her sister Levia gave her (灬º‿º灬)♡[/i]

At first, she couldn’t control the aura of wrath within her, causing some trouble. But with the help of the Closers and her own determination, she overcame the aura of wrath and even fought against Gildal and the Order alongside other Closers. However, letting go of the aura of wrath came at a cost. She lost much of her power and began to drift, unsure whether she truly belonged among humans. Due to this, and for other reasons revealed later, Triss embarks on her own journey. At the start of the story, she is not yet part of the Wolfdog team, much like Ria, and only joins after completing her personal journey. The main storyline will explore in depth how Triss became a "Vagabond," wandering to grow stronger.

One key trait to highlight is that Triss is both child and adult.

She appears mature and thinks like an adult, but she also shows childlike tastes and mindset. We put great effort into balancing these contrasting qualities, and we hope players will appreciate that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/ef230e1d4c81e1787e3eda64b58047a629a98510.png[/img]

[h3][b]Q. Why was Triss designed as a tall character?[/b][/h3]
 
[color=#89CFF0][b]Scenario Team:[/b][/color]
Initially, we imagined her as a small, cute child, which seemed natural for a newly born character. But we felt that was too predictable and dull. So we took a bold direction and made her taller than her older sister, adding an unexpected twist. This led to other traits, like her being self-conscious about her height and loving small, cute things.


[h3][b]Q. Any specific concept or inspiration behind Triss’s mature appearance?[/b][/h3]
 
[color=#c3a3ff][b]Character Art Team:[/b][/color]
We began with the contrast “Levia like a round-faced puppy, Triss like a sharp-featured cat.”
We explored many “cool beauty” archetypes and ultimately shaped Triss from there.


[h3][b]Q. It must’ve been challenging to reflect her various roles, such as Levia’s sister and a member of the dragon race.[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/50af3bb3d0d4f56750d5b7c00b081efc797634c1.jpg[/img]
[i]A rough image reflecting the extensive consideration![/i]

[color=#c3a3ff][b]Character Art Team:[/b][/color]
Here’s the first rough sketch.
Unlike the cute sister, Triss was planned to be an ice queen, so we aimed for a chic vibe.
We also thought a lot about how to reflect their parents’ genes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/fa7744229ffc81b3a775f6ba24d13b1c9dba7642.jpg[/img]

First draft after mindful considerations.
We debated over white vs. black hair and ultimately chose black as the base.
Triss was the first character to transition from a boss to a playable character, so we put a lot of effort into finding a balance between the two roles. While she needed to be a "playable" character who would be loved and supported by Agents, we also had to blend in the qualities of a “boss” character, as she was originally introduced as the formidable enemy commander of the Dragon Legion. Combining these two seemingly opposing elements in a natural and compelling way was a key part of the design process.

When deciding who Triss's horns and outfit should resemble, we ultimately felt it made the most sense for her to take after her father in the story. As a result, we drew heavily from Hecatoncheir’s design when creating her appearance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/58c1e49571cdc4bc1ffea1ed580ef554507ba228.jpg[/img]
[i]Unfortunately, the ribbon was dropped in the final version (☍д⁰)[/i]

This is the final version of Triss's face design.
Although we decided to choose black as the base, we added purple highlights to express individuality. 
Because of her Evil Eye concept, we gave her eyes a unique look to differentiate her from other characters, while maintaining a connection to her sister Levia through matching eyeliner and eye color.

In the initial drafts, her hair was designed to be tied with a ribbon. The backstory was that Levia had tied it for her when Triss was born, but that detail was unfortunately removed during the revision process.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/ccb52db7da75efc2f80dbe3e7f21776c47cda018.jpg[/img]
[i]Which costume do you like the most?[/i]

We spent a lot of time deciding on the 1st draft.
It all started with the question: 'What kind of outfit would Triss wear when she first came into the world?'
We chose leather-based clothes to enhance her confident, sword-fighter image.

We wanted to highlight her hips and thighs, so we aimed for a design that would showcase those features as much as possible, while still keeping things simple since it’s her base outfit.

 
[h3][b]Q. Let’s talk about the illustration. What was most important in designing Triss’s illustrations?[/b][/h3]
 
[color=#c3a3ff][b]Character Art Team:[/b][/color]
We especially focused on the abdomen and thigh areas to emphasize her silhouette. We believe a character with a beautiful body line is always appealing.


[h3][b]Q. Since all of Triss’s promotions have been released at once, what were the key points you focused on for each promotion illustration? Could you also explain the differences between them?[/b][/h3]
 
[color=#c3a3ff][b]Character Art Team:[/b][/color]
The key points are as follows:

[b]Regular Operative[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/ee918bbf6029ae3842c2957a0fe12cf3bdc9dd5a.png[/img]
We focused on subtly revealing skin through gaps in the outfit. 
Rather than emphasizing excessive exposure, we aimed to highlight elegance by accentuating the body’s natural silhouette.

[b]Special Operative[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/69c2dfa3e7f8079b7424c9d2d60574c07f94a2c0.png[/img]
Since the silhouette was similar to the regular outfit, we enhanced it with more elaborate and eye-catching elements. 
We placed particular emphasis on textures like decorative accents and transparent materials.

[b]Fatal Crew[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/65fffe29e788a61a98db677573deb3eb6ee03b3f.png[/img]
We moved away from the usual front-facing composition and opted for a pose that combines her side and back view.
The key highlights are the sharp side profile of her face and the flowing body line from hips to thighs.
We gave particular attention to emphasizing hips and thighs. ^^d

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/99aebfc33eda81e65827159a39c27f79c60387cd.png[/img]

[h3][b]Q. Let’s move on to her weapon. Why was a greatsword chosen for Triss?[/b][/h3]

[color=#4d4de6][b]Planning Team:[/b][/color]
The initial concept began with contrasting Triss against her sister, Levia.

Levia uses a staff to channel energy attacks in the form of orbs and projectiles, so for Triss, we aimed for a completely different combat style.

Given her "cool beauty" visual concept, we explored weapon types that would complement that. Favoring something simple, heavy, and metallic over something flashy or lightweight.

To contrast with Levia’s blunt staff, we decided on a bladed weapon, one that would focus on slashing and piercing physical attacks.

We also wanted to reflect the overwhelming presence of her father, Hecatoncheir, a massive and intimidating being, comparable in size to a skyscraper. To carry that symbolism forward, we gave Triss a similarly imposing weapon, which led to the decision to equip her with a greatsword.

[b]Cold, Massive Greatsword[/b].

The overwhelming destructive power of the massive weapon was ultimately defined as the core of Triss’s combat style and identity.


[color=#89CFF0][b]Scenario Team:[/b][/color]
There’s narrative meaning behind choosing a sword.
In the dragon clan, many dimensional monsters use swords, like the Vagabond, Astaroth, and Mamba after their transformations. We envisioned Triss as a young dragon following her clan’s tradition and growing by training in swordsmanship. Her class name “VAGABOND” reflects both her connection to the original Vagabond and her growth through wandering and self-training.


[h3][b]Q. What were some key visual effects and animations for Triss?[/b][/h3]

[color=#90EE90][b]VFX Team:[/b][/color]
Triss’s greatsword led us to focus on the impact and weight of each skill.

[previewyoutube=NerL0MfU0w0;full][/previewyoutube]
We emphasized the flow from charging, slashing, and the lingering shock after impact.

[table][tr][td][previewyoutube=kqTM6OMrU_g;full][/previewyoutube][/td][td][previewyoutube=fzsTxK-e7zQ;full][/previewyoutube][/td][/tr][/table]
While Levia’s effects involve curves and explosions, Triss’s are direct and cutting across the battlefield.

While the overall color scheme remains subdued, we adjusted it to evoke a sense of intimidation. We also simplified the visual elements boldly to increase density and ensure powerful immersion, even in short bursts of action.

[color=#FFAC1C][b]Animation Team:[/b][/color]
When creating the animations, we prioritized the tempo of a high-speed action game and the defining characteristics of the greatsword. Our goal was to allow for fast attacks without making them feel too light or unnatural, so we focused heavily on balancing weight and speed.

During production, we experimented with long, heavy objects to explore how such a weapon should move to feel natural, powerful, and satisfying.

Since the greatsword is nearly as tall as the character herself, we designed the motion with a lowered center of gravity, allowing the character's lower body movements to emphasize the weight and arc of each swing.

[table][tr][td][previewyoutube=rqw0gZR3PUE;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Her dance and emote animations are also designed to highlight lower body movement!
⸜(⠀  ᐢ ᵕ ᐢ  )⸝⸜(  ᐢ ᵕ ᐢ    )⸝‍[/i]
[/td][/tr][/table]

We made great effort to let players feel both the weight of the greatsword and the speed of Closers.

[h3][b]Q. How is Triss set apart from other characters?[/b][/h3]

[color=#90EE90][b]VFX Team:[/b][/color]
Although Levia and Triss belong to the same lineage, their personalities and combat styles are completely different. That’s why we felt it was important to express them visually in distinct ways.

We adjusted the colors and tones of the effects and also developed new visual techniques such as distortion, grayscale, and inversion to better match the mood and identity of Triss's skills.

[table][tr][td][previewyoutube=YaVJQIW5kQg;full][/previewyoutube][/td][td][previewyoutube=DJUwEoGEa60;full][/previewyoutube][/td][/tr][tr][td][previewyoutube=KhzMxEHD47Y;full][/previewyoutube][/td][td][previewyoutube=RMbSYsqSsik;full][/previewyoutube][/td][/tr][/table]
[i](Left - original / Right - Slo-mo)[/i]

We believe these attempts helped elevate the overall tone of the effects, making them more refined, and significantly enhanced the sense of immersion during combat.

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/6d1db7f34c52c4bad7b2f39fa112001a1d2354b9.png[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a7ba74fcdf79d6c241d2eb70eda3fc33be52f410.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]

[color=#89CFF0][b]Scenario Team:[/b][/color]
In the scenario, the most important focus was bringing to life the concept of Triss transitioning from a boss to a playable character. After receiving the planning request, the biggest challenge was making her appealing even as an enemy, while ensuring that her shift to a playable character wouldn’t feel awkward or unnatural. After all, we couldn’t make a simple villain, or a character who left a deeply negative impression on players, into someone they would actively want to play. This was one of the key considerations in the <Martyr’s Hill> scenario. We worked hard to portray her as an enemy, yet still compelling and guided by a strong sense of justice.

Another point we paid special attention to in terms of her background was giving Triss a narrative that aligns with the vibe of the Wolfdog team. After much discussion, we concluded that the most essential trait of a Wolfdog member is the yearning for freedom and the willingness to fight for it. Based on that, we shaped her character and story accordingly. We also revisited the past narrative of the Wolfdog team and made a conscious effort to build on it and evolve it in a meaningful way. We hope players will look forward to what we've prepared.

[h3][b]Q. Finally, what kind of players would enjoy Triss?[/b][/h3]
 
[color=#4d4de6][b]Planning Team:[/b][/color]
We recommend Triss to players who are familiar with rhythmical skill inputs based on different combat situations. She’s especially suited for those who enjoy refining their mastery by minimizing downtime between skills and discovering faster attack tempos.

That wraps up the origin story of the 22nd new character, Triss!

We hope you’ll show lots of love and support for this new character joining our journey. Thank you!

notes.title: July 9th Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f10dd0533fb0c9b4f9f30523c0b8a37268e9935f.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]Characters[/b][/color][/h3]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]1. 1st Skill System Revamp[/b][/color][/h3]
[list][*] Skill system has been revamped.[/list]
[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ Skill Point Revamp[/b][/color]
[list][*] Character lv. specific Skill Points are applied to all characters regardless of the character’s current SP.
[*] All characters now receive 3 Skill Points for each level increase.
[*] All characters receive 5 Skill Points for each 10 level increase. (i.e. At lv.10, lv.20... lv.90)
[*] Skill Points granted every 10 levels will not be distributed together with Skill Upgrade Points.
※ It will be 303 Skill Points when the character reaches lv.95.[/list]
[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ Active Skill Revamp[/b][/color]
[list][*] Active Skills no longer consume Skill Points directly.
[*] Skills are now learned automatically based on Promotion requirement and level.
[*] [Support] skill items are no longer consumed. Skills will be automatically learned once the requirements are met.
[*] All eligible skills will auto-level when the character levels up.
[*] Skills eligible for EX conversion will be automatically converted.
[*] The passive learning requirement has been removed from the 5th Skill's learning requirement.[/list]
[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ Passive Skill Revamp[/b][/color]
[list][*] Polish Passive Skills remain unchanged and are still optional to use.
[*] Passive Skills remain unchanged and levels can still be adjusted.
[*] Character specific Passive Skills no longer consume Skill Points to level up.
[*] 5th Passive Skill level is no longer adjustable, stat increase is now fixed at the current max level.
※ All Passive Skill Points will be reset after the update. Please redistribute them accordingly.[/list]
[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ Skill Ticket Item Adjustment[/b][/color]
[list]
[*] Skill Tickets are no longer usable following the skill system revamp. 'Unusable' has been added to the item description.
[*] Skill tickets have been discontinued from the UNION Store.
[*] The following methods are no longer available to acquire Skill Tickets:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/bc0589ee90de3259e8f5ab077aa111dca9db88da.png[/img][/list]
[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ UI Adjustment[/b][/color]
[list][*] [Skill Reset] check box in the Active Skill tab: the [EX] and [Master] buttons are no longer displayed.
[*] In Skill Tip descriptions, the requirements for already fulfilled conditions are no longer displayed.[/list]
[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ Additional Notes on the UI Adjustment[/b][/color]
[list][*] Active skills are now automatically sorted by learning order in the character’s skill window.
[*] A notification will be displayed when a new skill is learned through upgrading.
[*] A notification will be displayed when a learned skill is upgraded.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]New Contents[/b][/color][/h3]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]1. Integrated Farming Dungeon[/b][/color][/h3]
[list][*] Introduced the ‘Integrated Farming Dungeon’.
[*] Collectable items such as Chromatic Phase Essence, Sticky Residues etc can be acquired in the ‘Integrated Farming Dungeon’.[/list]
[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ Entering the Integrated Farming Dungeon[/b][/color]
[list][*] Complete the [Triumph] Mission in the [Scenery Beyond the Gate] episode with character Lv 95 or higher, and you can enter the dungeon via <Unified Entry System>.[/list]
[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ Integrated Farming Dungeon Details[/b][/color]
[list][*] You can enter each dungeon via <Unified Entry System> and acquire different rewards in each dungeon.[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/eef3c41d4896ef9b435feda18b0dadfd844f5630.png[/img]


[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ Available Rewards[/b][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f15a66143ddf5588dcd230c6807a6f29aef27ca5.png[/img]

[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ Additional Details[/b][/color]
[list][*] Certain dungeon rewards have been removed due to the introduction of the Integrated Farming Dungeon.
[list][*] The following dungeon rewards & PNA EXP have been removed:[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/60302a13efe8bf05d4307056d7fb70cd12556c2b.png[/img]

[list][*] Certain drop rewards listed above have been transferred to the Integrated Farming Dungeon reward pool.
[*] With the removal of certain material acquisition methods, related crafting recipes and upgrade materials will be adjusted.
※ The current crafting recipes will be removed in the future. A separate notice will be issued before removal.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/bb491851c270a99edf01c4d25b7dac0e8b9b2f49.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]Systems[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ Matter Mixer Update[/b][/color]
[list][*] Matter Mixer has been updated.[/list]
[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ Material Item Search[/b][/color]
[list][*] Introduced a new material item search feature.
[*] You can toggle the [Material Item Search] button at the top left to enable or disable the [Material Item Search] feature.
[*] With [Material Item Search] enabled, you can search for a material in the search window to view the items that can be crafted with it.
[*] With [Material Item Search] disabled, it functions the same way as the current Matter Mixer.[/list]
[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ Selecting Inventory Item Search[/b][/color]
[list][*] With [Material Item Search] enabled, it will enable the Inventory Item Search feature.
[*] With [Material Item Search] enabled, left-clicking a selected item in your inventory will search for the material by its item name.
[*] A “No search result” pop-up will appear when no matching results are found.[/list]
[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ Additional Notes on the Matter Mixer Update[/b][/color]
[list][*] The contents of the Matter Mixer Guide have been modified and removed to reflect adjustments.
[*] The Matter Mixer overall UI has been revamped to reflect the latest update.
[*] [Crafting time] has been removed in the Matter Mixer UI and replaced with [Crafting Item Expiry].[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]2. Entry Limit for Each Character[/b][/color][/h3]
[list][*] Entry counts for each character have been applied to dungeons that previously had account-based entry limits.
[*] e.g. If a dungeon has 6 weekly entries, the entry count per character is 2 — at least 3 characters are required to use all 6 entries.
※ Entry count per character currently applies to ‘Integrated Farming Dungeons’ and will be expanded to other dungeons in the future.
[*] Move the mouse over the top of a character’s Entry Limit to view which characters are eligible to enter the dungeon.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]3. Chip Crafting Recipe Adjustment[/b][/color][/h3]
[list][*] Chip crafting recipes have been adjusted following the introduction of the Integrated Farming Dungeon.
[*] The following crafting recipes have been removed:[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/6f553cc33c6a8d4d3cde21876488495bb2203024.png[/img]
[list][*] The new recipes are listed as follow:[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/dd897bcaee1aece5eccb4cdcc666703654a7a567.png[/img]

[list][*] The following recipes have been adjusted:[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/1f0a5a96f46ce6e0a4aff22bfc53335a197dd228.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]4. Added Awakening Cube Crafting Recipes[/b][/color][/h3]
[list][*] Added character’s awakening cube crafting recipes to the Matter Mixer.
[*] Awakening Cubes can be crafted by consuming 1m Credits.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]5. Added a New Dungeon Feature to confirm Shared Entry Limits[/b][/color][/h3]
[list][*] Move the mouse over the upper area of the Confirm Dungeon Entry Account / Character, the dungeon name will be displayed if a Shared Entry Count dungeon exists.[/list]

notes.title: [Developer Diary] Quick Evasion Improvements
notes.content:
Hello, this is GM Cuckoo.

Today, we're back with a new type of content called the “Developer Diary,” which we introduced in the May 2025 Developer Letter to foster closer communication with all Agents.

Our first topic is the behind-the-scenes story of the Quick Evasion improvements.


[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]0. About Quick Evasion[/b][/color][/h3]
 
Agents, what do you think about Quick Evasion?

At present, it's usable even in midair, and it's seeing more frequent use thanks to its ability to counter Gewurah’s mechanics and synergize with Hetero Genes that grant additional benefits.

But before the overhaul, Quick Evasion felt lacking if it wasn’t equipped, yet awkward to actually use when needed.

Even when it seemed like the right time to use Quick Evasion, it was often more effective to use an invincibility skill or an ultimate move to bypass the pattern instead.

So, how did this ambiguous skill turn into the improved Quick Evasion we have now?

Let’s find out.


[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]1. The Beginning of Quick Evasion Improvements[/b][/color][/h3]

“What if we improved the inconvenience of the current Quick Evasion and encouraged more frequent use? Wouldn’t that make combat feel more dynamic and action-packed?”

That’s where the idea began.

The first step was identifying the problems with the existing Quick Evasion system.

[b]■ Inconvenient because it couldn't be used in midair[/b]
[list][*]Many aerial skills exist, but Quick Evasion couldn't be used while airborne[/*][*]Being in the air often means using skills, but you couldn't use Quick Evasion while using a skill[/*][/list]
[b]■ High risk, little reward[/b]
[list][*]Successfully using Quick Evasion gave almost no benefit, while failure came with significant risk[/*][/list]
[b]■ Questionable value[/b]
[list][*]High risk, hard to use, and few rewards[/*][*]Other skills provided invincibility and let you attack at the same time, so there was little need to use it[/*][/list]
It was clear that Quick Evasion needed several improvements. Our first priority was to make it easier and more rewarding to use.

While considering what kind of improvements would enhance player convenience, we explored the idea of allowing Quick Evasion to be used in midair, and of granting greater rewards when it is successfully executed.

As such, we decided to first provide this convenience of midair usage and moved quickly into development.


[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]2. Gewurah and Quick Evasion[/b][/color][/h3]

The Quick Evasion revamp began during the development discussions of the new boss “Gewurah” in the Limbo of Ignorance content.

Gewurah’s concept was crystal clear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a75677b3f34c9faf343c5411e9be6cb5b22321ef.png[/img]
[list][*]A battle maniac obsessed with fighting.[/*][*]Seeks out any strong opponent and fights them without hesitation.[/*][*]A wild, gladiator-like centaur.[/*][/list]
The first things that stood out in Gewurah’s concept art were the charging silhouette on all fours and the sharp, solid horns.

[i][b]“The art of combat lies not in fleeing, but in meeting your opponent head-on.”[/b][/i]

It reminded us of fierce Spartan warriors in film.

While discussing Gewurah’s development, an idea hit us.

[i]“What if, instead of dodging a charging monster with a movement or invincibility skill, players could execute a well-timed evasion to face the charge head-on?”[/i]

Picture a Closers character narrowly dodging a frontal charge with precise timing.

We envisioned players using Quick Evasion in that moment to make the dungeon more exciting.


[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]3. Development of the Hetero Gene[/b][/color][/h3]
 
We designed Gewurah’s battle structure to match its personality and centaur design, emphasizing powerful charging attacks.

While developing this battle structure, our biggest challenge was creating a meaningful benefit for breaking its patterns.

Since players could already evade these charges using movement or invincibility skills, Quick Evasion needed a greater incentive.

We decided to introduce a clear reward system: [Fail the evasion = Gewurah powers up / Succeed = your character powers up.]

This way, instead of just dodging, players could feel the satisfaction of precisely breaking a pattern with Quick Evasion and being rewarded with more power.

To extend this rewarding feeling beyond Gewurah, we also looked at adding similar benefits to Hetero Genes.


[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]4. Development of Midair Quick Evasion[/b][/color][/h3]

We returned to Quick Evasion with renewed focus of improving the existing problems.
Refining the skill was essential for implementing Gewurah’s pattern and the Hetero Gene.

The most critical problems were the inability to use it in midair and the inability to trigger it while using other skills.

Because Quick Evasion was originally designed for ground use, we improved it to make the skill available in the air.

We also expanded the skill cancel system so that Quick Evasion could smoothly cancel other skills in progress.

To make successful evasions more noticeable, we added a visual effect to “Just Evasion,” so players could clearly see when they pulled it off.

[table][tr][th]
Prototype 1 (Yellow Effect)
[/th][th]
Prototype 2 (Blue Effect)
[/th][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/30ce71bc013c0118695125604bdd536647326a6c.gif[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a265e12e2fd58b6cdfcd78c2ad74388bb11e3656.gif[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
In the early concept, we considered two options for the Just Evasion effect color: yellow and blue.

[b]■ Blue Effect[/b]
[list][*]Matches many blue-tone world backgrounds (sky blue, navy, violet, etc.).[/*][*]Blends smoothly with other skill effects, providing visual stability.[/*][/list]
[b]■ Yellow Effect[/b]
[list][*]High visibility due to its brightness.[/*][*]A flashy effect that clearly says “You nailed the Just Evasion!”[/*][/list]
Although blue was the initial favorite due to familiarity, repeated testing swayed opinions toward yellow. It was ultimately selected for the final version.


[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]5. Test Play[/b][/color][/h3]

Through multiple stages of planning and in-depth discussions, we completed the Quick Evasion improvements.

As with any feature, we test it before releasing, so we ran a test of the new Quick Evasion.

[table][tr][th]
Quick Evasion Test
[/th][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f34e9c65b1233945ede799414333d379d83ee4eb.gif[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
Thanks to all the development steps and refinements, the test results were satisfying, and we were able to confidently present the revamped Quick Evasion to you.


[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]6. In Closing[/b][/color][/h3]

After a great deal of planning and discussion, Quick Evasion was first updated on June 11. With the addition of Gewurah in the June 25 update, Quick Evasion became even more widely used.

Despite many challenges in both planning and development, seeing how much you Agents enjoy the improved system has made it all worth it.

Every new feature requires careful planning and collaboration with many teams. It takes time, but thanks to your continued support, we can continue to move forward.

We will keep working hard to provide more convenience and exciting improvements for a better gameplay experience.

Thank you.

notes.title: [Important Notice] Inactive Account N-Coin Removal
notes.content:
Hello Agents,

To continue providing a smooth and enjoyable gaming experience for all, we will soon begin a system update to manage long-inactive accounts.

[b]As part of this update, unused N-Coins from inactive accounts will be removed[/b].

As stated in our [url=https://www.closersonline.com/terms-of-service][b]Terms of Service[/b][/url] under Paid Services, in-game currencies that remain unused for extended periods may be subject to removal.

[h3][b]▶ Scheduled Removal Date[/b][/h3]

[color=#FFAC1C][b] July 23, 2025 at 5:00 AM UTC [/b][/color]
[list][*]If your account has been inactive or not logged into since July 23, 2024 (1 full year), your remaining N-coin balance will be subject to removal on the above date.[/*][/list]
[h3][b]▶ What You Can Do[/b][/h3]
To retain your N-coin balance, [i][b][u]please log in to your Closers game account before July 23, 2025[/u][/b][/i].

[table][tr][th]Please Note[/th][/tr][tr][td]To avoid losing any unused N-coins, please make sure to log into the game itself. Logging into the official website is not enough, as only game login activity will be recognized.[/td][/tr][/table]
 
If you're having trouble accessing your account or believe your N-coins were removed in error, please reach out to us through our [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna][b]Customer Support Page[/b][/url][b] [/b]or send an email to: [b]support@closersonline.com[/b] as soon as possible. We are here to help!

Thank you for your understanding and continued support!

[list][*] Include your Closers Name and Character Name in your entry, missing info means your entry is invalid.

[/td][/tr][tr][td]

[color=#89CFF0][b]Criteria for Judging[/b][/color]
Entries will be chosen based on the following criteria:
[list][*] [b]Screenshot Creativity and Originality (40%)[/b]
[list]Showcase the originality and charm of your character's spring outfit! Let your creativity shine with unique color palettes and cozy styles that capture the spirit of the season. Adding effects and edits to enhance your screenshot is a bonus![/list]
[*] [b]Description/Message (40%)[/b]
[list]The story or description you provide should complement your character's spring look. Make it engaging, fun, and connected to your outfit and the spring season. Share a message that captures the essence of your character and the warmth and magic of spring![/list]
[*] [b]Community Vote (20%)[/b]
[list]The number of '❤️' votes the entry receives in the forum.[/list][/list]
 [color=#89CFF0][b]Event Info & Rules[/b][/color]
[list][*] New participants can get bonus to their total score, giving everyone a fair shot at winning and keeping the competition fresh and fun! Event rules will still apply.

[*] If you need to change or edit your entry or post, remove your first entry, then re-submit it again before the event ends.
[*] Closers Online Operation team can remove unrelated entries or discussions.

[list][*] Battle Program: Assassin of the Pole-Special Move stage requirement will be changed as follow:

[*] After: HP remain 95%, HP remain 60%, HP remain 30%[/list][*] Invincible effect removed when Battle Program: Assassin of the Pole Ice Pillar mode starts
[*] Certain attacking plates in Battle Program: Assassin of the Pole will be changed to Invincible Destruction Plates[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]3. Character Skin Window Improvement[/b][/color][/h3]
[list][*] Search feature will be added to the character skin window
[*] [View owned skins only] and [View equipped skins only] button positions will be swapped
[*] Max. Equipped Image Increased
[list][*] Current: 20
[*] After Update: Max.30
[color=#c3a3ff]※Skins equipped before the Feb 19, 2025 maintenance will be reset due to an increased maximum equipped image limit. Please kindly re-equip it after the maintenance. Thank you for your understanding.[/color][/list][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]4. Costume Locker System Improvement[/b][/color][/h3]
[list][*] Costume Locker System will be improved as follow:

[*] Packaged costumes are now applicable and equippable in the Locker[/list][/list]

[list][*] Automatically zoom in when entering the Costume Locker[/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Maximum Costume Locker Expansion Slots increased[/b][/color]
[list][*] Maximum Costume Locker Expansion Slots will be increased
[*] Costume Locker Expansion available by consuming N-coin

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/414d1f17345e5a558b809abb572f7f266e53c53a.png[/img][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Costume Set Slot Expansion[/b][/color]
[list][*] Costume Set slot increase
[*] Basic Costume Set slots increased to 15
[*] Costume Set expansion slots increased to 15
[*] Costume Set slots expansion is available by consuming N-coin

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/d5d461f8131d0c7e8add904db9b108923f1cd210.png[/img][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Costume Locker Function Improvement[/b][/color]
[list][*] [Put Visual Costume] and [Put Normal Costume] will be separated
[list][*] Put Visual Costume: It brings the equipped visual costume only
[*] Put Normal Costume: It brings the equipped normal costume only[/list][*] Costume slots can be purchased directly from the Costume Locker
[*] Rename Costume Locker is available
[*] Added Costume Locker Set List
[*] Added the Costume Locker Set List: A feature that allows you to obtain the set slot by clicking the slot you like
[*] Applicable to and equippable for Packaged Costumes
[color=#c3a3ff]※ Packaged status will be removed once the Packaged costume is equipped[/color]
[*] Changes to the Set Slot Expansion Icon

[*] Dragging the Costume out of the screen will not delete the Costume while opening the Costume Locker[/list]

notes.title: Sweety Valentine’s - Confess Your Love to your Favorite Character!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e5150f2a050f3bbcb6826bb0f57abddc5fb255b8.jpg[/img]

[color=#89CFF0][b]Event Period[/b][/color]
February 7, 2025 at 4:00 AM UTC - February 17, 2025 at 11:59 PM UTC

[color=#89CFF0][b]Winner Announcement[/b][/color]
February 18, 2025 UTC

[color=#89CFF0][b]Reward Distribution[/b][/color]
February 19, 2025 UTC (during the scheduled maintenance)
 
[color=#89CFF0][b]Event Mechanics[/b][/color]
[b]▶ What are the requirements?[/b]
Post a screenshot of your favorite Closers character with your confession with a hashtag #Sweety Valentine’s.
Don’t forget to include your Closers & Character Name!
 
[b]▶ How to submit my entry?[/b]
Submit your entry in Closers forums.
[list][*] Log-in to your Closers account on the Closers website: https://www.closersonline.com/signin.
[*] Post your screenshot and message with your Closers Name & Character Name.
[*] Post your entry in the [url=https://www.closersonline.com/forum/discussion?sub=70][b][Sweety Valentine’s] Forum[/b][/url].
[list][*] Main Category [General Discussion]
[*] Subcategory [Sweety Valentine’s]
[/list][/list]
[color=#89CFF0][b]Event Rewards[/b][/color]
A total of [b]5 winners will each receive 1,500 N-Coins[/b], offering even more chances to win than ever before!
 
[color=#89CFF0][b]Event Info & Rules[/b][/color]
[list][*] New participants can get bonus to their total score, giving everyone a fair shot at winning and keeping the competition fresh and fun! Event rules will still apply.
[*] Only one entry is allowed per Closers account.
[*] All entries must be made by the submitter specifically for the purpose of this contest.
[*] All participants should include their Closers Name and Character Name when submitting their entry; otherwise, the whole entry will be invalid.
[*] No explicit contents are allowed to be seen in the entry. Any entry that can make others feel offended or uncomfortable will be removed with or without permission from the Naddic staff.
[*] Once an entry has been submitted, players agree to have their work published publicly on our official channels (Website, Steam, and SNS).
[*] If you have submitted more than one entry, we will only refer to the first entry submitted.
[*] You can change or update your entry, and the final entry will be the one submitted before the deadline.
[*] The Naddic team can remove unrelated entries or discussions.
[*] The Naddic team is not liable for any violation of copyright or intellectual property. Any violations will be assumed by the event participant.
[*] Event details, rewards, and schedules may change or be cancelled based on circumstances. Please check the official website or in-game notices for the latest updates. Closers Online reserves the right to final interpretation.
[*] Contact https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna or support@closersonline.com for inquiries, concerns, or reports.
[/list]

notes.content:

[i]Even though I have almost no experience with this game, I'm growing fonder of it with each passing day. I discovered Closers in mid-2020; I spent a total of two months having fun leveling up, trying to understand the garden system as if it were the most important and relevant part of the game (it was something new for me, don't judge me). After that, I took a hiatus because I didn't understand anything. I don't interact with other players, which made it even more difficult for me to understand it, but my interest never died. I came back relatively recently. 4 months, maybe? I must say that I like it a lot more than before. The help, the constant updates and events were key. The best thing about New Year's? That I'm back to stay.
PS: A faithful Lucylover here.[/i]

notes.title: New Year’s Resolution – Start Your Year with a New Goal!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/abcc2913542488bba347667664ec2ec906fb978d.png[/img]

[color=#89CFF0][b]Event Period[/b][/color]
January 17, 2025 at 4:00 AM UTC - February 2, 2025 at 11:59 PM UTC

[color=#89CFF0][b]Winner Announcement[/b][/color]
February 5, 2025 UTC

[color=#89CFF0][b]Event Mechanics[/b][/color]

[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ What are the requirements?[/b][/color]
Write a minimum of 30 words to share your New Year's resolution. It can be Closers-related or about anything else you like!

[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ How to submit my entry?[/b][/color]
[list][*] Submit your entry in Closers forums.
[*] Log-in to your Closers account on the Closers website: [url=https://www.closersonline.com/signin][b]https://www.closersonline.com/signin[/b][/url]
[*] Post your message with your Closers Name & Character Name.
[*] Make sure it is under the [NewYear's Resolution] Tab:
[list][*] Main Category [b][General Discussion][/b]
[*] Subcategory [b][NewYear's Resolution][/b]
[*] Shortcut to [url=https://www.closersonline.com/forum/discussion?sub=69][b][NewYear's Resolution][/b][/url] Forum[/list][/list]

[color=#89CFF0][b]Event Info & Rules[/b][/color]
[list][*] New participants can get bonus to their total score, giving everyone a fair shot at winning and keeping the competition fresh and fun! Event rules will still apply.
[*] Only one entry is allowed per Closers account.
[*] All entries must be made by the submitter specifically for the purpose of this contest.
[*] All participants should include their Closers Name and Character Name when submitting their entry; otherwise, the whole entry will be invalid.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you that a client patch has been deployed to fix an issue where the in-game N-coin Charge button was redirecting users to another Closers server. We sincerely apologize for any frustration or confusion this may have caused. The issue should be fully resolved with this client patch, and the button will now direct you correctly to the World server.

Please re-login to the game and update your launcher to apply the changes.

If you encounter any other bugs or issues, please send us an email to: support@closersonline.com or through Customer Support web inquiry by clicking the banner below.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you of a known issue with the Visual Slot 18-set Package and the Inventory Slot Expansion Package in the shop.

The sale of these visual slot packages was scheduled for removal during the January 15th maintenance. Unfortunately, they were not removed as intended and remain accessible in the shop. Please be informed that this will be corrected during the next maintenance update.

Thank you for your continued support, and we appreciate your patience as we work to resolve this matter.

If you have any further concerns or questions, please send us an email to: [b]support@closersonline.com[/b] or through Customer Support web inquiry by clicking the banner below.

notes.title: Agents Favorite 2024 Updates Event - Win N-coins!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/0d3fc07c7453adb3e6a649df6f8ee1ad8ca6b0c5.png[/img]
 
[color=#89CFF0][b]Event Period[/b][/color]
December 4, 2024 - December 27, 2024 at 12:00 AM UTC

[color=#89CFF0][b]Winner Announcement[/b][/color]
December 31, 2024 UTC


[color=#89CFF0][b]Event Mechanics[/b][/color]
In this exciting event, we’re inviting all Agents to share your favorite game or patch updates from the Closers World server in 2024.

What updates caught your attention? Which ones made the biggest impact or brought the most fun? Now’s your chance to highlight the changes that stood out to you and left a lasting impression!

[color=#FFAC1C][b]▶ What are the requirements?[/b][/color]
[list][*]Participants must provide a title/topic for their entry.[/*][*]Write a [u]minimum of 100 words[/u] describing your favorite 2024 update in the Closers World server.[/*][*]Your entry should be in paragraph or bullet form, explaining why this particular update is your favorite and how it impacted your gameplay experience.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Winners of Autumn Screenshot Event
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce the winners of the [url=https://www.closersonline.com/news/autumn-screenshot-event-win-n-coins--oYVOSm1168][b]Autumn Screenshot Event[/b][/url]!

Thank you to everyone who participated and made effort to capture the warmth and beauty of the fall season in your stunning screenshots.

Congratulations to our winners:

[table][tr][td]
[b]Winner: Setsus [/b][url=https://www.closersonline.com/forum/thread/324][b]Link[/b][/url]
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
[i]Luna and Pheasant shine in the fall, under the tree, leaves gently fall, enjoying magical evenings together. White cats rest on the ground, Luna gently pets one's belly. A sunset landscape enchants, celebrating autumn with pure elegance.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/0b1f8d71560da119a9539fbd61c43ec908a13e94.png[/img]
[/td][/tr][/table]
 
[table][tr][td]
[b]Winner: Erudon [/b][url=https://www.closersonline.com/forum/thread/326][b]Link[/b][/url]
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
[i]I believe that catching autumn leaves is a must-try seasonal activity because it can definitely lift up your spirit when you caught one! But what are the odds of actually catching one?[/i]

[i]For the occasion, I dressed up my Harpy to match the warm colours of autumn. With the chilly weather creeping in, stocking is a woman's best friend when you want to wear a mini skirt. I added orange sunglasses to give her a stylish look as well. Lastly, I picked this background because its ambiance perfectly matches the autumn vibe! [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/dadf4a1497877ee0eae9524b958d243dc79fc653.png[/img]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table][tr][td]
[b]Winner: Howblast [/b][url=https://www.closersonline.com/forum/thread/322][b]Link[/b][/url]
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
[i]A Beautiful time for a Girl like Seth to look tender with this environment to wear a perfect outfit for any date[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/55ea7330858772958228fc3c3b34a7c3b1fb3105.png[/img]
[/td][/tr][/table]

Winner rewards will be provided during the next scheduled maintenance on December 4th.

[list][*] When registering items for sale in [Black Market] and [Purchase Reservation Black Market], the ‘Lowest Registration Price’ in each tab has been changed to be displayed in the ‘Unit Price’.

[list][*] Before: N mark removed when receiving items with [Receive all Credits / Items] button
[*] After: N mark removed when receiving all items in Purchase History[/list][*] When purchasing the last item registered in [Black Market] or [Purchase Reservation Black Market], a system message is displayed instead of a pop-up window.
[list][*] When purchasing the last item, the screen is refreshed to the previous search screen. [/list][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Some items have been changed to untradeable at Black Market Specification.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Items that are currently unobtainable, items that have rarely been traded in the past 6 months, old items, or items with very low necessity have been changed to specifications that cannot be traded in the Black Market.
[list][*] Target Item: Malek's Legacy, Skull Queen's Sight, Corrupted Treasure Shard, Magical Horn, Dragon's Broken Blade, Otherworldly Refugee's Horn and more
[/list][*] For items other than the announced Items, please refer to the Black Market Trade Specification through the Tooltip.

[b]Schedule:[/b] During the maintenance on November 20, 2024

[b]Details[/b]
[olist][*] [b]All items registered in the Black Market will be processed as failure in bidding during the maintenance on Nov 20, 2024.[/b]

notes.title: Autumn Screenshot Event - Win N-coins!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/25994dd200dcf1b34af3e95ac83bf0d772e99bdf.png[/img][color=#89CFF0][b]Event Period[/b][/color]
November 4, 2024 - November 29, 2024 at 11:59 PM UTC


[color=#89CFF0][b]Winner Announcement[/b][/color]
December 3, 2024


[color=#89CFF0][b]Event Mechanics[/b][/color]

[b]▶ Event Theme - All about Autumn/Fall Season![/b]
Show off your character’s best fall-themed look! Share a screenshot and a story or description that brings your autumn style to life!


[b]▶ How submit my entry?[/b]
[list][*] Log in to your Closers account on the Closers website: [url=https://www.closersonline.com/signin][b]https://www.closersonline.com/signin[/b][/url]
[*] After you logged-in to your account, visit this link: [url=https://www.closersonline.com/forum/art-media?catId=22][b]Forum - Art & Media[/b][/url]
[*] Select the "Create" button and provide the following:[olist]
[*] Input in Title: [b][Autumn Event][/b]
[*] Attach your screenshot entry and input your message.
[*] Include your Closers Name and Character Name in your entry.[/olist][/list]
[b]▶ Reminders[/b]
[list][*] Include your Closers Name and Character Name in your entry, missing info means your entry is invalid.
[*] Please note that using AI image creation tools may invalidate your entry.
[*] Follow all event mechanics and rules (see Event Rules below).[/list]

[color=#89CFF0][b]Sample Entry[/b][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/b60b2ec6fc8abaa4d407dc0c1d910fad6e1af6f8.png[/img]

[i]My Harpy's look is cozy and ready for fall!

Warm clothes, bright autumn colors, and a soft breeze give me a happy, comfy feeling perfect for this autumn season.

Closers Name: AutumnLeaf
Character: Harpy[/i]


[color=#89CFF0][b]Reward[/b][/color]
A total of [b]3 winners[/b] will receive the following:

[table][tr][td][color=#FFE135][b]Event Reward[/b][/color][/td][/tr][tr][td]

[b]1,500 N-Coins[/b]

[/td][/tr][tr][td]
[i]Winners will be announced on December 3 through the website and the rewards will be distributed during [b]December 4th[/b] maintenance.[/i][/td][/tr][/table]

[color=#89CFF0][b]Criteria for Judging[/b][/color]
Entries will be chosen based on the following criteria:

[list][*] [b]Screenshot Creativity and Originality (40%)[/b]
[list][*] Showcase the originality and charm of your character’s autumn outfit! Let your creativity shine with unique color palettes and cozy styles that capture the essence of the fall season. Adding effects and edits to enhance your screenshot is a bonus![/list]
[*] [b]Description/Message (40%)[/b]
[list][*] The story or description you provide should complement your character’s autumn look. Make it engaging, fun, and connected to your outfit and the fall season. Share a message that captures the essence of your character and the warmth and magic of autumn![/list]
[*] [b]Community Vote (20%)[/b]
[list][*] The number of '❤️' votes the entry receives in the forum.[/list][/list]

[color=#89CFF0][b]Event Rules[/b][/color]
[list][*] New participants can get bonus to their total score, giving everyone a fair shot at winning and keeping the competition fresh and fun! Event rules will still apply.
[*] Only one entry is allowed per Closers account.
[*] All entries must be made by the submitter specifically for the purpose of this contest.
[*] All participants should include their Closers Name and Character Name when submitting their entry; otherwise, the whole entry will be invalid.
[*] No explicit contents are allowed to be seen in the entry. Any entry that can make others feel offended or uncomfortable will be removed with or without permission from the Naddic staff.
[*] Once an entry has been submitted, players agree to have their work published publicly on our official channels (Website, Steam, and SNS).
[*] If you have submitted more than one entry, we will only refer to the first entry submitted.
[*] If you need to change or edit your entry or post, remove your first entry, then re-submit it again before the event ends.
[*] The Naddic team can remove unrelated entries or discussions.
[*] The Naddic team is not liable for any violation of copyright or intellectual property. Any violations will be assumed by the event participant.
[*] Contact [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna[/url] or support@closersonline.com for inquiries, concerns, or reports.[/list]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you in advance about the planned removal and change of some sub level dungeons, reward/craft recipe in Purification Ops Area scheduled on November 6, 2024 maintenance.  

Please check the following information for more details.

[color=#89CFF0][b]■ Pre-Notice on Purification Ops Area's some Dungeons/Reward Removal and Change[/b][/color]
[list][*] [b]Schedule[/b]: During the maintenance on November 6, 2024
[*] [b]Details[/b]

[b]1.) Purification Ops area's sub lvl. Dungeons will be removed.[/b]

[table][tr][td]
[color=#FFE135][b]Sub-dungeons to be Removed[/b][/color]
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
Purification Sector [Contamination Lvl. 1~5]
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
Warden Tindalos [Contamination Lvl. 1~5]
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
Monster Bird Harpas [Contamination Lvl. 1~5]
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
Yod's Domain [Contamination Lvl. 5]
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
Mirror Grabber Nitocris [Contamination Lvl. 5]
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
1st~2nd Chain Purification Ops
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
Yod’s Headwaters
- Yod’s Lagoon [Contamination Lvl. 1, 3]
- Last Dyke [Contamination Lvl. 2]
[/td][/tr][/table]
[b]2.) All dungeons in the Purification Ops area will be changed to be available without consuming entry materials.[/b][list][*] The owning ‘Contamination Purifier Capsule’ will be changed to available for sale in the Shop.[/list]
[b]3.) Other than visual(costume) items, all the rest of the rewards from the Purification Ops area dungeons will be removed.[/b]
[list][*] All dungeons' credit rewards will be removed.
[*] All dungeons' Operation Progress (Report Operation Result) will be removed and sale of Mission Drive Ver.1.0 will be ended at Contribution Shop.
[list][*] [color=#89CFF0]Please acquire the reward before the maintenance on Nov 6, 2024, if your Operation Progress is accumulated.[/color][/list][*] ‘Material/Consumable Item’ will be removed from dungeon clear reward, monster/boss monster drop reward.
[*] Gear item will be removed from Monster/Boss Monster drop reward.
[list][*] [color=#89CFF0]You can acquire Visual (Costume) Item depending on each rate same with existing.[/color]
[*] [color=#89CFF0]EXP, Contribution, and Event Item drop will be maintained.[/color][/list][*] ‘Purification Ops Exclusive Material’ Item will be changed to available for sale.[/list]
[b]4.) Purification Ops area's dungeon-related quests will be changed. [/b]
[list][*] The sub lvl. phrase will be removed from Purification Ops area's dungeon-related quest goal.
[*] Purification Ops Area's repetitive quest will be removed. 
[*] Purification Ops Gear, some material item, and credit item reward will be removed from Purification Ops Area Quest Reward.
[*] The required amount of ‘Contamination Token’ item for ‘Puriciation Ops/Commencing the Purification Ops’ quest will be reduced from 4 → 3.[/list]
[b]5.) The craft recipe of ‘Purification Ops Center’ tab from craft UI will be changed.[/b]
[list]
[*] The ‘Purification Ops: Gear’ Category, and the craft recipe for Awakended Cube and Gear in the category will be removed.
[*] Among the craft recipe materials from ‘Purification Ops : Materials’, ‘Contamination Hell Gear’, and ‘Yod’s Sea’ Category, items that consume ‘Purification Ops Exclusive Material’ for craft will be changed to consume other material item or Credit.
[list][*] [color=#89CFF0]Even if the craft recipe's material is changed, the craft restriction will not be reset but maintained.[/color][/list][*] The craft recipe regarding ‘Transcendence Stone Extract’ from ‘Purification Ops : Conversion’ and ‘Purification Renovation’ Category will be moved to ‘Conversion’ Category.[/list][/list]
Please refer to the information provided above to avoid any inconvenience while playing Closers. We will do our best to introduce more interesting content and events for all of you.

Thank you for your understanding and support.

If you encounter any bugs or issues, please send an email to: support@closersonline.com or through Customer Support web inquiry by clicking the banner below.

notes.title: 2024/2025 Closers Player Council - New Batch!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8543ea532eab22280169fecb9fb5c2c47278c9f4.png[/img]

Hi Agents!

The recruitment for the [url=https://www.closersonline.com/news/closers-player-council-2024-recruitment-9EwgGa1132?apiKey=6cff369fd3fe9f132e986b2a3ea7d921][b]2024 Closers Player Council (CPC)[/b][/url] is now over!

A big thank you to everyone who applied! We were excited to see so many of you eager to make the game and community better. Choosing the final members was tough because of all the great applicants

Let's welcome our returning/new Closers Player Council members!
[list]
[*] Aters
[*] Jay
[*] Nova
[*] Ryuusein
[*] Squall
[/list]
To the new members, you'll get an invite to our private CPC Discord channel soon, so please look forward to it!

Thank you once again to everyone who applied. Your support means a lot to us!

If you have any concerns or feedback, please reach out through [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna][b]Customer Support[/b][/url]. Also, don’t forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/w7hShma][b]Official Closers Discord[/b][/url]!

notes.content:
[h1]Memorial Fireworks Festival[/h1]
[i]Join the excitement at the dazzling Fireworks Festival![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/b103446a399727724c614b367f35b96c97c973a8.jpg[/img]
 
[color=#89CFF0][b]Event Period[/b][/color]
October 8, 2024 at 7:00 AM - November 6, 2024 at 7:00 AM UTC
 
[color=#89CFF0][b]Firecracker Material Removal[/b][/color]
November 6, 2024 at 7:00 AM UTC

[color=#89CFF0][b]Common Removal Date[/b][/color]
December 31, 2024 at 9:00 AM UTC


[color=#FFAC1C][b]1. Event Overview[/b][/color]

[table][tr][td]
[b]What are [Firecracker]?[/b]
[/td][td][list][*][Firecracker] is an event item that is only activated during the Fireworks Festival event period and can be acquired from both the Cash Shop and in-game.[/*][*]Using [Firecracker] can let you earn [Festival Points] based on the Fireworks grade, which is accumulated by a character and server.[/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]What are [Festival Points]?[/b]
[/td][td][list][Festival Points] are the accumulated points of players from a server. Once a certain amount of Festival Points has been achieved, it will activate the [Firework Buff].[/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]What is the [Fireworks Festival] Server Buff?[/b]
[/td][td][list][*]The[b] [/b]Server Buff[b] [/b]applies buff effects to all players and all characters.[/*][*]The Server Buff is stacked up to level 10 and will give better buff effects as the level goes up.[/*][*]All the buffs are activated at the same time upon reaching the required Festival points milestone.[/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]What is the [Fireworks Festival Gift] Buff?[/b]
[/td][td][list][*]The Buff is acquired when using Cash Shop Firework (Black Lambs, Wolfdog, Wildhüter, and Rattus)[/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]What are some other benefits?[/b]
[/td][td][list][*]Collect ‘Fireworks Event Souvenirs’ every 10 Festival points. This is your chance to obtain the Troubleshooter outfit (B type) and other exclusive rewards![/*][*]The top 5 Agents who contributed the most Festival Points to the server will obtain extra in-game rewards![/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]What determines the ranks?[/b]
[/td][td][list][*]The ranking is determined by the accumulation of [Festival Points] attributed to each character, with rewards allocated to Ranks 1 through 5.[/*][*]The Dragon Chair for Rank 1–3 is a newly introduced visual item.

[color=#FFAC1C][b]Dragon Chair[/b][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/268162d6fdbff5a34835d8246dc172b05b5534b6.gif[/img][/*][/list][/td][/tr][/table]

[*] All firecrackers are untradeable, cannot be sold, and cannot be moved to Account Storage.

notes.title: Trick-or-Treat! Be a Funny Halloween King/Queen!
notes.content:
