[color=#89CFF0][b]Event Mechanics[/b][/color]

[b]▶ Event Theme - All about Halloween![/b]
Capture a screenshot of your character in their funniest, silliest, or most creative Halloween outfit! Feel free to enhance your screenshot using Photoshop. Please also make sure to share a description or story that brings your look to life!


[b]▶ How submit my entry?[/b]
[list][*] Log in to your Closers account on the Closers website: [url=https://www.closersonline.com/signin][b]https://www.closersonline.com/signin[/b][/url]
[*] After you logged-in to your account, visit this link: [url=https://www.closersonline.com/forum/art-media?catId=22][b]Forum - Art & Media[/b][/url]
[*] Select the "Create" button and provide the following:[olist]
[*] Input in Title: [b][Funny Halloween King/Queen][/b]
[*] Attach your screenshot entry and input your message.
[*] Include your Closers Name and Character Name in your entry.[/olist][/list]
[b]▶ Reminders[/b]
[list][*] Include your Closers Name and Character Name in your entry, missing info means your entry is invalid.
[*] Please note that using AI image creation tools may invalidate your entry.
[*] Follow all event mechanics and rules (see Event Rules below).[/list]

[color=#89CFF0][b]Sample Entry[/b][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/c2f4ee7464f992c6db8b08d76ffef84ea3c951e6.png[/img]

[i]This happens when you're invited to a party without knowing there’s a pool!

Even though I’m in a fancy suit, I’ll add some quirky swimming items to turn it into a "Swim Suit". Nobody's gonna know ;)

Closers Name: McFunny
Character: CheolsuChuckles[/i]


[color=#89CFF0][b]Reward[/b][/color]
A total of [b]3 winners[/b] will receive the following:

[table][tr][td][color=#FFE135][b]Event Reward[/b][/color][/td][/tr][tr][td]

[b]1,500 N-Coins[/b]

[/td][/tr][tr][td]
[i]Winners will be announced on November 1 through the website and the rewards will be distributed during [b]November 6th[/b] maintenance.[/i][/td][/tr][/table]

[color=#89CFF0][b]Criteria for Judging[/b][/color]
Entries will be chosen based on the following criteria:

[list][*] [b]Screenshot Creativity and Originality (40%)[/b]
[list][*] Showcase the originality and uniqueness of your character's outfit! Let your imagination shine by using unexpected combinations of colors and styles that capture the Halloween spirit. Using effects and edits to enhance your screenshot is a bonus![/list]
[*] [b]Description/Message (40%)[/b]
[list][*] The story or description you provide should complement your character's look. It should be engaging, fun, and relevant to your outfit and the Halloween theme. Share a narrative that captures the essence of your character and the spirit of the season![/list]
[*] [b]Community Vote (20%)[/b]
[list][*] The number of '❤️' votes the entry receives in the forum.[/list][/list]

[color=#89CFF0][b]Event Rules[/b][/color]
[list][*] Only one entry is allowed per Closers account.
[*] All entries must be made by the submitter specifically for the purpose of this contest.
[*] All participants should include their Closers Name and Character Name when submitting their entry; otherwise, the whole entry will be invalid.
[*] No explicit contents are allowed to be seen in the entry. Any entry that can make others feel offended or uncomfortable will be removed with or without permission from the Naddic staff.
[*] Once an entry has been submitted, players agree to have their work published publicly on our official channels (Website, Steam, and SNS).
[*] If you have submitted more than one entry, we will only refer to the first entry submitted.
[*] If you need to change or edit your entry or post, remove your first entry, then re-submit it again before the event ends.
[*] The Naddic team can remove unrelated entries or discussions.
[*] The Naddic team is not liable for any violation of copyright or intellectual property. Any violations will be assumed by the event participant.
[*] Contact [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna[/url] or support@closersonline.com for inquiries, concerns, or reports.[/list]

notes.title: Closers Player Council 2024 Recruitment
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/5e151aaa71e0569099dddcfdd9f6476f078f58e6.png[/img]

Hello Agents!

Recruitment for the new batch of the Closers Player Council (CPC) is now open, running from October 2024 until next year. Previous council members, including those from earlier batches, have been helpful in identifying issues and voicing community concerns. For this new batch, we look forward to welcoming both new and familiar faces!

For those unfamiliar, the Closers Player Council is made up of players like you! As official Closers World admins, we communicate with the council to discuss ongoing concerns, report in-game issues, and assist fellow Agents.

If you feel you can contribute to this community, please feel free to submit your application, which will be reviewed by our team.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/25c9829edaefd8973f53b2dad9f791ce3935f71f.png[/img]

All CPC applicants must meet the following requirements and be willing to take on the following tasks.

[table][tr][td]

[color=#89CFF0][b][i]Requirements[/i][/b][/color]
[list][*] Must be a player on the Closers World server with at least one character at the current maximum level.
[*] Must stay up to date with Closers World server events and patch updates.
[*] Should have a basic to deep understanding of Closers Online.
[*] Must be able to communicate well in English.
[*] Must have a basic understanding of navigating Discord.
[*] No in-game infractions within the last 12 months.
[*] Veteran players of Closers are highly preferred.
[*] Must not share CPC group discussions or in-game reports outside the group until they are ready to be publicly announced.
[*] Knowledge and ability to enforce community rules (issuing warnings, muting, or recommending bans if allowed).
[*] Can look at things carefully, share ideas clearly, and be open and understanding with others.[/list]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table][tr][td]

[color=#89CFF0][b][i]Tasks[/i][/b][/color]
[list][*] Interacts with players and communicates clearly.
[*] Helps and guides players about Closers, answers questions, and creates a positive atmosphere.
[*] Sets a good example in-game and on other platforms (like Steam, Forums, Facebook, etc.)
[*] Knows the community guidelines, can handle conflicts between users, and enforces rules calmly when necessary.
[*] Engage in knowledge-sharing sessions with other players.
[*] Assisting players in other Closers community platforms such as Forum, Steam, etc. is not mandatory but it’s an advantage.
[*] Working together with Naddic staff and other CPC members when needed.[/list]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/547398d3c2604a25ab0a866d15cd09dadad1b2d7.png[/img]

All CPC applicants must meet the following requirements and be willing to take on the following tasks.
[list][*] Keep confidential or sensitive information within the CPC to avoid leaks of information regarding content in-game or player-base-related.
[*] If there is any action that is considered to affect the game service, there may be arbitration by Naddic.
[*] Inactivity in CPC activities or Discord moderation may result in reduced benefits (Please refer to the FAQ below).[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a92c52d43581b9b192a267ade4e105dcd4d4ac7b.png[/img]

[b]Deadline for CPC Application:[/b] October 18, 2024 at 11:59 PM UTC
[b]Announcement of the new batch of CPC:[/b] October 21, 2024 
[b]Term:[/b] October 22, 2024 - October 22, 2025 (1year)

[table][tr][td]
You can directly apply through this link
[url=https://forms.gle/T8X2ERUoc2heJQRT9][h3][color=#FFAC1C][b]Closers Player Council 2024 Recruitment Form[/b][/color][/h3][/url][/td][/tr][/table]
[list][*] All submissions will be reviewed by the Naddic staff. Once the CPCs are selected, their names will be announced, and the Naddic staff will contact them via Discord.
[*] Recruitment is for a limited time, and only applications submitted within this period will be considered.
[*] A maximum of 5 members will be accepted.
[*] Anyone can apply as long as they meet the requirements and willing to take the tasks. Previous CPCs may reapply for the next batch.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/6baf2f1836e152104a80246cf28ab8213af0f9c5.png[/img]

[list][*] [b]If I become a CPC, will I have direct contact with the Naddic support team?[/b]
[list][*] Yes, we will communicate in a private Discord group with the other Naddic staff.
[list][*] Please remember that we can only discuss community or general issues there. For personal matters or player reports, those should still be communicated through customer support inquiries for privacy reasons.[/list][/list][/list]
[list][*] [b]What does a Closers Player Council do?[/b]
[list][*] Community Assistance
[list][*] All Closers Player Council members will help moderate the Closers Discord server to create a healthy and safe environment for all users. They will also assist or direct users to the proper channels for their concerns.
[*] Interacts with players and communicates clearly in any Closers platforms (In-game, Discord, Steam, Forums, Facebook, etc.)[/list]
[*] Bug Reporting
[list][*] Report anything that has an unintended impact on the experience of playing Closers online. This covers dialogue/texts errors, broken skills/items, visual errors, quest bugs, environment bugs, graphical errors, etc.[/list]
[*] Community Feedback/Suggestion
[list][*] CPCs can communicate directly with us about what the player community is saying.
[*] Gives ideas and suggestions for Closers, like feedback on new updates or events[/list]
[*] Player Reporting[list][*] Reporting players who displayed inappropriate behavior in-game or on any Closers official sites.[/list][/list][/list]
[list][*] [b]What benefits are offered to the Closers Player Council?[/b]
[list][*] Members of the council do not receive special accounts or in-game items. However, they will receive a quarterly incentive during the first scheduled maintenance day in January, April, July, and October. The main benefits are the following:
[list][*] X3 ELITE Status (30-Days)
[*] 3,000 Bonus N-coin (Permanent)[/list]
[*] We understand that life can get busy, but if a CPC member is inactive or does not participate in any CPC activities or Discord moderation for more than 7 days, their incentive may be adjusted or not granted.
[*] Additionally, if a CPC member is completely inactive, they may be removed from the council. We appreciate your understanding.[/list][/list]
[list][*] [b]Does a CPC have the power to add, change, or remove anything in the game?[/b]
[list][*] No, CPC members don’t have access to any in-game tools. However, they can share their concerns with us, and we will look into them.
[*] Meanwhile, CPC Discord accounts will have extra permissions to help moderate the official Closers World Discord server.[/list][/list]
[list][*] [b]Can the CPCs know about upcoming updates and decide which updates or changes will be applied to the World server?[/b]
[list][*] Unfortunately, CPCs do not have the authority to decide which updates or changes will be applied in Closers or when they will be released, those decisions are still made by the Naddic team. Yet any insights are valuable, they can share them with us, and we will carefully evaluate those proposals for consideration.[/list][/list]
If you have any further concerns or questions, please send an email to [b]support@closersonline.com[/b] or submit an inquiry via our website at [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna][b]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna[/b][/url].

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f10dd0533fb0c9b4f9f30523c0b8a37268e9935f.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]1. Character Balance Adjustment[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Some Characters' Skill Balance have been adjusted.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Character: Levia, Tina, Mirae, Cheolsu Kim, Yoon Ria
[*] Some Skills' option and tooltip detail have been changed.
[*] Some Skills' coefficients have been adjusted.
[list][*] Skill Balance Adjustment Details[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/6ac020f20df0c36ae8de4069dd9caa97508857da.png[/img][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]2. Yoon Ria Polish Skill Additional[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Yoon Ria Character's Polish Skill has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Passive Skill ‘Polish’ can be opened and learned when each character's Prime Agent/Fatal Crew/Shadow Agent Promotion.
[*] In order to apply the Polish effect, you must acquire the active skill to which you are applying up to the maximum level.
[*] When you attack using an active skill with Polish applied, the Polish added attack will be subject to Air Strike/Back Attack/Chase Guaranteed judgment.
[*] The additional attack by Polish is not affected by the skill level.
[list][*] Yoon Ria Polish Skill[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/d291abe663d1f73414894c40647df406747366dd.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/543a784a4e6adaa1303891e9b545d1315a9ee3aa.png[/img][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]3. Dragon Core Convert Function[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The function to convert Dragon Core into Core of another type has been added.   [/b][/color]
[list][*] You can convert the Dragon Core by consuming credits and ‘Shining Dragon Core Piece’ or ‘Noble Dragon Core’ through the Upgrade NPC in each town. 
[*] Dragon Core Convert is only available for Atropos and bound extra grade cores.
[*] Dragon Core can only be converted for other cores within the same level and grade. 
[*] Only [Bound] Dragon extra grade cores can be converted, and tradable extra grade cores cannot be converted.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]4. Break Challenge Trigger Farming Ease[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Break Challenge Trigger ‘Infinite Gluttony Execution’ Item Farming has been alleviated.[/b][/color]
[list][*] 2 kinds of ‘Glutton King's Trigger Box (Epic)’ have been added to ‘Chapter of Infinite Gluttony’ Dungeon Clear Reward.
[*] You can acquire the ‘Infinite Gluttony Execution’ Item with a fixed grant option of minimum 2 Grade or higher and 4 Grade or higher from the ‘Glutton King’s Trigger Box (Epic)’ item added as a clear reward.
[*] The ‘Glutton King’s Trigger Box (Epic)’ Item Name added as a Clear Reward is the same but can be distinguished through the number displayed on the upper right of the icon and item tooltip.
[*] The two types of ‘Glutton King’s Trigger Box (Epic)’ added as a Clear Reward are tradeable for Black Market and can move to Account Bank.
[*] The ‘Glutton King’s Trigger Box (Epic)’ acquire method that cab be acquired as a ‘Chapter of Infinite Gluttony’ Dungeon Clear Reward has been changed to Drop Reward.
[*] ‘Glutton King's Memory Crystal’ item has been changed to ‘Glutton King's Trigger Box (Epic)’, from the dungeon clear reward of 3kinds of Elite Dungeons.              
[list]
[*] [color=#89CFF0]※ Please note that if you enter the 3 types of Elite Dungeons between 4:00 AM on Sept 21st, 2024 and before the maintenance on Sept 25th, 2024 the number of entries you can make will not be reset after the maintenance on Sept 25th, 2024.[/color][/list][*] ‘Glutton King's Trigger Random Box’ craft recipe has been removed and ‘Glutton King's Trigger Box (Epic)’ craft recipe has been added.[/list]

notes.title: September 11th Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f10dd0533fb0c9b4f9f30523c0b8a37268e9935f.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][url=https://www.closersonline.com/news/reign-of-the-dragon-king-new-dungeon-gears-events-DIbDHe1106][b]1. New Dungeon <Reign of the Dragon King>[/b][/url][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Dungeon ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ Dungeon is available by completing each corresponding quest, after accepting [False Preparation] Quest at Fantasy World : Dream Theater <<Reverse>> Town.
[list][*] Cradle of Dragons (1 player), Paris under Dragon’s domination (1 player): [The Power of the Dragon] Quest
[*] Cradle of Dragons (4 players), Paris under Dragon’s domination (4 players): [The Two Dragons] Quest[/list][*] ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ Dungeon is available by <Commander Subjugation Supporter - LeBlanc> NPC at Fantasy World : Dream Theater <<Reverse>>, The end: The world in flames, and Noah's Museum town.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/bd049d41455c38a7748410224ae404f374b9275a.png[/img]

[*] You can enter ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ dungeon, which has a fixed entry limit of 1 player, using the entrance ticket that can be obtained from 4 players dungeon.
[list][*] Entrance Material Item: Dragon Queen Astarte (1 player) Entrance Ticket, Dragon King Hecatoncheir (1 player) Entrance Ticket
[/list][*] You can acquire the additional reward through Bonus Reward System, at ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ 4 players Dungeon. (Once per character per week)
[*] You can acquire New Chip, Boss Accessory and Armband depending on the rate by clearing ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ Dungeon.
[*] You can acquire Material Item and ‘Dragon King's Noble Random Chest’ Item which are required for New Gear Craft and Upgrade, by clearing ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ dungeon.[list]
[*] New Gear: Furious Dragon Queen Staff/Whip, Furious Ancient Dragon Bright Core/Chakram, Astarte Disc
[*] Material Item: Shining Dragon Core Piece, Noble Dragon Core[list][color=#5f95cc]※ ‘Shining Dragon Core Piece’ can be acquired by Bonus Reward of 4 players' dungeon, and ‘Dragon King's Noble Random Chest’ can be acquired by Bonus Reward of 4 players' dungeon or Drop Reward of 1 player dungeon. 
※ ‘Noble Dragon Core’ can be acquired when opening Dragon King's Noble Random Chest, and Tradable Extra Core can be acquired with low probability.[/color][/list][/list][*] ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ Dungeon-related New UNION Watch, Growth Guide Mission, Farming Guide, and Achievement have been added. [/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Dragon King Boss Accessory & Illust Armband have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Dragon King Boss Accessory 6 kinds and Boss Illust Armband 2 kinds have been added.
[list][*] Dragon King Boss Accessory and Illust Armband can be acquired depending on each rate by clearing ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ 1 player/ 4 players dungeon.  
[*] Dragon King Boss Accessory and Illust Armband can be crafted through Craft NPC, by consuming ‘Shining Dragon Core Piece’ and Credit.[/list][list][list]However, accessories and illustration armbands are obtained as non-repackaging specifications in case of craft.[/list][/list][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]2. Bonus Reward System[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Bonus Reward System has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Bonus Reward System is a system that allows you to obtain additional rewards equal to the number of times you can receive rewards without having to click a separate button after clearing a dungeon.
[*] Dungeons with the Bonus Reward System set will display the icon and the number of times you can receive rewards on the lower left of the dungeon image in the entrance UI.
[list][*] Target Dungeon: Cradle of Dragons (4 players), Paris under Dragon’s domination (4 players), Castle of Darkness[/list][*] When you hover over the Bonus Reward icon and the number of times you can receive the reward in the dungeon entry UI, a description of the Bonus Reward will be displayed.
[*] Items and specifications obtained as Bonus Reward will be displayed in the Bonus Reward UI after clearing the dungeon.
[*] If you have used up all the number of times you can receive the Bonus Reward, the Bonus Reward UI will not be displayed even if you clear the dungeon.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]3. New Epic Core[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Epic Core ‘Furious Dragon Queen Staff/Whip’ and 'Furious Ancient Dragon Bright Core/Chakram’ have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] 4 kinds of New Epic Core have been added, and all can be equipped regardless of character's battle type. 
[*] New Epic Core's Enhancement Transfer Group has been added. 
[*] New Epic Core can be crafted and upgraded by consuming main materials, ‘Shining Dragon Core Piece’ and Credit through Craft NPC. 
[*] New Epic Core's Required Level is 94 and can be upgraded by Atropos grade.
[*] New Epic Core will have the Unleash Option activated and applied when it reaches Enhancement Lv. 18, 22, 26, and 30.
[list][*] New Epic Core 4 kinds Option[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/71bb190274e1b06783a9466c191988376786654d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e011caeae43cf69541015a07dc2037a60352742d.png[/img]
[*] New Epic Core Triggering Effect
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/7240fee06632e8119d287b6b7e574ee8fc11875b.png[/img]

[*] New Epic Core Unleash Option
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/22936a6c6f8e56ec48671bd81daa6baf11760bdf.png[/img][/list]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]4. New Extra Core[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Extra Core ‘Fallen Dragon Queen Staff/Whip’, ‘Fallen Ancient Dragon Bright Core/Chakram’ have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] 4 kinds of New Extra Core have been added and all are equippable regardless of character's battle type.
[*] New Extra Core's Enhancement Transfer Group has been added.
[*] New Extra Core can be obtained from ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ Dungeon, and details are as follows.
[list][*] Acquire by opening ‘Dragon King's Noble Random Chest’ depending on each probability that can be obtained from Reign of the Dragon King (4 players) Dungeon Bonus Reward and Reign of the Dragon King (1 player) Dungeon Drop Reward.
[*] Upgrade Dragon King Epic Core of Atropos grade into Extra Core, by consuming ‘Noble Dragon Core’ that can be acquired from Dragon King's Noble Random Chest, and Credit.[list][*] (Extra Core obtained through the upgrade cannot be traded on Black Market or cannot move to Account Storage.)[/list][/list][*] New Extra Core displays effects around the character or monster depending on the triggering effect, when applying it.
[*] New Extra Core will have the Unleash Option activated and applied when it reaches Enhancement lv. 18, 22, 26, and 30.
[list][*] New Extra Core 4 kinds Option[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e331f05a847e1fc517092aab46a74e783f0f5142.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e246b7d1d2b99a5ca16b87e21faa214174f128fa.png[/img]
[*] New Extra Core Triggering Effect
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/54383fc751f84fc599f9a48be1339b459d04bcd6.png[/img]

[*] New Extra Core Unleash Option
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/53066212abf119efd474a029f618af542e4c0863.png[/img][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]5. New Phase Awakening & New Chip[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Phase Awakening Gear ‘Astarte Disc’ has been added.[/b][/color]
[list]
[*] ‘Astarte Disc I’ can be obtained by upgrading ‘Dragon Disc III’ item by consuming main materials ‘Shining Dragon Core Piece’ and Credit. 
[*] ‘Astarte Disc I’ can be upgraded by ‘Astarte Disc III’ through  Upgrade NPC.
[*] ‘Astarte Disc’ can't be traded on Black Market Trade and can't be moved to Account Storage.
[*] When opening Chip Slot, you can equip a new chip that can be acquired from ‘Dragon's Vanguard’ or ‘Reign of the Dragon King’ Dungeon.
[*] You can use the active option by equipping ‘Astarte Disc’ at Skill Slot.
[list][*] New Phase Awakening <Astarte Disc> Option[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/35e5ffbe11d71c5b20ddadb549f9ef99cb8abb29.png[/img][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Chip ‘Dragon Queen Astarte Chip’ and ‘Dragon King Hecatoncheir Chip’ have been added.[/b][/color]
[list]
[*] You can acquire ‘Dragon Queen Astarte Chip’ depending on each rate, by clearing ‘Cradle of Dragons’ dungeon.
[*] You can acquire ‘Dragon King Hecatoncheir Chip’ depending on each rate, by clearing ‘Paris under Dragon’s domination’ dungeon.
[*] 2 kinds of new chips can be equipped to ‘Dragon Disc’ and ‘Astarte Disc’.
[*] Craft, Overclock, Inherit, and Transfer are not available for 2kinds of new chips.
[list][*] New Chip 2kinds Option[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/dadd94aa1f92113ed74768ba5f13b162c7bf5318.png[/img][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]6. Dungeon Skill Additional[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Dungeon skills and dungeons where dungeon skills can be used have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] New Dungeon Skill can be used by acquiring it after playing the target dungeon.
[list][*] Target Dungeon: Paris under Dragon’s domination (1 player, 4 players)[/list][*] For dungeons where you can use dungeon skills, you can check them in the dungeon entry information window and in the upper right area when entering the dungeon.
[*] Dungeon Skill can only be used by the Squad Leader.
[*] New Dungeon Skill Gauge can be acquired when the dungeon gimmick is successful.
[list][*] New Dungeon Skill Type and Consuming Gauge[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/2048a9c0f96fe641f951f0618dcc07fec51d3331.png[/img][/list][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]7. Enhancement System Improvement[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Enhancement System has been improved.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Physical/Psi Attack Power, Physical/Psi Crit Damage amount that would be increased when trinket item enhancement success has been increased.
[*] The Enhancement Rate Increase used to be applied through Enhancement Buff Voucher Item has been applied to the Basic Enhancement Rate. [[url=https://www.closersonline.com/news/enhancement-rate-notice-DD1ioZ1117][b]Go to Enhancement Rate Notice[/b][/url]]
[*] Enhancement fail rate targeting Enhancement +16, +17 grade has been removed.[/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Guaranteed Enhancement System has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Guaranteed Enhancement System is a system where the Guaranteed Enhancement Points are accumulated in an item according to the enhancement result value, and the enhancement is guaranteed to succeed when trying enhancement after reaching the maximum point value.
[*] If the Guaranteed Enhancement Point is accumulative over the maximum, the next enhancement try will succeed at a 100% rate, and the accumulative Guaranteed Enhancement Points will be reset.
[*] Guaranteed Enhancement Points are displayed in the lower right corner of the Enhancement System UI and in the Gear Item Tooltip.
[*] Guaranteed Enhancement Points accumulate when enhancement failure is prevented by adding Gear Booster Fortifier or when there is no change in enhancement.
[*] Guaranteed Enhancement Point is reset when enhancement success/great success or using Gear Booster or Enhancement Transfer Device.
[*] Guaranteed Enhancement Point is maintained when Enhancement Fail, Black Market Item Trade, Item Upgrade.  
[list]However, if Guaranteed Enhancement Points exceed the maximum in the lower Enhancement stage when Enhancement fails, the Guaranteed Enhancement Points exceeding the maximum will be removed.
(ex: If you acquired 15,000 Guaranteed Enhancement Points with +18 stage Gear and Enhancement fails, the Enhancement stage will be lowered to +17 stage, and the 3,000 points exceeding +17 stage (Maximum value 12,000) will be removed.[/list][*] Guaranteed Enhancement Point is acquired differently depending on the material item used for Enhancement.
[list][*] Acquire Guaranteed Enhancement Point 100pt when using ‘Gear Booster Fuel I’
[*] Acquire Guaranteed Enhancement Point 130pt when using ‘Lucky Gear Boost I’[/list][*] The maximum value of the Guaranteed Enhancement Point is different depending on the enhancement level.
[*] If you have acquired the Guaranteed Enhancement Point Maximum of the current Enhancement stage during continuous Enhancement, continuous Enhancement will end and the Guaranteed Enhancement Pop-up window will be displayed.
[*] When you try Enhancement in a status that has reached the Guaranteed Enhancement Point Maximum, Enhancement Material/Enhancement Additives/Credit will not be consumed.[/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ All Gear Items' enhancement stage has been expanded to a maximum of 30.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Gear effects for the expanded enhancement stages have been added.
[*] Chip Overclock's maximum level expansion will be applied through future updates.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]8. Unleash Option[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Unleash Option has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] A new system, ‘Unleash Option’, has been added to some Gear Items.
[list][*] Target Gear: Dragon King Epic Atropos Core, Dragon King Extra Core, Furious Dragon Module[/list][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The Unleash Option has been added to Furious Dragon Module.[/b][/color]
[list]
[*] The Unleash Option has been added to Atropos grade's Furious Dragon Module.
[*] ‘Unleash Option’ is activated sequentially when the target gear reaches the enhancement stage guided in Item Tooltip.
[list][*] Furious Dragon Module Unleash Option[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/b7fead1389a513a28eb8fb8f2a9bdb46d0c7fb6b.png[/img]
[*] ‘Unleash Option’ is displayed below Tuning Option and above Chip Option in Item Tooltip.
[*] Activated Unleash Option is displayed in ‘light blue’ in Item Tooltip, and Deactivated Unleash Option is displayed in ‘gray’.
[*] The effect of Deactivated Unleash Option is not applied.
[*] Unleash Option related game guide has been added.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]9. Yoon Ria Skill Balance Adjustment[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Yoon Ria Characters' some skill balance has been adjusted.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Target Skill's some tooltip descriptions have been added and modified.[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/df93435b550c8b8017f6bb14c89d4053b86d6ecf.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Skill damage has been added and some skill damage's coefficient has been adjusted.[/b][/color]
[list][*] New Skill Damage
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/1f27aaceb90fcfeabfce228825ea2350d0ae5b0a.png[/img]

[*] Skill Damage Coefficient Adjustment
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/4c8ba373784a2de14ae4e982def1f52a52e80280.png[/img][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Yoon Ria's resource status window has been changed.[/b][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/1d848779a1b2677cd583beda59ec0cc853b003a9.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ When using ‘Special Skill: Turn Over’ down arrow key with a Yoon Ria Character under the status of owning certain amount of [Sound Wave] stacks, the timing when the special skill cooldown is applied has been changed.[/b][/color]

notes.title: Enhancement Rate Notice
notes.content:
Hello Agents, this is Closers team.

We would like to inform you the Enhancement System Rate to provide more trustworthy gaming environment for you all.

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]■ Guaranteed Enhancement System Announcement[/b][/color][/h3]
[list][*] Guaranteed Enhancement Points are acquired differently depending on the fuel item used for Enhancement.[/*][*]If Guaranteed Enhancement Points are accumulative over the maximum, the next enhancement try will succeed at a 100% rate, and the accumulative Guaranteed Enhancement Points will be reset.[/*][*]Guaranteed Enhancement Points are reset when Enhancement Success/Great Success, Gear Boosters are used, and Enhancement Transfer Devices are used.[/*][*]Guaranteed Enhancement Points are maintained when Enhancement fails, Black Market item Trades, and item Upgrades.
  However, if Guaranteed Enhancement Points exceed the maximum in the lower Enhancement stage when Enhancement fails, the Guaranteed Enhancement Points exceeding the maximum will be removed.  
* Example: If you acquired 15,000 Guaranteed Enhancement Points with +18 stage Gear and Enhancement fails, the Enhancement stage will be lowered to +17 stage, and the 3,000 points exceeding +17 stage (Maximum value 12,000) will be removed.[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]■ Enhancement Rate when using Gear Booster Fuel I[/b][/color][/h3]
[list][*]If the Enhancement Try Result with Gear Booster Fuel I is Enhancement Stage <No Change>, you will be able to acquire 100pt of Guaranteed Enhancement Point.[/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/fe6f4a4a7c7a6b8dada526a49b83ea1408059ad3.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]■ Enhancement Rate when using Lucky Gear Boost I[/b][/color][/h3]
[list][*] If the Enhancement Try Result with Lucky Gear Boost I is Enhancement Stage <No Change>, you will be able to acquire 130pt of Guaranteed Enhancement Point.[/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/0f7dc18afa1206d17457c3e79de35434c4d14112.png[/img]

notes.title: [Summertime Forum Events] Challenge Best-Ever-Benefit Fanart & Video Contests!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/9c76506967707af69a98a2e16af7356d2d1b084b.jpg[/img]
 
[h3][b][Event 1: Fanart][/b][/h3]
[h1][b]The 2nd - Find Golden Hands[/b][/h1]
[i]Submit your fanart featuring Closers in the hottest 2024 swimwear![/i]


[color=#5f95cc][b]Event Period[/b][/color]
August 21, 2024 - September 30, 2024 at 11:59 PM UTC

[color=#5f95cc][b]Winner Announcement[/b][/color]
October 11, 2024 UTC


[color=#FFAC1C][b]Event Mechanics[/b][/color]
Create fanart featuring your favorite Closers characters wearing the latest [url=https://www.closersonline.com/news/2024-swimsuit-costume-summertime-resort--mlrahs1093][b]2024 Swimsuit Costume: Summertime Resort[/b][/url].


[h3][b]▶ How to Enter?[/b][/h3]
[b]1. Create original artwork that matches the event theme in these formats:[/b]

[color=#FFAC1C][b]Accepted Formats[/b][/color]

[table equalcells=1][tr][td]
[color=#FFE135][b]Traditional[/b][/color]
[/td][td]
[color=#FFE135][b]Digital[/b][/color]
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]Painting[/b]
or
[b]Hand Drawn[/b]
[/td][td]
[b]Digital Art[/b]
by using programs such as Photoshop, or any other art-making software.
[list][*]We may require seeing the raw file[/*][*]Above 1080x1080 in PNG or JPEG format only[/*][*]AI-generated works are not eligible for winner selection[/*][/list][/td][/tr][/table][list][*]Entry should be below 9MB for proper forum upload.[/*][*]Artwork should feature one or more Closers characters in the 2024 swimsuits with no explicit content or offensive imagery.[/*][*]Initial Progress, In-Progress Stage, and Final Result is required verifying that it's your own work (Please see the details below).[/*][/list]
 
[b]2. Submit your entry in Closers forums.[/b]

a) Log-in to your Closers account on the Closers website: [url=https://www.closersonline.com/signin]https://www.closersonline.com/signin[/url]

b) Upload your entry to [url=https://www.closersonline.com/forum/art-media?sub=66][b]Art & Media - Event[/b][/url] (Main Category: Art & Media with Subcategory: Event).
⮞ Input a Title for your Fanart including your Closers name.
⮞ Attach your [b]Fanart Entry[/b] (the completed artwork) by clicking the 'Attach Image' button.
⮞ [color=#c3a3ff][b]Required for valid entry[/b][/color] Click 'Insert Image' to upload the images showing the progression of your artwork:
[olist][*][b]Initial Progress[/b]: A sketch or concept of your artwork.[/*][*][b]In-Progress Stage[/b]: A mid-progress image/photo showing the development of your piece.[/*][/olist]
[color=#FFAC1C][b]Criteria[/b][/color]
[list][*][b]Creativity & Originality (40%)[/b][list][*]How unique and imaginative the artwork is, and how creatively it incorporates the [url=https://www.closersonline.com/news/2024-swimsuit-costume-summertime-resort--mlrahs1093][b]2024 Swimsuit Costume: Summertime Resort[/b][/url].[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Artistic Quality (30%)[/b][list][*]The overall quality, including technical skill, detail, color use, and visual appeal.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Relevance to Theme (20%)[/b][list][*]How well the artwork aligns with the 2024 swimsuits theme, including accurate representation and effective portrayal.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Community Vote (10%)[/b][list][*]The number of '❤️' votes the entry receives in the forum.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[color=#5f95cc][b]Winner & Rewards[/b][/color]
A total of [b]6 participants[/b] will win the following rewards:

[table][tr][td]
[color=#c3a3ff][b]1st Place Winner[/b][/color]
[b]x1 Winner of  25,000 N-coins[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
[color=#c3a3ff][b]2nd Place Winner[/b][/color]
[b]x1 Winner of 17,000 N-coins[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
[color=#c3a3ff][b]3rd Place Winner[/b][/color]
[b]x1 Winner of 15,000 N-coins[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
[color=#c3a3ff][b]Excellence Awards[/b][/color]
[b]x3 Winners of 3,000 N-coins[/b]
[/td][/tr][/table]
 
[h3][b][Event 2: Video][/b][/h3]
[h2][b]Summertime Resort is right here~! Video Contest[/b][/h2]
[i]Dance or sing along with the new summer theme song![/i]


[color=#5f95cc][b]Event Period[/b][/color]
August 21, 2024 - September 30, 2024 at 11:59 PM UTC

[color=#5f95cc][b]Winner Announcement[/b][/color]
October 11, 2024 UTC


[color=#FFAC1C][b]Event Mechanics[/b][/color]
Show off your summer spirit by dancing to "Summertime Resort's Dance Emotion" or singing along to the new theme song, "Dive into You".

[h3][b]▶ How to Enter?[/b][/h3]
[b]1. Create a YouTube video that is at least 20 seconds long of yourself either dancing to 'Summertime Resort's Dance Emotion' or singing along to the theme song, 'Dive into You'.[/b]
[list][*]Face covering is allowed, but the performance should be clearly visible and engaging.[/*][*]Videos should be posted publicly to ensure visibility and participation.[/*][/list]
[previewyoutube=Lj2gHb2SG20;full][/previewyoutube]
 
[b]2. Submit your entry in Closers forums.[/b]
a) Log-in to your Closers account on the Closers website: [url=https://www.closersonline.com/signin]https://www.closersonline.com/signin[/url]

b) Upload your entry to [url=https://www.closersonline.com/forum/art-media?sub=66][b]Art & Media - Event[/b][/url] (Main Category: Art & Media with Subcategory: Event).
⮞ Input your video title including your Closers name.
⮞ Attach your YouTube video link by clicking the 'Insert Media' button.

[color=#FFAC1C][b]Criteria[/b][/color]
[list][*][b]Creativity & Fun Factor (40%)[/b][list][*]How creative and entertaining is your performance? We’re looking for enthusiastic and enjoyable performances that capture the summer spirit![/*][/list][/*][*][b]Energy & Engagement (30%)[/b][list][*]The energy and engagement of your performance.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Adherence to Theme (20%)[/b][list][*]The performance aligns with the theme of dancing or singing to the theme song.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Community Vote (10%)[/b][list][*]The number of '❤️' votes the entry receives in the forum.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[color=#FFAC1C][b]Winner & Rewards[/b][/color]
A total of [b]3 participants[/b] will win the following rewards:

[table][tr][td]
[color=#c3a3ff][b]Winners[/b][/color]
[b]x3 Winner of 8,000 N-coins[/b]
[/td][/tr][/table]
 
[b]The 2nd - Find Golden Hands & Summertime Resort is right here~! Video Contest Event Rules[/b]
[olist][*]For The 2nd - Find Golden Hands event: AI-generated works are not eligible, and we require to see the Initial Progress and In-Progress Stage of the artwork.[/*][*]Only one entry is allowed per Closers account.[/*][*]All entries must be made by the submitter specifically for the purpose of this contest.[/*][*]All participants should include their Closers Name when submitting their entry; otherwise, the whole entry will be invalid.[/*][*]No explicit contents are allowed to be seen in the entry. Any entry that can make others feel offended or uncomfortable will be removed with or without permission from the Naddic staff.[/*][*]Once an entry has been submitted, players agree to have their work published publicly on our official channels (Website, Steam, and SNS).[/*][*]If you have submitted more than one entry, we will only refer to the first entry submitted.[/*][*]Participants are allowed to change their entries as much as they wish only during the event period.[/*][*]The Naddic team can remove unrelated entries or discussions.[/*][*]The Naddic team is not liable for any violation of copyright or intellectual property. Any violations will be assumed by the event participant.[/*][*]Contact [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna[/url] or [url=mailto:support@closersonline.com]support@closersonline.com[/url] for inquiries, concerns, or reports[/*][/olist]

notes.title: [Forum Event] Yoon Ria’s Welcome Party
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/c732064b9ab10200cb56baf624ecafcf0740d45f.png[/img]

[h1][b]Yoon Ria’s Welcome Party[/b][/h1]
[i]Share your warmest greetings and make Ria feel at home![/i]


[color=#89CFF0][b]Event Period[/b][/color]
August 7, 2024 at 7:00 UTC – August 20, 2024 at 11:59 PM UTC

[color=#89CFF0][b]Winner Announcement[/b][/color]
August 21, 2024


[color=#89CFF0][b]Event Mechanics[/b][/color]
To celebrate Ria's arrival, here's a special welcome event where you get to create a heartfelt welcome message for her!

[b]▶ How to Join?[/b]

[olist][*] [b]Write a creative and welcoming message for Ria.[/b]
[list][*] A total of 3 participants will win: 2 based on criteria (check the criteria below) and 1 lucky random participant.[/list]
[*] [b]Submit your entry in Closers forums.[/b]
[list][*] Log-in to your Closers account on the Closers website: https://www.closersonline.com/signin
[*] Post your message with your Closers Name & Character Name.
[*] Make sure it is under the [b][Ria Event][/b] Tab (Main Category [General Discussion] with Subcategory [Ria Event]).[/list]
[url=https://www.closersonline.com/forum/discussion?sub=67][b]▶ Shortcut to [Ria Event] Forum[/b][/url][/olist]
[color=#89CFF0][b]Sample[/b][/color]

[i]Welcome to Closers World, Ria! ❤️

I was so excited when I first heard the news about you. As a K-pop fan, it’s a dream come true to have a character that represents them! I know it’s been hard for you to sacrifice so much, but I bet it will be worth it!

Let’s rock all sectors with your trusty microphone 😂 Here’s to a new beginning for us all! ✨🎤🎶

Closers Name: Closeria
Character Name: Rialover[/i]

 
[color=#89CFF0][b]Rewards[/b][/color]
A total of 3 participants will win the following rewards:

[list][table][tr][td][color=#FFE135][b]Event Rewards[/b][/color][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]x1 S Guaranteed D Component: Gear[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]x1 T2 Platinum Chip Selectable Box[/b][/td][/tr][/table][i]Item Removal Date: December 31, 2024 at 9:00am[/i][/list]

[color=#89CFF0][b]Winners[/b][/color]
[color=#c3a3ff][b]2 Winners[/b][/color] will be chosen based on the following criteria:

[list][*] Creativity (25%)
[list]
[*] How original and imaginative is the message?
[*] The message encourages interaction and excitement among other Agents.
[/list]
[*] Clarity (15%)
[list]
[*] The clarity, coherence, and overall quality of the writing.
[/list]
[*] Relevance (25%)
[list]
[*] The message aligns with Ria's character and theme.
[*] Includes references to in-game lore, locations, or other characters that make it relevant.
[/list]
[*] Emotional Impact (25%)
[list]
[*] The message is heartfelt/warm, uplifting and welcoming, encouraging a positive atmosphere.
[/list]
[*] Community Vote (10%)
[list]
[*] The number of '❤️' votes the entry receives in the forum.[/list][/list]
[color=#c3a3ff][b]1 Winner[/b][/color] will be chosen randomly[/b]
[list][*]Provided that the rules and mechanics have been followed.[/*][/list]
[i]Winners will be announced on August 21 through the website and the rewards will be distributed on the same date.[/i]


[color=#89CFF0][b]Event Rules[/b][/color]
[olist][*]Only one entry is allowed per Closers account.[/*][*]All entries must be made by the submitter specifically for the purpose of this contest.[/*][*]All participants should include their Closers Name and Character Name when submitting their entry; otherwise, the whole entry will be invalid.[/*][*]No explicit contents are allowed to be seen in the entry. Any entry that can make others feel offended or uncomfortable will be removed with or without permission from the Naddic staff.[/*][*]Once an entry has been submitted, players agree to have their work published publicly on our official channels (Website, Steam, and SNS).[/*][*]If you have submitted more than one entry, we will only refer to the first entry submitted.[/*][*]Participants are allowed to change their entries as much as they wish only during the event period.[/*][*]The Naddic team can remove unrelated entries or discussions.[/*][*]The Naddic team is not liable for any violation of copyright or intellectual property. Any violations will be assumed by the event participant.[/*][*]Contact [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna[/url] or [url=mailto:support@closersonline.com]support@closersonline.com[/url] for inquiries, concerns, or reports.[/*][/olist]

notes.title: August 7th Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f10dd0533fb0c9b4f9f30523c0b8a37268e9935f.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]1. New Character Yoon Ria Update[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Character Yoon Ria has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Black Lambs team's 6th member ‘Yoon Ria’ has been added.
[*] Yoon Ria Character can start at Level 67 upon creation, and the Maximum Level is set to 88.
[list][*] Yoon Ria Character's maximum level is planned to be expanded by lv. 95 during the next maintenance.[/list][*] Yoon Ria Character's rank consists of Trainee, Novice Agent, and Regular Agent.
[*] Yoon Ria Character can use Gangnam District and International Airport town.
[*] Noah's Museum, Planar Gate/Planar Gate : Deep Layer, Ancient Dragon Historic Site, and Fantasy World : Dream Theater/Fantasy World : Dream Theater <<Reverse>> Town are available.
[*] UNION Camp (Your Room, Farm) entrance is available.
[*] UNION Arena (PVP) entrance is not available.[/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Yoon Ria Skill List[/b][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/fa500295800e27875e7619e314f5a5f9aaa5391c.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/360c72e7c23fcf9f5ef9a481866d36b853b0a371.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/65c51d2dd78df0fb48b48c4477dfd280e9f54544.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/c675677a4b431546e819cbfdf630601baa705573.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Yoon Ria's Quest has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Yoon Ria 1~2Area, Planar Gate, Ancient Dragon Historic Site, and Fantasy World : Dream Theater Quest have been added.[/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Yoon Ria's Achievement & Title have been added.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Yoon Ria's exclusive gear / item has been added.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Yoon Ria's 2kinds of Emotes have been added.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Yoon Ria's exclusive emotion has been added.[/b][/color]
[color=#c3a3ff]※ Yoon Ria Character can't craft and equip ‘Purification Ops Gear’.
※ Yoon Ria Character can't equip ‘Auto-Growth Core’ and ‘Auto-Growth Module’.
※ Yoon Ria Character can only use Boss Skin Pack for contents that are available for Yoon Ria character, after maintenance on Aug, 7th, 2024.[/color]


[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]2. Growth Guide System[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Growth Guide System has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] <Growth Guide> is a system that guides you through various content by clearing each stage's mission consisting of main content.
[*] When you click the Growth Guide button on the upper right, a dedicated UI will appear.
[*] When you click the 'Guide' button for each mission, a guide UI window related to the corresponding mission will open.
[*] When you click the 'Move Now' button for each mission, a UI window required for clearing the mission will open or you will move to the location of the related NPC.
[list]
[*] If the town you would move to is not open yet, the 'Move Now' button will be disabled.
[color=#c3a3ff]※ Some missions cannot be performed with the character Yoon Ria, and you will be able to move and clear it after the upcoming promotion update.[/color][/list][*] All mission clear rewards can be obtained once per account.
[*] Even if you have obtained the reward, you can click the 'Guide' button and 'Move Now' button for the mission.  
[*] The displayed TCP is the recommended TCP for performing mission, and you can check and clear the next stage's mission not clearing the previous mission.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]3. Washing Machine Accumulative Purchase Reset[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The function to reset accumulated purchases for Washing Machine has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] [Accum. Purchase Reset] button will be created after acquiring all the accumulative purchase rewards from the Washing Machine.
[*] When the [Accum. Purchase Reset] button is clicked, the ‘Accumulated purchase reward record’ for the corresponding washing machine will be reset, and rewards can be obtained from the beginning again depending on the accumulated purchase quantity.
[*] [Accum. Purchase Reset] button will disappear when the accumulated purchase reward record is reset by clicking [Accum. Purchase Reset] button.
[*] If clicking [Accum. Purchase Reset] button, [Current Accumulative Purchase] amount will be deducted by the maximum accumulated purchase reward requirement.[list][*] e.g.: When the maximum accumulated purchase reward requirement for washing machine is 800 and the [Reset accumulated purchases] button is clicked after purchasing it 850 times, the current accumulated purchase quantity will be changed to 50.[/list][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]4. Script Window Hide Function[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The function to hide the script window for enjoying quest illust has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] When you press [V] while the Quest script window is open, the script window will be hidden.
[*] After the Quest script window is hidden, pressing [V], [X], [Z], or [ESC] will reappear the hidden script window.[/list]

notes.title: [Developer Letter] Summer 2024 Update Plan
notes.content:
Hello, dear Agents!

I am the PD of Closers, Hyun-Jun Kang.

Greetings once again through this August Developer's Letter.

In this Developer's Letter, we aim to address any curiosities that our Agents may have by providing additional information about the upcoming summer updates.


[h3][color=#FFAC1C][b][August 7th][/b][/color][/h3]

[h3][b]<New Character Yoon Ria Launch>[/b][/h3]
The 21st new character, Yoon Ria, joins Closers after about a year and a half.

The new character, Ria, initially awakened her phase force early on, underwent some trials, gave up being a Phase user, debuted as an idol, and then returned as a Closer.

The story of how Ria returned to being a Closer from being an idol will unfold through the update on August 7.

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/285177ab838878874952086276bff3730efc072c.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Yoon Ria Novice Agent Illustration[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
We have put our best effort into capturing Ria's narrative and personality through details such as taking selfies and gestures where she holds a microphone to sing.

We have meticulously created each motion and effect from scratch to present an attractive character, and we look forward to seeing many players enjoy Closers with the new character.

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/5ed9fda072495e0729d7e0632090e4baaafc0048.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Yoon Ria Regular Agent Illustration[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
Especially since Ria is joining the Black Lamb team for the first time since Misteltein, we plan to introduce new chemistry with the existing Black Lamb members and showcase another charm of the Black Lamb team.

[h3][b]<Growth Guide>[/b][/h3]
A Growth Guide will be added to help the New/Returning Agents to get back into the game faster.

For Agents who are struggling to settle in due to the old systems and accumulated content, we have prepared a system in the growth guide. Upon first logging into the game, you can immediately check which dungeons you should go to at your current level, what actions to take next, and move directly to the relevant area with just a click.


[h3][color=#FFAC1C][b][August 21st][/b][/color][/h3]

[h3][b]<Yoon Ria Special, Prime Agent & Other Stories>[/b][/h3]
The update for Yoon Ria's Special Agent and Prime Agent will include the continuation of the story from the International Airport.

You can also look forward to a specially produced ending video for Yoon Ria. We hope you look forward to it!

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/08bde016c7c2272852b334d5af779c2c8b69cc0a.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Yoon Ria Special Agent Illustration[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
Regarding Yoon Ria's skills and promotion configuration, as you might expect, Ria does not have a Task Force promotion.

This means that her Special Agent promotion will include three normal skills and one Special Move, while her Prime Agent role will add two normal skills and one Special Move, similar to other characters.

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a5ee4ce33951e70a3d7dedff0b0cb18cea9049a5.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Yoon Ria Prime Agent Illustration[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
We aim to present Yoon Ria’s Special and Prime Agent updates with a high level of quality.

[h3][b]<Summer Dungeon: Dragon's Vanguard>[/b][/h3]
The highly anticipated 'Dragon's Vanguard' update, the prelude of Dragon King, is coming soon.

You will have the opportunity to face the 'Indomitable Gatekeeper,' Andras, and 'Violet Vanguard,' representing the younger years of Astaroth.

A new story and battles involving these characters await you.

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/401814be406eb1d8deead4568ab752cec5d59ca2.png[/img][/td][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/d89ac04ccd78703906a36d1d48eb4314dd03e674.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]Indomitable Gatekeeper[/b]
[/td][td]
[b]Violet Vanguard[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
In 'Dragon's Vanguard,' along with 'DRAGONISH Trans Discs,' announced in 'Closers Channel ON Ep.2', there has been a change to update two types of craftable modules. This update aims to enhance the gameplay of 'Dragon's Vanguard,' allowing players to access new gear more swiftly.

The 'DRAGONISH Trans Disc' will be updated from the existing Trans Discs : Supreme to include on-use effects.

These effects will be available for Trans Discs from levels 4 to 6, while previous levels will receive a set minor increase in stats. Please look forward to collecting these from levels 1 to 3 in 'Dragon's Vanguard' and levels 4 to 6 in the upcoming 'Reign of the Dragon King.'

[h3][b]<2024 Summer Swimwear>[/b][/h3]
The 2024 summer swimwear costumes that many Agents have been eagerly waiting for are almost here!

We are giving you a sneak peek at Seha in this costume and hope you’re as excited as we are.
 
[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/c82b8d4e46c8aff4d223a57ed2670040b2f41e15.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Seha 2024 Summer Swimwear Illustration (Normal)[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/824de39a02299c13645cc0169857845e4f26fa66.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Seha 2024 Summer Swimwear Illustration (Special)[/b][/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][color=#FFAC1C][b][September 11th][/b][/color][/h3]

[h3][b]<Summer Dungeon: Reign of the Dragon King>[/b][/h3]
Following the 'Dragon's Vanguard', the main story of 'Reign of the Dragon King' will be updated.

In this dungeon, you will encounter 'Astarte the Dragon Queen' and 'Hecatoncheir, the Dragon King', whom we introduced earlier. 

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/b1f61a3ba37a938c77435bac21d14a79b1a7dca4.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Astarte the Dragon Queen[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
The main objective of this quest is to uncover the connections between the new epic monster Astarte and the characters Astarte and Astaroth, as well as the events involving them.

Particularly, figuratively speaking, the previous form of 'Hecatoncheir' can be considered an undead state.

For those curious about his strength if he were alive, this update will let you experience his might and majesty from the era of the Dimensional War, revisiting his memories from the past in Western Europe.

We hope you look forward to how the story of the Dragon King will unfold.

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/049bfc6aee5ef34b79ebf2e85e286a4fabbd7814.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Cradle of Dragons Dungeon[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
In the <Cradle of Dragons>, where Astarte appears, the battle will involve preventing the Dragon Legion from intervening to protect Astarte. The battle dynamics can change based on your choices, promising a variety of fun strategic approaches.

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/b2ec30e64eab2892e11997e18e7feb346325ee80.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Cradle of Dragons Dungeon and Astarte[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
In <Paris under Dragon’s domination>, battles involve breaking the Dragon King Hecatoncheir's shields while removing debuffs. The combat is designed around the basic Closer's fight mechanics of dodging and attacking, with additional gimmick to keep the experience enjoyable and less burdensome.

In 'Reign of the Dragon King,' you will be able to farm Epic Core and Extra Core.

We previously mentioned that a craft recipe for untradable Extra Core will be introduced. This untradable Extra Core will be added to be craftable from Epic Core by ‘Upgrade’.

This will allow you to transfer settings from Epic Cores to the new untradable Extra Cores, improving the convenience of gear farming.

Tradable Extra Cores will still be obtainable through dungeon play as before.

[h3][b]<Bonus Reward System>[/b][/h3]
Starting with the Reign of the Dragon King dungeon, a new reward system called 'Bonus Rewards' will be implemented.

'Bonus Rewards' are additional rewards granted separately from regular drops and clear rewards. These are given immediately upon clearing the dungeon under specific conditions that qualify for ‘Bonus Rewards’. Once the limit for 'Bonus Rewards' is reached, no further rewards will be given until the reward count is reset.

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/49e9a7b214d900e9496e88542c36db84eba65539.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Extra Rewards System[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
The 'Bonus Rewards' system automatically collects rewards after clearing a dungeon without needing to press the 'Receive Reward' button, making gameplay more convenient. This system will initially apply to the 'Reign of the Dragon King' dungeon and is planned to be expanded to most dungeons that Agents frequently play in the future.

Additionally, this system will also be applied to existing dungeons, with more details to be announced later.

This is expected to alleviate issues where players could miss out on rewards due to unexpected errors or using up all of their Resurrection Capsules before clearing the dungeon.
 
[h3][b]<Enhancement Renewal>[/b][/h3]
Many Agents have been curious about the renewal of the enhancement system, and I'd like to provide further information on it.

Here is a brief recap of the previously explained details:
[olist][*]The enhancement buff system will be removed.[/*][*]Enhancement chances provided by enhancement buffs will be incorporated into the base chances.[/*][*]Guaranteed enhancement points will be acquired upon failure or no change in enhancement status.[/*][*]Once guaranteed enhancement points reach a certain threshold, the next enhancement attempt will succeed with a 100% chance.[/*][/olist]
Additionally, I would like to pre-announce the following updates.
[olist][*]Absolute Gear Booster can be used up to the expanded enhancement range, (up to right before the maximum enhancement level of +30)[/*][*]Failure chance will be removed up to the +17 enhancement level (up to the attempt from +16 to +17)[/*][/olist]
We are diligently preparing to introduce an enhancement system that makes more sense.
 

[h3][color=#FFAC1C][b][September 25th][/b][/color][/h3]

[h3][b]<3rd Memorial Quest>[/b][/h3]
As previously shared on the last Closers Channel ON, the story 'The Man's Stopped Time' featuring Tina and Trainer, is prepared as the third memorial quest.

We hope you look forward to discovering how this previously unknown chapter of their past unfolds.

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/60e81ce0d3a3351928ea9cb8a78ee88583972b53.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]Trainer and Tina's Talkface (Modified)[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
We are also preparing special costumes related to the story of the memorial quest, so we hope you will enjoy it.
 
[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/ba59b63be89d11a2d2f599165682ebda2faf3840.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Memorial Entry[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
Additionally, a new entry exclusive to the Memorial Quest will be introduced with the update of the third Memorial Quest.

[h3][b]<Balance Patch>[/b][/h3]
We are also preparing a balance patch for approximately four characters.
[color=#c3a3ff]([i]Note: The number of characters affected may vary depending on the development progress[/i])[/color]

This balance patch will focus on adding 'utility' as the key point and aim to enhance the damage output for some characters.

We strive to ensure that the adjusted characters will show significant improvements in both convenience and damage.

[h3][b]<Yoon Ria Skill Polish>[/b][/h3]
The final update for Ria character, 'Skill Polish,' will be added.

While we cannot reveal which skills will be subjected to the Polish target just yet, we are committed to developing changes that will give you more enjoyable skill combinations to experience.


[h3][color=#FFAC1C][b][October 8th][/b][/color][/h3]

[h3][b]<Teacher Young-Yi's Divine Battle>[/b][/h3]
Finally, Teacher Young-Yi returns with the Divine Battle!

Previously, the Divine Battles were hosted by the Dogra and Magra sisters, but this time, Teacher Young-Yi will take over their roles.

We'd like to give you a heads-up that we might also rename the Divine Battle to align with this update.
 
[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/50c624a6133a18f2cc7e5f9240d425caad97031d.png[/img][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Teacher Young-Yi's Talkface[/b]
[/td][/tr][/table]
The concept for this Divine Battle event dungeons is 'endless waves of monsters and non-stop barrage of skills.'

We plan to present this fun combat against numerous dimensional monsters in a new style, ensuring the gameplay is optimized to avoid any frame drops. We look forward to your participation and hope you enjoy the new challenges.

[list][*]Some of the content above is under development and is subject to change upon update.[/*][/list]
[h3][b][The End][/b][/h3]
We've mainly shared major content updates today, but we are also working on various other improvements as well.

We will provide more information on the details that have not yet been finalized in future updates.

That concludes the information we've prepared for today.

We are committed to meeting your expectations and ensuring Closers remains a game you’re excited to engage with.

Thank you.
Sincerely, Hyun-Jun Kang

notes.title: July 24th Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f10dd0533fb0c9b4f9f30523c0b8a37268e9935f.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]1. New Character Yoon Ria Pre-creation[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Character Yoon Ria's Pre-creation has been available. [/b][/color]
[list][*] You can enter and create the character name of the new character Yoon Ria. 
[*] The voice related to the pre-creation of the new character Yoon Ria has been added. 
[*] 1 character slot provided by default has been added. (21 slots → 22 slots)
[*] The maximum number of characters has been extended to 29
[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]2. Character Creation Window Renewal[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The character creation window has been renewed.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Character Selectable UI has been moved to the left upper side. 
[*] Class, main stat, story, and character skill preview UI have been changed. 
[*] Character story will be played when mouse-over on the story UI. 
[*] The magnified character skill video will be played by clicking the character skill preview UI. 
[*] When clicking the character promotion stage (Novice Agent/Regular Agent/Special Agent/Task Force/Prime Agent) button, it changes the character selection screen to the Illustration of the promotion selected.
[*] When selecting the character on the character creation screen, the background music of the corresponding character is applied. 
[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]3. Noah's Museum Town[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Noah's Museum Town has been refurbished as a cool Noah's Museum for the summer.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Summer event decorations such as tubes, parasols, and palm trees have been added to Noah's museum town.

notes.content:
Hello Agents,

We would like to give you advance notice regarding PNA EXP acquisition mitigation and some daily craft cycle changes scheduled for Jul 24th, 2024 maintenance.

notes.title: July 10th Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f10dd0533fb0c9b4f9f30523c0b8a37268e9935f.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]1. Skill Remake Additional Improvement[/b][/color][/h3]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Additional adjustments of skill remake for Yuri and J have been applied.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Yuri's skill improvement

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/6b3d454932ed82dcc42fa08f1ccd6e6134f90804.png[/img]
[*]J's skill improvement

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/41d74f2a0e5ccd2bb0dc1bb2f695c57cc4be1804.png[/img][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]2. Character Balance Adjustment[/b][/color][/h3]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Skill balance of some characters have been adjusted.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Character: Levia, Tina, Mirae[*]Skill Balance Adjustment Details

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/60eb0c6f2cfd77a9ed1b8ba2c6f365330e0858b8.png[/img][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]3. Skill Point (SP) change[/b][/color][/h3]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Skill Point (PVE/PVP) that is acquired when achieving Character Level 95 has been changed.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Detail : When achieving Level 95, give SP 10 → give SP 50.[*]SP 40 has been sent to all characters who achieved Level 95 before the maintenance on Jul 10th, 2024.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]4. New Dungeon ‘The World Tower of Sealing’[/b][/color][/h3]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Dungeon ‘Tiamat Of The Beginning - The World Tower of Sealing’ has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] ‘The World Tower of Sealing’ Dungeon is available by <Shop-Pheasant> NPC at ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site’ area, with a character level 95 or above who completed [Whispers of Fantasy] quest and accepting [The Whisper of a Girl] quest.[list][*] <Historic Site Entrance> from ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site’ Area
[*] <Combined Dungeon Entry - Gaston> from ‘Noah's Museum’, ‘Fantasy World : Dream Theater <<Reverse>>’, ‘The end: The world in flames’ Area[/list][*] Tiamat Of The Beginning - ‘The World Tower of Sealing’ dungeon and Practice Dungeon ‘The World Tower of Sealing [Guide]’ dungeon have been added to ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site’ Area. 
[*] ‘The World Tower of Sealing’ Dungeon Information

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/3d8d694c17e396bb4dfa021d2a8dd1b10245477f.png[/img][/list]
[*] ‘The World Tower of Sealing [Guide]’ Dungeon is a training dungeon for practice of monster pattern and the method of destroying, and monster defeat drop and clear rank rewards are not available. 
[*]  Under the condition of less than Gear Level also can use ‘Find a Squad’ at ‘The World Tower of Sealing [Guide]’ dungeon.
[*] Tiamat Of The Beginning Dungeon related achievement has been added. 
[*] Tiamat Of The Beginning Title has been added.
[*] Channel Bonus applies when playing ‘Tiamat Of The Beginning - The World Tower of Sealing’ dungeon at ‘EX ZONE’ Channel.[/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ ‘The World Tower of Sealing’ Dungeon Reward has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] You can acquire rewards by clearing ‘The World Tower of Sealing’ dungeon depending on each probability.  
[*] Main Clear Reward: Golden Rose of the Beginning, Origin Chip ×1 Box, Malek Diamon.
[*] You can craft Tiamat Of The Beginning Chip, Tiamat Of The Beginning Title, Illust Armband, and more by ‘Golden Rose of the Beginning’ item.
[*] Main Drop Reward: Tiamat Of The Beginning Illust Armband, Tiamat Of The Beginning Chip Selectable Box (Tradable), Origin Chip ×1 Box and more.[/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Dungeon ‘Tiamat Of The Beginning - The World Tower of Sealing’ Dungeon Reward has been added.[/b][/color]


[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]5. New Item ‘Tiamat Of The Beginning Chip’[/b][/color][/h3]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ ‘Tiamat Of The Beginning Chip’ 7kinds have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] New Chip ‘Tiamat Of The Beginning Chip’ 7kinds can be equipped only with Trinket and includes the option of 'Damage increase to DRAGONISH' in common. 
[*] ‘Tiamat of The Beginning Chip’ can be crafted at craft tab from chip inventory window.
[*] Main Craft Material: T3 Colored Chip, Golden Rose of the Beginning, Chromatic Phase Essence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/21dc002de169f9ead692f9ac702e2856edcf1514.png[/img][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]6. ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site’ Area Dungeon Play Improvement[/b][/color][/h3]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The monster appear condition of ‘Dragon's Execution Ground’ dungeon has been changed.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Target Dungeon: Dragon's Execution Ground, Dragon's Execution Ground [V.HARD], [Extreme] Dragon's Execution Ground[*]Change Detail:[list](Before) The next monster appears 30 seconds after the monster appears.
(After) Once the monster that appears is defeated, the next monster appears.[/list][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Monster's stamina from Mirage Repeated and Mirage Repeated [V.HARD] Dungeon have been lowering-adjusted.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The resurrection count of Mirage Repeated [V.HARD] dungeon has been changed.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Change: Can resurrect 4times → No restriction on resurrection[/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ ‘Proceed to Next Ops’ button has been applied to some dungeons.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Target Dungeon: Mirage Repeated [V.HARD] ↔ The World Tower of Sealing[/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Ancient Dragon Historic Site Dungeon Entry placement has been changed.[/b][/color]
[list][*] From ‘Fantasy World : Dream Theater <<Reverse>>’, ‘The end: The world in flames’, and ‘Noah's Museum’ Town's NPC <Combined Dungeon Entry - Gaston>,   ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site1’ tab has been removed and ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site2’ tab has been changed to ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site’.
[*] NPC <Combined Dungeon Entry - Gaston>'s some ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site’ tab dungeon items and placement order have been changed. 
[*] Added Dungeon: The World Tower of Sealing, The World Tower of Sealing [Guide]
[*] Removed Dungeon: [Nightmare] Ancient Dragon's Nightmare : Heart, [Nightmare] Ancient Dragon's Prison Castle
[*] The dungeon list order of Dungeon Entry NPC <Historic Site Entrance> at  ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site Area' has been changed.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]7. ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site’ Area Dungeon and Reward acquire Renew [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/215830/view/4181110370592246138][Go to Pre-Notice][/url][/b][/color][/h3]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Monster drop/clear rank reward from Ancient Dragon Historic Site Area lower-level dungeons have been migrated to ‘Mirage Repeated’ and ‘Mirage   Repeated [V.HARD]’ Dungeon.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Among the monster drop rewards, visual items that can be obtained in the existing lower-level dungeon will be maintained.
[*]Reward removal and migration dungeon details

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/bb4ebf3f2dae2950bc22f3ecbb06423543bc6739.png[/img][/list]
[*]Some of the reduced credit rewards from lower-level dungeons have been migrated to ‘Mirage Repeated’, ‘Mirage Repeated [V.HARD]’, and ‘The World Tower of Sealing’ dungeons.[/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The number of entries to the ‘Dragon’s Execution Ground’ dungeon has been consolidated and changed to once per week per character.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Target Dungeon: Dragon's Execution Ground, Dragon's Execution Ground [V.HARD], [Extreme] Dragon's Execution Ground.
[*]When using [Sector Pass - Dragon's Execution Ground] item, the number of ‘[Extreme] Dragon's Execution Ground’ entries and ‘Dragon's Execution Ground [V.HARD]’ will also increase.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]8. Chip System Convenience Renew[/b][/color][/h3]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Some chip craft methods has been changed : from Craft at NPC <Craft machine> to Craft at ‘Chip Inventory’ window. [/b][/color]
[list][*]Chip Box Item's all craft recipes have been removed.[list][*]Target Item: T1 Platinum Chip Random Box, T2 Colored Chip Random Box, T2 Colored Chip Selectable Box, T2 Platinum Chip Random Box, T2 Platinum Chip Selectable Box[/list][*]Chip craft receipt at [Chip Craft] tab from ‘Chip Inventory’ window has been added.[list][*]Target Item: T2 Colored Chip, T1 Platinum Chip, T2 Platinum Chip, Overclock Chip[/list][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ ‘Chip Inventory’ UI has been improved.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Each tab name from the top of Chip inventory UI has been changed to be intuitive.[*]Multiple chip recipes are displayed at once without left/right arrows moving.[*]Up to 3 chip craft recipes are displayed, and if there are more than 4, you can check them using the scroll bar on the right side of the list.[*]The credits, material items, and crafting restriction count required to craft chips are displayed together for one crafting recipe.[/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ With the reorganization of the chip system convenience, some chip-related images and descriptions in the in-game guide have been changed.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Changed so that credits are not consumed when Chip Overclock.[/b][/color]


[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]9. ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site’ Area Dungeon related other changes[/b][/color][/h3]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Ancient Dragon Historic Site Area Dungeon-related UNION Watch Mission has been changed partially.[/b][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7de7391009c118a10dd42b18c2d941d0b46ad5e.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Ancient Dragon Historic Site area dungeon related crew mission has been changed.[/b][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7de7391009c118a10dd42b18c2d941d0b46ad5e.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The number of craftable count for some items at NPC <Craft Machine> [Ancient Dragon Historic Site] tab has been reset, as Ancient Dragon Historic Site Dungeon and Chip Renew task proceeds.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Item reset list of the craftable count at the existing [Ancient Dragon Historic Site] tab
[*] Target Item

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7de7391009c118a10dd42b18c2d941d0b46ad5e.png[/img][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]10. Inventory Material & Mission tab Consolidation [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/215830/view/4181110370592246138][Go to Pre-notice][/url][/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ [Mission] tab has been removed from inventory and consolidated to [Material] tab.[/b][/color]
[list]
[*]As the removal of [Mission] tab, ‘UNION Slot Expansion : Mission Ver_1.0~6.0’ Items have been changed to unusable.
[*]The attribute of the existing ‘Quest Item’ has been changed to ‘Material Item’.
[*]Some 'Quest Item' that has nowhere to use has been removed through the maintenance on Jul 10th, 2024.
[*]In case of having 'Quest Item' subject to deletion packed by Gremory's Common/Greater/Special Dimensional Box before the maintenance on Jul 10th, 2024, it will not be deleted during the maintenance on Jul 10th, 2024.

※ You can obtain the corresponding item as 'Material Item' by opening the box after the maintenance on Jul 10th, 2024, and need to remove it directly if you want the removal.[/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ [Character's Temporary Storage] has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]You can check [Character's Temporary Storage] by NPC Storage.
[*]Among the ‘Quest Items’ stored in the [Mission] tab prior to maintenance on Jul 10th, 2024, those with usage source have been moved to [Character’s Temporary Storage].
[*][Character's Temporary Storage] will be maintained until the December maintenance, and will be deleted along with the stored items after the maintenance. (Detailed schedule will be announced later)
[*][Temporary Account Bank] has been added temporarily along with [Character's Temporary Storage].

※ Please note that [Temporary Account Bank] is a feature added for future use, and is currently unavailable as it is disabled.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]11. Inventory Slot Expansion[/b][/color][/h3]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Inventory Slot has been expanded.[/b][/color]
[list][*]The maximum slots in the inventory’s [Gear], [Consumables], [Materials], and [Costume] tabs have been expanded by 20 slots each.
[*](Before) 7x10 → (After) 9x10
[*]Inventory slot expansion is proportional to the opened slots.

※ Accordingly, there is no change in the maximum number of times that inventory slots can be expanded, and you can still use inventory slot expansion items that you own.[/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The currency consumed when expanding inventory slots have changed.[/b][/color]
[list][*]For all inventory tabs and slot expansion stages, the currency consumed during slot expansion has been changed to Credit.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]12. Item Sort Lock function[/b][/color][/h3]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Item Sort Lock function has been added to inventory and storage.[/b][/color]
[list][*]When clicking Item Sort Lock button, the mouse cursor changes to -ing status.
[*]When you left-click an item with a mouse that is in the sort lock state, the item will be in the sort lock state.
[*]Items that are sort lock will have a white border displayed in the item slot.
[*]Items in the sort lock state are not sorted and remain in position when ‘item sorting’ is performed.  
[*]If all items in sort lock state are used and the location becomes an empty slot, the lock state will also disappear. 
[*]If an item in the sort lock state is moved by dragging it with the mouse or stacked with an item of the same type, the sort lock state will be maintained. 
[*]The in-game guide has been updated with the addition of the inventory sort lock function.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]13. Storage Item usage and Item Amount display[/b][/color][/h3]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ When using some contents in ingame, it has been changed that items at Storage and Account Storage are also can be used.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Contents that consume storage items: Crafting, tuning, upgrading, upgrade tree, NPC shop, costume upgrade/conversion/tuning/dyeing, costume fusion, chip slot change, chip craft, enhancement transfer, pet evolution, pet feeding, PNA Upgrades, mutant manifestations, cross material conversion, operation result report, events (capsule draw, Closer Marble, lucky card)
