[list][*]‘Infinite Gluttony Beelzebub’ Monster's some attack damage and HP have been adjusted downward.
[*]‘Flying King Beelzebub's Heart’ Monster HP has been adjusted downward.
[*]‘Dermatobia’ Monster's HP has been adjusted downward and teleportation radius has been reduced.
[*]Basic Clear limit time has been changed from ‘10mins’ to ‘5mins’.[/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Phase Disintegration Debuff that occurs when entering dungeon with lack of gear level has been removed.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ It has been changed that the player character will not be down in case of being hit by  ‘Mirror Grabber Nitocris’s 1phase attack at <Gate Wave : Subjugation> dungeon.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ From ‘Nampo-dong’ Area to ‘World Peace Plaza’ Area, quest dungeon and normal area dungeon difficulty have been adjusted downward.[/b][/color]


[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]18. Pet Convenience Improvement[/b][/color][/h3]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Reaction Type has been added to Pet System.[/b][/color]
[list][*]New Reaction Type ‘No Type’ has been added.
[*]Reaction Type Exclusive Pet can be registered at ‘Pet Information(B)’ > 'Pet Container’.
[*]When registering 'No Type' exclusive pet in Reaction Type Exclusive Pet List, you can do the quick change to 'No Type' exclusive pet in dungeon w'-
[*]Pet exploring the UNION Camp Your Room can't be registered as pet of Reaction Type Exclusive Pet.

[color=#89CFF0]※ Please note that the list of 'Reaction Type Exclusive Pet' registered before the maintenance on Jul 10, 2024 will be reset due to pet convenience improvement work.[/color][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Automatic pet quick change function has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]You can use the automatic pet quick change function by [AUTO] button at Pet Quick Change System from Dungeon Entrance UI window.
[*][AUTO] button activated : When entering dungeon, automatically change the Reaction Type Exclusive Pet that suits for Boss Armor Type
[*][AUTO] button inactivated: When entering dungeon, use the currently equipped pet
[*]When entering the boss armor type dungeon of not registered to reaction type exclusive pet, the currently equipped pet will be used.[/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ In accordance with pet convenience improvement work, some images and content have been changed in the in-game ‘Guide - Pet Item’.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The total level required to activate the teamwork buff has been lowered.[/b][/color]

notes.title: Pre-notice: Enhancement System Improvement Plan
notes.content:
Hello Agents, I'm PD Hyun-jun Kang.

In addition to the content revealed in <CLOSERS CHANNEL ON. EP2>, there are additional matters I would like to introduce to all Agents, hence this message.

For a long time, we have been receiving feedback regarding Enhancement, and our development team has been carefully listening and constantly considering how to improve the Enhancement System to be more convenient.

Based on valuable feedback from Agents, we have identified several key factors that make the Enhancement System difficult:
[olist][*][b]The higher the Enhancement level, the greater the burden of attempting Enhancement, yet the feedback upon successful Enhancement is not sufficiently high.[/b][/*][*][b]There is significant variation in Enhancement efficiency among different equipment types, Trinkets in particular have a smaller advantage in Enhancement.[/b][/*][*][b]Enhancement buff has become a necessity for Enhancement attempts, therefore putting a significant burden on the attempts themselves.[/b][/*][/olist]
To address these concerns, we will be improving the Enhancement System on September 11, 2024. The Enhancement System is one of the most significant systems in character development, and we will approach its growth with caution.

Through these improvements, the following changes will be implemented:
[olist][*][b]Removal of the Enhancement Buff system and increased base success rates[/b][/*][*][b]Introduction of a new Enhancement Guarantee system[/b][/*][*][b]Increase in Trinket Enhancement efficiency[/b][/*][*][b]Addition of Enhancement Unleash Option[/b][/*][*][b]Maximum Enhancement stage extension and the probability adjustment for lower ranges[/b][/*][/olist]
I will provide detailed explanations for each of these topics.

[color=#5f95cc][b]1. Removal of the Enhancement Buff system and increased base success rates[/b][/color]
The current Enhancement Buff system provides probability boosts based on conditions, but since it involves paid items, it also adds to the burden of Enhancement attempts. Furthermore, its limitation is the inability to guarantee 100% Enhancement success.

Therefore, starting with the Enhancement System improvement update on September 11, 2024, the 1.2x probability boost provided by the existing Enhancement Buff will be reflected in the base Enhancement probability. The Enhancement Buff system will be removed, and a new Enhancement Guarantee system will be introduced.

As a preemptive measure, starting from the update on July 24, 2024, we plan to block enhancement buffs from being activated newly and remove existing acquisition paths altogether.

Additionally, any remaining Enhancement Buff Vouchers in possession can be exchanged for items of regular Gear Booster Fuel and Lucky Booster Fuel which are more valuable than its price.

[b][End of Enhancement Buff Voucher Sales, Unavailability, and Replacement Notice][/b]
[list][*][b]Schedule: [/b]During maintenance on July 24, 2024[list][*]End of Sales: Please refer to the [url=https://www.closersonline.com/news/pre-notice-enhancement-system-adjustment-GjO4RP1035]Pre-notice: Enhancement System Adjustment[/url][/*][/list][/*][*][b]End of Use (Unavailability)[/b][list][*]After the July 24, 2024 maintenance, you can’t activate Enhancement Buffs newly by using Enhancement Buff Vouchers.[/*][*]Enhancement Buffs already activated will remain until the remaining days.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Replacement:[/b][list][*]Enhancement Buff Voucher in possession before the maintenance on Jul 24th, 2024 will be changed to [Enhancement Fuel Selectable Box][*]The Enhancement Fuel Selectable Box contains the following items: x500 Gear Booster Fuel, x42 Lucky Gear Booster Fuel, and x17 Gear Booster Fortifier. You can choose one of these items.
※ Gear Booster Fuel and Gear Booster Fortifier will be distributed as tradeable items.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[color=#5f95cc][b]2. Introduction of a new Enhancement Guarantee system.[/b][/color]
Starting with the update on September 11, 2024, we will introduce a new Enhancement Guarantee system, which ensures a 100% success rate under certain conditions. This will become a fundamental feature of the Enhancement System, without the need to purchase additional items.

[b][New Enhancement Guarantee System][/b]
[list][*]If the Enhancement result is "No Change," the Fixed Enhancement Points will increase.[/*][*]If the Enhancement result is "Enhancement Success," the Fixed Enhancement Points will be reset. This also applies when transferring Enhancements or using Gear Booster.[/*][*]If the Enhancement result is "Enhancement Failure," the Fixed Enhancement Points that are currently owned will be maintained. If Fixed Enhancement Points exceed the maximum value of the previous Enhancement stage, the excess Fixed Enhancement Points will be removed.
(Example) If 100 Fixed Enhancement Points are accumulated in Enhancement Stage A, even if the stage drops to A-1 due to Enhancement failure, the Fixed Enhancement Points for that gear will still be 100. However, the maximum Fixed Enhancement Points for stage A-1 is 90, so only 90 Fixed Enhancement Points will be retained. Subsequent Enhancement attempts can guarantee 100% success.[/*][*]Fixed Enhancement Points will accumulate separately for each equipment item.[/*][*]Enhancement attempts with Fixed Enhancement Points at maximum value will guarantee 100% success.[/*][*]The maximum Fixed Enhancement Points required for fixed Enhancement of equipment will vary depending on the Enhancement stage.[/*][*]"Great Success" will not occur when attempting fixed Enhancement.[/*][/list]Through this approach, we aim to provide clearer feedback for Enhancement attempts.


[color=#5f95cc][b]3. Increase in Trinket Enhancement efficiency.[/b][/color]
As Trinkets have lower Enhancement benefits compared to other types of equipment, we will increase the Enhancement benefits of this type of gear, which has had lower Enhancement motivation issues due to their lower benefits.
[list][*]Increase in Physical/Psi attack increase for each Enhancement stage.[/*][*]Increase in Physical/Psi critical damage for each Enhancement stage.[/*][*]	The Trinket enhancement stat increase is applied to all gears, including the current gear.[/*][/list]By increasing the benefits of Trinket Enhancement, we aim to improve the lower motivation for Trinket Enhancement.


[color=#5f95cc][b]4. Addition of Enhancement Unleash Option.[/b][/color]
In areas where feedback has been felt to be lacking even if the enhancement stage has been increased, we plan to provide a clearer advantage of enhancement increase through the ‘Enhancement Unleash Option’.
[list][*]Unleash Option is a gear-unique option that is activated at a certain enhancement stage or higher.[/*][*]Unleash Option is activated in a fixed option, not in random.[/*][*]Each gear item will have different unleash options.[/*][*]Unleash Option will be introduced starting with <Core> gear that will be added after the September 11, 2024 update.[/*][*]No attributes (stats) will be deleted or lost due to the addition of the unleash option[/*][/list]Through these additions, we hope Agents will feel the feedback on the Enhancement stage increase. We will continue to update and actively contribute to character growth.


[color=#5f95cc][b]5. Maximum Enhancement Stage extension[/b][/color]
In addition to the improvements mentioned above, the Enhancement stage will also be extended to +30, providing long-term growth goals to become stronger characters.
[list][*]The maximum enhancement stages will be extended to +30.[/*][*]The success probability for Enhancements below +25 will be increased.[/*][list][*]In addition to the increased base probability due to the removal of the Enhancement Buff, probabilities for certain ranges will be further increased.[/*][*]The new Enhancement Guarantee system will also be applied to stages 26-30.[/*][*]The existing Enhancement Transfers can also be used in new Enhancement stages.[/*]
[/list][/list]Through these improvements, we will make every effort to prepare and provide reasonable and continuous gameplay goals for everyone.

This concludes the content of this Improvement Plan.

We kindly ask for your support as our development team diligently prepares for the Second Half of the Year Update.

Thank you very much.

notes.title: Scheduled Server Maintenance - June 19th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/80cd3c27fe6029acb9b2be2bd060a6e979ac8456.png[/img]

Greetings Agents,

We will perform maintenance on the Closers World server according to the following schedule, based on your time zone:[list]
[*][b]UTC:[/b] June 19, 2024 from 5:00 AM to 10:00 AM
[*][b]PDT:[/b] from June 18, 2024, 10:00 PM to June 19, 2024, 3:00 AM
[*][b]GMT+7:[/b] June 19, 2024 from 12:00 PM to 5:00 PM[/list]
Please log out of the game before maintenance begins. During this period, you will not be able to access the game, and the website may not function properly.

To stay up to date with news and other information, please visit our website or follow us on social media.

[list][*][b][url=https://www.facebook.com/ClosersGame]Official Closers Facebook Fanpage[/url][/b][/*][*][b][url=https://twitter.com/ClosersGame]Official Closers Twitter Page[/url][/b][/*][*][b][url=http://discord.gg/UkDuWZzByb]Official Closers Discord Server[/url][/b][/*][*][b][url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCSKUaz4gOXhj8160Xjbeb-g/featured]Official Closers YouTube Channel[/url][/b][/*][/list]
We appreciate your patience and understanding!

If you have any concerns or bug reports, you may send us an inquiry or an email to: [url=support@closersonline.com]support@closersonline.com[/url]

notes.title: Lovely Days with My Pet - Win 1,000 Ncoins!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/b0c9dd0dff4fb593051131dc288753b18d457f8c.png[/img]

[h3][color=#89CFF0][b]Event Period[/b][/color][/h3]
June 7 – June 23, 2024 9:00 AM UTC

[h3][color=#89CFF0][b]Winner Announcement[/b][/color][/h3]
June 26, 2024

[h3][color=#FFAC1C][b]Event Mechanics[/b][/color][/h3]

[h3][b]▶ How to Participate?[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Take a screenshot of you with your favorite pet!
[*] In a few sentences, show your appreciation and why they are special to you. The more thoughtful it is, the better your chances to get picked!

[quote][i][b]Sample[/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/5c103953acf8db73d2e8c36d2f5dba47853d9de5.png[/img]
I chose Mini Jina because she has been my companion for countless dungeon runs! She makes me feel like I'm undefeatable, even if the weather's bad, I always have a good day with her!
[/quote][/list]
[h3][b]▶ Reminders[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] All participants should input their Closers Name and Character Name when submitting their entry, or the whole entry will be invalid.
[*] Screenshots must not be edited outside of the game (no Photoshop or other editing software to enhance the screenshot).
[*]Character names don't need to be visible, and there are no specific dimensions required. Get as creative as you want!
[*]One entry per participant, using one Closers account for each category. 
[*]Make event mechanics and rules are followed (see Event Rules below).[/list]
[h3][b]▶ How to submit my entry?[/b][/h3]
[olist][*]Log-in to your Closers account to our official website: [url=https://www.closersonline.com/signin][b]https://www.closersonline.com/signin[/b][/url]
[*]After you're logged-in, click [b][Forum][/b] > [b][Art & Media][/b] > [b][Event][/b] Tab
[*]Upload the screenshot of your choice and post it to the [b][Event][/b] Category
[list][*] Participants are allowed to edit or change their screenshot entries as much as they wish during the event period[/list]
[*]Include [b][Lovely Days with My Pet][/b] on the Forum post title
[*]Remember to add your Closers Name and Character Name in your entry.[/olist]
[h3][color=#FFAC1C][b]Criteria for Judging[/b][/color][/h3]

[h3][b]▶ Pet Appreciation Description (40%)[/b][/h3]
[list][*] How well the description conveys your appreciation towards your pet.
[*] The clarity, coherence, and overall quality of the writing.[/list]
[h3][b]▶ Visual Appeal (40%)[/b][/h3]
[list][*] The overall aesthetic presentation and effort put into showcasing the pet.
[*] Clarity, quality, and resolution of the screenshot.
[*] Skillful use of in-game graphics and settings to enhance visual appeal.[/list]
[h3][b]▶ Audience Impact (20%)[/b][/h3]
[list][*] The number of '❤️' votes the entry receives in the forum.[/list]
[h3][color=#FFAC1C][b]Rewards[/b][/color][/h3]
[list][b][*]1,000 N-Coins for a total of 5 winners.[/*][/b][/list][olist][*]Winners will be announced on [b]June 26, 2024[/b] (Wednesday) through the website, SNS, and their screenshot entries will be featured on the Closers forums.[/*][/olist]
[h3][color=#FFAC1C][b]Event Rules[/b][/color][/h3]
[olist][*]Only one entry is allowed per Closers account.[/*][*]All entries must be made by the submitter specifically for the purpose of this contest.[/*][*]All participants should include their Closers Name and Character Name when submitting their entry; otherwise, the whole entry will be invalid.[/*][*]No explicit contents are allowed to be seen in the entry. Any entry that can make others feel offended or uncomfortable will be removed with or without permission from the Naddic staff.[/*][*]Once an entry has been submitted, players agree to have their work published publicly on our official channels (Website, Steam, and SNS).[/*][*]If you have submitted more than one entry, we will only refer to the first entry submitted.[/*][*]If you need to change or edit your entry or post, remove your first entry, then re-submit it again before the event ends.[/*][*]The Naddic team can remove unrelated entries or discussions.[/*][*]Entries suspected of using third-party applications such as Photoshop or AI to manipulate the screenshot image will be ruled out. Cropping the image is acceptable.[/*][*]The Naddic team is not liable for any violation of copyright or intellectual property. Any violations will be assumed by the event participant.[/*][*]Contact [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna][i]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna[/i][/url] or [i]support@closersonline.com[/i] for inquiries, concerns, or reports.[/*][/olist]

notes.title: June 5th Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f10dd0533fb0c9b4f9f30523c0b8a37268e9935f.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]1. Conquest Program Ver.2[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ <Conquest Program Ver.2> has been added. [/b][/color]
[list][*]<Conquest Program Ver.2> can be proceeded with a character starting from level 95 who has completed the [And Holy Lance] Quest.[/*][list][*] [And Holy Lance] Quest is available for characters with level 92 and above.[/list][*]<Conquest Program Ver.2> can be entered by <VR Combat Training Interlocking Device> NPC at ‘Noah's Museum’ town. [/*][*]<Conquest Program Ver.2> requires consuming ‘Program bio-verification key ver.2’ when entering the operation area, and ‘Program bio-verification key ver.2’ is obtainable as [Operation : Flame Wave] 4 players mission dungeon clear reward.[/*][list][*] Target Dungeon: ‘One-eyed Chaser: Kang Lim’, ‘Mirror Paradise: Bihyung’, ‘One-eyed Executioner: Kang Lim’, ‘Mirror Hell: Bihyung’.[/list][*]‘Program bio-verification key ver.2’ is consumed from the second stage (stage 2) of Conquest Program Ver.2.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ <Conquest Program Ver.2> operation area has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Conquest Program Ver.2 is a 1 player dungeon consisting of a total of 15 stages.[/*][*]Conquest Program Ver.2 can be cleared by defeating the boss monster within the time limit.[/*][*]In Conquest Program Ver.2, you can play dungeons that are opened in order by clearing each stage from stages 1 to 15.[/*][/list]
[b]Conquest Program Ver.2 information per stage[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/fa579c527cc23beabfe63d962339b5d77c71fff8.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ <Conquest Program Ver.2> rewards have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]You can obtain clear rewards when you first clear each stage in the Conquest Program Ver.2 dungeon.[/*][*]The reward acquisition information of Conquest Program Ver.2 is saved per character.[/*][*]Main Rewards: Conquest Program Elite Pet Selectable Box ver.3, High Ranking Conquest Challenger Token, Name Tag Ticket: The medal of the honorable conqueror Ver.2, Retro Phase Wing from the city of Dusk, Shadow Footprint, Emote Ticket: Joyful Noah/Sad Noah/Flustered Noah.[/*][/list]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ <Conquest Program Ver.2> shop has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*][Conquest Token] tab has been added to <Shop - Pheasant> NPC > Normal Shop.[/*][*]You can exchange reward items with a ‘High Ranking Conquest Challenger Token’ acquired through Clear Reward above a certain level.[/*][*]Main items: Conquest Awakening Strain Selectable Box (30. LV), T4 Platinum Chip Selectable Box, Conquest Unique Accessory Selectable Box, etc.[/*][/list]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The clear rank and my best clear time for <Conquest Program Ver.2> have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Conquest Program's dungeon clear ranking and my best clear time are recorded for each stage.[/*][*]In the Clear Ranking UI, the records of the three players with the fastest clear times among all players are displayed.[/*][*]You can check your best clear time in the My Best Clear Time UI.[/*][*]The clear rank of the Conquest Program is all reset at 4 a.m. on the 1st of every month.[/*][*]Conquest Program clear information per stage is saved on a per-character basis.[/*][/list]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The guide for <Conquest Program Ver.2> has been added.[/b][/color]


[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]2. TCP Improvement[/b][/color][/h3]

[list]※ Improvements have been made to the phenomenon where there is a large difference in TCP depending on the battle type when wearing equipment of a similar level, and the phenomenon where there is a large difference in monster attack damage depending on the battle type at a similar TCP level.[/list]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Hybrid Characters' skill coefficients have been adjusted.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ 'Lucky Cards’ game has been added. (~Until MA on Jul 10th, 2024)[/b][/color]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/80cd3c27fe6029acb9b2be2bd060a6e979ac8456.png[/img]

Greetings Agents,

We will perform maintenance on the Closers World server according to the following schedule, based on your time zone:[list]
[*][b]UTC:[/b] June 5, 2024 from 5:00 AM to 10:00 AM
[*][b]PDT:[/b] from June 4, 2024, 10:00 PM to June 5, 2024, 3:00 AM
[*][b]GMT+7:[/b] June 5, 2024 from 12:00 PM to 5:00 PM[/list]
Please log out of the game before maintenance begins. During this period, you will not be able to access the game, and the website may not function properly.

[b]Reminders[/b]
[list][*] We would like to inform you in advance of the changes to the UNION Camp Reward and UMP Shop products, which will be applied during the maintenance on June 5th, 2024.
[list][*] For more details, please visit this link: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/215830/announcements/detail/4148456737425886611][b]Pre-Notice for Renewal of UNION Camp Reward & UMP Shop Products (closersonline.com)[/b][/url][/list][/list]

notes.content:
[h1][b]New Seoul Fireworks Festival ♬ [/b][/h1]
[i]Only good things await you at this Festival![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a98b201c97571a469bdc7a4d106c763dac8d94ef.png[/img]

[color=#FFAE42][b]1. Event Overview[/b][/color]

[table][tr][td]
[b]What are [Fireworks]?[/b]
[/td][td][list][*][Fireworks] are event items that are only activated during the Fireworks Festival event period.[/*][*]Using [Fireworks] can let you earn [Festival Points] based on the Fireworks grade, which is accumulated by a character and server.[/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]What are [Festival Points]?[/b]
[/td][td][list][Festival Points] are the accumulated points of players from a server. Once a certain amount of Festival Points have been achieved, it will activate the [Firework Buff].[/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]What is the [Fireworks Festival] Server Buff?[/b]
[/td][td][list][*]The[b] [/b]Server Buff[b] [/b]applies buff effects to all players and all characters.[/*][*]The Server Buff is stacked up to level 10 and will give better buff effects as the level goes up.[/*][*]All the buffs are activated at the same time upon reaching the required Festival points milestone.[/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]What is the [Fireworks Festival Gift] Buff?[/b]
[/td][td][list][*]The Buff is acquired when using Cash Shop Firework (Black Lambs, Wolfdog, Wildhüter, and Rattus)[/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]What are some other benefits?[/b]
[/td][td][list][*]Collect ‘Fireworks Event Souvenirs’ every 10 Festival points. This is your chance to obtain the Hip-hot Street Crew outfit and other exclusive rewards![/*][*]The top 5 Agents who contributed the most Festival Points to the server will obtain extra in-game rewards![/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]What determines the ranks?[/b]
[/td][td][list]The ranking is determined by the accumulation of [Festival Points] attributed to each character, with rewards allocated to Ranks 1 through 5[/list][/td][/tr][/table]

[*] PST: May 22, 2024 from 12:00 AM to 4:00 AM

notes.title: May 8th Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f10dd0533fb0c9b4f9f30523c0b8a37268e9935f.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]1. New Option Cube[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Option Cubes have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Skill Cube New Option ‘Air Strike/Back Attack/Chase Damage’ has been added.[/*][*]New high-level Option Cube (Lv.5, Lv.6) for 3kinds of skill cube option ‘Air Strike Damage’, ‘Back Attack Damage’, and ‘Chase Damage’ have been added.[/*][*]New Option Skill Cube is acquirable by using Option Cube Box Item or Conversion.[/*][*]You can also obtain it using the selectable/probability-type option cube box you have acquired before the maintenance on May 8th, 2024.[/*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/7aa4bbed3221daff07745824b9baf7ee35128b59.png[/img][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]2. Legion Program Improvement[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Legion Program Dungeon's Weekly Entrance Count Restriction has been adjusted.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Target Dungeon: Legion Program - 6 kinds: INSECTAN/DEEPSEA/MACHINERY/WILD/IRREGULAR/INFERNAL[/*][list][*] [b]Before[/b]: can enter 6 dungeons once a week for each dungeon, for a total of 6 times.
[*] [b]After[/b]: can choose from 6 dungeons and enter a total of twice a week.[/list][*]The rewards available for clearing the dungeon once have been increased, so the reward level available for clearing the weekly Legion Program dungeon is the same as before the update.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Crew Mission Achievement Count and Reward regarding Legion Program Dungeon Clear have been adjusted.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Achievement Count Change : Legion Program Dungeon Clear 7times → Once[/*][*]Acquire Reward Change : Unidentified Epic Option Random Cube *1 → *3[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]3. Dungeon Usage Convenience Improvement [/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ ‘Proceed to Next Ops’ Dungeon has been added or changed in some dungeons.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Target Dungeon & Dungeon where to move when 'proceed to Next Ops' Information.[/*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/37bbfb34ecdf214befeecb7b41dcde2276f953da.png[/img]
[*]If there is no entry count restriction for the dungeon you are moving to, clicking ‘Proceed to Next Ops’ will not move the dungeon.[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]4. 5th Promotion Period Shortening[/b][/color][/h3]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Target number of ‘Solomon's Trial’ dungeon clear during Promotion Quest proceeding has been decreased.[/b][/color]
[list][*]([b]Before[/b]) Once - 5times - Once while Quest Proceeding  →   ([b]After[/b]) Once - Twice - Once[/*][*]In accordance with the Promotion Period shortening adjustment, the use of ‘Sector Pass - Solomon’s Trial’ has been changed to not be available. Also, the recipe for ‘Sector Pass Selectable Box ver.2.1’, which uses the ‘Sector Pass - Solomon’s Trial’ item as a material, has been added.[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]5. Gate Keeper Gear Item Farming Alleviation[/b][/color][/h3]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Some of the material item amount and consumed credits required for craft and upgrade of Gate Keeper Module and Trinket Gear Item have been decreased.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Target Material Item: Chromatic Phase Essence, Sticky Residue[/*][*]For the crafting of Gate Keeper modules and Trinket Gear and upgrades at all stages, the consumption of target material items has been reduced by 90% and credit consumption by 50% compared to before.[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]6. Character Passive Skill Change[/b][/color][/h3]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Character Defense Stat-related passive skill detail and figures have been changed.[/b][/color]

notes.title: Virtual Hugs: Mom's Day Screenshot Event - Win 1,000 N-Coins!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e6fff625e532505aaed873398651109cb7998bc2.png[/img]

[h3][color=#89CFF0][b]Event Period[/b][/color][/h3]
May 9, 2024 – [strike]May 19[/strike] May 26, 2024 at 9:00 AM UTC

[h3][color=#89CFF0][b]Winner Announcement[/b][/color][/h3]
[strike]May 22[/strike] May 30, 2024

[h3][color=#FFAC1C][b]Event Mechanics[/b][/color][/h3]

[h3][b]▶ How to join?[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Take a screenshot of your character with NPCs who are a mother OR an NPC you think is suitable as a mother!

[quote][i]Screenshot Sample[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/4ee5bec2e077b1707e5e65fd564dfe15e168d569.png[/img]
[/quote]
[*] Give a small description of why you chose this particular NPC.[/list]
[h3][b]▶ Reminders[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Character names don't need to be visible, and there are no specific dimensions required. Get as creative as you want!
[*] All participants should input their Closers Name and Character Name when submitting their entry, or the whole entry will be invalid.
[*] One entry per participant, using one Closers account for each category. 
[*] Make sure that event mechanics and rules are followed (see Event Rules below).
[*] All participants should input their Closers Name and Character Name with the title [b][Virtual Hugs: Mom's Day Screenshot Event][/b] when submitting their entry, or the whole entry will be invalid.[/list]
[h3][b]▶ How to submit an entry?[/b][/h3]
[olist][*]Log-in to your Closers account to our official website: [url=https://www.closersonline.com/signin][b]https://www.closersonline.com/signin[/b][/url]
[*]After you're logged-in, click [b][Forum][/b] > [b][Art & Media][/b] > [b][Event][/b] Tab
[*]Upload the screenshot of your choice and post it to the [b][Event][/b] Category
[list][*] Participants are allowed to edit or change their screenshot entries as much as they wish during the event period[/list]
[*]Include [b][Virtual Hugs: Mom's Day Screenshot Event][/b] on the Forum post title
[*]Remember to add your Closers Name and Character Name in your entry.[/olist]
[h3][color=#FFAC1C][b]Criteria for Judging[/b][/color][/h3]
[h3][b]▶ Creativity and Originality (40%)[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Uniqueness and unexpected elements that set the entry apart from others.[/list]
[h3][b]▶ Description (40%)[/b][/h3]
[list][*] The thoughtfulness behind your message and how it reflects the spirit of Mother's Day.[/list]
[h3][b]▶ Audience Impact (20%)[/b][/h3]
[list][*] The number of '❤️' votes the entry receives in the forum.[/list]
[h3][color=#FFAC1C][b]Rewards[/b][/color][/h3]
[list][b][*]1,000 N-Coins for a total of 5 winners.[/*][/b][/list][olist][*]Winners will be announced on [b][strike]May 22[/strike] May 30, 2024[/b] (Thursday) UTC through the website, SNS, and their screenshot entries will be featured on the Closers forums.[/*][/olist]
[h3][color=#FFAC1C][b]Event Rules[/b][/color][/h3]
[olist][*]Only one entry is allowed per Closers account.[/*][*]All entries must be made by the submitter specifically for the purpose of this contest.[/*][*]All participants should include their Closers Name and Character Name when submitting their entry; otherwise, the whole entry will be invalid.[/*][*]No explicit contents are allowed to be seen in the entry. Any entry that can make others feel offended or uncomfortable will be removed with or without permission from the Naddic staff.[/*][*]Once an entry has been submitted, players agree to have their work published publicly on our official channels (Website, Steam, and SNS).[/*][*]If you have submitted more than one entry, we will only refer to the first entry submitted.[/*][*]If you need to change or edit your entry or post, remove your first entry, then re-submit it again before the event ends.[/*][*]The Naddic team can remove unrelated entries or discussions.[/*][*]Entries suspected of using third-party applications such as Photoshop or AI to manipulate the screenshot image will be ruled out. Cropping the image is acceptable.[/*][*]The Naddic team is not liable for any violation of copyright or intellectual property. Any violations will be assumed by the event participant.[/*][*]Contact [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna][i]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna[/i][/url] or [i]support@closersonline.com[/i] for inquiries, concerns, or reports.[/*][/olist]

notes.title: [Developer Letter] Contents, Improvements, Special News!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Developer Letter[/b][/h1]

Hello Agents. It's been a while since I greeted you.

This is Hyun-jun Kang, the PD of Closers. I hope everyone is doing well.

I have been meaning to reach out more often, but I wanted to make sure we had everything in order before sharing updates with our Closers community. We appreciate your patience. The development team and I are doing our best to make Closers even better. This developer letter is our way of giving you a preview of the content that will be introduced from June onwards, as well as the new content planned for the second half of the year. First, let me introduce the updates for June.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/bba760869a3374e31d28a8356fe7500352171509.png[/img]
 
[h3][b]1. Conquest Program Ver.2[/b][/h3]
The Conquest program, which received much love from our Closers community, will be returning in June with Version 2.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/9b57287940cbc576b437948b037a12b7bd14e4f7.png[/img]
As you've been waiting patiently, Version 2 of the Conquest program is returning in June. In Version 2, we aim to provide a more intense and combat-focused experience that highlights the abilities of your trained characters. Now, let me briefly explain the changes in Ver.2.

Firstly, we've changed the battle format from 2:1 to 1:1. This adjustment aims to remove elements that hindered control in the previous Conquest program. It minimizes interruptions to the flow of character skills caused by monsters dodging skills or two monsters using skills simultaneously or individually. In Version 2, you'll be able to fully enjoy the combat environment where you can showcase the specs and control advantages of your nurtured characters.

Additionally, we've added conditions within dungeons where resurrection is not possible, and buff items like the "Piece of Cake" cannot be used. This decision was made to address the imbalance caused by differences in resurrection times between characters and costume motions, as well as to ensure that dungeon clearances are not determined by resurrection or the possession of certain consumables, which goes against the direction of the content.

Overall, in comparison to Version 1, we've designed Version 2 to accentuate the specs and control elements of characters more prominently. Furthermore, to give it significance as challenge content, we've included emoticon tickets and prepared rewards that can only be obtained through the Conquest program. We kindly ask for your active participation, Agents.

 
[h3][b]2. Character Skill Remake: Yuri and J[/b][/h3]
The "Skill Remake" that we first introduced during 'CLOSERS CHANNEL ON EP.1' is set to make its debut in June. Separate from balance patches, our goal is to provide meaningful changes and new experiences for each character, aiming to alter the structure and forms of their skills to offer a better gameplay experience.

The first characters to be showcased are Yuri and J from the Black Lambs team. Today, we'd like to give you a sneak peek at the revamped skills and some skill combo footage.

[table][tr][td]
[b]Yuri's Skill Combo Footages[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/b79403e1a010a4ed12ce6ea4a2979066059370a3.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/671c46ed61ca2df673e7dec5dc538e2fb2dd02ba.gif[/img][/td][/tr][/table]

[/td][/tr][/table]
[i]*This content is under development and is subject to change upon update.[/i]

The goal of skill remake is to upgrade the quality of old skills' effects and enhance the usability of various skills, providing a new level of excitement in battles. In addition to Yuri and J, skill remakes for other characters will be continuously carried out, following the order of the teams. While we aim to update as many characters as possible in a timely manner, please understand that it requires careful development processes to present them in a highly polished state. We appreciate your patience and support as we strive to showcase each character's impressive actions after the diligent efforts put into the development process.
 
[h3][b]3. Ancient Dragon Historic Site New Dungeon: Tiamat of the Beginning[/b][/h3]
Following the introduction of "Mirage Repeated," the new dungeon "Tiamat of the Beginning" in the Ancient Dragon Historic Site will be unveiled for the first time since then, with an update scheduled for June.

[table][tr][td][b]Tiamat of The Beginning Dungeon Background Original Painting[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/2dc940b924320bd35af763b6748dae2c09b42bb8.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
 
[table][tr][td]
[b]Tiamat of the Beginning Original Painting[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a070513064d8f7797331928f6db26add75fdc3f3.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
 
[table][tr][td][b]Tiamat of the Beginning Talk-Face[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/fe633ebead5a03e7e4f4aa932f5d1720b21535be.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]

In the upcoming new dungeon, we have planned for a different dungeon experience from what you've seen before, and we are currently preparing to present a high-quality appearance. Additionally, the transformed Tiamat awaits you in a new form. The intriguing story behind why Tiamat has become so small and cute, as well as its purpose, awaits you. We appreciate your anticipation for this exciting narrative.

With the addition of the new dungeon, there have been some changes. Whenever a new dungeon is added, it can be challenging to practice the gimmicks and patterns of the new monsters due to the dungeon entry limit. To address this, we have tentatively introduced a [Practice Dungeon] where you can research patterns and strategies without being limited by entry counts. We believe this will greatly reduce the initial burden of the challenge by allowing players to confirm monster gimmicks and patterns without the pressure of limited attempts. We appreciate your interest and participation in this addition.

Alongside the new dungeon, a new chip, the 'Tiamat of the Beginning Chip,' will be introduced. We aim to provide sufficient motivation for playing the new dungeon.

Next, I would like to introduce some of the improvements currently being prepared for a more enjoyable gameplay experience for all Agents.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/336cf15bf160b04d45877aab2bcf7b85f414fb7d.png[/img]
 
[h3][b]1. Ancient Dragon Historic Site Play Improvement[/b][/h3]
With the update to the new Ancient Dragon Historic Site dungeon, there will also be a revamp of the existing Ancient Dragon Historic Site dungeons.

Rewards from the old dungeons will be partially transferred to the latest dungeons, and some dungeons will be consolidated to reduce exhaustion. Additionally, the number of entries required for gameplay will be reduced, and rewards will be increased accordingly.

Please wait a bit longer, and we will introduce a more streamlined Ancient Dragon Historic Site gameplay for you to enjoy.
 
[h3][b]2. Chip System Convenience Improvement and Chip Overclock Balancing[/b][/h3]
Some conveniences in the chip system will be improved. Changes will be made to the chip crafting UI to allow users to see the crafting list at a glance, and some tab names will be updated to be more intuitive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/66d99ab70b49ddc9162ae58f72400deac85883ce.png[/img]
[i]*This content is under development and is subject to change upon update.[/i]

Additionally, we plan to add more crafting recipes to allow for the creation of more overclock chips. These recipes will be obtainable using resources acquired from the Tiamat Of The Beginning dungeon, enabling faster chip overclocking. The improvements to the chip system convenience and the addition of crafting recipes will be carried out simultaneously with the Ancient Dragon Historic Site update, so please look forward to it.

[h3][b]3. Inventory Improvement[/b][/h3]
You've been waiting for this for a long time, and I remember it being one of the most requested features. It's none other than inventory improvement.

It can be broadly divided into two parts: quantitative improvement and convenience improvement.

[b][u]1) Quantitative Improvement[/u][/b]
Currently, Closers utilizes a total of 5 tabs and 350 inventory slots. We have explored ways to increase this number, but we've concluded that it would inevitably impact the stability of the live servers with an unacceptable level of load. Given the complexity of the game system, a careful approach was necessary as any fundamental structural changes would be quite intricate.

Therefore, we've focused on practical improvements that can alleviate usability issues. One such improvement is the 'slot rearrangement' between tabs. Currently, the 'Mission' inventory tab is the least used, so by removing unnecessary items from here and adjusting the absolute usage, we can ultimately remove the 'Mission' inventory, thus adding 20 slots to other inventories. This results in a total of 360 slots utilized across 4 tabs, an increase of 10 slots from the previous setup.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/0847983d21c9a7cc05ff0ed876560d3bb0737d7d.png[/img]
[i]*This content is under development and is subject to change upon update.[/i]

To achieve this, items that were stored in the existing quest inventory and deemed useless, being only used in simple quests, will be removed. Items with utility, such as farming materials, will be moved to the 'Materials' tab. However, due to the possibility of the 'Materials' inventory becoming temporarily full during the update, some items will be relocated to the [Virtual Bank].

The [Virtual Bank] is a system created alongside inventory improvement. It's a new Bank format where items can only be stored but not used. Unfortunately, due to server overload concerns, this system cannot be permanently applied. After a certain period, we will announce the scheduled deletion date.

Additionally, credit account integration, an increase in account credit holdings, an increase in stackable item maximum quantities, and the addition of an inventory item locking feature will be implemented.

We're committed to enhancing your convenience and, above all, ensuring stability.


[b][u]2) Convenience Improvement[/u][/b]
Next, we're focusing on convenience improvements. You may have experienced inconvenience when crafting specific items or using consumables and materials, often needing to retrieve items from your account storage or logging in with another character to transfer items through the bank.

To eliminate this inconvenience, we're developing a system where Bank-stored materials can be used when crafting or performing similar actions. Most systems are considered to be enhanced to allow the use of items from both the inventory and warehouse, as well as the account storage, reducing many inconveniences.

Convenience improvements will be implemented after the quantitative improvements are updated and are also scheduled for the second half of the year.

 
[h3][b]4. Character Creation Window Enhancement[/b][/h3]
We plan to renovate the character creation window. After the update long ago, certain aspects may feel a bit outdated, so we're improving them to better convey the character's charm and information. With an increase in the size of skill video clips and the ability to view all characters' promotion illustrations, you'll have a clearer picture. This enhancement is slated for release in the latter half of the year.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/af0d3d79a64b2a165138ebdd8559bfbaf566aa7f.png[/img]
[i]*This content is under development and is subject to change upon update.[/i]
<< If you feel like the number of characters varies by team, you're not mistaken. >>
 
[h3][b]5. [Training Ground] Adding Defense Training Dummy[/b][/h3]
A "Defense Training Dummy" will be added to the training grounds.

The Defense Training Dummy is a dummy that replicates most of the attacks used by monsters, such as regular attacks, super armor crashes, and attacks that ignore invincibility, within a certain time frame. Skilled Closers can summon the Defense Training Dummy, while new Closers can observe the effects of monster attack patterns based on their visual cues.

The Defense Training Dummy is also scheduled for release in the latter half of the year.

Next, although it's a bit early, I'll introduce some new content planned for the latter half of the year along with ongoing optimization efforts.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/3058a0b318711b7e9a5fbe6d2e4a1737f74d99f9.png[/img]

[h3][b]1. Optimization[/b][/h3]
The development team has been consistently working on optimizing the client. While you may not yet fully feel the effects, some optimizations have already been implemented, and work is underway to make optimizations that can be felt during gameplay. Specifically, we are addressing issues such as frame drops that occur in various situations, such as when staying in certain towns, when multiple monster respawns occur, or when using specific skills. These optimizations are scheduled to be completed by the latter half of the year. Once the updates are finalized, we will provide detailed information again. Please bear with us a little longer as we strive to make Closers gameplay more enjoyable by making sufficient improvements.

[h3][b]2. New Dungeon: Dragon King Hecatoncheir, Astarte[/b][/h3]
In the upcoming second half of the year, we are excited to introduce two new bosses in the latest dungeon. They are none other than 'Dragon King Hecatoncheir' and 'Astarte.'

[table][tr][td]
[b]Dragon King Hecatoncheir Original Painting[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/c180105a7067a9f959ff02e0013cc6083ec3d28c.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
 
[table][tr][td]
[b]Dragon King Hecatoncheir Illustration[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/b2ec52955197d58838e601950b7081de8f6a9970.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]

Many Agents will surely recall the name 'Hecatoncheir.' Since the first season of the Black Lambs team, Legion Commander Hecatoncheir has been a figure of awe and respect. Now, in the upcoming second half of the year, he will finally reveal his true colors. How he returns from a state where he should have perished in the storyline, and why he appears in a slightly different form from what we knew, will all be unveiled in the update planned for the second half of this year.

[table][tr][td]
[b]Astarte Original Painting[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e70097a9cef9fc40b6970cab7f8fc0c7756d4915.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
 
[table][tr][td]
[b]Astarte Illustration[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a68a033d17f25d660515dac6a875f4742f07548d.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]

Alongside the Dragon King Hecatoncheir, a new boss named 'Astarte' will also make her appearance. With her beautiful yet icy demeanor, one may wonder about her true identity. And what relationship does she have with Hecatoncheir? We kindly ask for the continued interest and support of all our beloved Agents.

This upcoming new boss dungeon is designed for a recommended party size of four. It will offer a gameplay experience different from the previous investigation teams or advance parties, aiming to minimize the shortcomings of the previous systems.

More details will be provided in the second half of the year.
 
[h3][b]3. 6th character of the Black Lambs Team: Ria Yoon[/b][/h3]
[table][tr][td][i]*The character name has been decided as "Yoon Ria" during the development process.[/i][/td][/tr][/table]
In the last "World Peace Plaza: Epilogue - Audio Movie," the silhouette of a new character mentioned by Hildagarde was revealed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/4f6e7acaa2b6163c91fce61a1dc861503d011b47.png[/img]

This silhouette, as many Closers may have anticipated, belongs to the new character to be updated in the latter half of the year, 'Ria Yoon.'

'Ria Yoon' is the 6th member of the Black Lambs team. As a former idol with a unique phase force of 'Soundwave,' she is a rookie Closer who uses a microphone to defeat dimensional monsters. While we can't reveal too much yet, I'll share some glimpses of her appearance and skills, which I'm sure many Closers are eager to see.

[table][tr][td]
[b]Ria Yoon Illustration[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f62f85c06f155a2b4dfa38887b2ae584c47a8284.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]
 
[table][tr][td]
[b]Ria Yoon's Skill Combo Footage[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/42a014a3157e333dd2c9ad422328d88743f2d95f.gif[/img]
[/td][/tr][/table]
[i]*This content is under development and is subject to change upon update.[/i]

As a new member of the Black Lambs, we kindly ask for your attention to see what contributions she will make. More detailed information will be provided in our next communication.

[table][tr][td][b]Ria Yoon Story Dungeon Background Original Painting[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e90a8d584902f423d7242d1647bf6a0b02f7a95d.jpg[/img][/td][/tr][/table]

That's all for today's prepared content.

Thanks to the support of all Agents, Closers is moving forward toward the future. We ask for your continued support and encouragement to bring joy to all our Agents.

We'll be back with richer content next time. Thank you always.

Best Regards,
Kang PD.

notes.title: April 11th Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f10dd0533fb0c9b4f9f30523c0b8a37268e9935f.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]1. Break Challenge[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Contents ‘Break Challenge’ has been added. [/b][/color]
[list]
[*]‘Break Challenge’ Dungeon can be entered by the new NPC <Break Challenge Entry - Queen> at ‘Noah's Museum’ Town.
[*]Entry NPC <Break Challenge Entry - Queen> is displayed to the character of 95lv or higher who has cleared the ‘And Holy Lance’ Quest.
[*]‘Break Challenge’ contents have been added to the Game Farming Guide, UNION Watch - Dungeon Mission, and Achievement. 
[list][*]‘Break Challenge’ Achievement Main Reward: ‘Name Tag Ticket: Signet of the One who Chained Up Gluttony’, ‘Glutton King's Trigger Random Box’[/list]
[/list][color=#ffae42][b]▶ 4 types of ‘Break Challenge: Fly King’ themed Dungeon have been added. [/b][/color]
[list]
[*]‘Break Challenge: Fly King’ themed 3 Elite Dungeons and 1 Challenge Dungeon have been added. 
[*]‘Infinite Gluttony ticket’, which is the entrance material for Challenge Dungeon, is acquirable from Elite Dungeon. 
[*] 3 types of Break Challenge Elite Dungeon can proceed consecutively when clearing the dungeon, by [Proceed to Next Ops]. 
[*] Elite Dungeon [Proceed to Next Ops] Order:  Campus of Singing Deception → Flesh-eating Streets → Island of the Strong
[/list]
[b][Dungeon Information][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/de34b636d4a45a5db80812d38471d28a7b0fa5ce.png[/img]
[i]*Basic Resurrection Restriction count is 3 times and Basic limit time is 5 minutes, without proceeding to ‘Chapter of Infinite Gluttony’ Challenge Dungeon's restriction adjustment. [/i]

[b][Clear Rank Reward by Dungeon][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a0c532ddbe520a9dd78c76491cc0b8a8b727d58f.png[/img]
[i]*[color=#5f95cc]Clear Rank Reward[/color] can be acquired at a set probability depending on the clear rank.[/i]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Restriction Adjustment System has been added to the ‘Break Challenge’ Dungeon. [/b][/color]
[list][*]Challenge Dungeon of ‘Break Challenge’ can adjust the dungeon difficulty by restriction adjustment, and the acquirable point is changed when clearing the dungeon depending on that. [/list]
[b][Restriction Adjustment Details][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/451ee168708a3e1e0c5b3b307f0c9254b28f0d17.png[/img]
[i]*Depending on the restriction adjustment, some abilities in the character information window > Details within the dungeon may appear as negative numbers or the character's damage may be applied as 0.[/i]

Please note that this is a result based on restriction adjustment and is not an error when using the game.
[list][*]The acquired challenge Point from Dungeon Clear is not accumulated but will be renewed as the Best Point within the period. 
[*]Acquired challenge Points can be checked at 'My Point', at the bottom left of the dungeon entrance screen.  
[*]Point Reward is acquirable according to the obtained challenge Point. 
[*]Main Point Reward Item: Glutton King's Trigger Box (Epic),  Glutton King's Memory Crystal, Chromatic Phase Essence, Sticky Residue
[*]Point Reward is acquirable per challenge point reward, once per character.
[*]Challenge Point and Reward acquire count is reset on every Saturday at AM 4:00.[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]2. New Trigger[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ 2 types of New Trigger have been added. [/b][/color]
[list]
[*]‘Gluttony Execution’, and ‘Infinite Gluttony Execution’ Trigger are acquirable by playing Break Challenge ‘Challenge Dungeon’ or crafting and opening ‘Glutton King's Trigger Random Box’. 
[*]‘Gluttony Execution’, and ‘Infinite Gluttony Execution’ Triggers are acquired with an unappraised status when initially acquired, and Tuning Option and Fixed Granted Option are granted when proceeding with Identify Item.  
[/list]
[b][2 types of Trigger][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/d380b5ee17ebc0457e598655837696994df43013.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Trigger Fixed Granted Option has been added. [/b][/color]

[list]
[*]Trigger Fixed Granted Option Item: ‘Gluttony Execution’, ‘Infinite Gluttony Execution’
[*]Fixed Granted Option is at the top of the Tuning Option, and a total of 10 options are available with grades of 6 (Grade 1~6).  
[*]The probability of the appearance of all fixed granted options and grades is the same, and the same options can be obtained as duplicates.
[*]The fixed granted option cannot be checked on an item that is in an unappraised state and can be checked when appraising the item (identify item).
[/list]
[b][Fixed Granted Option Type and Grade][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/17eace38ad8ea936ec8accc609cc2e915e4abb3f.png[/img]

[b][Glutton King's Trigger Box Specification][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/438e68e019c7e78cf26c5c3b234738a4326f2379.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]3. Trigger Tuning Transfer[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The Trigger Tuning Transfer System has been added.[/b][/color]

[list]
[*]‘Trigger Tuning Transfer’ is a system that allows you to transfer the tuning option of a trigger to another trigger.
[*]Available items for Trigger Tuning Transfer: ‘Gluttony Execution’, ‘Infinite Gluttony Execution’
[*]It can be proceeded by right-clicking the New Consumables Item ‘Trigger Tuning Extractor’ for Trigger Tuning transfer, or NPC <Crafting/Salvaging/Tuning Transfer - Allan>.
[*]Tuning information of ‘Extract Target Gear’ can be transferred to ‘Transfer Target Gear’ at the Tuning Transfer System window. 
[*]When Tuning transfer, Credits and ‘Trigger Tuning Extractor’ Item is consumed.  
[*]When Tuning transfer, ‘Extract Target Gear’ is destroyed, and the tuning count of ‘Transfer Target Gear’ remains the same as before tuning.
[*]While using the tuning transfer system, Item Remove, Sort, Appraisal, Costume Locker Open, and Search functions cannot be used.
[/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]4. Trigger Fuel System Removal[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The Trigger Fuel System has been removed. [/b][/color]

[list]
[*]The effect activated through Trigger fuel activation has been transferred to the Basic Option.
[*]The Original Trigger ON/OFF button has been changed to a preset button.
[*]The supply source where trigger combustion can be obtained has been removed from existing content.
[list][*]Craft machine - Trigger Combustion Recipe, NPC Shop, Monster drop, Reward and more[/list]
[*]‘Trigger Combustion’ and ‘Trigger Combustion - Boost’ Items have been changed to be available for sale at the shop. 
[*]The ‘Trigger Combustion - Epic’ Item has been changed to be unavailable to trade on the Black Market.
[list][*]Items registered in the black market before the maintenance on 4/11 (Thursday) will be rejected after the maintenance. You must receive the rejected 'Trigger Combustion - Epic’ item to re-register the items in bulk.[/list]
[*]The New Craft recipe has been added for the 'Break Challenge Trigger Material Selectable Box' that uses the ‘Trigger Combustion - Epic’ Item as a material.
[*]The ‘Gluttony King’s Memory Crystal’ item has been sent by mail according to the trigger fuel figure activated before the maintenance on 4/11 (Thursday).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/4efa935f9d8c23d6db4fda3887c0f3042bd73518.png[/img]
 
[h3][color=#89CFF0][b]Event Period[/b][/color][/h3]
April 3, 2024 – April 18, 2024 at 9:00 AM UTC

[h3][color=#89CFF0][b]Winner Announcement[/b][/color][/h3]
April 24, 2024

[h3][color=#FFAC1C][b]Event Mechanics[/b][/color][/h3]

[h3][b]▶ How to join?[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Use the template panel below and create a meme or a funny comic related to Closers!

[quote][i]Sample[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/4a33f644ee05e605c312f569d9975847ab08c36b.png[/img]

[i]Template[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/bac1d6ef62c7f3289389655c84d1e8caa4c787b1.jpg[/img]
[/quote]
[*] Participants will be using screenshots or image assets from Closers (drawing or AI may not be valid).
[list][*] [b]Not valid[/b]: Editing the character's face/body, moving the character to a different image background, adding images to the photo that is not included in the game, and/or using AI or drawings.
[*] [b]Valid[/b]: Cropping/resizing/using in-game screenshot or assets from Closers Official website ([url=https://www.closersonline.com/news?type=0]Notice section[/url]).[/list][*] Upload your entry to [url=https://www.closersonline.com/news/(https://www.closersonline.com/forum/art-media?sub=66)][b][Forum] > [Art & Media] > [Event][/b][/url] Tab along with your Closers Name and Character Name.
[*] Winners will be decided based on the criteria (see Criteria for Judging below).[/list]
[h3][b]▶ How to submit an entry?[/b][/h3]
[olist][*]Log-in to your Closers account to our official website: [url=https://www.closersonline.com/signin][b]https://www.closersonline.com/signin[/b][/url]
[*]After you're logged-in, click [b][Forum][/b] > [b][Art & Media][/b] > [b][Event][/b] Tab
[*]Upload the screenshot of your choice and post it to the [b][Event][/b] Category
[*]Include [b][Agents of Comedy Comic Contest][/b] on the Forum post title
[*]Participants are allowed to edit or change their entries as much as they wish during the event period. [/olist]
[h3][b]▶ Reminders[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Only use the official 6-panel template and upload it in JPG or PNG format.
[*] Make sure that the event mechanics and rules are followed accordingly (see Event Rules below).
[*] You can only join once [1 Closers account = 1 Entry] during this event.
[*] Entries that don't include [Agents of Comedy Comic Contest] in the title will be invalid.
[/list]

[h3][color=#FFAC1C][b]Criteria for Judging[/b][/color][/h3]
[h3][b]▶ 40% Screenshot Creativity[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Entries will be judged on how participants utilize in-game components (emotes, costume, location, etc.) to their creativity.[/list]
[h3][b]▶ 40% Text Originality[/b][/h3]
[list][*] While it's acceptable to take inspiration from existing memes, original ideas, especially funny dialogues related to Closers, are preferred[/list]
[h3][b]▶ 20% Audience Impact[/b][/h3]
[list][*] ‘❤️’ votes it receives in the forum entry.[/list]

[h3][color=#FFAC1C][b]Rewards[/b][/color][/h3]
[list][b][*]1,000 N-Coins for a total of 5 winners.[/*][/b][/list][olist][*]Winners will be announced on [b]April 24,2024[/b] (Wednesday) UTC through the website, SNS, and their screenshot entries will be featured on the Closers forums.[/*][*]The rewards will be distributed during the maintenance after the winners' announcement.[/*][*]Participation rewards are only provided to entries that have followed the rules.[/*][/olist]
[h3][color=#FFAC1C][b]Event Rules[/b][/color][/h3]
[olist][*]Only one entry is allowed per Closers account.[/*][*]All entries must be made by the submitter specifically for the purpose of this contest.[/*][*]All participants should include their Closers Name and Character Name when submitting their entry; otherwise, the whole entry will be invalid.[/*][*]No explicit contents are allowed to be seen in the entry. Any entry that can make others feel offended or uncomfortable will be removed with or without permission from the Naddic staff.[/*][*]Once an entry has been submitted, players agree to have their work published publicly on our official channels (Website, Steam, and SNS).[/*][*]If you have submitted more than one entry, we will only refer to the first entry submitted.[/*][*]If you need to change or edit your entry or post, remove your first entry, then re-submit it again before the event ends.[/*][*]The Naddic team can remove unrelated entries or discussions.[/*][*]Entries suspected of using third-party applications such as Photoshop or AI to manipulate the screenshot image will be ruled out. Cropping the image is acceptable.[/*][*]The Naddic team is not liable for any violation of copyright or intellectual property. Any violations will be assumed by the event participant.[/*][*]Contact [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna][i]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna[/i][/url] or [i]support@closersonline.com[/i] for inquiries, concerns, or reports.[/*][/olist]

▶ ‘Second Password’ feature has been added.[/b][list][*]You can set up a second password when logging into the account from the in-game "Game Start" screen. Authentication to your registered email is required during this process for security purposes.[/*][*]The button for setting up the second password is located on the lower right part of the start screen.
[/*][*]The same authentication process is required for changing/removing a registered second password after setting up.[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]Bug Fix[/b][/color][/h3]
 
[b]▶ An issue where, after registering a pet in Your Room and proceeding with exploration, the game would end if the pet used for exploration was re-equipped, has been fixed.    

▶ An issue where checking the data file didn't work properly by Game launch window -  clicking the magnifying glass icon has been fixed.  

▶ An issue where the game would end when using all of the pet's skills in a dungeon after equipping a pet with only basic combat skills has been fixed.[/b][list][*]Target Pets: Mini Scavenger, Mini Snatcher,  Mini Kryzaloid, Andras' Anchor, Long Cat Winter Edition, Lucky Chick[/*][/list][b]▶ An issue where UI windows, images, and texts were abnormally exposed in some resolutions has been improved.  

▶ An issue where keyboard input did not work properly in the character selection screen has been fixed. 

▶ Some missing story character dialogue scripts and voices have been fixed.   

▶ An issue where character Seha's skill [Fire Grinder] isn't activated when using 6 stacks of Burst has been fixed. 

▶ The tooltip notation for the Cheolsu Kim character’s [Special Skill: Tactical Stance] will be modified.

▶ An issue of being banned when using a pet's automatic skill in a dungeon after equipping a pet that does not have a pet manual skill has been fixed.

▶ An issue where damage was output abnormally when using the Lucy character's Peaceful Ninisina skill in the air has been fixed. 

▶ An issue where the Z-axis movement speed does not increase when using the Eunha character's Fallen Starlight skill has been fixed.

▶ An issue that the resulting item was incorrect when salvaging the Mini Flame's Daughter pet has been fixed.

▶ An issue where salvage materials were obtained abnormally when salvaging certain gear in VVIP status has been fixed.[list][*][Updated] Compensations have been sent to respective accounts as of March 28th.[/*][/list]
▶ Yuri's 'Special Skill: Shift' has been adjusted to resolve the disconnection issues.

▶ Fused Phase Wings Description for Level 14 has been updated: "Damage increase/PF Charge Speed +100% when in Empowered State".[/b]

notes.title: Scheduled Server Maintenance - March 27th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/80cd3c27fe6029acb9b2be2bd060a6e979ac8456.png[/img]

Greetings Agents,

We will perform maintenance on the Closers World server according to the following schedule, based on your time zone:[list]

[*][b]UTC[/b]: March 27, 2024 from 6:00 AM to 10:00 AM
[*][b]PDT:[/b] March 26, 2024 from 11:00 PM to March 27, 2024 3:00 AM
[*][b]GMT+7:[/b] March 27, 2024 from 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM[/list]

To stay up to date with news and other information, please visit our website or follow us on social media.

If you have any concerns or bug reports, you may send us an inquiry or an email to: [url=support@closersonline.com]support@closersonline.com[/url]

notes.title: Pre-Notice for Changes in Flame Wave Reward Claim Count
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you that after the maintenance on March 27th, 2024, some changes related to Flame Wave reward acquisition are planned. Please check the following information below.

[h3][b]■ Changes related to obtaining Flame Wave rewards:[/b][/h3]
[olist][*] Flame Wave's 4-person mission rewards can now be obtained twice instead of just once.
[*] The number of times Flame Wave’s 4-person mission rewards can be obtained is shared with the Normal dungeon. 
[list][*] (For example, if you obtain a reward twice in a Normal dungeon on the same day, you cannot obtain a reward from Hard mode)[/list][*] Flame Wave’s map dungeon location is refreshed once.
[list][*] (The type and location of the map displayed before maintenance may change.)[/list][*] If you receive the 4-person mission reward before the regular maintenance, you can only receive the 4-person mission reward once after the reset at 4:00 AM UTC on the day of the maintenance.[/olist]

[list][*] It has come to our attention that Yuri's 'Special Skill: Shift' is causing disconnections from the game, particularly when the skill's keys are pressed too quickly in a short period of time. Please be informed that this skill will be adjusted during the scheduled maintenance on March 27th. notes.title: March 13th Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f10dd0533fb0c9b4f9f30523c0b8a37268e9935f.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]1. ‘Fused Phase Wings’ Upgrade Level Expansion[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The upgrade level of ‘Fused Phase Wings’ has been expanded up to level 20. [/b][/color]
[list][*]You can upgrade ‘Fused Phase Wings’ through ‘Costume Fusion’ with material items and credits.[/*][*]When upgrading, the required material items and credits are different for each level, and a 100% guaranteed probability is applied for costume fusion.[/*][*]Material Item: ‘Costume Fusion Fiber’, ‘Splendid Phase Fiber’, ‘Phase Wings Essence’[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Additions and changes to options for each upgrade level of ‘Fused Phase Wings’.[/b][/color]
[list][*]If options from the same series are applied additionally, the numbers are added together and displayed.[/*][*]Some of the existing ‘Fused Phase Wings’ options for level 1 to 10 have been improved. (Excluding level 2)[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/72edc8320104c7ac4c22d73cca336cd3e83ee598.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Additions and changes to the buffs at each upgrade level of ‘Fused Phase Wings’.[/b][/color]
[list][*]The name of the Empowered State skill [Release Phase Force], which changes when level 5 or higher ‘Fused Phase Wings’ is worn, has been changed to [Release Phase Force I].   [/*][*]When wearing ‘Fused Phase Wings’ of level 15 or higher, the Empowered State skill is changed to [Release Phase Force II] skill. [/*][*]Some of [Release Phase Force I] Buff have been improved.[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8c3a425eca33fa8f957ab3433c8e6db6731f36ff.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ ‘Fused Phase Wings’ effect custom ‘Change the World’ has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]The effect custom ‘Change the World’ is activated when you equip ‘Fused Phase Wings’ upgraded to level 20 or higher or store it in inventory.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Other changed rlated to ‘Fused Phase Wings’[/b][/color]
[list][*]When the upgrade is successful, the conditions for the message output to all servers have been changed. (Success at level 7 → Success at level 10)[/*][*]Some contents of the guide related to ‘Fused Phase Wings’ have been modified.[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]2. Fiber Shop Addition[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ [Fiber Shop] has been added to NPC Shop.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Character of above level 80 can use ‘Fiber Shop’ from <Shop - Pheasant> NPC > Normal Shop.[/*][*]You can exchange ‘Common Phase Fiber’, ‘Splendid Phase Fiber’ Item into ‘Phase Wings Essence’, ‘Costume Fusion Fiber’, ‘Special Agent/Special Crew/Hireling Costume Full Set’, ‘3-star Accessory Item Full Set’ and more.[/*][*]All items acquired from the Fiber Shop’ cannot be traded on the black market, and some items cannot be moved to the account storage.[/*][*]Some costumes and accessory items obtained from the ‘Fiber Shop’ are acquired in a state that cannot be repackaged.[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]3. Addition of PNA system Awakended Gene[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ A total of 14 types of Awakened Gene A, B, and C of the PNA system Awakening strain have been added.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The number of awakening material capsules that can be obtained in one play in Gremory Dungeon has been increased.[/b][/color][list][*]Target Dungeon: Advanced Central Laboratory, Bear Land, Gremory Science Facility (Each includes [V.HARD])[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]4. Dungeon Reward acquire improvement[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ To improve dungeon play and reward acquisition, some dungeon rewards have been removed or added.[/b][/color]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f5783d1319a584246a4fb598ea1ebbf16e8a492e.png[/img]
[list][*]If there was a party clear reward in the ‘Reward Removal Dungeon’, the party clear reward has been changed to a reward for obtaining a drop from defeating a boss monster.[/*][*]Main Reward Item: Gear Booster Fuel I, Fast Dual Recovery Capsule, Malek Crystal, Common Phase Fiber, Pet Food etc.[/*][*]The amount of ‘Malek Diamond’, the main reward item in the Flame Wave 4-person mission dungeon, has been increased.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Some changes have been made to Gremory Dungeon reward items and acquisition methods.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Drop reward items in some Gremory Dungeons have been changed to improve convenience in using inventory space.[/*][*]Target Dungeon: Advanced Central Laboratory, Bear Land, Gremory Science Facility (Each includes [V.HARD])[/*][*]Major changes: Credit → Gold Malek Statue /  PNA Evolution Additives → Unified as Doctor's Secret Box / Various Evolution & Mutation Material Capsule → Unified as Standard Evolution/Mutation Material Capsule.[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]5. Addition and Improvement of Pet System Features[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ An Exclusive Pet registration function for each Dungeon Armor Type has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]You can register the exclusive pet for each dungeon armor type in Pet Information > Container.[/*][*]When you click the ‘Exclusive Pet Registration Button’ displayed at the top left of the pet you wish to register in the pet container, you can register the pet as a dedicated pet that matches the dungeon armor type.[/*][*]When you left-click a registered exclusive pet in the reaction type dedicated pet window, detailed information about the pet is displayed, and when you right-click, the dedicated pet is deactivated.[/*][*]Only one dedicated pet can be registered for one reaction type.[/*][*]The same pet can be registered as a dedicated pet in multiple reaction types.[/*][*]If you hover your mouse over the ‘Quick Change’ button in the armor type dungeon entry guide UI, you can check the registered pets dedicated to the reaction type of the corresponding dungeon.[/*][list][*] By clicking the ‘Quick Change' button, you can quickly replace the pet with a registered reaction type exclusive pet.[/list][*]The ‘Quick Change’ button can only be used in armor type dungeons. (Not displayed in normal/special operations area/matrix dive/party pop-up.)[/*][*]Reaction Type Exclusive Pet List is saved and shared on an account basis.[/*][*]If it is registered as a dedicated pet, Pet Salvage, Evolution, or Enhancement of the pet is not available.[/*][*]When Pet Enhancement, a pet registered as a dedicated pet is not exposed to Enhancement Material.[/*][*]Information regarding Exclusive Pet registration has been added to the Guide.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Pet Skill automatic change function has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]If a pet active skill is equipped in the skill slot, the pet's active skill is automatically changed when the pet changes.[/*][*]After equipping a pet active skill in a skill slot, if you equip a pet without an active skill or do not equip a pet, the skill slot will be displayed as an empty icon.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Other Pet System usage conveniences have been improved.[/b][/color]
[list][*]‘Pet Nametage/Automatic Item Effect Hide’ function's name has been changed to ‘Turn off pet UI Effects’.[/*][*]When ‘Turn off Pet UI Effects’, Pet Stamina Cooldown guage bar and phrase to guide Pet Evolution including Pet Nametag/Automatic Item effect hide will not be displayed.[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]6. Character Balance Adjustment[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ All Characters' some skill balance have been adjusted.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Some skills' options and tooltips have been changed.[/*][*] The coefficients of some skills have been adjusted.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Match the Snapshot Challenge! - Chance to win 1,000 N-coin!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/1bdbc7b319d18bac7d925df9ee5d45dc793ded79.png[/img]
 
[h3][color=#89CFF0][b]Event Period[/b][/color][/h3]
March 8, 2024 – March 22, 2024 at 9:00 AM UTC

[h3][color=#89CFF0][b]Winner Announcement[/b][/color][/h3]
March 27, 2024

[h3][color=#FFAC1C][b]Event Mechanics[/b][/color][/h3]

[h3][b]▶ How to play?[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Select 1 out of the 3 in-game locations from the screenshots below.

[quote] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e3fd81001fece68691f5ddbef118f481ea35e2af.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/cb567d4399b1f23c36b87566fe80946228fd27cb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/d15708b4f38a2463b13a94d147c1698f04b34fa6.png[/img][/quote]
[*] Capture a screenshot of your chosen in-game location with your character at the same spot in-game.
[*] Upload your entry to [url=https://www.closersonline.com/forum/art-media?sub=66]https://www.closersonline.com/forum/art-media?sub=66[/url] along with your Closers Name and Character Name.
[*] Participants with accurate screenshots will be included in the random pool, and 5 of them will win 1,000 N-Coins each![/list]
[h3][b]▶ How to join?[/b][/h3]
[olist][*]Choose 1 location from our screenshot selection and take a screenshot on the same location with your character (make sure the Character Name is visible & input your Closers Name and Character Name with your entry).[/*][*]Log-in to your Closers account to our official website: [url=https://www.closersonline.com/signin][b]https://www.closersonline.com/signin[/b][/url][/*][*]After you're logged-in, click [b][Forum][/b] > [b][Art & Media][/b] > [b][Event][/b] Tab[/*][*]Upload the screenshot of your choice and post it to the [b][Event][/b] Tab[/*][*]Entries should be in PNG or JPG format only with image specification: Above 1080 x 1080 px / Less than 4MB.[/*][*]Participants are allowed to edit or change their screenshot entries as much as they wish during the event period.[/*][/olist]
[h3][color=#FFAC1C][b]Criteria for Judging[/b][/color][/h3]

[h3][b]▶ The accuracy of the screenshot from the original shots:[/b][/h3]
[olist][*]Location[/*][*]Background[/*][/olist]※ The characters and their outfits used in the entries won't be considered in the judging criteria, feel free to use any!

[h3][color=#FFAC1C][b]Rewards[/b][/color][/h3]
[list][b][*]1,000 N-Coins for a total of 5 winners.[/*][*]The winners will be chosen with a random generator.[/*][/b][/list][olist][*]Winners will be announced on March 27 (Wednesday) UTC through the website, SNS, and their screenshot entries will be featured on the Closers forums.[/*][*]The rewards will be distributed during the maintenance after the winners' announcement.[/*][/olist]
[h3][color=#FFAC1C][b]Requirements[/b][/color][/h3]

[h3][b]▶ The following must be accomplished while taking the screenshot to make it a valid entry:[/b][/h3][olist][*]Make sure that your character name can be clearly seen in the screenshot; otherwise, the entry will be invalid.[/*][*]Make sure that the event mechanics and rules were followed accordingly (see Event Rules below).[/*][*]You can only join once [b][1 Closers account = 1 Screenshot][/b] during this event.[/*][/olist]
[h3][color=#FFAC1C][b]Event Rules[/b][/color][/h3]
[olist][*]Only one entry is allowed per Closers account.[/*][*]All entries must be made by the submitter specifically for the purpose of this contest.[/*][*]All participants should include their Closers Name and Character Name when submitting their entry; otherwise, the whole entry will be invalid.[/*][*]No explicit contents are allowed to be seen in the entry.
