notes.title: February 28th Update Patch Notes [Updated]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f10dd0533fb0c9b4f9f30523c0b8a37268e9935f.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]1. New Town <World Peace Plaza> & <Origin Wheel>[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Town ‘World Peace Plaza’ has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]‘World Peace Plaza’ is the next story area after 'Command and control room, New Seoul branch'.[/*][*]You can accept ‘Gathering Flames’ quest from <Miniwheel> at Command and Control room, New Seoul branch Town and play it after completing ‘Concluded’ Quest with the character of 92Level or above.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Town ‘Origin Wheel’ has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]You can enter ‘Origin Wheel’ Town by accepting ‘Behind the Broadcast’ Quest from <Simon Park> NPC after completing ‘Unexpected Uninvited Guest’ quest at World Peace Plaza Town with the character of 92 level or above.[/*][*]‘World Peace Plaza’ and ‘Origin Wheel’ can be transferred to each other through ‘Origin Wheel Transfer Beam’ in Town by accepting the Behind the Broadcast Quest.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ ‘World Peace Plaza’ Area Dungeons have been added.[/b][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/3fac88276e6f7287055fc3ecec02964981ae3a66.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Season 4 Update and New Town ‘World Peace Plaza’ related other updates.[/b][/color]
[list][*]World Peace Plaza Area Progress Reward has been added.[/*][*]Season 4 Channel has been added.[/*][list][*] You can acquire additional exp by playing dungeons in ‘World Peace Plaza’, ‘Origin Wheel’ Area from Season 4 Channel.[/list][*]‘World Peace Plaza’ has been added to Crew Reputation.[/*][*]Dungeon clear mission in ‘World Peace Plaza’ Area has been added to Crew Weekly/Daily mission.[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]2. New Operation Area <Operation: Flame Wave>[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New Operation Area <Operation: Flame Wave> has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]You can enter ‘Operation: Flame Wave’ by <Origin Wheel situation monitor> NPC at ‘Origin Wheel’ Town, after completing ‘And Holy Lance’ Quest from <Soohyun> NPC.[/*][*]Characters of level 95 can participate ‘Operation: Flame Wave’.[/*][*]‘Operation: Flame Wave’ is divided into ‘1-player (single) Mission’ and ‘4-players Mission’, which can be opened by entrance UI from <Origin Wheel Situation Monitor> where you can check dungeon type, clear reward, and entrance restriction count.[/*][*]You can change the mission and reward by [Refresh] at ‘1-player (single) Mission’ Dungeon.[/*][*][Refresh] is available once a day for free and will require credit consumed after that.[/*][*][Refresh] will not renew ‘4-players Mission’.[/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/0c709704fc0e70dd3a2dfaf58ec8300ddf2c0528.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ ‘1-player (Single) Mission’ Dungeon is consisted of 12 types.[/b][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/38df98f52d4945a31bb0dd32bc9bc1c8f938d7ad.png[/img][list][*]The ‘1-player (single) Mission’ Dungeon is available according to each rate, and when you clear it and receive the reward, another ‘1-player (single) Mission’ Dungeon becomes available on the map depending on the rate.[/*][*]If there are acquirable clear rewards at the ‘1-player(single) Mission’ Dungeon, player cannot enter another ‘1-player (single) Mission’ Dungeon.[/*][*]‘1-player (single) Mission’ Dungeon can no longer be entered once the available number of rewards received reaches 0.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ ‘4 players Mission’ Dungeon consists of 3 types.[/b][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/3cf42bf5dfdb1c6356996f887354c172c466ec0d.png[/img]
[list][*]In ‘4-players Mission’ Dungeon, each fixed dungeon appears for each day of the week.[/*][*]The <New Seoul Boss Box>, which can be obtained when clearing the ‘4-person mission’ dungeon, allows you to obtain the following items depending on the probability when opened.
: Chromatic Phase Essence, Sticky Residue, Normal D Component: Gear, Splendid D Component: Gear, Normal D Component: Costume, Splendid D Component: Costume, Gear Booster Fortifier, Perfect PNA Evolution Kit, Overclock Chip[/*][*]When entering ‘Mirror Hell: Crossroads’ Dungeon, you will be entered into ‘One-eyed Chaser: Kang Lim’ or ‘Mirror Paradise: Bihyung’ Dungeon according to the set rate.[/*][*]‘4-players Mission’ Dungeon is recommended to proceed with 4 players, and there is no restriction on the number of entrances. However, after receiving a reward, Entrance and Retry are available, but receiving additional rewards is not available.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ <Operation: Flame Wave> Rewards have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]The number of times you can obtain the ‘Operation: Flame Wave’ Reward applies to each character.[/*][*]The number of times you can obtain ‘Operation: Flame Wave’ rewards is reset every day at 4:00 AM UTC.[/*][*]The number of times ‘4-players Mission’ reward can be obtained is once per day and is charged a maximum of once.[/*][*]‘1 player (single) Mission’ Reward acquirable count’ is charged 3 times daily when logging in, and accumulatively charged up to a maximum of 6 times.[/*][/list]※ Some reward items do not match the trade specification information listed in the tooltip.
You can check the actual Trade Specification by hovering your mouse over the ⓘ icon next to ‘Receive Reward’ in the Clear Reward area in the Flame Wave Entrance UI.


[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Scavenger Reward has been added to <Operation: Flame Wave> Dungeon.[/b][/color]
[list][*]5 types of Scavengers are available depending on the probability when entering ‘Operation: Flame Wave' Dungeon, and you can acquire rewards by defeating it.[/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8692c0c633b6a8ec2d075500c7d61b4013f3fbeb.png[/img]


[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Gate Wave Dungeon Specification has been changed.[/b][/color]
[list][*]<Operation: Gate Wave> [Party] Dungeon has been changed to ‘Gate Wave: Subjugation’ Dungeon.[/*][*]One of the monsters among ‘Mirror Grabber Nitocris’, ‘Lightning Kiten’, and ‘Yod's Domain’ appears at ‘Gate Wave: Subjugation’ Dungeon, and Golden Scavenger doesn't appear.[/*][*]‘Gate Wave: Subjugation’ Dungeon can be entered by <New Seoul Branch Situation Monitor> NPC at ‘Command and Control Room, New Seoul Branch’, or <Combined Dungeon Entry - Gaston> NPC at ‘Noah's Museum’ Area.[/*][*]‘Gate Wave: Subjugation’ Dungeon Specification[/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/b9007b6a75fa2e31f4356a71b406a54443c7cfff.png[/img][list][*]Dungeon Main Rewards[/*][list][*] Guaranteed drop Reward when defeating boss: Induced sleep ticket, UNION tactics analysis file, UNION battle analysis report.[/*][*] Gear Craft/Upgrade Material Drop has been doubled up compared to before.[/*][*] Dungeon Clear Rate Reward: Program bio-verification key.[/*][*] The existing <Operation: Gate Wave> 1-player dungeon and [Party] dungeon missions will end, and mission rewards can be obtained through <Operation: Flame Wave>.[/*][/list][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The contents below have been modified in accordance with the addition of <Operation: Flame Wave> and changes to the dungeon specifications of <Operation: Gate Wave>.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Content related to <Operation: Gate Wave> has been deleted from the in-game guide, and content related to <Operation: Mission> has been added.[/*][*]NPC <New Seoul Branch Remote Monitor - Edgar EX> has been deleted from ‘Noah’s Museum’ and ‘The end: The world in flames’ towns.[/*][*]NPC <Origin Wheel Remote Monitor - Edgar EX> has been added to ‘Noah's Museum’ and ‘The end: The world in flames’ Town.
You can play the ‘Operation: Flame Wave’ dungeon through this entry.[/*][*]UNION Watch Dungeon Mission has been added. (Order: Flame Wave)[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]3. New Gear Additional[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ ‘World Peace Plaza’ Area's New Gear Item and Material Item have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]1 type of Module and 9 types of Trinkets (3 sets of 3 types) for each attack type have been added.[/*][*]Major craft and upgrade material items ‘New Seoul Damage Analysis Report’ and ‘New Seoul Disaster Analysis File’ can be obtained through the <Operation: Flame Wave> mission.[/*][*]When basic-crafting new Module Gear, Phase Gear Level is 230, and when upgrading to ‘Super’ level, Phase Gear Level is 240.[/*][*]When basic-crafting new Trinket Gear, Phase Gear Level is 220, and when upgrading to ‘Super’ level, Phase Gear Level is 230.[/*][*]New Gear Enhancement Transfer/Salvage Group has been added.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ 1 type of New Module <Fury Fire>[/b][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/32a62c442c1ebbd1dd90e4b5ba42129863620cf6.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ 3 types of New Trinket <Mirror Dimension>[/b][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/3e97ae356462d9c42e227d1baeab505f1d401d22.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ 3 types of New Trinket <One-eyed Jack>[/b][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e4cfc518620982d82d3aad1c842ae7788c8e45fe.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ 3 types of New Trinket <Fury Fire>[/b][/color]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/3d5c64ec1f109b2cbbd04dca0f8bda703ab506da.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]4. Shop NPC Change[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Shop NPC's name and modeling have been changed.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Shop NPC name at every town and dungeon has been changed.[/*][*]Change: <Shop - Vending Machine> → <Shop - Pheasant>[/*][*]Shop NPC's appearance and dialogue at every town and dungeon have been changed.[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]5. Rapid Growth System[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Rapid Growth system has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Rapid Growth allows your character over a certain level to grow until the specific specification by using the item.[/*][*]‘One-shot Growth Lv. 92’ item to use Rapid Growth system has been added.[/*][*]Rapid Growth specification that uses ‘One-shot Growth Lv. 92’.[/*][*]Visit the [url=https://www.closersonline.com/news/jumping-event-guide-rapid-growth-system--OiuLKF895][b]Jumping Event Guide[/b][/url] for more details on creating a character during the Jump Event![/*][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/4e779a62a861c6283bb9c178e27ff609f26842da.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]6. Max. Level Expansion[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The maximum level of all characters has been expanded. (Lv. 92 → Lv.95)[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ A new item has been added as the character maximum level expansion.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Target Item: Omega Equalizer (Lv. 93~100)[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ As the maximum character level has been expanded, the wearable levels of some quest and material items have changed.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The character level accomplishment achievement has been added by expanding the character's maximum level.[/b][/color]


[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]7. NPC Modeling Renew[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Ingame modeling of some NPCs has been revamped.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Target Character: Bitna, Carol, Susan, Yujung Kim, Jungmi Woo, Bona Choi[/*][/list]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]Other Updates[/b][/color][/h3]
 
[b]▶ Some specifications of Prelude quest dungeon have been changed.[/b][list][*] Normal and boss monster HP has been lowered.[*] The boss monster mutation type display in The Dungeon entry has been deleted.[*] Dungeon phase gear level restrictions have been removed.[/list]
[b]▶ The difficulty of three Tragedy of a flame: Encore dungeons have been eased.[/b][list][*] The damage and defense stats of Lovecraft, Annabelle, and Tindalos have been lowered by about 20%.[*] The ‘Dimension Distortion Field’ stamina of 3 types of monsters has been reduced, and the character has been adjusted to inflict more damage without using ‘Phase Awakening’.[*] The cooldown of Lovecraft's press attack that is activated during ‘I’m outside of the factory! There’s no stop button!’, and ‘Dance! Faster, faster!’ has been adjusted.[*] The cooldown of Annabelle’s random laser attack during ‘Nano cannon, full burst!’ and the random shield attack during ‘I will borrow the power of alliance.’ have been adjusted.[*] The cooldown of Tindalos’ random flame attack during ‘The flame of the clan, let be the same as baptism.’ and the random energy sphere attack during ‘Flame, protect your servant.’ has been adjusted.[/list]
[b]▶ Farming Guide has been improved.[/b][list][*] Information on costumes that can be obtained as drops for each farming dungeon has been added.[/list]
[b]▶ Some phrases in the game related to mutation have been modified.[/b][list][*] Modified detail: ‘Mutant Type’ → ‘Reaction Type’, ‘Mutant Level Total’ → ‘Mutant Level’[/list]
[b]▶ Some item names and item descriptions have been modified as the maximum character level has been expanded.[/b]

[b]▶ Emotion Ticket/Skill Ticket items have been changed to be available for shop sale and repurchase.[/b]

[b]▶ NPC Noah's name at Noah's Museum has been modified.[/b][list][*] Modified detail: <Area Transfer / Create Crew - Noah> → <Area Transfer / Create Crew / Brazier Buff - Noah>[/list]
[b]▶ Sector Pass - Gate Wave: Subjugation Item has been added to Sector Pass Selectable Box ver.2.1.[/b]

[b]▶ Additional improvements for J and Harpy Characters' modeling have been proceeded.[/b]

notes.title: Jumping Event Guide (Rapid Growth System)
notes.content:
Hello Agents!

As we celebrate the 6th Anniversary Jumping Event, you're faced with two exciting options to level up your Closer. Which characters should you go for this time?

Choose between two fantastic options: jump a character during selection or claim the One-shot Growth Lv.92! These choices are available once per character, and the decision is yours to make. Join us in exploring these options!
 
[h3][url=https://www.closersonline.com/news/6th-anniversary-celebration-jumping-union-pass-n-coin-bonus-and-more--o9jiQZ876][u][b]■ New Character Only: Jumping by Jumping Ticket[/b][/u][/url][/h3]
[list][*][b]Summary[/b]: Create only one new character during the 1st Jump Event by using the Jumping Ticket to instantly level it up to Lv. 92 during character creation![/*][/list]
[quote]Note: No assistance is available for character deletion, changing jumping characters, or recovering jumping tickets, even if a jumping ticket was used to create an unwanted character or a contract was made incorrectly with a regular character.[/quote]
 
[h3][b]Steps to Jump a Character by Jumping Ticket![/b][/h3]

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/5da4d0956912494c8b21a6f9b898c1ce4723ee07.png[/img][/td][td]
Upon logging into the game, you will immediately see the following message in the character waiting room.

Click 'Contract' to access the character creation window.
[/td][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/0ca7cd35ca9286e3e53a2833eeb31686fb1df5bf.png[/img][/td][td]

[b]Please ensure that you have selected the character you want to Jump.[/b]

After selecting the character that you wish to create as a jumping character, click the [Contract JUMPING] button.

[/td][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/32fd94d664dc2fe38312aa25930fd3649310bf1b.png[/img][/td][td]Select the ‘6th Anniv. Jumping!’ Ticket and click ‘Use’[/td][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/595d86ffa32498150f6306698a8af0c30d934365.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/cd81c70d57b0c43ed2e3eab051e13875409c01c3.png[/img][/td][td]
Enter the name of the character you wish to use and proceed to create the character.

[b]Double-check your name, as it will be your character's final name![/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/40c8bbded841145bb56e2b2e0f49573abf0b3c67.png[/img][/td][td]This is the final notice that the character will be created as a Jump character! Select 'Ok' to proceed.[/td][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/c368c00bebb70caabac7d447aca50dd2faf88e17.png[/img][/td][td]
You can choose between going through a tutorial or skipping it.

Congratulations, Agent! You have successfully created your Jump character!
[/td][/tr][/table]
 
 
[h3][url=https://www.closersonline.com/news/2nd-jumping-new-or-existing-max-level-expansion-operation-flame-wave-Tu927K890][u][b]■ Existing Characters Less than Lv.92 or New Character: Jumping by using One-shot Growth Lv.92 Item[/b][/u][/url][/h3]
[list][*][b]Summary[/b]: Select an existing character (Less than Lv.92) or create a new character to reach Lv.92 during the 2nd Jump Event using the [One-shot Growth Lv. 92] item from the in-game Event Tab![/*][/list]
[quote]Note: Obtain the [One-shot Growth Lv. 92] only once per account during the event period for characters under level 92.

Changing characters, canceling item use, or restoring items after rapid growth using the 'One-shot Growth Lv. 92' item is not possible. Please use the 'One-shot Growth Lv. 92' item specifically for the desired character.[/quote]

[h3][b]Steps to Jump a Character by using a [One-shot Growth Lv. 92] item![/b][/h3]

[table][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/7afe7239561fc9f2d4719a73db4f6212de09acd4.png[/img][/td][td]

Upon logging into the game with your character, proceed to check the Event menu and look for the '2nd Jumping Event' tab.

Obtain the [One-shot Growth Lv. 92] which will direct to your character's inventory. Right-click on the item to use it.

[u][b]Important Note[/b][/u]:[b] Make sure that you are activating it on the right character.[/b]

[b]Avoid claiming and using this item on the character where you used the Jump Ticket or on a Lv.92 character to fully utilize the Jump level experience.[/b]

[/td][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/dbc34b3617c1c004d5a38d48ea05d4faf4a89368.png[/img][/td][td]
A pop-up window will appear with information about the Rapid Growth System.

After confirming, click the [Rapid Growth] button.
[/td][/tr][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/0524ec9cbd51918bf0b180617f078101289f59c6.png[/img][/td][td]
The Rapid Growth System notice is displayed.

This serves as the final notice before using the [One-shot Growth Lv. 92].

[b]Please carefully review the notice before proceeding.[/b]

Click 'Ok' if you have finished reading and wanted to proceed.

Congratulations, Agent! You have successfully created your Jump character!
[/td][/tr][/table]
Thank you, Agents, for navigating through this guide.
If you have any concerns or bug reports, you can submit a [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna][b]1:1 Inquiry[/b][/url] or send us an email at [b]support@closersonline.com[/b].

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,
    
We would like to inform you about an upcoming update regarding the reward claim count for New Area World Peace Plaza - Flame Wave which will be updated during the scheduled server maintenance on February 28th.    
    
Please note that Flame Wave's reward claim count is shared with the existing Gate Wave.    
    
Therefore, if you play Gate Wave and receive rewards between the reset at 4:00 AM UTC on February 28th and before maintenance time, please be aware that you will not be able to receive rewards from 'Flame Wave' as many as you claimed rewards from Gate Wave on that day after the update.    
    
Please refer to the information provided above to avoid any inconvenience while playing Closers.    
We will do our best to introduce more interesting content and events to all of you.

notes.title: Agents Love Adventures - Screenshot Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/4dc3934ae4600acb937ce5337e3633829f7fb234.png[/img]
 
[h3][b]Event Period[/b][/h3][list][*]February 7, 2023 – February 23, 2023 at 2:59 PM UTC[/*][*]February 7, 2023 – February 23, 2023 at 6:59 AM PST[/*][*]February 7, 2023 – February 23, 2023 at 9:59 PM GMT+7[/*][/list]
[h3][b]Event Mechanics[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]How to join?[/b][/*][/list][olist][*]Log-in to your Closers account to the Closers website: [url=https://www.closersonline.com/signin][b]https://www.closersonline.com/signin[/b][/url][/*][*]After you logged-in, click on the following links according to the category that you will join:[list][*][url=https://www.closersonline.com/forum/thread/143][b]Solo Category - Agents Love Adventures Event Link[/b][/url][/*][*][url=https://www.closersonline.com/forum/thread/144][b]Pairs Category - Agents Love Adventures Event Link[/b][/url][/*][*][url=https://www.closersonline.com/forum/thread/145][b]Group Category - Agents Love Adventures Event Link[/b][/url][/*][/list][/*][/olist][list][*]Entries should be on PNG or JPG format only with image specification: Above 1080 x 1080 px / Less than 4MB.[/*][*]Use the in-game 'Selfie' feature or directly take a screenshot according to the following:[/*][*][b]Solo Category (1 character only)[/b][list][*]Take a screenshot of your character with your [b]Closers name[/b] and [b]Character name[/b].[/*][*]Add a message expressing gratitude for yourself![/*][/list][/*][*][b]Pairs Category (2 characters only)[/b][list][*]Include a screenshot of two characters, whether your partner or a friend, with your [b]Closers names[/b] and [b]Character names[/b].[/*][*]Narrate your love story or express gratitude for that person.[/*][*]Only one member should post this entry as a representative.[/*][/list][/*][*][b]Group Category (Minimum of 3 - Maximum of 4 members per group)[/b][list][*]Include a screenshot of 3 to 4 characters, with your [b]Closers names [/b]and [b]Character names[/b].[/*][*]Share a group shot where all members fit in the screenshot. Share tales of your epic adventures or express gratitude for your friends or crewmates.[/*][*]Only one member should post this entry as a representative.[/*][/list][/*][/list][h3] [/h3][h3][b]Reward[/b][/h3][list][*][b]Two winners for the Solo Category = 1,000 N-coins for each winner![/b][/*][*][b]Two 'Pairs' (4 Individuals) will win for the Pairs Category = 1,000 N-coins for each winner![/b][/*][*][b]Two 'Groups' (6 - 8 Individuals) will win for the Group Category = 1,000 N-coins for each winner![/b][/*][/list][olist][*]Winners will be announced on February 28 (Wednesday) UTC through the website, SNS, and their screenshot entries will be featured on the Closers forums.[/*][*]The rewards will be distributed during the maintenance after the winners' announcement.[/*][/olist]
 
[h3][b]Requirements[/b][/h3][list][*]The following must be accomplished while taking the screenshot to make it a valid entry:[olist][*]Make sure that your character name can be clearly seen in the screenshot; otherwise, the entry will be invalid.[/*][*]Make sure that the event mechanics and rules were followed accordingly (see Event Rules below).[/*][*]You can only join once (1 Event entry = 1 Closers account) in any category during this event.[list][*]Example: If you already joined the ‘Solo’ category, your ‘Pairs’ or ‘Group’ entry will be invalid.[/*][/list][/*][/olist][/*][/list][h3][b]Event Rules[/b][/h3][olist][*]Only one entry is allowed per Closers account.[/*][*]All entries must be made by the submitter specifically for the purpose of this contest.[/*][*]All participants should include their Closers Name and Character Name when submitting their entry; otherwise, the whole entry will be invalid.[/*][*]No explicit contents are allowed to be seen in the entry. Any entry that can make others feel offended or uncomfortable will be removed with or without permission from the Naddic staff.[/*][*]Once an entry has been submitted, players agree to have their work published publicly on our official channels (Website, Steam, and SNS).[/*][*]If you have submitted more than one entry, we will only refer to the first entry submitted.[/*][*]If you need to change or edit your entry or post, remove your first entry, then re-submit it again before the event ends.[/*][*]The Naddic team can remove unrelated entries or discussions.[/*][*]The Naddic team is not liable for any violation of copyright or intellectual property. Any violations will be assumed by the event participant.[/*][*]Contact [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna][i]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna[/i][/url] or [i]support@closersonline.com[/i] for inquiries, concerns, or reports.[/*][/olist]

[b]Sample Entry (for Solo Category)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/d45b60ea0cae0c40257ffec09ac17ee3ecc738e2.png[/img][quote=author][b]I'm embracing every step, acknowledging my strength. I'm thankful for myself, and proud of the growth![/b]
[b]Closers Name: SOMA Character Name: QAsoma[/b][/quote]

[h3][b]Criteria for Judging[/b][/h3][list][*][b]35% Creativity and Originality of Screenshot[/b]
  ○ How well the screenshot captures the character, focusing on visual appeal, the name is clearly visible.
  ○ Unique and imaginative use of in-game elements to convey a romantic theme.
  ○ Clarity, quality, and resolution of the screenshot.
  ○ Skillful use of in-game graphics and settings to enhance visual appeal.[/*][*][b]35% Creativity and Originality of Message[/b]
  ○ How your message was thoughtfully created.
  ○ Emotional impact and the ability to evoke feelings of love through the message.[/*][*][b]20% Relevance to the theme[/b]
  ○ How closely do the screenshot and message resemble Love! How well it interprets to the judges the love theme.
  ○ Originality in expressing love within the game environment.
  ○ Representation of the Valentine's theme in a genuine and heartfelt manner.[/*][*][b]10% Audience Impact[/b]
  ○ Number of ‘❤️’ votes in your Closers Forum entry.[/*][/list]

Greetings Agents,

We will perform maintenance on the Closers World server according to the following schedule, based on your time zone:[list]

[*][b]UTC[/b]: February 7, 2024 from 5:00 AM to 10:00 AM
[*][b]PST:[/b] February 6, 2024 from 9:00 PM to February 7, 2024 2:00 AM

To stay up to date with news and other information, please visit our website or follow us on social media.

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]1. Phase Force Grand Sports Day Event[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Phase Force Grand Sports Day Events have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Event NPC <Commander Song> and <Mission Minder 'Edgar'> have been added to the Command and control room, New Seoul branch area.[/*][*]Event quest ‘A Dangerous Plan’ is available by accepting it with a character with Lv.90 and more from NPC <Miniwheel> at the Command and control room, New Seoul branch area.[/*][*]3 types of Phase Force Grand Sports Day event dungeons (6 types if quest dungeons are included) have been added.[/*][*]Phase Force Grand Sports Day event dungeon is available by proceeding event quest or by NPC <Mission Minder 'Edgar'> after completing it.[/*][/list]
[b]Phase Force Grand Sports Day event dungeon information is as follows.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/0db6e84d443ccde291d69ca5e010bd50d5037cc3.png[/img]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Sports Day Event Dungeon Clear Event has been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*] Event Dungeon is available once per account per day, and this restriction is for 3 types of dungeons, as a combined restriction. 
[*] You can acquire ‘Grand Sports Day Coin’ by defeating the boss monster at the event dungeon within a limited time. 
[*] You can gather ‘Grand Sports Day Coin’ to exchange various rewards at NPC <Shop - Vending machine>. 
[*] ‘Grand Sports Day Coin’ main rewards: ‘S Guaranteed D Component : Gear’, ‘Gold Medal is mine! Title Ticket’, ‘Gear Booster Fortifier’, ‘Han High School Gym Costume (C Type)’ 
[*] Event Reward ‘Han High School Gym Costume (C Type) Selectable Box’ can be moved to Account Storage, but the costume acquired by opening the box can't be moved to Account Storage.      
[*] Accessory costume that's acquirable as some of the event rewards can't be moved to Account Storage. (Except for Footprint, Eye Costume)
[*] Unused ‘Grand Sports Day Coin’ Items and related Exchange Shop will be removed on February 28, 2024 7:00 AM.
[*] Unused rewards and consumables from the event will be removed on December 31, 2024 9:00 AM.[/list]

[h3][color=#377bbf][b]Bug Fix[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The issue where a Chase judgment occurs when using Tina's 'EX Thunderbolt' skill in the air has been fixed.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The issue where teeth were not visible when using the Harpy emote has been fixed.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The issue in which some of Mantic's attacks and attack rendering did not match in the dungeons 'The Cave That Usurps the Throne' and 'The Cave That Defies Providence' has been fixed.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The issue where the mission clear text occasionally overlapped and appeared abnormal when reporting Matrix Dive operation results has been fixed.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The issue that the transparency of the Phase Wings increases and the town background is visible through the Phase Wings when equipping some of them has been fixed.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The issue where the location of Tina's 'Fly King's High Grace Phase Wings' costume was abnormally exposed has been fixed.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The issue where the ‘Sunbed’ emote was not activated when wearing mixed Beach costumes (Wangsan, Sokcho, or Naksan) has been fixed.[/b][/color]


[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]Etc.[/b][/color][/h3]
 
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The drop probability of Vulturous Burning Bearer epic gear has been increased.
▶ The validity check on the patcher has been changed to be not forcibly proceeded. For any concerns, please use the manual check by clicking the magnifying glass on the patcher. [/b][/color]

notes.title: January 10th Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f10dd0533fb0c9b4f9f30523c0b8a37268e9935f.png[/img]

[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]1. Polish skill 1 type added[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ 'Polish' skills for each character have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Passive skill 'Polish' can be opened and acquired when promoted to Prime Agent/Fatal Crew/Shadow Agent.[/*][*]To apply the polish effect, you must acquire the applicable (target) active skill to the highest level. [/*][*]When attacking using an active skill with Polish applied, Air Strike/Back Attack/Chase guaranteed judgment is applied to the additional attack by Polish.[/*][*]Additional attacks resulting from polish are not affected by Skill Level.[/*][/list]
[b]New Polish Skill[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/b6e46c7eed6fd56a10a4e89eef4d786359ef96d2.png[/img]
 
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]2. Character Skill Adjustment[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Some characters' skills have been adjusted.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Target characters: Seha, Sylvi, J, Misteltein, Harpy, Tina, Soma, Cheolsu Kim, Aeri[/*][*]Some of the Skill Tooltips have been amended according to the skill adjustment. [/*][/list]
[b]Skill Adjustment Details[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/1dd104cbdebcf083d90df91efa960a3ea763e6ce.png[/img]
 
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]3. Sound stereo effect function added[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The volume decreases depending on the distance from which the sound occurs, and sound is output in left and right directions depending on the location of the sound.[/b][/color]
[list][*]You can set the function by checkbox from [Settings] > [Sound] > [Remove distance/direction sound effects].[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]4. Night Maze Dungeon improvement[/b][/color][/h3]
 
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The popup message display time has been reduced when moving to the Night Maze Dungeon stage.[/b][/color]
 
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Improvements have been made so that up to 2 recovery potions can be used in Night Maze Dungeon.[/b][/color]
 
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The amount of acquirable clues has increased in some stages of Night Maze Dungeon.[/b][/color]
 
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The Difficulty of Night Maze Hidden Boss ‘Camilla’ has been adjusted downward.[/b][/color]


[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]5. J/Harpy Character modeling improvement[/b][/color][/h3]
 
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ J and Harpy's Characters' modeling has been improved.[/b][/color]
[list][*]J and Harpy's Characters' face modeling has been improved. [/*][*]The costume worn around the character's face has been changed to match the improved modeling. [/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]6.  PNA Awakening strain Balance Adjustment[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Awakening strain's ‘Enforced Breakthrough’ synergy effect has been changed.[/b][/color]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Some of Awakened Genes' detailed effects in the Awakening strain have been adjusted.[/b][/color]
 
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Some Awakened Gene effects have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Target Awakended Gene: ‘Attack: Strong blow’, ‘All-round: Strong blow’, ‘Special skill: Strong blow’[/*][/list]
[h3][color=#5f95cc][b]7. Landing Maneuver Changed[/b][/color][/h3]
 
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ All characters have been changed to be able to use the Landing Maneuver.[/b][/color]
 
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Super Armor (1 Level) Status is changed to apply during Landing Maneuver activation.[/b][/color]
 
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The Landing Maneuver's movement distance has been changed to increase in proportion to the character's Movement Speed ability.[/b][/color]
 
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The damage reduction option applied to some characters has been removed.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Character: Soma, Bai, Seth, Cheolsu Kim, Mirae, Eunha, Lucy, Aeri[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The cancellation method for Landing Maneuver Status has been changed.[/b][/color]
[list][*]When the Arrow Key is pressed while the Landing Maneuver is in effect, the Landing Maneuver Status is not canceled and has been changed to move in the input direction.[/*][*]While Landing Maneuver is in effect, Landing Maneuver Status has been changed to be canceled by pressing the ‘dash + jump key’.  [/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Some characters' Landing Maneuver method and motion have been changed.[/b][/color]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Greetings Agents,

We will perform maintenance on the Closers World server according to the following schedule, based on your time zone:[list]

[*][b]UTC[/b]: December 27, 2023 from [b]7:00 AM[/b] to [b]10:00 AM[/b]
[*][b]PST:[/b] December 26, 2023 from [b]11:00 PM[/b] to December 27, 2023 [b]2:00 AM[/b]
[*][b]GMT+7:[/b] December 27, 2023 from [b]2:00 PM[/b] to [b]5:00 PM[/b][/list]
Please log out of the game before maintenance begins. During this period, you will not be able to access the game, and the website may not function properly.

To stay up to date with news and other information, please visit our website or follow us on social media.

[list][*][b][url=https://www.facebook.com/ClosersGame]Official Closers Facebook Fanpage[/url][/b][/*][*][b][url=https://twitter.com/ClosersGame]Official Closers Twitter Page[/url][/b][/*][*][b][url=http://discord.gg/UkDuWZzByb]Official Closers Discord Server[/url][/b][/*][*][b][url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCSKUaz4gOXhj8160Xjbeb-g/featured]Official Closers YouTube Channel[/url][/b][/*][/list]
We appreciate your patience and understanding!

If you have any concerns or bug reports, you may send us an inquiry or an email to: [url=support@closersonline.com]support@closersonline.com[/url]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f10dd0533fb0c9b4f9f30523c0b8a37268e9935f.png[/img]

[h3][color=#377bbf][b]1. New Contents ‘Flame's Finale’ [/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New dungeon ‘Flame's Finale’ has been added. [/b][/color]
[list][*]‘Flame’s Finale’ dungeon can be entered by Flame’s Finale tab of <MissionMinder - Count D's Moris> at <The end: The world in flames> town after completing the preceding quest.    [/*][*]If you complete all Flame King Advance party quests, you can receive and proceed with the ‘script 0 and 1’ quest, and upon completing the quest ‘script 4, and grand finale’, you can enter the ‘Flame’s Finale’ dungeon.[/*][*]‘Flame’s Finale’ dungeon can be entered by consuming entry item ‘Invitation to the Finale’ x2.[/*][/list]

[list][*]When you defeat the boss in the ‘Flame’s Finale’ dungeon, you can definitely obtain the ‘Burning Throbbing Heart' item and the ‘Flame King’s OOPArts Box’, and you can obtain Flame’s Finale accessory of 3 kinds as a drop according to each probability.[/*][*]Vulturous Burning Bearer Amplifier and accessory, Illust armband, Phase wings, Footprint, Burning Throbbing Heart item and more can be obtained from ‘Flame King's OOPArts Box’ according to each probability. [/*][/list][list][*]The following are how to acquire ‘Invitation to the Finale’ item: [list][*]Obtainable by drop with a chance when clearing <Tragedy of a flame: Encore> 3 types of dungeons, and can be obtained as a weekly reward in the 'Castle of Darkness' dungeon.    [/*][*]Obtainable by weekly reward when clearing <Farce of a Flame> advance party.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ ‘Flame’s Finale’ accessory of 3kinds and Figure emotion have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Flame’s Finale accessory of 3 kinds: ‘Presence of Revered God’, ‘Liver Pecking Spear of Bird’, ‘Chains Tied to Rocky Mountain’[/*][*]Three types of Flame’s Finale accessories can be crafted in the craft machine with additional items and credits, including the ‘Burning Throbbing Heart’ item.[/*][*]You can create a ‘Flame King’s Collection Box’ with ‘Burning Throbbing Heart’, and when you open the ‘Flame King’s Collection Box’, you can obtain either the ‘Burning Throbbing Heart’ item (min 1 ~ max 500) or ‘Frozen Throbbing Heart’ item depending on each probability. [/*][*]You can craft a ‘Flame’s Finale Emotion Ticket’ with the ‘Frozen Throbbing Heart’ item.[/*][*][Figure standing: Flame’s Finale] emote can be acquired using ‘Flame’s Finale Emotion Ticket’.[/*][/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Flame’s Finale achievement and rewards have been added.[/b][/color]
[list][*]Achievement to clear Flame’s Finale has been added. [/*][*]Depending on the number of achievements you achieve, you can receive various rewards such as ‘Visual Frame Ticket: Flames of Liberated Inferno’, ‘Name Tag Ticket: Blooming Ember of Greed’, and more. [/*][/list]

[b]▶ The issue where the boss cut scene and pop-up display timing did not match with the voice in the pattern of ‘You aren’t going to stop now, are you? A bit more! Enjoy!' of Flame King Advance party ‘Prometheus’ has been fixed.[/b]

[b]▶ The issue where arrow key input was not possible when using the Harpy's [Mystic Tempest] skill has been fixed. [/b]

[b]▶ The issue where arrow key input was not possible when using the Harpy's [Joint skill: Queen of Hearts: Urgent Deployment B] skill has been fixed.[/b]

[b]▶ The issue where the Ultimate Move motion is paused temporarily when hit by a time stop attack while using the Ultimate Move skill has been fixed.[/b]

[b]▶ After the Ultimate Move skill ends, the invincibility effect has been improved to apply for 1.5 seconds.[/b]

I would like to tell this with caution and an apologetic heart.
We are aware that there may be inconveniences in using the newly revamped Black Market.
We plan to prepare a new Black Market that encompasses both the convenience of the existing one and the new features of the revamped one, however, this seems likely to take a considerable amount of time. We will share any news via another notice again when we can expect any detailed schedule.
We will do our best to present a clearly improved Black Market to Agents.

Wishing a Happy Birthday to Harpy, the Dynamic Combatant! Her journey to her current role is a testament to her versatility. Wishing her a day as swift and graceful as her combat skills and a future full of dynamic challenges!

Don’t be late! This event only runs for only 24 hours.

notes.title: Scheduled Server Maintenance - December 13th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Greetings Agents,

We will perform maintenance on the Closers World server according to the following schedule, based on your time zone:[list]

[*][b]UTC[/b]: December 13, 2023 from [b]5:00 AM[/b] to [b]10:00 AM[/b]
[*][b]PST:[/b] December 12, 2023 from [b]9:00 PM[/b] to December 13, 2023 [b]2:00 AM[/b]
[*][b]GMT+7:[/b] December 13, 2023 from [b]12:00 PM[/b] to [b]5:00 PM[/b][/list]
Please log out of the game before maintenance begins. During this period, you will not be able to access the game, and the website may not function properly.

To stay up to date with news and other information, please visit our website or follow us on social media.

notes.title: Known Issue Notice - November 23rd
notes.content:
Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you of the known issues that were found in-game after the November 22nd maintenance.

[list]
[*] [b]Castle of Darkness Portal.[/b] When solo clearing the dungeon, the portal to transfer the player to the second stage of Gildal does not appear sometimes, and this happens occasionally when playing in crew as well.  
[*] [b]Castle of Darkness general bugs.[/b]  Some other known issues related to the dungeon have been also spotted, such as reviving teammates or inactivated effects.[/list] 
While we look into this matter, we ask for more information, such as the time it occurred and your Client
Log file to help determine the cause as quickly as possible. To find the log file, please follow these steps:


Closers folder → Log folder → CW_(date)_(time).log file 

[color=#9c9994](eg: CW_20201030_222408.log)[/color]

 
We apologize for any inconvenience caused and will do our best to fix these issues.

Thank you for your understanding!

You may send us an inquiry or an email to: support@closersonline.com with the information above or any other concern.

notes.title: Scheduled Server Maintenance - November 22nd
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Greetings Agents,

We will perform maintenance on the Closers World server according to the following schedule, based on your time zone:[list]

[*][b]UTC[/b]: November 22nd, 2023 from [b]07:00 AM[/b] to [b]10:00 AM[/b]
[*][b]PT:[/b] November 21st, 2023 from [b]23:00 PM[/b] to November 22nd [b]02:00 AM[/b]
[*][b]GMT+7:[/b] November 22nd, 2023 from [b]14:00 PM[/b] to [b]17:00 PM[/b][/list]
Please log out of the game before maintenance begins. During this period, you will not be able to access the game, and the website may not function properly.

To stay up to date with news and other information, please visit our website or follow us on social media.

[list][*][b][url=https://www.facebook.com/ClosersGame]Official Closers Facebook Fanpage[/url][/b][/*][*][b][url=https://twitter.com/ClosersGame]Official Closers Twitter Page[/url][/b][/*][*][b][url=http://discord.gg/UkDuWZzByb]Official Closers Discord Server[/url][/b][/*][*][b][url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCSKUaz4gOXhj8160Xjbeb-g/featured]Official Closers YouTube Channel[/url][/b][/*][/list]

notes.title: Scheduled Server Maintenance - November 8th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Greetings Agents,

We will perform maintenance on the Closers World server according to the following schedule, based on your time zone:[list]

[*][b]UTC[/b]: November 8th,, 2023 at [b]05:00 AM[/b] to [b]10:00 AM[/b] UTC
[*][b]PT:[/b] November 7th, 2023 from [b]23:00 PM[/b] to November 8th [b]02:00 AM[/b]
[*][b]GMT+7:[/b] November 8th, 2023 from [b]14:00 PM[/b] to [b]17:00 PM[/b][/list]
Please log out of the game before maintenance begins. During this period, you will not be able to access the game, and the website may not function properly.

To stay up to date with news and other information, please visit our website or follow us on social media.

[list][*][b][url=https://www.facebook.com/ClosersGame]Official Closers Facebook Fanpage[/url][/b][/*][*][b][url=https://twitter.com/ClosersGame]Official Closers Twitter Page[/url][/b][/*][*][b][url=http://discord.gg/UkDuWZzByb]Official Closers Discord Server[/url][/b][/*][*][b][url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCSKUaz4gOXhj8160Xjbeb-g/featured]Official Closers YouTube Channel[/url][/b][/*][/list]
We appreciate your patience and understanding!

If you have any concerns or bug reports, you may send us an inquiry or an email to: [url=support@closersonline.com]support@closersonline.com[/url]

[url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/09e80334f73f4ab5dc983f95743d961b7394fa33.png[/img][/url]

- 2 kinds for each type of Physical, Psi, and Hybrid have been added for Flame King Epic Core.

- 3 kinds for each type of Physical, Psi, and Hybrid have been added for Flame King Epic Module.

- Each of the 3 Flame King Epic Modules has Air Strike/Chase/Back Attack conditional effect properties applied. 

- You can wear up to 3 Flame King Epic Modules, and when you wear 2 or more, 2 Set Effects are applied.

- Flame King Epic Module Set Effect is not compatible with Gluttony Module/Lusty Module/Overflowing Lusty Module/Sloth Module/Precise Sloth Module gear. 

- Flame King Epic Module can be equipped in duplicate with other modules such as Gluttony Module/Lust Module/Overflowing Lust Module/Sloth Module/Refined Sloth Module and more.

[h3][color=#377bbf][b]3. New battle pattern <Dimension distortion field>[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New battle pattern <Dimension distortion field> has been added. [/b][/color]

- Dimension distortion field is a combat pattern that opens and activates its power when a monster protected by the Flame Sanctuary reaches a certain level of stamina.  

- When the Dimension Distortion Field is activated, a shield spreads around the monster, and the durability of the shield is displayed in a gauge bar above the monster's head.

- The durability of the dimension distortion field's shield can be consumed by damaging it with attacks, and when attacking in a phase awakening state, the durability of the shield is consumed quickly.  

- When the type of phase awakening is high, the damage that goes into the shield of the Dimension distortion field increases. 

- The monster's next action is determined depending on whether the shield is destroyed within the time limit.

- The durability level of the shield increases when playing in a party. 

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Dimension distortion field guide has been added to the in-game help (H). [/b][/color]

[h3][color=#377bbf][b]5. ‘Post-processing effect’ function [/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Game screen filter function, ‘Post-processing effect’ has been added.[/b][/color]

- You can see the Post-processing effect settings pop-up window by clicking the [Post-processing effect] button in the fixed menu at the bottom, after clicking the [Menu] button or pressing the [ESC] key to open the quick menu.

- The [Post-processing effect] button has been added to the bottom fixed menu, and the existing [Guide] menu button has been moved to page 2 of the top menu list.

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Detail control function of ‘Post-processing effect’ has been added. [/b][/color]

- You can adjust the source of light, depth of field and color calibration at Post-processing effect setting popup window.

- When you click the [Default Settings] button, you can reset it to the system default settings.

- The applied Post-processing effect setting value will be saved to the local PC. 

- Post-processing settings are saved regardless of the character and need to be reset when changing the PC. 

[h3][color=#377bbf][b]6. Game Screen Filter Function [/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ A sharpness adjustment option has been added to the game screen filter function ‘Post-processing effect’.[/b][/color]

- You can set sharpness options in the pop-up window that opens when you click the [Post-processing effect] button at the bottom of the game quick menu (ESC).

- The sharpness option can be set with ON/OFF.

- When you set the sharpness option as ON, a bar for setting detailed values will be activated and you can save the settings by pressing the [Apply] button.

[h3][color=#377bbf][b]7. New Passive Skill 'Polish' Update [/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ A new passive skill ‘Polish’ has been added. [/b][/color]

- The new passive skill ‘Polish’ can be opened and learned when each character is promoted to Prime Agent/Fatal Crew/Shadow Agent.

- When learning the ‘Polish’ passive skill, ‘Polish’ can be applied to two active skills for each character. However, in order to apply the polish effect, the target active skill must be acquired to the maximum level.

- Acquiring the ‘Polish’ passive skill and activating the target skill's passive activation does not consume SP.

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ A passive function has been added that allows you to apply 'Polish' to two active skills for each character. [/b][/color]

- When you activate the Target Skill Polish passive in the Skill > Passive tab, the polish effect is applied to the Target Skill.

- When attacking by using the active skill with applied Polish, additional attack might be available or the skill coefficient might be increases depending on the skill. 

- When attacking by using the active skill with applied Polish, Air Strike/Back Attack/Chase guaranteed judgments are applied to the attack added through polish.  

- Attacks added through polish are not affected by skill level.  

-  To view the detailed information of skill coefficients of the additional attack when applying the polish passive, please head over to our [url=https://www.closersonline.com/news/october-25th-update-patch-notes-826]Official Website.[/url]
