notes.title: Scheduled Server Maintenance - October 25th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Greetings Agents,

We will perform maintenance on the Closers World server according to the following schedule, based on your time zone:[list]

[*]UTC: October 25th, 2023 at [b]05:00 AM – 10:00 AM[/b] UTC
[*]PT: October 24th, 2023 at [b]22:00 PM[/b] – 25th, 2023 at [b]03:00 AM[/b] PT
[*]GMT+7: October 25th, 2023 at [b]12:00 PM – 17:00 PM[/b] GMT +7[/list]
Please log out of the game before maintenance begins. During this period, you will not be able to access the game, and the website may not function properly.

To stay up to date with news and other information, please visit our website or follow us on social media.

[list][*][b][url=https://www.facebook.com/ClosersGame]Official Closers Facebook Fanpage[/url][/b][/*][*][b][url=https://twitter.com/ClosersGame]Official Closers Twitter Page[/url][/b][/*][*][b][url=http://discord.gg/UkDuWZzByb]Official Closers Discord Server[/url][/b][/*][*][b][url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCSKUaz4gOXhj8160Xjbeb-g/featured]Official Closers YouTube Channel[/url][/b][/*][/list]
We appreciate your patience and understanding!

If you have any concerns or bug reports, you may send us an inquiry or an email to: [url=support@closersonline.com]support@closersonline.com[/url]

[url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/09e80334f73f4ab5dc983f95743d961b7394fa33.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Q&A with the Closers World Devs! – Answered
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8b5dbe2b630eaa14f81a75b4a8a6ae9a3bba5388.png[/img]

We appreciate all the Agents who took the time to ask questions, provide comments, and offer suggestions.

The subject of our discussion, accompanied by a concise overview of your inquiries and our responses, is available on this page.

We want to convey our immense gratitude to all those who participated in the Dev Q&A session this season!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/be004744bc24865cf830bc14fe3b3a09bdf26d6b.png[/img]

[color=#377bbf][b]► There's a lack of security for our accounts. Can you add Multi-Factor Authentication? Captcha is not enough![/b][/color]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]We appreciate your concerns regarding account security. We will be exploring ways to strengthen security by implementing secondary password measures.
We will try more to fortify the protection of Agents' valuable information and maintain the integrity of the game's security at the same time.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/d71818645a7ef015f1ad84fe40e8c4e90a64194c.png[/img]

[color=#377bbf][b]► I hope for the first time a top-up bonus to encourage people to get those deals. Special days like holidays (Christmas/New Year/Valentine's day, etc) or things like Black Friday with a top-up increase N-coins to encourage people to buy more things.[/b][/color]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]We're dedicated to organizing coin charge bonus events in alignment with special occasions. Take, for instance, the commemoration of our 5th service anniversary in January this year, or the recent GM's event held in August where we provided gifts. Rest assured, we're continually researching numerous options to ensure that our valued Agents can relish even more generous benefits. Right now, our GMs are also brainstorming events and giveaways for the community, please look forward to it.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[color=#377bbf][b]► Washing Machine: suggestion to make it 50nc per pull instead of 90nc. Washing Machine RNG doesn't work well on a server that does not believe in the current pricing.

► Washing Machine has too many useless items and takes too long and too much money to get the set you want.

► Chain discount it's 29,200 N-Coins just to clear one chain, and 87,600 for all three chains. That's 800 USD. (33,000 + 55,000). People living in other countries can't even think of affording it!

► Is there any point in introducing consumable materials to be able to use equipment/ skills? Why do we need an awakening capsule to be able to use Phase-Awakening? Why is pet food still necessary for pets when the only reliable way to get it is by spending real money? Why do we still need trigger fuel to be able to enjoy the effects of our equipment? There are many forced costs that throw off the players.[/b][/color]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]In our ongoing effort to enhance the appeal of the Washing Machine, we've taken steps to relax the cumulative purchase rewards conditions since the May update earlier this year. Furthermore, we're continuously working to improve the products we offer. We're also actively considering ways to provide our Agents with more opportunities for Chain Discounts and access to various sale items.

Let's dive into more detail about the design intent behind Phase Awakening, awakening capsules, and pets in the game.

To explain the design intention behind your question, Phase Awakening is a distinctive feature in our game that allows characters to unlock and utilize limited skills. Unlike traditional character abilities, which they possess from the start, Phase Awakening skills are not inherently part of the character's skill set. Instead, they can only be accessed by utilizing special items known as awakening capsules. 
These capsules are obtained through gameplay and are often tied to the storyline of the awakened skill, making them a part of the narrative experience of the acquired phase awakening skill, but for gameplay convenience, a certain amount is set to be automatically recharged.

Regarding the pets, they are creatures that require the player's management for growth and battle. It helps in battle with its unique skill effects along with abilities as strong as its growth, but it has been set to manage ‘Action Power(AP)’ in order to fully enjoy the effect..[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[color=#377bbf][b]► When will there be more available costume sets in the n-coin shop? Although we have had reruns, in the future, can the pieces of the costumes be purchased individually?

► Will naksan/sokcho/wangsan return in the future? I  hope it can be added to the shop or have a rerun.[/b][/color]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]In terms of costume resale and sales methods, we're diligently structuring our resale plan to align with the scheduled updates. Simultaneously, we are actively exploring various methods for acquiring costumes to ensure diversity.

We want to offer a wider array of options, enabling Agents to access their favorite costumes in different ways. We aim to make the costume-collecting experience more enjoyable and accessible.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[color=#377bbf][b]► Please add better and different payment options! Steam has a huge markup and Xsolla seems to not be liked by banks in SEA.[/b][/color]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]In the case of Steam, it is an independent service platform external to our company, so please understand that it is difficult to support payment options other than those provided by Steam.
For us, our  World Server is literally a global, world server, so we choose and support the payment providers that offer payment options available in as many countries as possible to avoid anybody being left behind. However, we will internally review some friendly payment companies in the Southeast Asian market too.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[color=#377bbf][b]► A game that used to be under Naddic (Counterside) allowed players to purchase a subscription ($7 US) that gave players a small lump of paid currency, and for 30 days gives a small amount of it every day. Maybe you could the same thing but with N-Coins. That way light spenders would have something of value they could spend their money on.[/b][/color]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]We genuinely appreciate your suggestion regarding a subscription system.
In order for players to receive various and abundant benefits through periodic payments, we will think about items and plans in various ways, not only about the subscription system. We wiill refer to this in future planning.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a468b3ee466550da3afbf4b4e6b253a18f47b999.png[/img]

[color=#377bbf][b]► I think Q&A sessions are a great way to gather feedback, but will you consider surveys as well? If you have questions that people can answer by leaving a rating from 1 to 10, there would be a better understanding of what people are satisfied with and what they aren't satisfied with.[/b][/color]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]We value your feedback, and we're thinking about how to ease the communication among players and between players and our newly appointed game master staff. Currently, you can share your thoughts and suggestions through events featuring our in-game goods, as well as on our social media platforms, including YouTube and Discord.
In order to explore more effective methods for gathering feedback and insights from our many Agents, we're dedicated to introducing new ways for collecting your opinions. Your input is instrumental in shaping the game, and we appreciate your engagement with us.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[color=#377bbf][b]► 1. Will there ever be a continuation of the Closers anime? Would be nice to see Tina story
Do you guys have plans for more MVs, animated shorts or any other audiovisual content?

► 2. Will there be a Closers anime after Side: Black Lambs?

Closers: Side blacklambs (anime.)I only watch until fight with malek, judging by the opening, it should end at least with Astaroth, when will it be released? And the side wolfdog? I still wanna see Mamba again.

► 3. I think it would be interesting to see Tina’s parents appear in some upgrade related quest for Tina and have her grapple with the fact that she has a family that isn't technically hers because she's not a human. Any chance we could see something like that?

► 4. Collaboration: Events with Anime or Video Game[/b][/color]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]1~2. Thank you for your interest and affection for various related content other than Closers game. We also are on the same page and agree that it will be good for Closers to produce a lot of various video content. However, please understand that this requires a lot of time, effort, and resources. We will try to create conditions that allow us to create as much video content as possible so that we can provide sufficient video content.

3. In the future, there might be an opportunity to uncover Tina's untold story within the game.

4. We're always on the lookout for collaboration prospects, and if the opportunity arises, we believe it could lead to interesting results for both us and the players. We'll keep an eye on this.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/64315c624898a9b3056316a8c46aa0e6757db762.png[/img]

[color=#377bbf][b]► Game events. Collab between server's exclusive contents into annual events would be great! Have you ever considered/idea of a collaboration on exclusive game contents into (maybe annual) events between other servers? For example, collab with JP servers (most possible since TW are not much different with World), with craftable signature/unique costume sets. Of course, materials needed for craft will be maintained.
Even some of attributes are slightly differents (like all of the costume are untradeable/unresealable), or duration of the event takes only 2-3 weeks, it possibly make World more F2P friendly. Is it possible to do that?[/b][/color]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]We appreciate your understanding that the utilization of server-specific content on other servers can be challenging due to the distinctiveness of each service area's laws and policies. We are trying to prevent any inequality or discrimination based on the service area.
Regardless, we will strive to satisfy World Server Closers with various events and rewards and make it unique and have its own characteristics.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[color=#377bbf][b]► More funny events, like Tinatonaka (gigant Tina). Also maybe some events with another gameplay, not just clearing sectors with your power, really every in-game event like this, just different decoration and story.
Maybe some pvp related event, or even not related to fight, maybe some race, maybe play as chibi pet, maybe fight against chibi pets, or run away from them. Maybe special mechanics and control only for event. Hi3rd already have this type events and that's really fun. What about turn one player into gigant for hunting another players, or turn all players into chibi and leave one hunter, don't forget about traps. Maybe some maze, not like new dungeon, real maze. Just imagine mini Seulbi come for your soul, hug her penguin doll and summon busgeddon[/b][/color]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]We greatly appreciate your intriguing idea. 
We're fully committed to delivering more fun and exciting events that cover a wide range of topics. We want to keep the excitement and enjoyment flowing.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[color=#377bbf][b]► Is there any plan to bring the name reset event again?[/b][/color]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]Thank you for your suggestion!
We will consider this positively when planning future events.
We will provide detailed information through announcements on the official website and Discord channel, please look forward to it.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[color=#377bbf][b]► Will we have a rerun of the even where you get those trinkets you have to keep for inventory for buff? A buffed version of them maybe? (Referring to the Fine Harpas Claw/Beak/Feather items)[/b][/color]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]We distribute items with the talisman effect in a manner that activates the effect when used via the [Premium Buff]. Unfortunately, at this time, we do not have plans for an event where the talisman effect is activated simply by having the item in your inventory. Thank you for your understanding.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[color=#377bbf][b]► Is the divine battle event going to return anytime soon? [/b][/color]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]We're actively reorganizing the Divine Battle internally, and it's set to receive an update following this renewal. 
Once we've perfected the related specifics, we'll share the information through a separate notice as soon as possible. We will strive to provide even better and more fun events in the future.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/9a4cd01b087187ba49ced0acc7e590c78367b504.png[/img]

[color=#377bbf][b]► Why does the global server have different event rewards with Korean servers? [/b][/color]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]Just as each country's currency holds a distinct value, it's imperative to account for various factors, including content and item values, in each region.
Our continuous goal is to minimize disparities, striving to offer all Agents the opportunity to enjoy the same engaging activities and rewards.
We kindly request your understanding where differences are unavoidable.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[color=#377bbf][b]► I would like a QoL change to pets: letting them use their skills on their own or even giving us a Pet Skill button in the dungeon. The button B is used as the default key shortcut out of the dungeon to bring up the pet list, why not have it be the way to use the skill in the dungeon? It wouldn't take one of our skill slots for more beneficial options, such as zenith awakening when Flame King bosses get here.

► Is there any intention to make the use of pets on multiple characters any easier? It is inconvenient to have to swap the pet used on different characters.[/b][/color]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]To enhance the convenience of using pets in the game, we're actively exploring ways to automatically switch pet skills when changing pets. 

However, we've discovered that significant internal changes to the skill and slot system are necessary for this enhancement. Therefore, we are considering alternative approaches to implement this feature.

Additionally, we're also contemplating the possibility of allowing multiple characters to equip the same pet simultaneously. We are committed to improving your pet experience and appreciate your patience and understanding as we work on these solutions. Please look forward to it![/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[color=#377bbf][b]► Any plans on increasing inventory slots? 

► With the passing of time more consumables, materials and mission items are added to the game, but our space remains the same. It's not hard to find 2, 3 or even 4 of the same item in a person's inventory.[/b][/color]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]The inventory slots currently supported are the maximum amount the server can handle. Please understand that it is difficult to provide additional inventory space at this time.
There are various data options for items at Closers, and on the server, it checks all options for each item for each slot in the space where the item is stored, and rechecks the options for all items each time the player or the system operates. 
We also recognize that this improvement suggestion has been around for a long time, and it is one that the development team would like to apply as well.
Although we review systems frequently whenever improvements are made, these spaces still place a significant load on the servers.
The development team knows that many Agents want it and feel sorry that we cannot brought this change in the near future but we will continue to look into it when improvements can be made.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[color=#377bbf][b]► 1. Do you have plans to install Empowered State fix on Global servers now? It still leads to DC from the game sometimes.

► 2. Do you have plans to update our old xigncode anticheat or replace it with something better? It's a really buggy thing which causes a lot of problems in games like DC in case of players desync during multiplayer operations in some raids/dungeons. This problem has existed in Closers for years!

►3. Fix Ultimate skill disconnected issues please

► 4. Ever since post DX11 Patch, there has been some sort of glitch that causes the game to possibly freeze when typing in chat Inside and Outside of dungeons. Can it be fixed?

► 5. When you alt tab to another screen and alt tab back into the game, it pops up tons of UIs that shouldn't pop up and I don't think this has ever been addressed! (Please refer to this)

► 6. Is there gonna be any reconsideration of how the ingame file management is structured? With the current structure it has proven to not only be inefficient, but also affect the stability of the game, notably in parties where more files for multiple player assets need to be read and are scattered in 100's of folders, causing drops and dips in performance that really hinders the enjoyment of the game, one proposed solution I may want to consider to Naddic is taking all the folders and making giant folders instead of small ones, to make read and writing to them easier and allow for better load times & other improvements.

► 7. Please fix character voice disappear after skill activated, or add game option turn on/off character voice disappear!

► 8. Can you remove the delay from opening a bunch of chips/boxes?[/b][/color]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]1~3. We're dedicated to identifying and addressing any skill-related issues, striving for continuous improvements. We're actively working on resolving issues related to ultimate skills, and we anticipate these fixes will be implemented early next year alongside the resolution of Empowered State's concerns. Keep an eye out for a more detailed update schedule in an upcoming notice. 
4~5, 8. We understand the challenge in pinpointing the problem since it can't be replicated internally. If you encounter any issues while playing the game, please reach out to our customer service center. We're committed to responding as swiftly as we can. Our dedicated GMs are diligently collecting and forwarding these concerns to our developers. We want to remind you again that your feedback is invaluable in helping us improve the game.
6. Currently, we're unable to make changes to the game's file structure within the current development process. However, please note that we are actively working on enhancing the loading speed as part of our ongoing improvement efforts.
7. If you experience the character's voice being muted during skill usage, it is likely a bug, and we appreciate your reports. Please provide detailed information or reproduction steps to our customer service. If you wish to mute the character's voice intentionally, you can do so by accessing Options - Sound Settings and adjusting the volume to 0.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[color=#377bbf][b]► Because of the usual Network issues, if player DC is in solo dungeon, GM can give you the refund of sector pass items and it's good. But why not just change it to if the dungeon is not completed, the ticket/attempt won't be counted? That way is easier for the GM and players![/b][/color]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]We sympathize and understand the inconvenience of not being able to refund or respond to sector passes as quickly as desired.
However, refraining from consuming admissions or entries simply because you haven't finished playing the dungeon may pose a risk of potential abuse. To counter this, we currently assess whether the disconnection or crash occurred during gameplay or if there was a deliberate attempt to exploit the situation. Please understand that we are responding after this internal verification process.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[color=#377bbf][b]► Is there any plan to bring the UI renovation announced in September 2020? Some good changes were announced, like better optimization of HUD, UI renovation to make it have a more modern and cleaner look and also make the game run smoother, but apparently those changes were discarded and never heard of again.[/b][/color]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]An attempt was made to change the HUD design, but the design was not finalized.
Design changes require major structural changes within the UI system and for this reason, the update plan is currently on hold, but the development team will try to change the HUD design again and plan to restart with the necessary UI functions, such as UI optimization and scaling, implemented to some extent in stages.
We apologize for not being able to deliver the news to Agents who look forward to this. We would like to ask for your understanding,[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[color=#377bbf][b]► Any plans of EU/SEA servers? The lag when even picking up items impoverishes the experience.[/b][/color]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience that may have been caused. We will work to improve the environment to ensure you an even more enjoyable and seamless gameplay experience. [/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[color=#377bbf][b]► Where are the 1-15 channels?[/b][/color]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]Some channels were cleaned up after server relocation through maintenance on Aug 16th.
Although we have responded to inquiries through Discord and our website, we will still provide guidance through a separate announcement in the future.
Through the maintenance on Oct 25th, the remaining channels will be modified to be visible starting from channel 1.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[color=#377bbf][b]► Any plan for the main story exp renewal for Blacklambs, Wolfdog and Wildhutter team? It's kinda bored when you stuck at lv 78-79 and you need to leveling again to lv 80[/b][/color]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]We are currently reexamining character growth in general.
Rest assured, if there are any updates or news to share, we will promptly notify you through an official notice.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/510441d7f5f6fb70dd297f26c1090e6c8b58d387.png[/img]

[color=#377bbf][b]► Are there any plans to advertise the game to attract new players?[/b][/color]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]We continuously promote our updates through various channels like Google and Facebook. Additionally, we're exploring new marketing initiatives such as engaging YouTube videos and exciting events. Our commitment is to continually enhance and expand the game experience to even outside the game and make the Closers experience more fun.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[color=#377bbf][b]► Is there any intention to streamline farming? With the introduction of gatewave which was termed as "main farming area" by Naddic, we actually are forced to farm more. More common materials are needed lately.

► In last QNA, you said "We think that the amount of time spent on the different parts of the game could lead to gaining better rewards, and this is especially true when using more than one character." This is now untrue as more characters mean more farming for common materials or other resources. The amount of time spent farming/ playing is now increasing by a lot. Is game desiGN moving towards the expectation that players spend 3 or more hours playing the game?[/b][/color]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]We plan to improve the acquisition of essential equipment, such as Gate Waves, to enhance your farming experience and access various in-game content while playing the game, making it more convenient for all players.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[color=#377bbf][b]► Purification Sector Key was said to be removed in the las QNA. When will it be removed?[/b][/color]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]As mentioned earlier, we have included the removal of the Purification Sector Key in our plans. Please note that the specific timetable may be subject to change depending on future update schedules. We kindly ask for your patience and look out for further information, which will be provided in a separate notice in the future.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[color=#377bbf][b]► When are additional levels of Type 2 Phase Wings coming?[/b][/color]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]We're considering making adjustments to the Fused Phase Wings. As you suggested, there might be a way to increase the level, but we're exploring ways to make equipment progression more meaningful and motivating. Our goal is to deliver results that will satisfy a wide range of Agents, and we'll do our best to achieve that.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[color=#377bbf][b]► 1. New Seoul Branch - Gate Wave rewards, please increase the amount of Chromatic Phase Essence to match Sticky Residue reward.

► 2. Chip Protector is not easy to obtain if you're a F2P player, and they're used a LOT. Suggestion: Increase the weekly purchase amount from contribution shop or add as a reward in New Seoul Branch - Gate Wave

► 3. New Seoul Branch - Gate Wave.  Please consider reducing the entry into 4 instead. Make the entry reset to 2 per day and increase the rewards amount by 1.5x. If it's possible, please consider making an auto-refresh system for refreshing the operations list. We can present the item list filters that we're looking for first. The auto refresh will stop when the items that we're looking for appear.

► 4. There is a lack of chromatic phase essence because lately the cost to craft items is really high compared to what we actually gather, you have to play a lot of characters just to gear 1 character. Please increase chromatic phase essence reward in area 12.5 by x5 or decrease craft cost on items by 80%!

► 5. Consider making Uncommon Enhancement Transfer Device a free item.

► 6. Ancient Dragon Tiamat Content (Heart/Castle/NM). Please consider changing the entry limit from per week per character to one entry per account per day for each dungeon instead (as the game did with Gremory content in future update) and increase the material drop (maybe 4x from the normal drop is enough). This game already has a lot of content and not all players can do all the content.

► 7. Ancient Dragon Tiamat Content (Mirage Repeated Normal/VH). Please consider revamp this content properly, this content is not worth doing. We're wasting too much time to clear this because this dungeon is really buggy and that makes it slower to clear it. The reward is also not really worth compared to old Tiamat content.[/b][/color]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]1~4. We are being very cautious when it comes to adjusting the rewards from the Gatewave content. 
While we understand the request to increase the quantity of Chromatic Phase Essence rewards and reduce the number of entries to Gatewave, along with increasing rewards, we will closely monitor data changes and review potential adjustments to reward amounts.
5. Regarding the request for free crafting of Uncommon Enhancement Transfer Devices, we are aware of the continuous suggestions received through development Q&A. However, we regret to inform you that, as with previous responses, it remains difficult to provide support in this area due to the current situation. We will strive to consider user suggestions to the best of our ability, as seen in existing cases such as promotional benefits like selling the Enhancement 100 package or adjusting the time/period of Enhancement buff contract rights. However, please understand that it is difficult to change the fundamentals.
6~7. Thank you for your suggestion. We will consider improving environments where players have to continuously play like the Ancient Dragon Historic Site dungeons so players won't get tired easily.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[color=#377bbf][b]► The item quality system impacts so little to the stats given by the item and brings an unnecessary "gacha" system to the game. Why not just make every item "perfect" the moment they are crafted?[/b][/color]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]We understand your opinion that the item quality system has become less engaging. We are exploring either potential changes or methods to remove it from the game. 
Once detailed plans and schedules are decided and updated, we'll share the news with you through a separate notice. Please look forward to it.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[color=#377bbf][b]► As stated by some other players, the heavy emphasis on playing multiple characters is becoming way too high and it devalues playing the game casually. Every new release of content is basically just a treasure trove for the hardcore and nolife player while the casual audience gets left behind, this is coming from someone who plays and gears up about 15 characters. Looking at the future raid, it seems to be following same path too. There are just so many designs that reward multisets that playing 1 char is just very brutal in comparison. On the flipside, I do get that players who grind a lot should be rewarded and the option is there for the hardcore players, but I think the gap is getting way too large and casual players shouldn't be punished this heavily. It's overall detrimental to allow that level of grinding to invalidate casuals, the game caters so extremely toward the hardcore playerbase and it turns off many new/casual players who don't have the time to be grinding for long hours every day. I don't know if anything will really be done to fix a lot of these "problems" though, a lot of it is just due to the fundamental design of the game. But I don't think the current design philosophy is a "healthy" or works for OUR server, this is assuming you care about getting more new players and improving the players retention instead of having the same addicted players. Some possible solutions would be: improving the events, implementing some sort of limits (hard caps such as account entry or soft caps such as getting less as you do more), buffing the drops/rewards (mostly after adding limits) etc.[/b][/color]

[table equalcells=1]
[tr]
[td]One of the ways to fully enjoy Closers is to grow and farm various characters. The game places significant emphasis on its 20 characters, all with a rich narrative. As a result, we are continuously implementing adjustments to the farming methods, aiming to ensure that multi-character development is rewarding. Additionally, we periodically make farming more accessible to enhance the overall experience. We appreciate your emphasis on character growth, and we are working to make it even more enjoyable.
Looking at it from another perspective, the fact that casual players maintain a similar gap with multi-character playing players means that there is little feedback on multi-character development or that there is very little need to develop more than two characters.
We want to emphasize that this type of game design is fundamental in a character-training online game like Closers, which places a strong emphasis on bottom-up leveling. It's challenging to make a transition to a more casual game design, as this approach aligns with the core experience of character development in Closers.
However, this does not mean that we will ignore the inconvenience felt by casual players and allow the gap to widen.
We all are very interested in the direction needed for casual players who are just starting out in Closers to continue enjoying Closers. We ask for your opinions and suggestions and hope that we can help you through improvements and events.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[i]To view the full answers, please head over to our [url=https://www.closersonline.com/news/q-a-with-the-closers-world-devs-answered-825]Official Website.[/url][/i]

notes.title: Find Golden Hands - Winners! [Revised]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

[h1][b]Find Golden Hands - Winners[/b][/h1]
[i]Every contest comes to an end, time to announce the winners![/i]

Hello Agents,

Thank you everyone for participating in the [color=#ffc000][b]Find Golden Hands[/b][/color] drawing contest! We would also like to congratulate the five winners of the event, which we have chosen carefully. It was difficult to choose!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/c44dc90822e14ea688384a36ca4ffd11d5357be8.png[/img]

Hello everybody! This is a personal message from the Game Masters. It's our pleasure to announce the winners of our drawing contest ‘[b][color=#ffc000]Find Golden Hands[/color][/b]’. Your passion and dedication are much appreciated; we also value that you share your intermediate progress to see the development of each drawing and follow you through the process. We were very excited when you contacted us through Discord to ask for some details about your doubts about it! 

All the participants really captured the essence of '[color=#ffc000][b]Daily Life of Closers[/b][/color]', we think it was a topic open to a lot of interpretation and good moments. We are also surprised at the creativity within the topic and how you incorporated a lot of small details! 

Each piece really showed your love for Closers, videogames, and characters. We can tell the decision was an arduous task. But let's not talk much more and get straight to the winners!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/884379af56e72dfed126bc62101335afe62d24a0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/35726ed45beb1a0351cd87882d8f53af431bea94.png[/img]

MoonFate, Charming, D3M0ND, [color=#ffc000][b]Berserker,[/b][/color] Fiamma777, anderleyon, Airu12[/td]

But that's not all! We have exciting news to share: After careful consideration, we have decided to amend the awards. Initially, there were 5 Excellence Awards, but we [b]increased[/b] it and gave it to [b]everybody who participated![/b] There was an error calculating the entries of the contest, and mistakenly missed someone in the competition. 

[b]Now all of you are included! [/b]We want to encourage everybody to [b]join future contests[/b]: your artistic talents truly deserve it. 

All N-coin rewards will be given out during the next scheduled maintenance on October 25th.


Thank you again to all Agents who participated in this event and shared your artistic side with the community!

If you have any concerns or bug reports, you may send us an inquiry or an email to: support@closersonline.com

notes.title: Closers Player Council – 2023/2024 Batch!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

[h1][b]2023/2024 Closers Player Council[/b][/h1]
[i]The recruitment for the [url=https://www.closersonline.com/news/closers-player-council-2023-recruitment-802][b]Closers Player Council[/b][/url] is finally over. The new batch is here![/i]

Hello Agents!

The recruitment process for the Closers Player Council (CPC) was finalized on October 6th. Today, we are thrilled to introduce the new batch of CPC members to the entire Closers community!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/099000549de76626ca75b3f678bed9f25256dbfa.png[/img]
We extend our heartfelt appreciation to all who stepped forward and applied for the Closers Player Council.  This year the response was overwhelming and we received more applications than we expected, which truly shows your desire to improve the game and community.

Selecting just five members from the pool of applicants was indeed a challenging task. Most of you are veteran players with good insights and passion for the game. In order to provide higher coverage in Discord and keep improving the quality of the community, [b]we have expanded the batch for this year to SIX members.[/b]

We firmly believe that the chosen individuals will make significant and positive contributions to the newly formed Closers Player Council.

Without further ado, let's give a warm welcome to the 2023/2024 Closers Player Council:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/65688291abdf9c5a62df08fda7302bf71b535fa3.png[/img]

We are genuinely excited to collaborate with this new batch toward a more robust and vibrant player community.

To our newly initiated CPC members, you will soon receive an invitation to our exclusive Closers Player Council Discord channel using the Discord account ID you provided during registration. We encourage all CPC members to keep an eye on that channel for upcoming communications and discussions.

We cannot emphasize enough how grateful we are for all Agents who applied for this unique opportunity!

Don't forget that your feedback is always welcome. You can share your suggestions for Closers by reaching out to us through [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna]Customer Support.[/url]

Additionally, consider joining our official Closers Discord server by clicking the image below to connect with fellow Agents, share your experiences, and stay updated on all things Closers.

[url=https://discord.gg/w7hShma][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/595bf38e549c010361cef8dfb2b4a1c5d337161a.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: October 4th Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2][b]Contents[/b][/h2]

[h3][color=#377bbf][b]1. PNA System Renewal[/b][/color][/h3]

[color=#ffae42][b]▶ PNA and mutant systems are integrated into account-based.[/b][/color]

[color=#d4a1f0]1) Integration Changes[/color]

- EXP for each type of PNA and mutant held on a per-character basis have been integrated on an account basis.
[list][*] All mutation materials consumed in the existing variant system are combined and refunded to your account.[/list]
- All PNA genes of Attack/Defense/Support/Special/Amplifier Strains in PNA system have been integrated into the Account basis.

- Evolution/Enhancement/Mutation materials are shared on an account basis and the maximum holding quantity is expanded. (Maximum possession quantity of each material is 999,999) 

- In accordance with the system reorganization, the tooltips for enhancement/evolution material items and PNA material consumables have been changed.


[color=#d4a1f0]2) Changes to opening conditions[/color]

- PNA and mutation opening conditions have been changed.
[list]
[*] PNA Open: Open when a character on your account reaches level 51 for the first time.    
[*] Mutant Open: Open when reaches account PNA level 80.   
[*] The PNA and mutant systems are open to all characters without any restrictions after initial opening.[/list]
[color=#d4a1f0]3) PNA Quest Changes[/color]

- Due to PNA account integration, some related quests have been changed or deleted.

- All PNA-related achievements except ‘Succeed with PNA evolution’ have been deleted.

- All Gremory Dungeon quests have been changed to be available when level 87 or higher.
[list]
[*] The PNA system opens when a character in your account reaches level 51 for the first time, but PNA growth is available with characters of level 87 or higher.  
[*] PNA quests in progress before the maintenance on Oct 4th will be canceled and can proceed again after level 87. (If you have already completed it, there is no need to proceed again)
[/list]
[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New content [Awakening Strain] has been added to the PNA system. [/b][/color]

- The Awakening Strain tab has been added to the PNA window.    

- Three types of awakening material types A, B, and C, and three types of Awakening Gene types A, B, and C have been added.  

- In the Awakening Strain tab, you can equip up to 3 awakening genes by right-clicking or left-clicking and dragging.  

- The effect of the equipped awakening genes is displayed in the ‘Factor effect’ column of the awakening strain tab.   

- Awakening genes of the same type are displayed with the same icon and cannot be equipped in duplicate.   

- Awakening genes of the same type are displayed in the same color.  

- The synergy effect is activated when two or more awakening factors of the same type are equipped.

- The synergy effect of the equipped awakening factor is always applied.  

- When you click the [PNA Analysis] button, you can check comprehensive information on the awakening factor currently equipped.     

- Left-click on the awakening factor to view detailed information.  

- Selected awakening factors can be upgraded with awakening materials, and factors that will not be used can also be dismantled.  

- About the types of awakening genes, and their abilities according to the upgrade stage.


[color=#ffae42][b]▶ The Mutant system has been reorganized.[/b][/color]

[color=#d4a1f0]1) Levels and abilities for each type[/color]

- The maximum level of each Mutant type has been expanded. (Lv.20 → Lv.75)

- EXP required to level up each type of Mutant has been changed.

- The name displayed when a Mutant level up or reaches level MAX has been changed. (Example: VERUS → IRREGULAR)

- The damage increase stat for each Mutant type has been changed to apply at all times.

- ‘Total Mutant Level’, which is the sum of the levels for all Mutant types, is displayed at the top of the Mutant system window.


[color=#d4a1f0]2) Variant reorganization[/color]

- Variant has been reorganized.
[list]
[*] Variants are displayed at the top, and Variant stats have been changed to be always applied when the Mutant system is opened.
[/list]
[color=#d4a1f0]3) Manifestation Body Added[/color]

- 15 Manifestation Bodies have been added.

- Manifestation Body can be opened whenever the total Mutant level reaches a certain number.

- However, if the preceding Manifestation Body is not opened, opening the next Manifestation Body is not available.

- Manifestation Body can be opened using credits and mutation materials, and stats are given according to each probability as soon as it is opened.

- Manifestation Body stats are added and displayed in ‘Manifester stat’ at the top of the UI.

- Manifestation Body stat option: C~SS grade

- Manifestation Body stats can be changed by clicking the [Manipulate] button. [Manipulate] consumes mutant materials.   

- When manipulating the Manifestation Body, it is possible to acquire stats ranging from C to SS option grade depending on each probability.  

- The number of Manifestation Body manipulations is 10 times, shared by all Manifestation Bodies.

- The available number of Manifestation Body manipulations is shared by all Manifestation Bodies.

- If you have consumed all possible Manifestation Body manipulation counts, you can reset the count by consuming the ‘Perfect PNA Evolution Kit’.


[color=#d4a1f0] 4) Mutation material conversion reorganized[/color]

- The amount of goods consumed at the final stage of the mutation material conversion system using 
enhancement/evolution materials and at each stage have been changed.

- The overload level has been expanded from a total of 4 to 8 levels.

- As the overload level increases, the materials and credits consumed increase.


[color=#ffae42][b]▶ New materials and consumable items have been added.[/b][/color]

- Test/Standard/Greater Awakening material A/B/C capsule: Acquire each type of awakening material

- Awakening Genes A/B/C Random Ampoule : Acquire one type of awakening Genes of each type according to each probability

- PNA/Phase Force Growth Activator: Acquire PNA/Character EXP when using


[color=#ffae42][b]▶ Special strain samples have been added and some specifications have been changed.[/b][/color]

- Special Strain samples have been added.

- Special strain samples can be purchased Shop > Support Shop at <Shop - Vending Machine>. (Once a week per account)

- Specifications have been changed so that special strains can be disassembled.


[h3][color=#377bbf][b]2. Gremory Dungeon[/b][/color][/h3]

[h2][b]ETC[/b][/h2]

[h3][color=#377bbf][b]1. Other Updates / Bug Fix[/b][/color][/h3]

The packaging status of Phase Wings and Footprints will be changed as follows after the regular
maintenance on Oct 4th, 2023.
> Phase wings and footprint items acquired from the shop are obtained in a packaged state.
> Phase wings acquired by crafting and contribution shops is acquired in a bound state.


[h3][color=#377bbf][b]2. Changes[/b][/color][/h3]

▶ The effect displayed when Tina’s character ‘Special Move: Finish them: Orbital strike’ skill is strengthened with Overheat stack has been improved.

▶ Errors with some characters have been corrected.

- An issue where the range of ‘EX Wind Sting’ was narrowed in Harpy character PVP has been fixed.

- An issue where The Harpy character’s ‘Special Skill: Mask of Prom Queen’ buff was not updated using The draw Skill has been fixed.

- An issue where resource acquisition/consumption of Tina’s character ‘Special Move: Finish them: Orbital strike’ skill occurred at abnormal times has been fixed.

- An issue where the ‘Petal slash’ attack of Violet character’s ‘Special Move: Fluttering blade: Bloody rose’ skill was activated before the ‘Thorn slash’ attack has been fixed. 

- An issue where the Seth character ‘EX Nephthys’s Grace’ skill effect was displayed in an abnormal location has been corrected.

- An issue where the skill effect was not visible or had a minimal effect that was difficult to identify when setting the optimization (low spec) in the effect optimization option has been improved.


▶ The time required for the character's knockdown and wake-up motions has been adjusted. 

- The animation speed of some knockdown and wake-up motions has been adjusted. 

- The time for knockdown and wake-up motions to be canceled by using the arrow keys has been adjusted quickly.


▶ The tooltip for Tina’s character EX Sharp Shooting skill has been modified. 

- (Before) 6 Overheat stacks are acquired when a Double Shotgun Finish attack is activated. 

- (After) 6 Overheat stacks are acquired when the skill ends after activating Double Shotgun Finish 

▶ Legion Program: The difficulty of the INFERNAL has been adjusted.


▶ The number of days required for Task Force/Black Hand promotion has been reduced. 
- Number of items required to complete the quest: (Before) 10 → (After) 2


▶ The craft explanation in ‘Awakening marble’ item tooltip has been modified.

- (Before) Awakening marble can be crafted in the [Planar Gate]-craft machine. 

- (After) Awakening marble can be crafted in the craft machine. 


▶ The issue where all skill icons flashed when using a skill has been corrected. 


▶ The skill effects of some characters have been optimized. 


▶ A typo in the helpful dialogue displayed during the battle of ‘Belphegor Investigation Group – Annabelle’ has been corrected.


▶ Effect optimization options have been added.

The rendering optimization option has been removed.

- Effect optimization options can be set from the selection between ‘Basic(high specifications)’ and ‘Optimized(low specifications)’. 

- Dungeon entry/psychic moves/Dungeon clear motions are displayed the same regardless of optimization options. 

- When ‘Optimized(low spec)’ is set in the effect optimization options, some skill effects are not displayed.
※ It has been confirmed that some effects are displayed abnormally when using signature/unique costume-exclusive emotes after setting ‘Optimization (Low Specs)’ in the effect optimization options.
Improvements will be made through additional optimization work in the future, and the detailed schedule will be announced in a separate notice.


▶ Some quest achievement conditions have been improved.

- Some quests that require clearing The same Dungeon more than two times have been adjusted to one time.


▶ [Gremory Arcade] Operation Area 'Fighting game... Teddy fight!’ pattern has eased slightly. 


▶ The Damage Increase option value for each type has been adjusted according to the level of each Mutant type. 

- The Damage Increase option for each Mutant type obtained upon reaching level 20 has been changed. (260% → 270%)  

- After each Mutant type reaches level 20, the increase in Damage Increase option effect for each type according to level up is the same as before. 

 
[h3][color=#377bbf][b]3. Bug Fixes[/b][/color][/h3]
 
▶ The issue where the character’s gaze was directed towards the monster when using the ‘Ultimate Move: Climax’ skill with Cheolsu Kim’s character has been corrected.

▶ The issue where the icon for the skill 'Special Skill: Awaking Nergal' was displayed abnormally when the Lucy character died under 'Nergal's Gaze' 5stacks and was revived has been fixed. 

▶ The issue where Cheolsu Kim’s character '[Mercy] - Dance Macabre' skill's Mark of Judgment increased damage received by 15% debuff was not activated has been fixed.

▶ The issue where the ground and air demons summoned in Lovecraft did not explode when touching the character has been fixed.

▶ The issue where potions could be used in the Night-Maze Dungeon has been fixed.  

▶ An issue where the Nightmare NPC existed for a moment and then disappeared after the door to the next gate was opened in the Nightmare shop area of the 'Night-Maze' dungeon has been fixed.

▶ An issue in the Aeri character ‘Rooftop: Second Half_Very Hard’ dungeon where the Puppet Master, which only appears in quests, appears even in situations where there are no quests has been fixed.

▶ The issue where the teleport gimmick within the dungeon did not activate during the character resurrection motion has been fixed.

▶ [Dungeon] UI - An issue where the number of potions in the same spot as B quick slot is displayed in yellow when the additional hit cooldown timer is activated in quick slot A has been corrected.   

▶ [Dungeon] Erosion: An issue that Glutton King's Core King of Gluttony Beelzebub's skill did not work properly has been fixed. 

▶The issue where the cooldown of [Super Acceleration] skill was not reduced when Lee Seha character [Special Move: Combustion: Fierce lightning and thunder] skill was used has been fixed.

▶ The issue of Soma character’s [Joint skill: Good Fellas] skill being deactivated while using [Special Skill: Mantra] skill has been corrected. 

▶ The issue of monsters being pushed back excessively when using Sylvi character’s [Wormhole Buffer] skill has been corrected.

▶ The issue of monsters being pushed back excessively when using Seth character’s [Atum's Memory] skill has been corrected. 

▶ The issue where the rocket summon effect was displayed in an abnormal location when using Tina's [Special Move: Battlefield] skill has been corrected. 

▶ The issue in which the number of hits of the basic attack decreases when Tina's character's attack speed increases has been corrected. 

▶ The issue where the damage of the Mirae character's [Special Move: Lullaby] skill's wild attack was applied differently on the ground and in the air has been corrected.  

▶ The issue where Violet's awakening strain jump effect was not activated in the enhanced state while using [Special Move: Transcendence] has been corrected.  

▶ The issue where the attack judgment activated in stages 2 and 3 of Tina’s character [Heat Shot] skill is not subject to the advance cube effect has been corrected.

TaskForce/BlackHands Promotions are planned to be eased through the update on October 4th, and the TaskForce/BlackHands Promotion (Free Pass) Package Sales will be ended accordingly.

 For more details, please refer to the following information:

Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Closers Player Council 2023 Recruitment
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

[i]Closers Player Council or “CPC” consists of existing Closers players who volunteer to keep the player community safe, active, and in communication with the official Naddic staff.[/i]

[h3][b]How to be a CPC?[/b][/h3]
[list][*]You can directly apply through our Inquiry System [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/event-promo-inquiry]here[/url]. All submissions will be evaluated by the Naddic staff. Once the CPCs have been selected, their names will be announced and the Naddic staff will contact them.[/*][*]The recruitment has a limited time and only applications made within the time period will be considered.[/*][*]A maximum of 5 members will be accepted, and the duration of this position is only 1 year.[/*][*]Anyone may apply, provided they meet the requirements. The previous CPCs may reapply, and they have a good chance of being re-included if they made significant contributions.[/*][/list]

[h3][b]Requirements[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Must have at least one Closers character with the current maximum level on the World server.[/*][*]You must be up to date with the most recent Closers World server events and patch updates.[/*][*]Must be able to communicate effectively with the official staff in English (Knowing multiple languages is an asset.)[/*][*]Must have a basic understanding of Discord.[/*][*]Veteran players of Closers are a definite advantage.[/*][*]No in-game infractions within the past 12 months[/*][/list]

[h3][b]Reminders[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Keep confidential or sensitive information within the CPC to avoid leaks of information regarding content in-game or player-base-related.[/*][*]If there is any action that is considered to affect the game service, there may be arbitration by Naddic.[/*][/list]

[h3][b]Application[/b][/h3]
If you wish to join the Closers Player Council team, please send us via Customer Support inquiry the following information. You may copy and paste these questions with your answers:

[list][*]Inquiry category: Event/Promo[/*][*]Character name: (input your main character’s name)[/*][*]Event name: Closers Player Council[/*][*]Title: Application[/*][*]Contents:
[list][*]Your Nickname: (please input the name you wish to be called)[/*][*]Your Discord ID: (input your Discord ID)[/*][*]Closers Name: (your Closers name)[/*][*]Character Names: (your other characters name)[/*][*]Country: (country where you are currently residing)[/*][*]Schedule when you are online: (your typical online time in Closers and Discord)[/*][*]Character that you use the most: (Seha, all Rattus members, etc.)[/*][*]Languages: (languages that you know)[/*][*]Are you willing to monitor Closers Discord and other official Closers sites to report inappropriate conduct? (Yes/No)[/*][*]Do you confirm that you will not abuse the CPC’s privileges or permissions? (Yes/No)[/*][*]Describe why you should be accepted into the Closers Player Council:[/*][/list][/*][/list]

[table equalcells=2]
[tr]
[td][b]Deadline for CPC Application[/b][/td]
[td]October 6, 2023 (3 weeks)[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][b]Announcement of the new batch of CPC[/b][/td]
[td]October 13, 2023[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][b]Term[/b][/td]
[td]October 21, 2023 - October 22, 2024[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[h2][b]F.A.Q.[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]If I become a CPC, will I have direct contact to the Naddic support team?[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Yes. We will communicate in a private Discord group. For reasons of privacy and security, you are required to send an email or submit a Support inquiry for questions or concerns related to your personal account.[/*][/list]
[h3][b]What does a Closers Player Council do?[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Discord Management
[list][*]All Closers Player Council members will assist in moderating the Closers Discord server to provide a healthy and secure environment for all users.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Bug Reporting
[list][*]Report anything that has an unintended impact on the experience of playing Closers online. This covers localization errors, broken skills/items, visual errors, quest bugs, environment bugs, graphical errors, etc.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Community Feedback/Suggestion
[list][*]CPCs can communicate directly with us about what the player community is saying, and they can provide their own feedback on new updates or events.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Player Reporting
[list][*]Reporting players who displayed inappropriate behavior in-game or on any Closers official sites.[/*][/list][/*][/list][i]Details will be provided once you have chosen to be a member[/i]

[h3][b]What benefits are offered to the Closers Player Council?[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Members of the council do not receive any in-game benefits and only apply because they want to enhance the server’s gameplay experience. We want to inform you that the CPCs is not responsible for determining which updates will be applied or when they will be released, as these decisions are still made by the Naddic team.[/*][*]Having determined that CPCs were effective, we will therefore distribute quarterly incentives on the first business day/scheduled maintenance date of January, April, July, and October.[/*][/list]
[table]
[tr]
[td]X3 ELITE Status (30-Days)
3,000 Bonus N-coin (Permanent)[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
[h3][b]How will I know if I am accepted as a CPC member?[/b][/h3]
[list][*]After we have reviewed all applications, we will announce it on our website, official social media pages, and Discord.[/*][/list]

Greetings Agents,

We will perform maintenance on the Closers World server according to the following schedule, based on your time zone:[list]

To stay up to date with news and other information, please visit our website or follow us on social media.

notes.title: Q&A with the Closers World Devs!
notes.content:
[b][h1]Q&A with the Closers World Devs![/h1][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/dbad1465fcf9312bcb1ac248f5fe7aa95bd3d69e.jpg[/img]
Hello Agents!

We would like to announce a greatly anticipated session where you can have your questions answered by the Closers World Development team themselves!

You may reach the Closers World devs by posting in the [b]#dev-q-and-a[/b] channel on Discord with any questions, comments, or recommendations you may have.

Don’t miss this chance, and please remember to keep it constructive and clear. Comments that aren’t relevant to the topic at hand or that contain insults of any kind ought to be removed.
 
[b]How to Submit Your Entry[/b]

Join in the official Closers World Discord server by clicking this picture:

[url=https://discord.com/invite/UkDuWZzByb][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/b4c50c7745a8e4e4f039b32404f73e34e8f8c571.png[/img][/url]

Then post your questions, feedback, or suggestions for the Closers World Developers, in the #dev-q-and-a channel.

Please refer to previously asked questions to give feedback and avoid content outside of the scope of the game.

Tips/Reminders:
[list]
[*]To clearly identify your entries, please list the topic followed by its associated details.

In [b]October 2023[/b], the list of entries and Developers’ responses, will be published on the official Closers website.

Please keep in mind that you are always welcome to give your feedback and suggestions to Customer Support via [url=support@closersonline.com]support@closersonline.com[/url] or [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna[/url] if you miss to submit your contribution. [color=#377bbf][b]1. Legion Program - INFERNAL, IRREGULAR[/b][/color]

▶ <Legion Program - INFERNAL> and <Legion Program - IRREGULAR> have been added.

notes.content:
[i]A contest to showcase your talent with a big prize for the winners! [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/652dbac9c4dc66005fa5f4ff1de336bd7b565535.jpg[/img]

Closers World is holding a drawing contest! The topic for this time is: [b]Closers' happy daily life![/b]
Grab the chance to show off your artistic abilities! 

[color=#377bbf][b]How to join?[/b][/color]

[b]Step 1[/b]: Go to closersonline.com > Forum > Art & Media > Event tab
[b]Step 2:[/b] Click the “Create” button to submit your art. On this page,

★ [b]Make sure[/b] the [b]sub-category[/b] is [b]“Event”[/b]
★ The [b]title[/b] should contain the [b]name of your piece and your Closer's name.[/b]
★ Attach your final file by clicking [b]▲ Attach Image[/b]
★ For the [b]content of the pos[/b]t, include a total of [b]3 images (initial drawing, intermediate stage, and final art)[/b] by clicking the picture icon.

[b]Step 3:[/b] Check your information, format, and submit your entry!

[b][color=#377bbf]Event Period[/color][/b]
August 30, 2023 - October 4, 2023

[color=#377bbf][b]Winner announcement[/b][/color]
October 18th

[color=#377bbf][b]Format[/b][/color]
[olist]
[*] Above 1080X1080 
[*] JPG format
[*] Less than 5MB 
[/olist]
Please be cautious about size and format when you submit the entry.
AI-created results are [b]NOT[/b] considered a valid entry.

[color=#377bbf][b]Benefits[/b][/color]

[table][tr][td][b]Rank[/b][/td][td][b]Number of Winners[/b][/td][td][b]N-coin[/b][/td][/tr]
[tr][td]1[/td][td]1[/td][td]15000[/td][/tr]

[tr][td]Excellence Award[/td][td]5[/td][td]2000[/td][/tr][/table]

[color=#377bbf][b]Rules and reminders[/b][/color]
[list]
[*] One entry per Closers account.
[*] Make sure YOU made it! All entries must be made by the submitter specifically for the purpose of this contest.
[*] Artwork that was previously submitted to any other contest will not be accepted.
[*] Commissioned works will not be accepted.
[*] Art can be digital (we may require to see the raw file), painting, and hand drawn.
[*] Entries should be submitted in image form only such as PNG or JPEG (GIF, Video, etc. will not be valid).
[*] All participants are required to input their Closers Name and Character Name otherwise; the entry will be invalid.
[*] No explicit contents are allowed to be seen in the entry. Any art that can make others feel offended or uncomfortable will be removed.
[*] Once you have submitted your entry, we may post it publicly on our official channels (Website, Steam, and SNS)
[*] If you need to change or edit your entry or post, remove the original entry then re-submit it again.
[*] If you have submitted more than one entry, we will only refer to the first entry that was submitted.
[*] Naddic team has the right to remove any non-related entries or discussions in the event channel. If you have any concerns or reports, you may contact us at support@closersonline.com.
[*] As long as there are no copyright issues, it is acceptable to use other backgrounds such as other images or AI-generated backgrounds; however, the main character artwork must be originally drawn or created by the submitter.
[*] AI-generated works are not eligible for winner selection.
[*] When submitting a work, please attach all of the rough + intermediate + final version. If the work process cannot be confirmed, it may be excluded from selection.
[*] If the use of AI is detected even after the event, the prize can be canceled and the prize can be retrieved. Also, it can be subjected to a ban on gameplay.
[/list]

notes.title: Scheduled Server Maintenance - August 30th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Greetings Agents,

We will perform maintenance on the Closers World server according to the following schedule, based on your time zone:[list]

[*]UTC: August 30, 2023 at 07:00 AM – 10:00 AM UTC
[*]PDT: August 30, 2023 at 00:00 – 03:00 AM PDT
[*]GMT+7: August 30, 2023 at 14:00 PM – 17:00 PM GMT +7[/list]
Please log out of the game before maintenance begins. During this period, you will not be able to access the game, and the website may not function properly.

To stay up to date with news and other information, please visit our website or follow us on social media.

[list][*][b][url=https://www.facebook.com/ClosersGame]Official Closers Facebook Fanpage[/url][/b][/*][*][b][url=https://twitter.com/ClosersGame]Official Closers Twitter Page[/url][/b][/*][*][b][url=http://discord.gg/UkDuWZzByb]Official Closers Discord Server[/url][/b][/*][*][b][url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCSKUaz4gOXhj8160Xjbeb-g/featured]Official Closers YouTube Channel[/url][/b][/*][/list]
We appreciate your patience and understanding!

If you have any concerns or bug reports, you may contact us at:
[url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/b][/url]

Or, email us at:
[url=support@closersonline.com][b]support@closersonline.com[/b][/url]

notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Y5vGPkOZcmU;full][previewyoutube=Lc4JK8ipj3A;full][previewyoutube=Lc4JK8ipj3A;leftthumb][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]

[h1][New Seoul branch] Wheel of Trinity, request for test driver.[/h1]

Hello. This is the UNION New York Branch.


Team Black Lambs of Special Task Force, New Seoul Branch, UNION
Team Wolfdog of Special Task Force, New Seoul Branch, UNION
Team Wildhüter of Special Task Force, New Seoul Branch, UNION
Team Rattus of Special Task Force, New Seoul Branch, UNION


Considering the aforementioned Closer teams’ performance and achievements they have been selected as the test drivers of <Wheel of Trinity>, the auto-maneuver type phase-charged bike.

Wheel of Trinity is a part of the <Reverse project> which has been led by the UNION in secret and is one of the replicas reproduced by analyzing and reverse engineering the technology of Dimensional monsters.
Therefore, much of its performance, operation, and versatility are still unknown.

At this time, we are sending 20 bikes to the main office of the New Seoul Branch, so please carry out the test following the instructions of built-in AI.


That's all for now.
Please do your best to contribute to the advancement of humankind.


Vice President of the UNION New York branch.

[i]Hildegard Veerman [/i]


[hr][/hr]


[i]“What on earth is this? I’ve been to the promotion test and a letter from a higher-up is waiting for me?”

“I-I’ve got the message just now... the Vice President seems to be leading some kind of a project.”

“I see. And did the Temporary District Chief say anything about it?”

“Yes. Only that we’d need to get on with the tests as the memorandum says.”

“Ah, I’m sick and tired of all the secretiveness... I always think that it would be great if they’d at least tell us something before giving orders.”

“Machines that have been made by analyzing the technology of Dimensional monsters... what’s it gonna be like?”

“That, we’ll get to find out from now on. But before that, we should explain how it is to the kids...”



“Yeehaw! The wild motorbike appears! I’m sure I’ll think of a great joke if I ride on this!”

“Impressive! A tricycle moving by itself! Is there a ghost in it?”

“S-silly you. What makes you think it’s a ghost? It says there’s an AI on it!”



“... Those three troublemakers. Already on them, having fun. What if it explodes or something?”

“E-explode? There’s no way the Vice President would send something so dangerous...”

“Let’s examine those machines for now. It just started saying something.”

“Yeah. Whatever funny stuff that motorbike has to say... let’s hear it out.”[/i]





[h2]<START SERVER…>

<INITIALIZATION COMPLETE…>[/h2]





Hey… Boy and girl…

Language packs off during shipping... Very inhumane...

Anyway, you must be... the Team Wildhüter of the Germany Branch? For real? Really?

Nice to meet you... I am <Blue Rider>...

Wheel of Trinity? That name is untrue... Blue Rider is the name of my soul...

You Team Wildhüter... I’ve heard from my first driver...

We riders... AI that evolves by setting our first drivers as our role models...

That’s why our personalities and languages are alike... very sorry if this confuses you...

Anyway, my first driver mentioned that... you will make me perfect...

The <Reverse project> was made to analyze Dimensional monsters’ ships that were captured during the war with reverse engineering... 

We are the by-products of the research... The Wheel of Fortune and Reverse Wheel that you know of were made in such ways too...

But the analysis was not perfect... and as a result, the Wheel series and we were born with limitations...

However, we are types that learn and grow... able to level up with the drivers...

So you... should be my teammates...

With these superior reverse three-wheels, it’s able to break through any rough terrain... 

The built-in phase-charged engine enables traveling faster than a jetliner...

Then you’ll be like... a streak of meteor! Kyahahahahah!!

 



“Wow, that’s some evil-sounding laughter! Just the same as Wolfgang!

“What? When did I laugh like that? Also, that’s a woman’s voice, in the first place!”

“The first driver that the AI mentioned... who could it be? Does anyone in our team know about it?”

“Sure... If we met her, we would be sure to know her. If it was such a wei... I mean, a unique person.”

“Just speak it out: weird. It seems that the person is a speed maniac as well as an eccentric.”

“But... is anybody surprised? That's the Reverse wheel... Wheel of Fortune was made from Dimensional monsters’ technology...” 

“I kind of had such an idea. Such over-technology doesn't just fall down from the sky.”

“I-is it okay? I mean, I was on it all this time and all...”

“Yeah. It does make you think. Still... the ship is not the villain. It’s the dimensional monsters who are bad.”

“Okay, enough with the small talk. On the higher-ups’ request, let’s do the testing.”

“We’re gonna ride on that? Then, Seth will take the one on the far left! That looks the cutest!”

“Cu-cute? But, they all look the same...”

“Ah! How could you do that!? I was the one who saw the one on the left first!”

“People, don't rush it. There are 5 of them anyway, one for each of us.”

“Yeah. Besides, I’m more worried about my partner. Can you really drive that thing?”

“Of course. After lots of training, I’ve become pretty used to machines. I can even click on the mouse.”

“Uh, yeah... that sounds swell... anyway, it’s got an AI so I guess you’ll do fine.”

“Ohh! Will you look at that! This tricycle can really go fast!”

“Huh? Seth already took off! Teach! Now it seems I can only go onward, too!”

“S-Soma? Just wait a second! Ahh? Already gone so far?!”

“Hey, don’t just run off thoughtlessly...! Bah, those troublemakers... never a quiet day for them.” 

“Look on the bright side. At least, the kids seem to like the new equipment.” 

“*Sigh*, yeah. We gotta test them anyway... let’s go then.”

“Fufu. All of you’re so motivated. I’ll be wishing for all your safe return, then.”

“Safe return... that sounds rather sinister, Alice...”

[h1][New Seoul branch] Wheel of Trinity, request for test driver.[/h1]

Hello. This is the UNION New York Branch.


Team Black Lambs of Special Task Force, New Seoul Branch, UNION
Team Wolfdog of Special Task Force, New Seoul Branch, UNION
Team Wildhüter of Special Task Force, New Seoul Branch, UNION
Team Rattus of Special Task Force, New Seoul Branch, UNION


Considering the aforementioned Closer teams’ performance and achievements they have been selected as the test drivers of <Wheel of Trinity>, the auto-maneuver type phase-charged bike.

Wheel of Trinity is a part of the <Reverse project> which has been led by the UNION in secret and is one of the replicas reproduced by analyzing and reverse engineering the technology of Dimensional monsters.
Therefore, much of its performance, operation, and versatility are still unknown.

At this time, we are sending 20 bikes to the main office of the New Seoul Branch, so please carry out the test following the instructions of built-in AI.


That's all for now.
Please do your best to contribute to the advancement of humankind.


Vice President of the UNION New York branch.

[i]Hildegard Veerman [/i]


[hr][/hr]

[i]“Wow... everybody, come see these bikes. Aren’t they the coolest?”

“There’s a pigeon as well.”

“M-Mirae. That’s no pigeon; it’s a state-of-the-art drone.”

“Hm... I’m not very okay with this. What kind of experiment is the UNION planning to perform on us this time?

“Right, I felt uneasy too, so I’ve done a check-up. But it’s totally a failsafe, safety-wise. Rather than that...”

“Rather than what...?”

“The technology used on these bikes, they’re all so incredible!” Especially this phase-charged engine that enables traveling at the speed of an airliner, the unique frame structure that can change its form in certain situations, and the balance of the mounted suspensions are superior! Not to mention the installed AI which has been designed to imitate the neural network structure of a human brain and could self-study with no additional data input...!”

“Soohyun Min’s eyes are shooting sparks! It’s Soohyun Min, the mecha-loving version!”

“Still the one getting totally lost in such stuff.”

“... Anyways, I guess all that means it’s safe.”

“Huh? Wait... there’s this flashing light on the bike. Perhaps it has something to say?”

“... You’re right. Maybe we should hear them out?”[/i]


 
[h2]
<START SERVER…>

<INITIALIZATION COMPLETE…>[/h2]





Hey… Boy and girl…

Language packs off during shipping... Very inhumane...

Anyway, you must be... the Team Rattus of the New Seoul Branch? For real? Really?

Nice to meet you... I am <Purple Rider>

Wheel of Trinity? That name is untrue... Purple Rider is the name of my soul...

You Team Rattus... I’ve heard from my first driver...

We riders... AI that projects our first drivers as our role models...

That’s why our personalities and languages are alike... very sorry if this confuses you...

Anyway, my first driver mentioned that... you will make me perfect...

Us riders are unstable by nature... the downgrade of the Dimensional monster ship that has been captured during the war... 

And the owner of that Dimensional monster ship is assumed to be the Machine King...

Reanimator Origin... The Machine King's Legacy... Human over there, you made contact with that legacy, am I right...?

Such people... may be able to help with my upgrade.

So you... should be my teammates…

With these superior reverse three-wheels, it’s able to break through any rough terrain... 

The built-in phase-charged engine enables traveling faster than a jetliner...

Then you’ll be like... a streak of meteor! Kyahahahahah!!





“What the... is its personality supposed to be like this?”

“I think it’s the influence from the first driver. She used to be an agent of our branch, widely known as a big-time speed maniac.”

“Used to... so she’s not an agent now?”

“Yes. She got assigned by someone above. Now she’s been assigned to another institution.”

“Hm~ that’s too bad. I would have liked to know her; she’d be good with deliveries...”

“Suji Jeo. That's not the point now. Didn’t you hear it mentioning Machine King's Legacy?”

“Uh... yeah, I did hear that, but what about it?”

“Something that Annabelle said. She said she could sync with any kind of battleship as long as the data got transmitted.”

“Yeah. And that’s how she crossed over the dimensional pressure, which is supposed to be very hard.”

“That’s right. And it was the Origin Wheel, restored by the UNION, that she used as a beachhead.”

“Ah... that reminds me, her name has"Wheel" in it, too. Same as Reverse Wheel and these bikes...”

“They’re known as the Wheel series. This Wheel of Trinity is one of them.”

“Temporary District Chief?”

“I don’t think this could be a coincidence. The Machine King’s technology is being spread around, and also for humanity restoring it.”

“Do you mean, it was introduced on purpose? So that we would provide a reason for invasion?”

“Or, it has a collaborator. This project was originally run by Michael von Kiske.”

“... Either way, I don’t feel up to testing them. Don’t get too close, Suji Jeo.”

“Uh, um... but our guys... why did Team Rattus agree to perform the testing?”

“Mirae was the one. Saying that something to ride would be a great help for working as an Errand Runner.”

“Mirae said that? That fool... ... No one can stop her, I guess.”

“... So that’s how things are. In that case, I’ll go with the test, too.”

“Wha--at? What’s gotten into you, Aeri?!”

“Because I will not admit defeat as the Errand Runner of Suji Jeo.”

“Aha! Guys! Look at all these motorbikes! They’re super cool!”

“Wow! That’s great! These things are moving on their own! I guess they understand what we’re saying!”

“I’m sure they can. They mentioned they have built-in AI on them.



“... *Sigh* Really. Nobody’s ever careful around here.”

“Th-there was no time to stop him, he just ran over to the bikes...”

“Has no fear of machines whatsoever. For myself, I always feel like I’m at war every time I change my phone.”
