notes.title: Q&A with the Closers World Devs!
notes.content:
Hello Agents!

You can get your burning questions answered by the Closers World Development team themselves!

You may reach the Closers World devs by posting in the #dev-q-and-a channel on Discord with any questions, comments, or recommendations you may have.

Don’t miss this chance, and please remember to keep it constructive and clear. Comments that aren’t relevant to the topic at hand or that contain insults of any kind ought to be removed.

[table][tr][td]

[h3][b]How to Submit Your Entry[/b][/h3]
Join in the official Closers World Discord server:

[url=https://discord.gg/UkDuWZzByb][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a1af9ace8f6b39ecfb67e01066ed7550c3a91950.png[/img]
[/url]

Then post your questions, feedback, or suggestions for the Closers World Developers,
in the [b]#dev-q-and-a [/b]channel.

Tips/Reminders:
[list][*]To clearly identify your entries, please list the topic followed by its associated details.[/*][*]If possible, we would greatly appreciate it if you could include bullet points and images, if they are available.[/*][*] Example:[list][*]Topic: Costume Inquiry[/*][*]Details: Are there any plans to re-release the Spring Fairy costumes in the future?[/*][/list][/*][/list]
We will collect this data [b]starting February 17, 2023, until February 23, 2023, at 8:00 AM UTC[/b].

In [b]March 2023[/b], the list of entries and Developers' responses, along with the first roadmap video of the year, will be published on the official Closers website.

[/td][/tr][/table]
But please keep in mind that you are always welcome to give your feedback and suggestions to Customer Support via [url=support@closersonline.com][b]support@closersonline.com[/b][/url] or [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna][b]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna[/b][/url] if you miss to submit your contribution.

We always appreciative the countless submissions we have received during our past Dev Q&As, and we appreciate your unwavering support!

notes.title: Dungeon Issues Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

It has come to our attention some issues related to the dungeons. Please read the following topics below for details:

[h3][b]Disconnection after using Ultimate Skill[/b][/h3]
We’ve received reports that after using a character’s Ultimate skill, players are being kicked out of the game (with the message “Connection to game server lost.”).

At this time, we have observed that this occurs intermittently. As we do our investigation, any information you can provide, specifically the log files, will be greatly appreciated.

Please provide the following information if you have recently experienced a connection loss while using the ultimate ability:
[list][*] Your “.log” file located in your CLOSERS/Log folder. Kindly provide the log file with the time of disconnection was recorded.
[*] Name of the dungeon were you got disconnected[/list]
Please forward this information to [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/b][/url] or [url=support@closersonline.com][b]support@closersonline.com[/b][/url] once you’ve finished gathering these needed data.


[h3][b]Invisible Astaroth Bug[/b][/h3]
It has been reported that Astaroth is not spawning or is invisible by the time it should appear to have been defeated. Also, we have observed that it doesn’t occur everytime. We continue to investigate this situation and appreciate your patience.

Meanwhile, please provide the following information if you have found that Astaroth is currently not spawning or is invisible during your dungeon run:

[list][*] A full screenshot or video of that you encountered this bug during your dungeon run.[list][*] The ‘/time’ or the time and date, as well as your character’s name should be clearly seen.[/list][*] Your “.log” file located in your CLOSERS/Log folder. Kindly provide the log file with the time that you encountered this bug.[/list]
Please forward this information to [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/b][/url] or [url=support@closersonline.com][b]support@closersonline.com[/b][/url] once you’ve finished gathering these needed data.

If there are any updates, we will post them on the official website as soon as they become available.

Thank you for your cooperation and please do not hesitate to discuss with us for any other concerns.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents, 

We’d like to thank each and every one who plays and enjoys our game. The passion of our players is what drives us each and every day to make your playing experience a great one. 

In line with our efforts to ensure the balance of the game economy, we’d like to inform everyone that we recently enforced a permanent suspension more than 100 accounts that damaged the in-game economy. We’ll continue to keep an eye out for any actions that are similar to this one, as well as any activity that are detrimental to the playing experience. 

We want to remind everyone that abusing the game will result in a permanent ban from both the account and the Closers World server. 

Please immediately report any serious issues or suspicious players to our customer support by visiting [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/b][/url]. Alternatively, you can email us at [url=support@closersonline.com][b]support@closersonline.com[/b][/url]. 

Thank you for your cooperation and understanding.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

[h1][b][b][b]Year-End Closers Party[/b][/b]! – Winners[/b][/h1]

Thank you for being a part of this event. Here are the final entries and winners of the [b][url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20221230-year-end-closers-party-discord-event/]Year-End Closers Party! Discord Event[/url][/b].

Event Rewards
[table][tr][td][b]Year-End Closers Party! Rewards[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b] Solo (max of 5 participants) [/b]

[b]► 1,000 N-coins each participant ◄[/b]

• This item expires on December 31, 2023 at on 9:00 am UTC.
[/td][/tr][/table]
[table][tr][td]

[b]The X10 Hair Dyeing Ampoule (non-tradable) will soon come in the in-game mail, while all N-coin rewards will be given out during the [/b][b]January 11th scheduled maintenance.[/b]

[/td][/tr][/table]

[h1][b]Solo Category Winners[/b][/h1]

[table][tr][td]

Character Name: [b]ScarletClaw[/b]
Just as in this dream theater the CLOSERS create memories to become stronger, so are the memories that each of us as players have created, be it with friends who no longer play, with the people who play with you every day, or simply the ones we will meet in this coming year, my wish for everyone is that we continue sharing, playing, farming and killing dimensional monsters with our friends and loved ones for many more years…HAPPY NEW YEAR 2023 to all the CLOSERS!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/b47f21c753129a88535b4f3a8619fdde96d1ff47.png[/img]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table][tr][td]

Character Name: [b]Hoverdash[/b]
Yuri Claus brings all the presents at Mach 5, always in time.Every time I return to play Closers I feel incredibly wholesome, there is no such experience in any other game. Happy New Year, let’s hope 2023 brings us more cool stuff.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/93627165563ebf3a9c5884256f20680b48997b53.png[/img]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table][tr][td]

Character Name: [b]PurpleWinter[/b]
Happy New Years to all.Another year, the same you. We all know you’re not going to keep your New Year Resolution but no matter. There will be more happy times, more sad times and more fun times, the grind is not yet over. We still have Beast King to farm, Immortal sets to finish and more costumes to acquire.HAPPY HOLIDAYS AND HAPPY NEW YEARS NOW STOP READING AND GET BACK TO GRINDING

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/1b134e22db287338edf4f378ee41a8e805dec1cf.png[/img]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table][tr][td]

Character Name: [b]REvibna[/b]
We made a lot of Memories in 2022 and let’s create a lot new precious memories in 2023!!Happy New Year for everyone! let’s start the new beginning with new resolution!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/ca493fabf0e8be2742c45503b78d1ef97aeaadd5.jpg[/img]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table][tr][td]

Character Name: [b]Arete[/b]
New Year’s is a time for both celebration and reflection. It’s a time to be grateful to live to see another year with the people we love. While I am not close to a majority within the Closers Community, I have nonetheless enjoyed my stay in the community we’ve built. As we celebrate this special occasion, I hope everyone can look forward to the year ahead with optimism and joy. I wish that everyone overcomes any obstacles that stand in their way. Persevere and Happy New Year! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/208c012088aa33f41306c520838055d51e353954.png[/img]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[h1][b]Pair Category Winners[/b][/h1]

[table][tr][td]

Character Name: [b]Jpart2 and WP[/b]
Prepare for trouble! And make it double! To protect the world from devastation! To unite all peoples within our nation! To spread the word of truth and love! To extend our reach to the stars above! Jessie! J! Team Trainer parties throughout the night! Join us now, and prepare for delight! Meowth! That’s right! We wish you a Happy Holidays as we blast off into the new year! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/6a766a52556624414f655f38c39b525929f2039b.png[/img]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table][tr][td]

Character Name: [b]ZenXYuri and Bianca[/b]
Thank you for 2022 and welcome to 2023. May this new year bring us much joy and fun. May we find peace, love, and success. Sending our heartiest new year wishes to you all!Our friendship made it another year around the sun. Here’s to another great one, and hopefully, many things we could do in the closers together this year.~HAPPY NEW YEAR EVERYONE

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/9302320503baa2631841908a14afa13d792cf4e9.png[/img]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table][tr][td]

Character Name:[b] xHannaChanx and Sakyita[/b]
I want to start my message by wishing everyone a Happy New Year! especially everyone who made this wonderful game possible thank you very much to all the Naddic team for allowing me to meet amazing people in this game with whom I had the pleasure of playing and share wonderful moments some are no longer there or we simply don’t talk but I hope that one day we can share again. 2022 was a year full of many emotions for me, both happy and sad, but I have learned many things and I am very grateful, especially with my best friend (the one with me in the photo) with whom I have been friends for many years and has always supported me in everything, you deserve the best. My best wishes to all of you in this new year, I hope you can achieve your goals and have a lot of prosperity in everything you do

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/bd1911967d385e9d4f7755392222dcde66df1a3a.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]

[table][tr][td]

Character Name:[b] Seyzh and NlNA[/b]
We would like to start by wishing everyone a Happy New Year!Life has for sure been changing around us, but in the end it’s gentle and kind.In both ways, the good and the unpleasant moments, we need to remind ourselves that there should always be love, and also will be time.As we continue our path forward, life will be filled with surprises, and some of them will pursue on for many years ahead.We thank each other for this surprise life, and this game, brought to both our lives.And there may be ups and downs, but we know Closers made us encounter and will make us reunite again.We wish to everyone, that your relationships, no matter what kind, continue flourishing as life goes on.“We sometimes wonder what’s in store for us, and we have to make it clear to our heart…That our will to continue wins!”For your happiness and ours, our most sincere wishes. Thank you

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/210e2155b31c8de86591968db4fc217ce90ad724.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]

[table][tr][td]

Character Name:[b] Yadorigichan and Mistilteinn[/b]
Another year left us full of mixed emotions, some pleasant others not, but somehow all the bad experiences made us reflex, opened up our minds and made us stronger, and overall they leaded us in one or other way to something positive. We can say goodbye to this year without regrets, and welcome the new year full of determination.There are many people that continue together along with us and some others that left us due to life circumstances, so lets enjoy this new year to the fullest and make a lot of memories, so we can have a lot of stories to tell when we reunite again some day.Thank you Naddic for bringing us another year full of adventures, together with all the Closers around the world! We wish everyone the best and that you can fulfill your dreams along with your loved ones! As the Closers we are, lets fight together this new year to make the world a better place where everyone can smile!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/c4ec94ca88b978a151968a730a55b6fc27343ffd.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]

[h1][b]Group Category Winners[/b][/h1]

[table][tr][td]

Character Name: [b]Soeki, Cu7eJR, Text, Anous, and Influence[/b]
It’s a beautiful night here at Centum City heading into 2023 partying with your dear friends, who are very lucky and more powerful than what I could ever be heading into the new year. So let’s start off this year with a cup of coffee (for farming purposes) and enjoy yet another year of Closers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/7a8da1766ebaf18e7a702822d301e5bd8ba80709.png[/img]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table][tr][td]

Character Name: [b]D3M0ND, LewdcyOwO, LoveLegend, and Chro[/b]
“The Christmas tree here is so beautiful It’s almost new year.Let’s take picture together for a good memory and to commemorate the start of a new year Happy New Year 2023 wish you all stay healthy , have good gacha luck , and stay together playing Closers for a long time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8c0fd758be34896869ed6bbcf9fe6a7495d598a7.png[/img]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table][tr][td]

Time flies so fast, I hope in this new year, all of us can beat every challenges, get more hapiness and less sadness, I hope you guys can achieve what you want in this blessed year.Happy new year 2023

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/b1e81529f572183592f75ca6ecb7fbdb65362b81.png[/img]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table][tr][td]

Character Name: [b]Verheerender, loshimaroo, and Mogeko[/b]
2022 has had it’s ups and downs. What has gotten many of us through these past few years have been our family, friends, and the community. Cheers to the new year and hopefully it will be an even better one! May rnjesus be with everyone

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/b80beabc7a676c4953db17353342075dae81adc6.png[/img]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/6c6963264ca6549bb09bb1a3c43b51e6eeea7f50.png[/img]

[h1][b]Year-End Closers Party![/b][/h1]
The year may be winding down, but the celebrations continue! Have a party and invite your closest friends and loved ones.

[h2][b][u]Event Location[/u][/b][/h2]

[table][tr][td]
[b]Closers Official Discord Server[/b]

[url=https://discord.com/invite/w7hShma][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a4e3999d7cb6358a9db5854c31625425c0d7156c.png[/img][/url]
[/td][/tr][/table]
[h2][b][u][b]Event Schedule[/b][/u][/b][/h2]

[table][tr][td][u][b]Timezone[/b][/u][/td][td][u][b]Schedule[/b][/u][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]UTC[/b][/td][td][b]December 30, 2022 at 12:00 AM – January 10, 2023 at 2023 at 12:00 AM[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]PST[/b][/td][td][b]December 29, 2022 at 4:00 PM – January 9, 2023 at 2023 at 4:00 PM[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]GMT+7[/b][/td][td][b]December 30, 2022 at 7:00 AM – January 10, 2023 at 2023 at 7:00 AM[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
[h2][b][u][b]Mechanics[/b][/u][/b][/h2]

[table][tr][td][table][tr][td]
 
[list][*]Use the [b]‘Selfie’[/b] feature in-game and take a screenshot based on your chosen category:
[list][*][b]Solo (1 character)[/b][/*][*][b]Pairs (2 characters)[/b][/*][*][b]Group (minimum of 3 – max of 5 members)[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list] [list][*][b]The following must be accomplished while taking the screenshot to make it a valid entry:[/b]
[list][*]Make sure that the [b]‘Add Watermark’[/b] option is turned on in the Camera settings for the Closers Online logo to appear in the results.[/*][*]Make sure that [b]all character names can be clearly seen[/b] in the screenshot; otherwise, the entry will be invalid.[/*][*]Make sure that the event rules were followed accordingly (see Event Rules below).[/*][/list][/*][/list]
 
[list][*][b]After taking a screenshot, post your entry according to the category with your Year-end message[/b]
[list][*]You may send a New Year’s greeting to Closers, your friends, crewmates, or anyone else you care about. It doesn’t have to be about the year that has just ended. It can be a message you wish to convey in anticipation of 2023![/*][*][b]Discord Channels:[/b][list][*][b]#solo_year_end_party[/b] – for Solo category[/*][*][b]#pair_year_end_party[/b] – for Pair category[/*][*][b]#group_year_end_party[/b] – for Group category[/*][/list][/*][*][b]You can only join once (1 Discord account = 1 Closers account) in any category during the event.[/b]
[list][*]Example: If you already joined the ‘Solo’ category, your ‘Pair’ entry will be invalid.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]

[u]Sample Entry[/u]

[b][i]Cheers to a New Year! Hoping for everyone’s wishes will come true, more monsters to fight, and new memories to have, especially with my buddies in-game! <3[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e93b8992e0d38184d1ce43aceca901838bf3d247.png[/img]

[b][u]For the Pair and Group categories, only one representative should send in the entry.[/u][/b]

[b]Each member would receive a prize if a specific pair or group won.[/b]
• Note: If you have submitted more than one entry, we will only refer to the first entry submitted. So, if more than one representative posted an entry, we will refer to the first representative who posted the entry.
• If a participant joined again, but with a different pair or group, that individual would be disqualified.

[/td][/tr][/table][/td][/tr][/table]

[h2][b][u]Criteria for judging[/u][/b][/h2]

[table][tr][td][h3][i][b]35% Creativity and Originality of Message[/b][/i][/h3]
[list][*]How your message was thoughtfully created.[/list]
[h3][i][b]35% Creativity and Originality of Screenshot[/b][/i][/h3]
[list][*] How well did the screenshot capture the character/s. Visually appealing.[/list]
[h3][i][b]20% Relevance to the theme[/b][/i][/h3]
[list][*] How closely do the screenshot and message resemble New Year or a party! How well it interprets and reminds the judges of the New Year theme.[/list]
[h3][i][b]10% Audience Impact[/b][/i][/h3]
[list][*] :heart:votes in Discord (Any other Discord reacts will not be counted)[/list][/td][/tr][/table]

[h2][b][u]Prizes[/u][/b][/h2]

[table][tr][td]
[table][tr][td][u][h3][b]Year-End Closers Party! Rewards[/b][/h3][/u][/td][/tr]

[tr][td][h3][u][b] Solo (max of 5 participants) [/b][/u][/h3]
[b]5 Solo = 5 individual winners[/b]

[b]► 1,000 N-coins each participant ◄[/b]

[/td][/tr]

[tr][td][h3][u][b] Pair (max of 2 participants) [/b][/u][/h3]
[b]5 Pairs = 10 individual winners[/b]

[b]► 1,000 N-coins each participants ◄[/b]

[/td][/tr]

[b]4 Groups = Maximum of 20 individual winners[/b]

[b]► 1,000 N-coins each participants ◄[/b]

[/td][/tr]

• Rewards will be given right after the winner announcement on January 10, 2023 UTC.

[list][*]One entry per Discord account and Closers account.[/*][*]All participants including those who didn’t win must adhere to the event’s rules and procedures for the participation reward.[/*][*]Adding speech or adjustments to your screenshots is not required but can count toward the 10% Creativity of Screenshots score if you choose to do so.[/*][*]All entries must be made by the submitter specifically for the purpose of this contest.[/*][*]Entries should be submitted in image form only, such as PNG or JPEG (GIF, Video, etc., will not be valid).[/*][*]All participants’ Character Names should be seen and identified in the screenshot entry; otherwise, the whole entry will be invalid.[/*][*]No explicit contents are allowed to be seen in the entry. Any entry that can make others feel offended or uncomfortable will be removed with or without permission from the Naddic staff.[/*][*]Once you have submitted your entry, you agree that we may post it publicly on our official channels (Website, Steam, and SNS)[/*][*]If you have submitted more than one entry, we will only refer to the first entry submitted.[/*][*]If you need to change or edit your entry or post, remove your first entry, then re-submit it again before the event ends.[/*][*]Naddic team can remove non-related entries or discussions in the event channel.[/*][*]If you have any inquiries, concerns, or reports, contact us at [url=_wp_link_placeholder][b]support@closersonline.com[/b][/url].[/*][/list]

Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you of a known issue that was found after the recent patch. The following concern will be fixed during the next scheduled maintenance update:

[list][*] [b]Sylvi’s Holy Night Bunny Costume[/b]
[list][*] The current name of Sylvi’s Holy Night Bunny Top is “Seha’s Holy Night Bunny Top”. This item should function properly for Sylvi, and the name of the costume will be updated during the next maintenance.[/list][/list]
Thank you for your understanding and we apologize for the inconvenience that this has caused.

If you have any concerns or bug reports, you may contact us at:
[url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/b][/url]

Or send us an email to:
[url=support@closersonline.com][b]support@closersonline.com[/b][/url]

[h1][b]December 21st Update Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

(Normal Difficulty has no restriction) [/*][/list][/*][/list]

[list][*][b]Immortal Searing Wind Gear Transcendence[/b][list][*]Immortal Searing Wind Gear can be transcended to a maximum 2 Levels.[olist][*]Lv. 1 Transcendence : [Physical/Psi/Hybrid] Super : Immortal Searing Wind[/*][*]Lv. 2 Transcendence : [Physical/Psi/Hybrid] Extreme : Immortal Searing Wind[/*][/olist][/*][/list][/*][/list]

[list][*]Battle Program : Another Lucifer missions have been added.[/*][*]Battle Program : Another Lucifer Achievements & Titles have been added.[/*][*]UNION Watch Dungeon Mission ‘Order : Fortress of White/Polar Night’ Mission has been modified.[list][*]As-Is : Clear Battle Program : Searing Wind Dust[/*][*]To-Be : Clear Battle Program : Searing Wind Dust 2 types or Battle Program : Another Lucifer 2 type[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]4 types of dungeons related to the Battle Program : Another Lucifer get Season 3 Channel Bonus.[/*][*]4 types of dungeons related to the Battle Program : Another Lucifer get Fortress of White/Polar Night Area Crew Reputation Buff applied.[/*][/list]
[h3][url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20221221-another-lucifer/]► [b]Phase Awakening System[/b][/url][/h3][list][*][b]Phase Awakening System has been added[/b][list][*]Phase Awakening System is a new system activating ‘Phase Awakening Skill’ when ‘Phase Awakening Gear’ equipped.[/*][*]During the activation of Phase Awakening Skill, the appearance of the character changes and some stats get increased during the active time.[/*][*]Phase Awakening Gear can be obtained by clearing ‘Proving oneself’ mission at Fortress of White/Polar Night along with unlocking Phase Awakening Slot.[olist][*]Item Name : Trans Disk : Supreme[/*][/olist][/*][/list][list][*]Using ‘Phase Awakening Skill’ will consume ‘Awakening Capsule’ Item.[/*][*]‘Awakening Capsule’ Item automatically get charged upto 5 at 4AM daily, and maximum 30 capsules can be held.[/*][*]Clearing UNION Watch by Lv.90 or higher characters Awakening Capsule will let you obtain 5 more ‘Awakening Capule’ item.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]Phase Awakening Gear can be upgraded[/b][list][*]Phase Awakening Gear can be upgraded through Matter Mixer.[/*][*]‘Supreme Gene’ and Credit are required to upgrade ‘Trans Disk : Supreme’ Item.[/*][*]‘Supreme Gene’ Item can be obtained by clearing ‘Battle Program : Another Lucifer’ Dungeon.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]Phase Awakening System Guide has been added.[/b][/*][/list]
[h3][url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20221221-another-lucifer/]► [b]Dungeon Skill System[/b][/url][/h3][list][*][b]Dungeon Skill System has been added[/b][list][*]Dungeon Skill System is a new system activating unique skill only can be used in certain dungeons when using the point obtained from the dungeon.[/*][*]Dungeon Skill can only be used by the squad leader.[/*][*]Currently dungeon skills are only available in ‘Imitative Succession Ritual (all difficulties)’ and ‘Battle Program : Another Lucifer(all difficulties)’.[/*][*]The way to get points and available skills in ‘Imitative Succession Ritual (all difficulties)’ and ‘Battle Program : Another Lucifer(all difficulties)’ Dungeons are as following[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[table][tr][td][b]Way to get points[/b][/td][td][b]Acquiring Points[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]When Using Normal Skill [/b][/td][td][b]1[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]When Using Finishing Move Skill[/b][/td][td][b]10[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]When Using Pet’s Activa and Auto Skill[/b][/td][td][b]3[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]When Defeating Monsters[/b][/td][td][b]1[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]When squad member is dead[/b][/td][td][b]50[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]When using Ultimate Move skill[/b][/td][td][b]50[/b][/td][/tr][/table]

notes.title: A Letter from Lee PD
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/7ac33cf859d132d72c8813ee5f5115e06b44ef14.png[/img]

[table][tr][td][h1][b]A Letter from Lee PD[/b][/h1][table][tr][td]

Greetings Agents,


I hope your day goes well.
Through this letter, I’d like to tell you about myself.
I’m Lee Seungheon, the next project director of Closers. Please call me Lee PD.


Since I’ve only been working on developing the game until now, it feels awkward and makes me shy to introduce myself to everyone. I can’t figure out what I’m supposed to say.

As a newly appointed director, I would appreciate your understanding if I were to make any mistakes.


I’ve mainly participated in the development since last year, during the renewal of Teamwork and UNION Watch.

I’m just a regular game developer who loves Closers, appreciates positive feedback, and frets over getting criticism from the Agents as we prepare improvements for next year, like DirectX 11 upgrade, new gaming systems, more convenience features, an expanded Investigation Group, and so on.


I’ll do my best to make Closers a game that all Agents can enjoy and immerse themselves in.


To honor the commitment we made with the Agents, and at the request of Yu PD, I promise to making necessary changes and improvements, updating game graphics, and adding characters and scenarios while keeping in mind that Closers is a subcultural, supernatural action game set in New Seoul.


In addition, I’d like to extend my gratitude to all the Agents that enjoys playing Closers.
I will keep you up to date on our following developments one at a time through various channels.
Please provide us with your interest and support as we continue to progress.


I would also like to briefly introduce the new character, Aeri that we are currently developing.


We wanted to come up with a character who is skilled with a bow.

She is not just a Closer who fights with a bow but also a half-dimensional monster and half-human combination.
She resembles Kalbach Tux, Jisu Black (when she’s turned into Omega Queen), and Herbert West Hoffman.


She launches arrows infused with either poison (from her human half) or water (from her dimensional monster side) Phase Force. We put a lot of thought into the design of this character in the hopes that you can engage in strategic plays.


I’m hoping you’ll be interested in Aeri’s adventure as she tries to make alternative decisions in the conflict between humanity and dimensional monsters including her eventful backstory.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/6d3a49eb9610bdc17d8e7dda4db4f3c59561967c.png[/img]


Aeri has been introduced. Therefore, it’s time for me to wrap up my remarks.
I’m looking forward to the next time I can share other stuff with the Agents in Closers World.


And this brings us to another point!
Additionally, I’ve prepared a special present for each Agent.
Please don’t forget to get your gifts.


I look forward to your love and support.
Thank you very much.


Sincerely,
Lee PD


There is a special in-game reward prepared for you that can be received until December 7, 2022 maintenance. Please check your mailbox now!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/3f0d8d6f8c523489f6f9b15fc14167af35584f3c.png[/img]

[h1][b]November 23rd Update Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[u][h2][b]Contents[/b][/h2][/u]
[h3][b][url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/2022123-fortress-of-white-night/]► New Area <Fortress of White Night/Polar Night>[/url][/b][/h3][list][*]New Area ‘Fortress of White Night/Polar Night’ has been added[/*][/list][list][*]Fortress of White Night/Polar Night Area is the next story area after ‘Centum City’, which can be entered with Lv.89 or above characters.[/*][*]

notes.title: A Letter from Yu PD
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/18f882f5b4be2c99f9ec9511a46bae9286c4eedd.png[/img]

[table][tr][td][h1][b]A Letter from Yu PD[/b][/h1][table][tr][td]

Greetings, Agents!
I’m Yu PD, the chief project director of Closers.


It’s been a while since I said hello to you with the update roadmap video.
I hope you’ve all been doing well.
These days, the temperature has dropped significantly in Korea. Please always take good care of yourself.


I’m here to tell you about the changes that are coming for the winter of 2022.


I still have vivid memories of the day when I was appointed as the producer of Closers.
As we prepare for 2023, I want to tell you about the new producer who will take over for me.


Many things have happened in the past few years.
I’ve heard feedback from Closers Agents that range from excellent to negative and everything in between.
Whenever I received negative criticisms, I truly regretted that I was unable to meet your satisfaction due to my lack of ability.


We always listen to your feedback so we can keep making improvements.
With confidence, I can tell that your contributions have improved the game.


You have loved and cared about Closers, and I will never forget it.


You have shown us your interest and made numerous suggestions expressing your support, which has inspired the team to work harder.


Even though I won’t be in this role anymore, I will continue following and supporting Closers.


The next producer is someone who has developed Closers with me for a long time.
I have no doubt that he would try his hardest to make your gaming experience better.
It was a privilege to develop Closers alongside the team and, of course, all the Closers Agents.
Please continue to keep New Seoul safe.


Thank you very much.
– Yu PD

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/c8d3acd924e0c3a73758bfdb1ea3824d68029689.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]Fortress of White Night[/b][/h1]
[i]Step into the snow, and find out the unexpected answers that await you![/i]

[table][tr][td]

[h2][b]Fortress of White Night Letter[/b][/h2]

Greetings Agents,

We are the game developers of Closers.

We would like to take this opportunity to thank you for your patience and support throughout Season 3 of Closers, which has officially come to an end with this update.

From <Season 1: Humans vs Dimensional Monsters>,
to <Season 2: Humans vs Humans>,
and to <Season 3: Closers vs Closers>.

Your love and support made it possible for all these stories to begin and reach the conclusion. 
Agents, we sincerely appreciate it.

This concludes the story of how the young people who formerly defended the small city of <New Seoul> became the courageous Closers who protects the world.
We hope that the story will leave all of the agents with pleasant recollections.

We would like to inform you that all of these stories were only <Closers – Part 1>. 
We promise to learn from our successes and mistakes to give more meaningful and genuine stories to everyone. 
The countless Closers stories are something we hope you look forward to.

But before we proceed, we have a favor to ask of you. 
Many secrets will be revealed in the third season’s new and last area, <Fortress of White Night>.

Therefore, for the time being, we kindly ask that you avoid from exposing any <Fortress of White Night> spoilers.

For the Closers who have finished Season 3, we have prepared a special reward called
the [b]<Memorial Box of White Night>[/b] to show our appreciation and support.

Here is the list of the rewards:

[table][tr][td]
[b]x1 New Accessory[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td][list][*]You can obtain the reward for each character by completing the story.[/*][*]Image can be equipped.[/*][/list][/td][/tr][tr][td]
[b]x1 Effect Costume (Phase Wings) [/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td][list][*]Available for a limited period only till February 22, 2023 maintenance
[list][*] Can not be obtained after February 22nd, 2023 maintenance[/list][/*][*]You can claim the reward for each character after completing the story to get this item.[/*][/list][/td][/tr][/table]
We’ve thought a lot about how we can offer this reward, and we’ve concluded that it needs to be [obtained by completing the story] because it is closely tied to the storyline.

We hope that you enjoy the final story of Season 3 that we’ve poured our hearts into, as well as receive the special rewards!

Season 3 is over, but Closers’ story is just getting started.
There are still a lot of Closers-related stories to be told.
We’d like to introduce the forthcoming features that we are working on before we start <Closers – Part 2>.

[b][New System][/b]
We’re getting ready to update a system that will utilize the content from <Fortress of White Night> so stay tuned for that.
 
[b][Closers – Part 2][/b]
[b]<Back to Everyday Life>[/b]
The theme for Season 4 is <Back to Everyday Life>.
We’d like to tell you the story of Closers who had no alternative but to disregard their daily lives due to confrontations with formidable foes.
 
However, they still fight evil in their daily lives.
Season 4 will include a furious conflict between the Closers who want to safeguard their ordinary lives and the enemies who want to destroy them.
 
Additionally, we intend to improve Closers by utilizing more unique and diversified ideas in terms of tale structure and presentation.
We sincerely hope you will anticipate it.
 
We made it this far because of the support from all agents.
As the developer who completed <Closers– Part 1> this year, my heart is brimming with happiness.
 
We’ve been able to get this far thanks to your love and interest for Closers, as well as your encouragement and support.
We want to express our sincere gratitude to you once more.
 
We will always be grateful for your love and encouragement, and we will work hard to keep getting better.
We hope you’ll keep anticipating Closers’ never-ending adventures.
Thank you very much.
 
Sincerely,
The developers of Closers

[/td][/tr][/table]

notes.title: November 2022 – Account Suspensions
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

Thank you to everyone who let us know about the suspicious gaming activities discovered in-game.

After a thorough investigation, we banned more than a hundred Closers World server accounts for taking advantage of the Jump Event. We are going to keep an eye out for any further activities that are similar to this one.

We want to remind everyone that abusing the game can lead to a permanent ban from both the account and the Closers World server.

Thank you for your cooperation and understanding.

Please report any serious issues or suspicious players right away to our customer support by visiting [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/b][/url]. Alternatively, you can email us at [url=support@closersonline.com][b]support@closersonline.com[/b][/url].

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/7194640287f589ebc656ff00aaeb25810859780f.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Universal Children’s Day[/b][/h1]
[i]We can reimagine a better world for all children if we work together. Let’s celebrate Children’s Day with a blast![/i]

[h2][b][u]Universal Children’s Day Attendance[/u][/b][/h2]
[i]Simply logging in every day for ten consecutive days will get you a new Accessory item,[/i][i]and on the first day of logging in, you’ll also receive a Celebration Box![/i]

Event Period
[b]November 9, 2022 at 7:00 AM – November 23, 2022 at 7:00 AM UTC[/b]

[table][tr][td][u][b]Day[/b][/u][/td][td][u][b]Item Name and Amount[/b][/u][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]1[/b][/td][td][b]x1 Children’s Day Celebration Box[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]2[/b][/td][td][b]x10 Drawing Coin[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]3[/b][/td][td][b]x2 Perfect PNA Evolution Kit[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]4[/b][/td][td][b]x1 Transcendental Elixir[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]5[/b][/td][td][b]x10 Drawing Coin[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]6[/b][/td][td][b]x2 Slot Type Modification Tool[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]7[/b][/td][td][b]x1 Anna Accessory Selectable Box (3-star, Cannot be repackaged)[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]8[/b][/td][td][b]x1 Gear Booster Fortifier[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]9[/b][/td][td][b]x20 Drawing Coin[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]10[/b][/td][td][b]x1 Boss Eye Random Box (3-star, Cannot be repackaged)[/b][/td][/tr][/table][list][*]Drawing Coin expiration: December 7, 2022 at 7:00 AM UTC[/*][/list][table][tr][td][table][tr][td][b]Children’s Day Celebration Box[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]
x1 Candy Rain [Event]
x1 Elite Status (1-Day)
x10 Luck Stabilizer
x10 Piece of Cake
x1 Resurrection Capsule X11
[/td][/tr][/table][/td][td][table][tr][td][b]Anna Accessory Selectable Box[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]

[/td][/tr][/table][/td][/tr][/table]

[h2][b][u]Children’s Day Capsule Machine[/u][/b][/h2]
[i]We like the Capsule Machine as much as the child does! Collect capsules and coins to unlock a range of prizes![/i]

Sales Period
[b]November 9, 2022 at 7:00 AM – December 7, 2022 at 7:00 AM UTC[/b]

[b]Empty Capsules[/b]
[list][*] Use to refill item slots in an Event Capsule Machine.
[*] You will need 16 Empty Capsules to reset the item pool until you like the loot.[/list]
[b]Drawing Coin[/b]
[list][*] Use to collect items from an Event Capsule Machine.
[*] Obtain Drawing Coins in the Attendance Event and Exchange Shop.[/list]
[h3][i][b]Get these hot random rewards from the Capsule Machine![/b][/i][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e61d16604a21f07ac8576625090ba11733e74b50.png[/img]


[h2][b]How to Gather Empty Capsule and Drawing Coin?[/b][/h2]

[h3]► [i]Acquire [b]x5 Empty Capsules [/b]by clearing[/i][url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/target-dungeon-list/][b][i]Target Event Dungeons[/i][/b][/url].

► [i][b]Drawing Coins [/b]can be obtained through Attendance Event and Exchange Shop.[/i][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/809dbfb65c73bbf314fe9003c37ce596314c4f4e.png[/img]

notes.title: Q&A with the Closers World Devs! – Answered
notes.content:
[i]We would want to extend our gratitude to all of the Agents who contributed their questions, feedback, and suggestions.[/i]

You will find the topic, together with a summary of your questions and our Developers’ responses, at the bottom of this page on this website.

We truly appreciate everyone who participated in this season’s Dev Q and A session!


[h3][b]► Costume Related Concerns[/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Just as the Fatigue System was removed for the Closers World Server, “Seasonal Trend” for costumes should also be removed.
[/*][*]
Release the “Paradise” Swimsuit Washing Machine as soon as you can without waiting for the “Season (Every Summer, June of the year)”
[/*][*]
As of now, the only way to purchase old costume pieces is via the Union Store, and they’re all in packages. In Closers KR, you can buy each item individually instead of the packages that Closers World doesn’t have. Could you sell costume pieces separately while also selling the package version? Also, could we get more older costumes? 
Example: Sailor, Ninja, Shaman, All-Star, Pirate, Noble costume sets (packages and pieces) to Union Store.
[/*][*]
Since the game moved to Naddic, the synchro fiber failed merge pool for 2* costumes has stayed the same. This is especially true for Rattus characters, who have only had their release costumes and cozy winter costumes. Is there a plan to rotate the costumes?
[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[u][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/u]

We will do all in our power to ensure that the newest costumes and content are made available as quickly as possible on the World server, which will unquestionably give the server a better sense of freshness when it comes to these kinds of updates.

We support the idea of getting rid of the “Seasonal Trend”, and as part of our commitment to this idea, the “Paradise” Swimsuit costume that was released on the Closers Korea server this year will also be released more quickly on the World server than it normally would be. However, we would like to ask for your patience on this matter because we also have structural challenges to address before we can bring forward any costume updates.

In addition to that, we assure you that we will return even more of our older costumes to the Union store. We will prioritize your suggestions, such as Sailor, Ninja, All-Star, Pirate, and Noble. Meanwhile, the Shaman costume was recently on sale during the past patch update.

Please know that we always welcome any additional recommendations. You can send it to Customer Support, where we often collect feedback and ideas.

More topics regarding Costume Conversion Failure costumes need to be covered. As soon as we have news to share with you, we’ll let you know.

[/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► In-game Updates Related[/b][/h3]
[list][*]
I discovered that Silvy’s Prime Agent skill is based on the Global version’s outdated version. There were numerous complaints about it, thus it has now been upgraded to the current one.

Another aspect is the latest roadmap announcement of the “Signature costume conversion 100% success” feature update. This feature was only introduced on September 7th in the Korean server, but Global has already made it available.

It’s either that some updates are coming out much faster while all older content is coming out much slower or that some should have been updated to the latest version but continue to use the old version despite numerous complaints. Could you please clarify more about it?
[/*][*]
The only thing that distinguishes this server is Thanksgiving, which was brought over from the Korean server, and Black Friday, which is now just a big sales event. For a server that caters to multi-region playerbases, shouldn’t there be more incorporated celebrations or efforts to make Thanksgiving events stand out? For example, Japan has Golden Week and Korea has Chuseok events.
[/*][*]
Closers Korea server will soon get a QOL update for raids that allows players to depart after defeating the main boss without having to “alt+f4”. Would it be possible to implement this update on World server ahead of schedule?
[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[u][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/u]

To begin, we would like to point out that not all systems and not every piece of Closers content follows the same structure. Some of them can be put into place in each region at the same time, while others can’t.

Based on this difference, we will do our best to roll out some updates as quickly as possible in order to give all agents a better gaming experience, regardless of the system’s structure or the frequent content gaps.

Your feedback on the update timing has been heard, and we are doing everything in our control to find ways to make the updates available more swiftly. Even though it will take some time, we guarantee that the updates will be made far more efficiently from now on.

As this is a global service, we are currently putting greater emphasis on universality with regard to the world-exclusive event and content. On this point, we agree with you that there needs to be more diversity. Outside of the typical game content, we are going to come up with some new ideas for interesting themes to incorporate into the overall experience.

The QoL improvement related to the ability to leave the raid after defeating the boss is not an update that can be deployed immediately or simultaneously. With regard to this matter, we would ask for your utmost patience till this is ready to be applied on the World server.

[/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Characters Related Concern[/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Hybrid characters suffer large stat losses because hybrid equipment and damage are weaker than single-type ones. I’m curious as to why there are different types of damage, especially since they affect the game’s balance.

I want to know if there are plans to make hybrid characters more balanced and/or merge damage types, fix hybrid gear, and recalculate the combat power of hybrid characters.
[/*][*]
I’m wondering if having many characters to farm consumables, materials, and credits is the game’s intended approach. Running all dungeons with my best-equipped character is often less beneficial for rewards than running another character through a specific set of dungeons. Which makes playing a few characters less rewarding than having a number of dungeon-farming characters.
[/*][*]
Could the final member of the Rattus team arrive, perhaps early next year?
[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[u][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/u]

The character’s power cannot be accurately gauged solely by looking at the numbers associated with their skill damage. In order to create a balance between the character skills, factors like cooldown, casting time, and any special circumstances that may arise after performing a skill are being considered. Aside from the method of balancing, we fully recognize that the existing Hybrid characters are not powerful enough when their TCP is taken into consideration.

We are unable to disclose the specific blueprint for the Hybrid characters at this time. However, we will conduct a thorough review on this topic and reveal how we want to improve the Hybrid characters when the information is ready.

For the next question, we think that the amount of time spent on the different parts of the game could lead to gaining better rewards, and this is especially true when using more than one character.

Please think of each character as one of the many different pieces of content that are included in Closers, and consider that playing a number of them is one of the more enjoyable and gratifying ways to enjoy Closers.

As for the last Rattus member, when we have any information regarding the newest member of the Rattus team, we will be sure to share it with you on our official webpage. Therefore, we ask that you keep an eye out for any additional announcements.

[/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Closers Player Council[/b][/h3]
[list][*]
What do the Closers’ Player Council members do?
[/*][*]
What kind of rules should they still follow that only the admins are allowed to do, and what kind of authority do they have to maintain the server itself?
[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[u][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/u]

Members of the Closers Player Council often assist the Naddic team in managing the Closers Discord server, reporting bugs, and moderating the Closers community. Any specific details were shared with those who are currently serving on the council. They are expected to treat one another with respect and to provide frequent feedback and suggestions.

The same rules that apply to the players also apply to them, but because they have additional privileges in the official Closers Discord, including the ability to ban or kick users, they must adhere to additional procedures before taking such action. We want to emphasize that they do not possess any unique abilities associated with their accounts within the game. They’re players like you, and we ask that you treat them with the respect that should be extended to other gamers in the community.

Moreover, we would like to use this opportunity to clarify that CPCs are not responsible for determining which updates to apply or when they will be delivered, that obligation remains with Naddic team.

[/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► In-game Item Related Concerns[/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Is it possible for old achievement accessories or rare cosmetic accessory drops from old story dungeons to be easier to obtain, either via vending machines or as event items?
[/*][*]
Can PVP players trade gold medals for something? My suggestion is to exchange gold medals for something that helps get late-game gear.
[/*][*]
Can we get more use out of PvP medals or awards from playing PvP?
[/*][*]
Please add the option of producing necessary consumables with the sea breeze.
[/*][*]
Can we get more benefit from the Gold Hero Plate?
[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[u][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/u]

We are grateful for all of your comments and suggestions regarding the use of the various material items. We assure you that we will expand the use of PVP medals, Gold Hero Plates, and Essence of Sea Breeze in the near future.

When it comes to the old accessories and costumes, we will look for the most popular options while keeping the examples that were given in mind and making them available through different events.

[/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Past Dev QnA Concerns[/b][/h3]
[list][*]
According to the previous Q&A, there would be considerations for more powerful state effects and cosmetics surrounding legion commanders for players to earn. Has there been any further discussion?
[/*][*]
Why is communication between a player and a developer useful if another server provides more insight into the future?
[/*][*]
Instead of being condescending and saying that your input is appreciated but nothing will change, please provide a list of topics or game content that you intend to improve.
[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[u][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/u]

There are a lot of topics for which we can’t say for sure when they will be available or when they will be updated.

However, we are confident in telling you that the decisions regarding the next updates and improvements have been made based on the input of Agents from all over the world, not just from the Korea server.

Your suggestions and feedback regarding ways to improve the gameplay are very helpful to the developers as we plan out the updates and take steps to correct any issues. As a result, we would appreciate it very much if you could continue to share your opinions on Closers.

We are going to have a further discussion about how we can make it more clear to you that your input is being taken into account and incorporated into the game.

[/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Squad Related Concern[/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Is there any other way to encourage squad play? Currently, being in a squad offers a small bonus item found increase.
[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[u][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/u]

At this time, we are thinking about different approaches to relieve the pressure that is caused by the squad play, both on the system end and the content end.

Please keep an eye out for this in future updates.

[/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Dungeons/Item Drops/Rewards[/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Is there any help provided to newer players to help them proceed through dungeons as their gears are prerequisites to the latest raids and dungeons?
[/*][*]
How will future dungeon drops/rewards be balanced? Why does balancing drops/rewards often lead to the removal of their sources, which is unpleasant?
[/*][*]
Can you remove the Contamination capsule purifier as the key to enter the purif sectors?
[/*][*]
Is it feasible to craft or boost the drop rate of epic gears like Athena Warrior, Valhalla, Advancing Gluttony, etc. for newer players?
[/*][*]
Can you balance the reward for IF – Asmodeus? At least make it slightly better than IF – Beelzebub or just make it same as IF – Beelzebub.
[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[u][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/u]

In the Purification Sectors, we are going to take away the item that serves as the entrance key. Thank you for your insightful comments. Please keep in mind that the actual update to the World server will take a while to finish.

We are quite grateful for the thoughtful concerns regarding the new players’ gear farming. In the near future, there are plans to implement an update that will make it possible to receive a full set of gear that is equivalent to those earned by completing legion commander quests. We have the hope that new players will have an easier time overcoming the hurdles.

This reversed situation occurs with regard to the rewards from the Asmodeus IF dungeon, and it is caused by the low value of the Essence of See Breeze item. We are going to expand this item’s range of uses, which will lead to an increase in its overall value.

We have a general understanding of your feedback on the balancing of dungeon rewards and gear. We will be taking a more cautious approach to the item balancing after taking into consideration the insightful comments you have provided.

[/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Divine Battle[/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Dream Theater seems to be a meaningless hub that you should only visit to complete your task force/black hands mission and collect your trigger. When you can’t even get the scissors in the first place, nobody will bother crafting Dogra or Magra effects, especially beginner players. Additionally, there are no new themes or any efforts to guarantee that DB will be released on time.
[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[u][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/u]

We believe that the current Divine Battle is loose to some extent and does not follow the original intention of a point competition between two camps.

We are looking into how we may improve the delivery of the intrinsic fun that comes with this content. After giving it enough time to plan, we would then show the changed part of the content. 

[/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Enhancement[/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Trinkets and amplifiers don’t offer viable stat improvements at each enhancement level, although the probability of enhancement is the same as the core or module. What is the significance of this if no one wants to use these two components to their maximum potential?
[/*][*]
Beyond +15, enhanced stat gains diminish, there is no ilvl growth, and the buff voucher need 250 consecutive misses to enter fever time. Should this requirement not be reworked downwards to reflect the scaled down stat gains?
[/*][*]
Is it possible that the gear booster fortifier can be crafted in some way?
[/*][*]
Please consider lowering the cost of the Uncommon device or make it a completely free and accessible system.
[/*][*]
Will enhancement rates be updated so that there is the possibility of +14 -> +16?
[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[u][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/u]

We are aware that there are a range of opinions regarding the usefulness of Trinket and Amplifier enhancements, as well as the difficulty of gaining access to the Uncommon Enhancement Transfer Device.

Please bear with us while we have in-depth discussions about this. Rest assured that it will be for the better, and we will reveal the results soon in one of our game updates.

At this time, there are no plans for us to reduce the requirement for Enhancement buff fever, add +2 success to +14 gear enhancement, or provide crafting for Gear Booster Fortifier item.

Having said that, we do understand that you want improvements that are easier to use in general.

We would like to have an approach to this topic in the aspect of default enhancement rate and stats.

We will continue to investigate and develop new ways to make the enhancement more user-friendly while maintaining the value of high enhancement level gears. 

[/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Events[/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Is there a method to obtain existing characters the gear that jumping characters get? I’ve seen events give out gears before.
[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[u][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/u]

We also wanted to provide support for the characters who were already in the game, which is why the Autumn Jumping Support Box is now being made available to every character. 

We will make an effort to provide Jumping events that are both convenient and effective continuously.

[/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Washing Machine[/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Can we stop discouraging people to cash due to bad costume/accessory draw rate and unsightly tier reward?
[/*][*]
When are My Room washing machines’ costumes rotated?
[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[u][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/u]

With the update that was released on October 12, a system that can supply a “My Character piece selected box” has been updated.

We are going to make the accumulative bonuses for washing machines more flexible by adding more ‘Selectable’ options for you to choose from.

The costume for the My Room Washing Machine has been changed to Training Wolf as of the update that went live on October 12. After a certain interval, we shall carry out the following rotation.

[/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Game Features[/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Are there plans to expand the in-game command feature such as the ‘/inspect’, and what direction does Naddic plan to take player privacy? For example, will there be a ‘/find’ command to let us know where players are? Will there be a way to keep a profile and/or TCP in-raids private?
[/*][*]
Are there plans to make it possible to block players based on the mail they send?
[/*][*]
Have there been any thoughts about extending the Black Market sales duration from 24 hours to something greater (possibly unlimited time)?
[/*][*]
Will the Black Market have a sort-by-recent-sale option?
[/*][*]
Has Naddic given any thought into the sale of NCoin vouchers that can be sold on the black market and redeemed directly for NCoin, potentially with some sort of additional repackaging cost for NCoin voucher resale?
[/*][*]
Are there plans to have a Couple/Marriage system and features?
[/*][*]
If possible, it would be highly appealing to players if you updated housing/garden boosts to work like platinum status and persist once you activate the elite version until it fully expires instead of deactivating below 30d.
[/*][*]
Please make sector entry consumed only when we cleared it.
[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[u][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/u]
[list][*]The following features are going to receive a favorable evaluation from us.
[list][*]Extension on Black Market sales duration[/*][*]Mail Block (Connect to Messenger Block)[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]We do not presently have any plans to introduce the following features since they might have a negative effect on the game’s economy and community or they might not be compatible with the overall concept of the game. We genuinely hope that everyone will understand.
[list][*]Find player location command[/*][*]N-Coin Voucher item[/*][*]Couple/Marriage System[/*][*]My Room/Farm buff VVIP period adjustment[/*][*]Sector entry check change[/*][/list][/*][/list][/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Gear[/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Please describe the thought process going into the creation of a new gear tier grade.
In summary, please justify why these gears couldn’t be Epic Grade droppable gear instead like Hell Modules.
[/*][*]
Lv.80-90 has represented about 5+ years worth of Naddic content averaging 4 iterations of gears yet the level gaps between these iterations are barely 2-3 levels apart. This may not be significant for the long-term player, but for new players the EXP per level gap between them can be addressed within a matter of days.
[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[u][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/u]

Extra Gears are designed to have a longer lifetime than Legendary Gears.

Their distribution on the server is intentionally limited, but taking into account the size of the player base on the World server, we have adjusted the drop rate accordingly.

The process of obtaining Extra gears will be dualized in an upcoming Legion Commander update in February 2023, making them slightly more accessible to players.

In the future update, completing the relevant quests will reward players with a full set of most of the old gear.

We would like to narrow the content gap that exists between old and new players while simultaneously increasing the number of new players retained, which will ultimately result in a more dynamic server.

Please use the appropriate support channel to communicate any feedback you may have on the gear farming system and new player assistance systems. It would be very much appreciated.

[/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Skills[/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Will Naddic improve skill descriptions in October’s Character Skill Rebalance patch? In-Game Examples are Sylvi: EX Supercluster, Yuri: Rank 4 Special Move: Invincible Yuri, and Lucy: Special Move: Aratta’s Ruler.
[/*][*]
Please provide a possibility to adjust flares for skill effects other than requiring a full set.
[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[u][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/u]

We’ve updated Yuri’s skill description, and the adjustment will be applied in the next patch update.

We will take care of the imprecise translations, inaccuracies, and insufficient skill descriptions. Please let us know through Support Inquiry if you have any current issues about a particular skill description, and we’ll look into it more.

At this time, we are having a hard time making changes to the effects of skills. We are sorry that we are unable to provide you with a satisfactory response.

[/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Others[/b][/h3]
[list][*]
Since the roadmap announced about the main website renewal, will the Discord server also get a similar upgrade treatment?
[/*][*]
Regarding the Player Conference that happened last 2021. There are many implemented contents, however some aren’t. Even a year after the conference, some unavailable content has no clear schedule.
[/*][*]
How interested is Naddic in the concept of player retention?
[/*][*]
I understand that Naddic does not plan to bring back AOS, but do the assets still form a part of the client files? If so, are there any issues in removing it entirely?
[/*][/list][table][tr][td]

[u][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/u]

We will explore the possibilities of enhancing the functionality of Discord in any way that is available to us. If you have any suggestions that you would want to pass along, you can send them to our Customer Support team or discuss them with any of our Closers Player Council members, who will then share your thoughts with the rest of the team.

Even if many of the promises made regarding the KR player conference have been fulfilled, there are still a few topics that require further time to evaluate. Regarding the subject at hand, we would humbly request your kind patience.

We are concerned about player retention and a pleasant gaming experience. That is mostly all we care about. There may be instances where your expectations are not satisfied, but please keep in mind that we plan out updates, events, and sales in order to offer you with the best game experience possible.

Although there are no plans to relaunch AOS, the client files cannot simply be removed because they are relevant to the other contents as well. We will work hard to optimize the game client, as we have always done.

[/td][/tr][/table]

[h1][b]Monthly Attendance Renewal

notes.title: Known Issue Notice – OCT 27th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you of a known issue that was found after the most recent patch, and that we will be conducting temporary maintenance according to the following time zone schedule:

Schedule by time zone
[list][*] October 27 at 6:00 AM to 7:00 AM UTC
[*] October 26 at 11:00 PM to October 27 at 12:00 AM PDT
[*] October 27 at 1:00 PM to 2:00 PM GMT+7[/list]
During this maintenance, a known bug discovered in the most recent patch release will be resolved.

[h3][b]Sign of Growth Talisman Box[/b][/h3]
[list][*] We found that the Sign of Growth Talisman Box was unintentionally set to account basis per class. We will make this a "once per character" fix, so each of your characters can get one Talisman, even if they have the same class type.

For example, if you already had a Eunha character and got a Talisman from it, and then later made another Eunha character, that new one should also have its own Talisman.

[*] After this temporary maintenance, the player’s current event and talisman items will be removed, and a new talisman with the corrected functionality will be provided.[/list]
[b]Additional Known Issue[/b]
[list][*] [b]Missing NPC Monster/Unable to proceed completing dungeon due to missing NPC Monster[/b]
[list][*] There are certain players who deal an excessive amount of damage to the dungeon monsters, which prevents them from completing the dungeon objective. This is a known bug, but it only happens very infrequently when players swiftly kill monsters. In order to avoid this problem, it is generally advised that you restrain from dealing the monster too much damage all at once when it is very close to being defeated.[/list][/list]
Thank you for your understanding and we apologize for the inconvenience that this has caused.

If you have any concerns or bug reports, you may contact us at:
[url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/b][/url]

Or send us an email to:
[url=support@closersonline.com][b]support@closersonline.com[/b][/url]

notes.title: Closers Player Council – New Batch!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

[h1][b]Closers Player Council – New Batch![/b][/h1]
[i]The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/215830/view/3287088138445351146]recruitment for the [b]Closers Player Council[/b] [/url]is finally over, and here are the updates for the new batch of CPC[/i]

[table][tr][td]

Hello there, Agents.

We sincerely thank everyone who applied for the Closers Player Council. Each entry was carefully reviewed, and we are pleased to see the applicants' eagerness to support the Closers player community and willingness to go the extra mile for Closers.

It was difficult for us to select only five applicants from the pool, but we believe that these players will make valuable contributions to the new Closers Player Council.

[table][tr][td]
Let’s welcome the new Closers Player Council Batch 2!

[b]『沈む』#6980
Spotted Garden Eel#0569
0kiki0#8158
Pie#6371
Vaff1016#2798[/b]

[/td][/tr][/table]
We are excited to work with the new batch and help each other build a stronger player community.

All new batch CPC members will be invited to our exclusive Closers Player Councils Discord channel using the Discord account ID provided during registration. To all CPC members, please stay tuned for more information on that channel.

We want to say once more how much we appreciate every Agent who applied for this chance!

Don't worry! By sending us your feedback and suggestions via [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]Customer[/b] [b]Support[/b][/url], anyone can collaborate and can share your thoughts for Closers.

[h1][b]October 12th Update Patch Notes[/b][/h1]

[h1][b][u]Contents[/u][/b][/h1]

[table][tr][td][h3][b] 1. Character Balance Adjustment                                                                     [/b][/h3][/td][/tr][/table]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/7b15574cbfa2c7b0bd6fd790ae5f4c4c5af67104.png[/img]


[h3][b]► Sylvi’s ‘Neutron Buster’ Skill has been Improved[/b][/h3][list][*]Superelectron Sphere 4 hit has been changed to Superelectron Sphere (Explosion) 1 hit[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/ea6d3df2e05be0055e1a501556186a6b740244a4.png[/img]


[table][tr][td][h3][b] 2. Item Craft Renew                                                                     [/b][/h3][/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Item Crafting List in each Hub has been Renewed.[/b][/h3][list][*]Area crafting now can be accessed regardless of the character’s current location.[/*][*]Crafting feature of some NPCs has been integrated.[/*][*]If the crafting item consists of several crafting methods, they will be shown on the right side of the UI[/*][*]Title, Pet, Black Market favorites list has been reset due to the crafting renewal.[/*][/list]
[h3]► [b]New Functions have been Added to the Crafting System.[/b][/h3][list][*]Level search: Search crafting items in Minimum ~ Maximum Level scope.[/*][*]Item search: Search crafting methods for a certain crafting item.[/*][*]Now favorites for crafting can be set per character.[/*][*]Craft Link: If there’s craft method link, arrow mark will be shown.[list][*]Craft method can be checked by double clicking the Material Item[/*][*]A button returning to the previous crafting method will be activated on the right-top by clicking craft Link.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]► Category Changes[/b][/h3][list][*]Crafting items that can be crafted after completing missions now will be shown in ‘Quest’ Category always. (Except for Module no.666)[/*][*]‘Task Force’ Category at Fantasy World: Dream Theater area has been integrated to the ‘Quest’ Category.[/*][*]‘Awakening Bead’ Item in ‘Housing’ category has been moved to ‘Consumables’ Category.[/*][/list]
[h3][b]► Some Crafting Item has been Removed.[/b][/h3][list][*]‘Purification Trinket 6 Set Box’ in ‘Planar Gate: Deep Layer’ tab has been removed.[/*][/list]
[h3][b]► Crafting UI has been Improved.[/b][/h3]


[table][tr][td][h3][b] 3. Chip Farming Eased                                                                                    [/b][/h3][/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Origin Chip Farming has been Eased[/b][/h3][list][*]Weekly crafting count for Origin Chip per Material has been increased.[/*][*]Amount of materials for crafting Origin Chip has been decreased.[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/0e6dad17a9d1b3c63f5c4a5b18ab412551088e8b.png[/img]


[table][tr][td][h3][b] 4. Chatting System Improved                                                                                   [/b][/h3][/td][/tr][/table]

[h3]► [b]Chatting System has been Improved.[/b][/h3][list][*]Adding/Modifying/Removing chatting tab function has been added.[/*][*]Maximum 6 chatting tabs can be added, and name of each tab can enter from 2 to 4 characters.[/*][*]All/squad/Crew/whisper/System tabs are default, and they can be modified or removed.[/*][*] Adding/Modifying/Removing chatting tab and adjusting size/location can be done in hub, housing and crew hangout.[/*][*] Minimize feature has been added to chatting tab and clicking the button will activate/deactivate the tab.[/*][*]Chatting Window size adjustment function has been added. Left-click the right-top corner of the chatting window and drag to change the window size.[/*][*] A button adjusting the location of the chatting window has been added.[/*][*]Chatting command Guide button has been moved to the right-bottom corner.[/*][*]New command /cr has been added. Entering the command will reset the size and location changes of the chatting window.[/*][*]New commands for the crew chatting and whisper chatting have been added.[/*][*]Whisper function has been improved.[list][*]Enter /whisper + [Character Name] and Space Bar to enter whisper chat.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Entering ESC button while writing chat will deactivate chatting window only.[/*][*]Chat history will preserve even after changing the channel.[list][*]However, returning to Character Lobby will reset the history.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[table][tr][td][h3][b] 5. Guide System Renewal                                                                                    [/b][/h3][/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]► Guide System has been Renewed.[/b][/h3][list][*]Guide UI now consists of [Main Category / Sub Category / Page].[/*][*]Search function has been added.[/*][*]When searching with a certain keyword, all subcategories containing the keyword will be shown on the search result page.[/*][/list][h3][b]► Guide now Provides the Latest Content.[/b][/h3]

► Incorrect skill damage of Lucy’s ‘Judge Adad’ Skill has been fixed.

► Seth’s ‘Apophis’s Confinement’ Skill now applies Super Armor longer as it is originally intended.

notes.title: Q&A with the Closers World Devs!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

[h1][b]Q&A with the Closers World Devs![/b][/h1]

Hello Agents!

In addition to the release of the [b][url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20210727-qa-with-the-closers-world-devs/]Closers World Roadmap – Oct 2022 to Mar 2023[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20220928-closers-player-council-recruitment/]Closers Player Council Recruitment[/url][/b] announcement, here’s some more excellent news.

Questions and Answers with the Closers Developers is here to hear your voice once more!

During this opportunity, submit your questions, feedback, and suggestions in our official Closers Discord server.

[table][tr][td]

[h3][b]How to Submit Your Entry[/b][/h3]

Join in the official Closers World Discord server:
[url=https://discord.gg/UkDuWZzByb][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a4e3999d7cb6358a9db5854c31625425c0d7156c.png[/img][/url]

Then post your questions, feedback, or suggestions for the Closers World Developers, in the [b]#dev-q-and-a [/b]channel.

The Closers World development team will respond to frequently asked issues and concerns from the community!

Tips/Reminders:
[list][*]To clearly identify your entries, please list the topic followed by its associated details.[/*][*]If possible, we would greatly appreciate it if you could include bullet points and images, if they are available.[/*][*] Example:[list][*]Topic: Costume Inquiry[/*][*]Details: Are there any plans to re-release the Spring Fairy costumes in the future?[/*][/list][/*][/list] 
We will collect this data [b]starting September 30, 2022, until October 7, 2022, at 4:00 AM UTC[/b].

The list of concerns and the Developers’ answers will be posted on the official Closers website in October 2022.

[/td][/tr][/table]

Remember that you are always welcome to give your feedback and suggestions to Customer Support via [b][url=mailto:support@closersonline.com]support@closersonline.com[/url][/b] or [b][url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna[/url][/b] if you miss to submit your contribution.

We always appreciate the countless submissions we have received during our past Dev Q&As, and we appreciate your unwavering support!

notes.title: Closers Player Council Recruitment
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

[h1][b]Closers Player Council Recruitment[/b][/h1]
[i]Closers Player Council or “CPC” consists of existing Closers players who volunteer to keep the player community safe, active, and in communication with the official Naddic staff.[/i]

[h1][b]How to be a CPC?[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Naddic will publish a recruitment notice that includes a link to the online form where you should submit your  responses. All submissions will be evaluated by the Naddic staff. Once the CPCs have been selected, their names will be announced and the Naddic staff will contact them.[/*][*]The recruitment form will only be accessible for a limited time.[/*][*]A maximum of 5 members will be accepted, and the duration of this position is only 1 year.[/*][*]Anyone may apply, provided they meet the requirements. The previous CPCs may reapply, and they have a good chance of being re-included if they made significant contributions.[/*][/list]
[h1][b]Requirements[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Must have at least one Closers character with the current maximum level on the World server.[/*][*]You must be up to date with the most recent Closers World server events and patch updates.[/*][*]Must be able to communicate effectively with the official staff in English (Knowing multiple languages is an asset.)[/*][*]Must have a basic understanding of Discord.[/*][*]Veteran players of Closers are a definite advantage.[/*][*]No in-game infractions within the past 12 months[/*][/list]
[h1][b]Application[/b][/h1]

If you wish to join the Closers Player Council team, please send us via Customer Support inquiry the following information. You may copy and paste these questions with your answers

Go to: [b][url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/url][/b]
Select “[b]Event[/b]” as Category.
[list][*]Inquiry category: Event[/*][*]Character name: (input your main character’s name)[/*][*]Event name: Closers Player Council[/*][*]Title: Application[/*][*]Contents:

[list][*]Discord Management

We want to inform you that the CPCs is not responsible for determining which updates will be applied or when they will be released, as these decisions are still made by the Naddic team.[/*][*]Having determined that CPCs were effective, we will therefore distribute quarterly incentives on the first business day/scheduled maintenance date of January, April, July, and October.

[list][*]After we have reviewed all applications, we will announce it on our website, official social media pages, and Discord.[/*][/list]

[h3][i][b]Make a piece of artwork, be it drawn by hand, painted, or created digitally, based on the themes of Misery, Sandman, or characters from [url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20220921-misery-of-nightmare/]Closers dressed up as Misery/Sandman[/url].[/b][/i][/h3]

[/td][/tr][tr][td][h3][u][b] 2nd Place Winner [/b][/u][/h3]
[b]5,000 N-Coin + Cosplay Cafe Full Set[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td][h3][u][b] 3rd Place Winner [/b][/u][/h3]
[b]3,000 N-Coin + Cosplay Cafe Full Set[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td][h3][u][b] 5 Runner-up [/b][/u][/h3]
[b]1,000 N-Coin[/b]
[/td][/tr][/table][/td][/tr][/table]
