[list][*][b]Winners Announcement:[/b] October 14, 2022 UTC[/*][*][b]N-Coin Distribution Date: [/b]October 26, 2022 UTC during the server maintenance[/*][/list]
[h2][b][u]Rules and Reminders[/u][/b][/h2]
[list][*]One entry per Discord account and Closers account.[/*][*]Make sure YOU made it! All entries must be made by the submitter specifically for the purpose of this contest.[/*][*]Artwork that was previously submitted to any other contest will not be accepted.[/*][*]Commissioned works will not be accepted.[/*][*]Art can be digital (we may require to see the raw file), painting, and hand drawn.[/*][*]Entries should be submitted in image form only such as PNG or JPEG (GIF, Video, etc. will not be valid).[/*][*]All participants are required to input their Closers Name and Character Name otherwise; the entry will be invalid.[/*][*]No explicit contents are allowed to be seen in the entry. Any art that can make others feel offended or uncomfortable will be removed.[/*][*]Once you have submitted your entry, we may post it publicly on our official channels (Website, Steam, and SNS)[/*][*]If you need to change or edit your entry or post, remove the original entry then re-submit it again.[/*][*]If you have submitted more than one entry, we will only refer to the first entry that was submitted.[/*][*]Naddic team has the right to remove any non-related entries or discussions in the event channel. If you have any concerns or reports, you may contact us at [url=mailto:support@closersonline.com][b]support@closersonline.com[/b][/url][b].[/b][/*][/list]

[h2][b][u]Additional Rules & Reminders[/u][/b][/h2]

[list][*]As long as there are no copyright issues, it is acceptable to use other backgrounds such as other images or AI-generated backgrounds; however, the main character artwork must be originally drawn or created by the submitter.[/*][*]You may include dialogues in your submission.[/*][/list]

Greetings Agents,

We will have our server maintenance for Closers World server on the following schedule by time zone:

Schedule by time zone

Hello Agents,

It has come to our attention that the [url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20220713-summer-vacance-event-round-1/][b]Jumping Character Exclusive Attendance Event[/b][/url] doesn’t appear to Jump Characters in-game. If you encountered any bugs or issues, we highly suggest contacting us via Support inquiry to [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/b][/url] or send us an email to, [url=support@closersonline.com][b]support@closersonline.com[/b][/url] for further investigation.

notes.content:

Hello Agents,

It has been brought to our attention the issue regarding the [Finder of Sloth King's Passion (Physical/Psi/Hybrid) Title Ticket] has been missing in the SSS rank clear reward of <Machine King's Strategy Analysis Lab> dungeon.

This issue will be fixed during the [b]August 24, 2022 [/b]scheduled maintenance and below are the details:

[olist][*]The rate for <Finder of Sloth King's Passion (Physical/Psi/Hybrid) Title Ticket> items will be added to the rank reward correctly.
[/*][*]A new craft exchanging multiple <Machinery Memory Device> items to <Finder of Sloth King's Passion (Physical/Psi/Hybrid) Title Ticket> (not tradeable) will be added.[/*][/olist]
We apologize for this inconvenience that this may have caused.

In addition, during the next scheduled maintenance on [b]September 7, 2022[/b], all players who have cleared <Machine King's Strategy Analysis Lab> according to the dungeon clear count from [b]April 6, 2022 maintenance [/b]to [b]August 24, 2022 maintenance [/b]will be receiving the following items as compensation:

[table][tr][td][u][b]Strategy Analysis Lab SSS Reward Random Box[/b][/u][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Can obtain only one of the items below by each probability.[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Machinery Memory Device x1[/b]
[b]Finder of Sloth King's Passion (Physical) Title Ticket x1[/b]
[b]Finder of Sloth King's Passion (Psi) Title Ticket x1[/b]
[b]Finder of Sloth King's Passion (Hybrid) Title Ticket x1[/b][/td][/tr][/table][list][*]
<Strategy Analysis Lab SSS Reward Random Box> will provide double chance of obtaining title ticket items compared to the regular route.[/*][*]
<Strategy Analysis Lab SSS Reward Random Box> will be sent to each character who has dungeon clear record.[/*][*]
<Strategy Analysis Lab SSS Reward Random Box> can be moved to account storage.[/*][/list]
Thank you for your understanding.

If you have any bug reports or concerns, you may contact us at [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/b][/url] or email us to [url=mailto:support@closersonline.com][b]support@closersonline.com[/b][/url].

[*] You can get a maximum of 160 Drawing coins during the event period.[/list]

notes.title: Jumping Character EX Skill
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

Thank you for taking notice of the new [b]Jumping Character EX Skill[/b]. We would clarify a few points on what should be noted when proceeding with a Jumping Character:
[list][*]Due to the last June 29th update, Ex skills can now be earned from their previous normal skills of level 1 instead of level 10.[/*][*]With this change, more SPs are spent on normal skills for jumping characters unintentionally because their normal skills were set to level 10.[/*][*]You can downgrade the current EX skills all the way back to level 1 of their normal skills and upgrade them at level 1.[/*][/list]
We apologize for this inconvenience and the normal skill setting will be corrected starting from the next jumping character event.

Thank you!

notes.title: June 29th Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/3f0d8d6f8c523489f6f9b15fc14167af35584f3c.png[/img]

[h1][b][u]Contents[/u][/b][/h1]

[h3][b][url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20220629-mock-battle-renewal-update-omega-knight-transmitter/] ▶ Mock Battle Renewal[/url][/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]Added 2 new boss type[/b]
[list][*]DEEPSEA Boss, [b]‘Vasuki’[/b][/*][*]INSECTAN Boss, ‘[b]Master of Poison[/b]‘[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]The battle runs on weekly basis from now on.[/b][/*][/list]
 ▶ [b]Squad Matching Improvement[/b]
[list][*][b]Squad Matching System is improved.[/b]
[list][*]You can join a squad from almost anywhere, regardless of channel or town.[/*][*]Clicking Squad Menu(F3) opens a list of created squads, except secret squads.[/*][*]Squads that are full do not appear on the list, but can be searched.[/*][*]Squad name can be from 2 ~ 30 letters.[/*][*]Characters appear in squad info in the order of creation.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]Squad Menu(F3) UI is changed.[/b]
[list][*]A function of searching squad name and squad leader is added.[/*][*]Searching a squad has 5 seconds of cooldown.[/*][*]When clicking Squad Menu(F3), squads appear in the order of creation and the searched list is renewed by reopening it in 5 seconds.[/*][*]When opening Squad Menu(F3), the initial list of squads don’t renew automatically before reopening UI after 5 seconds or searching again.[/*][*]Squad Menu(F3) doesn’t open together with the following UI:
UNION CAMP/Selfie Mode/UNION Arena/Investigation Group UI/Chip Inventory/Key Bindings/Character Selection/Channel Change[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]Squad Invite System is improved.[/b]
[list][*]‘List of Received Invitations’ in Squad Menu(F3) shows a list of received invitations.[/*][*]‘List of Received Invitations’ is available only when you are not in a squad, and if ‘Block All Squad Invitations’ is activated, you won’t get invitations anymore.[/*][*]There is a cooldown of 15 seconds for a leader to invite a same character.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]Investigation Group System is improved.[/b]
[list][*]Regardless of channels and towns, all players can join a created investigation Group.[/*][*]When opening the Investigation Group menu, the list shows Investigation Groups in the order of creation, and there is a cooldown of 5 seconds when successful joining through auto matching.[/*][*]Investigation Group UI that pops up after clearing Investigation Group does show the group leader anymore.[/*][*]Investigation Group UI that pops up after clearing Investigation Group the group leader’s function to move members among squads is removed.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
  ▶ [b]Item Farming Improvement[/b]
[list][*][b]Some recipes are added to Crafting Maching in Busan – Nampo-dong.[/b]
[list][*]Muscular/Devotion Bug Lump can now be crafted with ‘Busan Protection Certificate’.[/*][*]‘Locust Hell’ gears can be exchanged with ‘Transcendent Locust Hell’ gears.[/*][*] Materials for ‘Go, Scarlet Scorpions!’ title are changed.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]Farming in [Meet with Legion Commander : Lust King Asmodeus] is improved.[/b]
[list][*]Materials for ‘Ocean King Trigger’ are changed to be easier.[/*][*]Materials for ‘Condensed [Trigger] Ocean King’s Transcendence Stone’ are changed to be easier.[/*][*]Materials for ‘Roughly First-sewn Ocean Clothes’ are changed to be easier.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]The crafting limit for Traitor’s Yoke is removed.[/b][list][*]Recipes for Traitor’s Yoke are trimed down to one as the above change.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
  ▶ [b]Skill Tooltip Improvement[/b]
[list][*][b]Tooltips for several skills are improved.[/b]
[list][*]Some skills of characters become easier to understand.[/*][*]Descriptions for some active skills are changed only while those of Ex, Mastery, Passive, Combat Dodge, and Cancel skills remain the same.[/*][*]But tooltips for Ex, Mastery, Passive skills will be changed later.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]▶[/b] [b]Hair Costume Dyeing System[/b]
[list][*][b]Hair Dyeing system is added.[/b]
[list][*]A system to change your hair costume color is added.[/*][*]Hairs that are available for dyeing show the information in their tooltip.[/*][*]Hairs that are not available for dyeing don’t have the info.[/*][*]An icon of dyed hair shows its changed color.[/*][*]Some hairs cannot be dyed and the list is as follows:[/*][/list][/*][/list][table][tr][td][b][u]Costumes[/u][/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Yuri’s Icon Hair (Ver.HW)[/b]
[b]J’s High Tide Helmet[/b]
[b]Davy Jone White Hair[/b]
[b]Yuri’s Icon Hair[/b]
[b]Asmodeus Black & White Hair[/b]
[b]Transparent Dimensional Hat[/b]
[b]Time-Limited Hair[/b][/td][/tr][/table][list][*][b]Hair Costume Bleach system is added.[/b]
[list][*]‘Bleach’ recovers an original color of an hair costume.[/*][*]Bleach costs credit.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]How to Dye/Bleach hair costume[/b]
[list][*]Please follow the instructions below:
1. Use ‘Hair Dyeing Ampoule’ or ‘Selectable Hair Dyeing Ampolue’ in inventory[/*][/list][list]2. Through Costume NPCs (Dr. Jung, Ara, Suji Jeo, Count D, etc)[/*][/list][/list][list][*]Hair Costume Dyeing is separated into ‘Random Color’ and ‘Selectable Color’.[/*][*]‘Random Color Dyeing’ costs ‘Hair Color Ampoule’, and it chooses a random color under a same rate (Each color has an identical rate) [/*][*]‘Selectable Color Dyeing’ costs ‘Selectable Hair Dyeing Ampoule’, and it chooses a color of your choice.[/*][*]You can bleach an already dyed hair costume through ‘Bleach’ button in Dyeing UI.
[b]   ※ Be careful when dyeing/bleaching hair costume because the process is irreversible.[/b][/*][/list][list][*][b]Cautions for dyeing/bleaching hair costume:[/b]
[list][*]Packaged hair costumes are unpacked during the process.[/*][*]Successful upgrading/converting a dyed hair costume will remove the color.[/*][*]Repacking, Trading in Black Market, Failing to upgrade/Convert don’t remove the color.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]▶[/b] [b]PNA Mutant EXP Targeting[/b]
[list][*]PNA Mutant EXP Targeting system is added.
[list][*]‘PNA Mutant EXP Targeting’ system enables focusing PNA EXP to a certain Mutant Type.[/*][*]Mutant type that is ‘EXP Targeted’ can earn EXP with priority than other ‘activated’ types.[/*][*]‘PNA Mutant EXP Targeting’ only applies a single Mutant type at a time.[/*][*]It cannot be applied to an already maxed out type, and the setting will automatically be OFF when the selected Mutant type reaches its max level.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]▶[/b] [b]Levia Skill Improvement[/b]
[list][*]Levia’s skills are improved.[/*][/list][table][tr][td][u][b]Skill[/b][/u][/td][td][u][b]Change Info[/b][/u][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Flash of Pain[/b][/td][td][b]The attack range is increased.[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Serpent’s Waltz[/b][/td][td][b][Dragon’s Will]’s attack range is increased.[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]EX Dimensional Singularity[/b][/td][td][b]Back Attack / Chase become guaranteed.[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]EX Fang Stab[/b][/td][td][b]The skill continues to be casted even without clicking the button.[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Empowered State[/b][/td][td][b][Dragon’s Will] isn’t casted from time to time – Fixed[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Hell’s Trap – Sphere of Terror[/b][/td][td][b]The casting time is slightly improved.[/b][/td][/tr][/table]
[b]▶[/b] [b]Investigation Group Voting to Expel[/b]
[list][*][b]A system to vote for expelling a member is added to Investigation Group.[/b]
[list][*]Investigation Group Expelling Vote system is designed to maintain a stable dungeon run by expelling unwanted members.[/*][*]There are Voting Host and a target member to expel and the rest will be voters.[/*][*]The vote runs except the target member for 3 minutes and the expelling requires unanimity.[/*][*] There is a cooldown of 10 minutes for the expelling vote in Investigation Group.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]▶[/b] [b]Mock Battle Improvement[/b]
[list][*][b]Mock Battle system is improved.[/b]
[list][*]Mock Battle Bosses can be defeated. (doable for those of 15 million TCP)[/*][*]Mock Battle score is calculated based on a time that it takes to defeat a boss. (The time limits are same as before)[/*][*]Mock Battle now runs ‘Weekly’ not by season, and the highest score will determine the weekly rank and agent rank.[/*][*] Mock Battle Rank is reset at 04:00 on Saturdays UTC.[/*][*] Mock Battle Entrance per character changes : 1 -> 3 times.[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][b]Mock Battle reward is changed.[/b]
[list][*]The reward for both Mock Battle Rank and Clear are obtainable only for the character that defeated a boss, and if it fails to defeat a boss, there will be no rank or rewards.[/*][/list][list]· Rank Reward : varies depending a weekly rank(%) before every reset at 04:00 on Saturdays UTC[/list][list]· Clear Reward : can be earned once a week by defeating a boss(1 time per week and per account)[/list][list][*] ‘Training Token’ is added to Mock Battle rewards, which can be used in Crafting Machine to craft various items.[/*][*]‘Training Wolf [D Type]’ is added to UMP Shop.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

[h1][b]Facebook Guess the Costume Event[/b][/h1]
[i]Be keen and watch out for the runway trends.[/i]

[i]We shall showcase costumes and it’s time to guess it correctly to win rewards in the Guess the Costume Facebook Event![/i]

[i]It’s also your chance to receive a x1 Firecracker Set Box by just participating in this event. Check out the details on how to join![/i]

[b][i]Event Period[/i][/b]

[table][tr][td][u][b]By Timezone[/b][/u][/td][td][u][b]Event Schedule[/b][/u][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]PDT[/b][/td][td][b]June 17 to 20, 2022 at 5:00 PM - 6:00 PM PDT[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]UTC[/b][/td][td][b]June 18 to 21, 2022 at 12:00 AM - 1:00 AM UTC[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]GMT+7[/b][/td][td][b]June 18 to 21, 2022 at 7:00 AM - 8:00 AM GMT+7[/b][/td][/tr][/table]

[h3][b]Event Mechanics[/b][/h3]
[list][*]During the event period, we will randomly announce the question of the day in the [url=https://www.facebook.com/ClosersGame][b]Official Closers Facebook Fanpage[/b][/url].[/*][/list][list][*]Participants should guess the name of the costume based on the clue that has been announced.[/*][/list][list][*]All participants should input their answer in the comment section of the question of the day following this format:[list][*][b]“Costume Name”, “Closers Name” #GuessTheCostume #ClosersOnline[/b][/*][*]Example: Urban Fighter, CLSRSname #GuessTheCostume #ClosersOnline[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]BONUS ROUND:[/b]
[list][*]5 random participants who shared the question of the day with their answer, Closers name and hashtags #GuessTheCostume #ClosersOnline can also win rewards![list][*][b]“Costume Name”, “Closers Name” #GuessTheCostume #ClosersOnline[/b][/*][*]Note: [u]Please make sure that the post is shared as ‘Public’ for verification purposes.[/u][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]Event Rules[/b][/h3]
[list][*]All participants should follow the required submission format to make it valid.[/*][*]Any incorrect answers and spelling will not be valid.[/*][*]Please make sure that your Closers Name is properly indicated (not the character name) in order to receive the rewards.[/*][*]The name of the costume should be complete to make it valid. There’s no need to mention the name of the character who wore it.[/*][*]Main winners (Fastest and Random sharer) can join again the next day of the event.[/*][*]Participation reward is only given once during the whole event period.[/*][*]If the fastest participant corrected or changed his/her entry through edit, we will choose the 2nd fastest entry with the correct answer.[/*][*]Winners’ announcement, compiling of entries for the random winner, and prize distribution will be on June 20 (after the event ends).[/*][/list]

(x1 Black Lambs Fireworks, x1 Wolfdog Fireworks, x1 Wildhuter Fireworks, x1 Rattus Fireworks)

notes.title: Training Wolf & Goodnight Kiss
notes.content:
[h1][b]Training Wolf & Goodnight Kiss[/b][/h1]
[i]Put on your [b]Training Wolf [/b]costume and get ready for action! Sing a song and put yourself to lullaby with the [b]Good Night Kiss [/b]costume![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/436046768379aad8b009372f01f9888bfa952ba5.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Training Wolf Story[/b][/h1]

[table][tr][td][table][tr][td]
The man always did his physical training alone around dawn.
He trains in an exclusive Closers-only gym located in the New Seoul branch.
Since he came back to UNION, the man commutes to the gym every morning.
The reason he is stuck training alone at dawn was because he does not want any Closers or his Agents to see him training.
He thinks he is a trainer who is supposed to be responsible for training others.
That is what is on his mind.


The woman always did her physical training alone in the middle of the night.
She also trains in an exclusive Closers-only gym located in the New Seoul branch.
Having decided to return to the mission, she went to the gym sneaking, out without her son noticing.
She is stuck to training alone at midnight is because she does not want any Closers or her Agents to see her training.
Since she was quite well known, she didn’t want to disturb other Closers in the gym by attracting their attention.
That is what is on her mind.

 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/80ab83f4fdc322b00ff05883aefb2df645036929.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/0ef8f2f26c272625553ff1e47a9468b9df60d531.png[/img]


Looking at all those tides in the reply, the man had a bitter smile.
‘Protect humanity together’ huh?
The man couldn’t believe that this one could spit out the big word so easily, which was too far away from himself now.
‘This person must be so strong or shameless to say it’
The man got curious about this agent. But he held it soon.
‘Since we still have this strong and shameless agent’, 
“we might still have a hope for the mankind.”


Doing Muscle exercise with a heavy-weight special alloy, the woman had a bitter smile from her hilariously stern tone in the memo.
‘If it were a battlefield and those equipment were your gears for battle, it would risk your life.’
The woman has met no one like him who was worried about her in that way. If she has to pick one, her teammates or her son, maybe?
Thinking back, there was a man in her memory who was worried about her by nagging all the time, knowing that she was the most powerful. It was her teammate and a trainer back in the days who always said that either you are the strongest or the weakest, regular training is one of the duties of an Agent.
What an annoying lecture. But seeing herself training every day following the advice,
“Maybe, he is still my trainer.”
 

Probably, the man and the woman won’t meet in the gym at the same time.
But if any miracle happens, and they meet each other, it will be nagging from one side and complaining from the other side. The past will happen again, but both will still follow the arrangement just like 20 years ago…
The time had passed.
Many things have changed, but there are things that will never change.
She’s the one who is our hope for humanity, and he is the trainer.
[/td][/tr][/table][/td][/tr][/table]

[list][*]You could also receive a powerful personal buff from the [Team Firecrackers].[/*][*]Collect 'Fireworks Event Souvenirs' every 10 Festival points. This is your chance to obtain [b]Training Wolf[/b] outfit or boosters![/*][*]The top 5 Agents who contributed the most Festival Points to the server will obtain extra in-game rewards! [/*][/list][/*][/list][/td][/tr][/table]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/302b79f3734bfca82180f249da7294248f797d57.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Cheap Cosplay Contest[/b][/h1]
[i]We present to you our first Cosplay event with a twist!

Gather materials and create a cosplay that resembles Characters, NPC, Pets, Monsters, Items, and Costumes in Closers Online![/i]

[i][b][h3]Event Period[/h3][/b][/i]
[table][tr][td][b]By Timezone[/b][/td][td][b]UTC[/b][/td][td][b]PDT[/b][/td][td][b]GMT+7[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Start[/b][/td][td][b]June 5 at 12:00 AM UTC[/b][/td][td][b]June 4 at 05:00 PM PDT[/b][/td][td][b]June 5 at 07:00 AM GMT+7[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]End[/b][/td][td][b]July 3 at 12:00 AM UTC[/b][/td][td][b]July 2 at 05:00 PM PDT[/b][/td][td][b]July 3 at 07:00 AM GMT+7[/b][/td][/tr][/table]

[i][b][h3]Entry Submission[/h3][/b][/i]
Join us in the [b]Official Closers Discord [/b]server and upload your entries in [b]#cheap-cosplay-contest[/b] channel.
[url=https://discord.gg/UkDuWZzByb][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a1af9ace8f6b39ecfb67e01066ed7550c3a91950.png[/img][/url]

[table][tr][td]

[h3][b]Contest Mechanics[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Join in the [url=https://discord.gg/UkDuWZzByb][b]Official Closers Discord[/b][/url] server.
[list][*]Check [b]#discord-events[/b] channel for the event details[/*][*]Submit your entries in [b]#cheap-cosplay-contest[/b] channel[/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*]Submit your entry in image, video, or GIF format.[/*][/list][list][*]Make sure to input the following information with your entry:
[list][*][b]Closers Name[/b][/*][*][b]Character Name[/b][/*][*][b]Input the name of the character, NPC, monster, boss, pet, or item that you are trying to replicate[/b][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]Notes:[/b]
[olist][*] You may submit extra images for additional reference of what you are portraying (max of 3 images).
[*] This is a real life cosplay event, the more effort that you made the craft in-real life the higher the chance to win![/olist]

[h3][b]Contest Rules[/b][/h3]
[list][*]A participant can only win once during the whole event period.[/*][*]Make sure YOU made it! All entries must be made by the submitter specifically for the purposes of this contest. Work previously submitted to any other contest will not be accepted. Commissioned works will not be accepted.[/*][*]All entries will be judged by Naddic team and 10% will be from the Discord react votes.[/*][*]In case that you wanted to change it, please delete your first entry then upload your new entry during the event period.[/*][*]Any non-Closers cosplay images that are added to their entry will be invalid.[/*][*]Participants should also follow the rules and guidelines to receive the participation reward.[/*][*]Minors are not permitted to participate in the cosplay contest (18 yrs below).[/*][*]Entries can be provided in image, video, or GIF format only.[/*][*]Costume Guidelines:
[list][*]Real Firearms are strictly prohibited. All Props and Cosplay must not cause any safety issues.[/*][*]No nudity.[/*][*]No revealing costumes.[/*][*]No profanity. This includes messages on clothes, props, or background.[/*][*]No poor sportsmanship, harassment, or bullying.[/*][*]Entries with NSFW content will not be permitted[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]Additional Notice[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Your entries will be posted publicly on our official channels (Website, Steam, and SNS).[/*][*]Your entries will be used as example entries for the next similar events.[/*][/list][/td][/tr][/table]

[i][h3]Criteria for Judging[/h3][/i]

[h3][b]30% Craftsmanship[/b][/h3]
[list][*]How the participant made their costume, use of materials and creativity, attention to detail[/list]
[h3][b]30% Creativity[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Thoughtful use of materials, ingenuity, personalized embellishments, etc.[/list]
[h3][b]30% Accuracy[/b][/h3]
[list][*]How closely the costume resembles the source material and/or how well it interprets and reminds the judges of the design of the source material.[/list]
[h3][b]10% Audience I mpact[/b][/h3]
[list][*]‘👍’ votes in Discord (Any other Discord reacts will not be counted)[/list]


[h3][i][b]Event Rewards[/b][/i][/h3]

Event rewards that are not cheap!

notes.title: Account Suspension to Game Exploiters
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

Please be informed that several accounts have been found conducting an in-game exploit during the Jump Event. We have verified and applied each account a game suspension which will restrict them to continue playing Closers.

We want to maintain a fair environment, and we don’t want to let this kind of inappropriate behavior to exist in the game.

If you find any player who is doing any in-game exploitation or abuse, please do not hesitate to contact us at [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/b][/url] or email us to [url=support@closersonline.com][b]support@closersonline.com[/b][/url]. Any evidence or details about the report that are provided beforehand are appreciated.

notes.title: Known Issue as of May 18
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you of a known issue that was found after the recent patch.
[list][*][b]Re-pack Count Deduction of Dark Command Accessories[/b]
[list][*]Once you have opened a “Dark Command Accessory Full Set Box” from the “Signature Accessory Full-Set Selectable Box”, all four accessory pieces will come out as unpacked along with a -1 repackaging count (98/99) which is not intended.[/*][*]The said “Signature Accessory Full-Set Selectable Box” came from Midnight Crusader Washing Machine which is obtained by chance, or from the Accumulative purchase bonus of 700.[/*][*]This issue will be addressed during the upcoming server maintenance on May 25th. We will provide Quality Assurance Seals to those who have chosen the “Dark Command Accessory Full Set Box” from the “Signature Accessory Full-Set Selectable Box”.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
We apologize for the inconvenience that this has caused, and we sincerely thank you for your understanding.

[url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/405a5c180381b9a097bb3967f1419f6ca5985722.jpg[/img][/url]

[list][*]When there are items that are about to be expired soon in Inventory or Storage, the system lets you know through Pop up or item UI.[/*][*]The notice appears in case of Login/Logout a character, and moving to Waiting Room.[/*][*]When you have durational items that have less than 1 Day or 7 Day in Inventory or Storage, a pop up will let you know.[/*][*]Checking off ‘Don’t want to see it again today’ in Last minute notice pop up will cease the notice for that day, and this applies per character.[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h3][b]► Direct Shop[/b][/h3]
[list][*][b]Direct Shop system is added.[/b][list][*]When clicking a material item that is required in NPC ‘Vending Machine’, a list of items that can be bought with the material directly opens.[/*][*]When Ctrl + Alt + Mouse Right Button on an item for Direct Shop in Inventory, it directly goes to the shop.[list][*]The list of item for Direct Shop can be checked by the following way.[/*][*]Direct Shop Items : The Direct Shop hot key appears in the item tooltip.[/*][/list][/*][*]Other Items : No Direct Shop hot key info in the tooltip.[/*][*]Direct Shop can be used in hub only and is not available in Your Room/Garden/Crew Hangout/Dungeon.[/*][*]Direct Shop doesn’t support opening inventory, selling items or re-purchase items.[/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Q&A with the Closers World Devs! – Answered (Part 2)
notes.content:
[h3][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/215830/view/3224024423351159627]Click to return to Q&A with the Closers World Devs! – Answered (Part 1)[/url][/b][/h3]

______________________________________________________________

[h3][b]►Contribution Shop[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Can we get an increase cap on the weekly Contribution limit or make Dungeon Missions in Union Watch not able to count towards the weekly limit since it is possible to reach the max limit in 3-4 days with just three characters[/*][*]Can we get purchaseable double talisman and if possible PNA stabilizer on contri shop?[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
The max contribution limit was increased in the KR server this year. This means that the World server will also have that update during the future patch. Please stay tuned in our website for further updates regarding this.

We see that PNA leveling is essential for players, therefore, we will positively consider adding more helpful items to the Contribution Shop.

______________________________________________________________

[h3][b]►Future Updates I[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Is it possible to have 5th character in Rattus team in the future?[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
We will check all possibilities since it is great to have a 5th character in Rattus team. If that day comes, please welcome the new character once he/she is released. Stay tuned to Closers!


[h3][b]►Future Updates II[/b][/h3]
[list][*]In the last Q/A you talked about collaborations, but there is still no indication of anything, can you give us a clear answer about this?[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
There are no collaborations at this time, but once we have an update, we will definitely share this great news to all.


[h3][b]►Future Updates III[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Suggestion: Universal Hub[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
We are taking into consideration for having a universal hub in Closers. However, the hub is a challenge for us to implement in-game since it is a place where we should accommodate a lot of characters all at once and in one place. For the meantime, please enjoy the event towns that are currently available in-game.

______________________________________________________________

[h3][b]►Details in Feature[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Luck stabilizers in potion-limited Commander Raids (Meet Lust King, Machine King Confrontation)Will you permit the use of luck stabilizers in these raids?[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
Update as of May 3rd:

We would like to clarify that the drop rate for items is very low in commander raids to keep its rare value. As an alternative, and a much faster way to get those items, is to craft them. Therefore, we will keep it as it is now. Please use Luck Stabilizer in other dungeons where it can make full use of it.

______________________________________________________________

[h3][b]►Inflation in game[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Are there any plans to curb inflation? With the private BM coming out, I’m expecting the number of credits kept in reserve to decrease, which may (at least in the short term) result in higher prices elsewhere. Did Naddic have any plans to address this?[/*][*]Due to inflation that global has, i feel like global shouldn’t really copy exactly every changes that are Korean server is getting and should alternate the amount of credits/entries earned because I recently found out that they also change the amount of entries for the IF dungeon to just 3 instead of 6If I remember that the PD has said along the lines that “it’s to balance out the economy ” but this is based off the Korean server. so that this logic wouldn’t balance out with globalDid the developers also think that this decision is also appropriate to global and that is there any plans on changing the economy in any shape or form?[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
It is expected that additional credit spending will come as the Private Black Market feature will be added to the game soon. We anticipate that this will contribute to stabilize the amount of credit in game.

We appreciate your time to share your point of view regarding the IF dungeon. Making the entry limit into 3 for IF dungeons is necessary for both KR and World server to ease the inflation.

Overall, we will keep on monitoring the economy of World server and see what our next course of action will be.

______________________________________________________________

[h3][b]►Chip System Renewal[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Are there plans to revamp the chip system? (Most notably the amount of EXP and the amount gained per level)[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
During the [url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20220406-april-6th-update-patch-notes/][b]April 6th update[/b][/url], there was a renewal for the Chip System. It is mainly focused on reducing the amount of EXP required for overclocking.

______________________________________________________________

[h3][b]►Difficulty of Gear Spec-up[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Are there plans to make gear transitioning easier? (As in more methods that doesn’t require paying to transfer tunes and enhancement)[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
We added an Enhancement Transfer system to provide an easier option for players to change gears.

We will also come up with other ideas to lower the difficulties of farming such as launching a Machine King Instant Transcendence event.

______________________________________________________________

[h3][b]►General Inquiries I[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Disbursement of entry passes for future farming events to be mandated[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
We are currently providing sector passes as many as we can and we will continue to provide more of it in the future. For now, you may get them through in-game events. We kindly suggest checking the event announcements on our official website about where and how to gain passes.


[h3][b]►General Inquiries II[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Equalizer change
Change equalizer to rarity based like fabric treatments so that older equalizers can utilized for newer content[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
We ask for your understanding that as of the moment, we will keep the current system where Equalizers are split by level to keep its original design.


[h3][b]►General Inquiries III[/b][/h3]
[list][*]More empowered state effects I think it is worthwhile to have something besides armbands offered as craft/achievement/chain discount reward and it also adds to cosmetics. Something that could be of suggestion is to have empowered effects from Irina onwards or the legion commanders[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
We will certainly consider the suggestion for the Empowered State effects. We also believe that it would be a great addition to the game’s design.

______________________________________________________________

[h3][b]►Game Features I[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Has there ever been any consideration of adding the ability to skip cutscenes/death animations after everyone has seen it at least once?[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
If you are referring to the cut scenes and the death animations of boss monsters, we will consider the ‘skip’ feature positively.


[h3][b]►Game Features II[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Would it be possible to implement a setting to select specific sectors to activate triggers and/or auto-use item slots on so that players don’t have to manually toggle every time they want to have them on/off?[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
Thank you for sharing your idea of having On/Off triggers. Since there are too many dungeons in-game, this feature will not be considered at this time. We ask for your understanding regarding this matter.


[h3][b]►Game Features III[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Are there any plans to make a multiqueue system, where a player could potentially queue for more than one sector at a time?[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
We understand that it takes time to complete a squad during queuing and having an option to join in multiple queues would be a great idea! We will refer to this suggestion for Closers’ future development planning. For the meantime, we have updated some parts of the squad system for improvements.


[h3][b]►Game Features IV[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Something I want to add is that the game should try to be more ‘in your face’ with vital game tutorials.
From the recent returning event my observation and discussion with crew members + general public was that there have been a lot of people asking how to unlock trigger slots[/*][/list]
[b][b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b][/b]
Thank you for sharing with us your observations and actual feedback from players who returned from playing Closers. We will keep these details in mind while we are completing the Tooltip renewal that will be applied in our future patch.


[h3][b]►Game Features V[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Is there a reason CMC tickets are only purchasable when there is a CMC event active, while the CMC tickets themselves can be used during any CMC event?[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
We appreciate your inquiry and feedback regarding CMC. It is intended to make CMC Tickets only available during promotional periods and it is not designed for stacking up. We ask for your understanding that we will maintain its limited-time purchase since this event provides quite a lot of benefits.


[h3][b]►Game Features VI[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Could there be some way to transcend our Asmo gear to Machine King gear?[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
In order to facilitate a smoother gear transfer, we currently set up an event for an instant transcendence.

During this event period, players can transcend a Lusty Infinite Trinket to Sloth Infinite Trinket instantly!

You may check out this link to find more information about it: [url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20220406-machine-king-belphegor][b]Machine King – Belphegor[/b][/url]


[h3][b]► Game Features VII[/b][/h3]
[list][*]More usage for sliver hero plate coin in the future[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
We see to it that some wants to have an alternate use of Hero Plate Coins. We hope for your understanding that there are no plans to expand its usage in the future.

______________________________________________________________

[h3][b]►Community[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Are there any plans to recruit more CPC members in the future?[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
Yes, we consider opening a recruitment for additional Closers Player Council members in the future. Further details will be announced on our website or on our social media channels.

______________________________________________________________

Once again, thank you for the unending support to Closers Online!

If you miss out sharing your feedback and suggestions, you are always welcome to message us through our [b][url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/]website support[/url][/b] or email us to [b]support@closersonline.com[/b].

See you all next time for another Q&A session!

notes.title: Q&A with the Closers World Devs! – Answered (Part 1)
notes.content:
Thank you to all Agents who shared their questions, feedback, and suggestions!

Below in this webpage, you will see the topic along with yourquestions, and theanswers of our Devs.
We sincerely appreciate all entries for this Q&A session!

[h3][b]►Rewards for Veteran Users[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Can veteran players get some kind of rewards as well and not just the new/returnee player? At least something to motivate current players to continue playing Closers?[/*][*]Will there be events for veterans who have been playing the game for years?[/*][*]Will veteran players or players who have been playing daily get Bai/Mirae/Luna Daki since returnee and new players are getting them.[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]

First of all, we sincerely appreciate your continuous support to Closers, and we hope that you all stay with us as more updates are yet to come!

The New/Returned agent rewards are designed to help new and returned players settle down and to quickly enjoy playing with veteran players. Veteran players will also feel a similar need when trying new characters in a different account or coming back from having a break in playing.

We wanted all to know that we recognize the worth of your time in playing Closers. Various events from each update is one of the benefits for those who are playing the game frequently. For a meantime, we put our best effort into providing fruitful events in every patch update, such as buffs or rewards that are useful for your characters. You can check out the [url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20220420-closers-world-roadmap-may-sep-2022/][b]2022 Closers Roadmap[/b][/url] for the main updates that you can look forward to.

We will consider the “Dakimakura” on a positive note as an in-game event reward. We’ll be finding the right schedule when we can release this. Please look forward to it!

______________________________________________________________

[h3][b]►QoL Update[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Can QoL updates from KR be brought earlier to WORLD server instead of waiting for a few months?[/*][*]Can we get QoL faster (for now bankable asmo gears, nerfed busan and tiamat are enough imo)?[/*][*]When can we expect the important QOL updates to global?[/*][*]Talismans account-based update when will come to CLOSERS World?[/*][*]Is there any chance in future mutant could be account bound?[/*][*]Will it be possible to make costumes inside the costume locker have images, effects, etc. so we could still distinguish it without having to equip the entire set.[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]

We understand your sentiments about the QoL updates. We ask for your understanding that all updates are added successively per region, and it is difficult to update a specific feature ahead of schedule given the current structure of the game.

We seek for your patience that some of these updates may take a while since we are making sure that it is stable on our server. Yet we will try our best to apply those contents as early as possible for the convenience of the players.

For the Talismans, these are already combined with Premium Buff, so these are now account-based. Please enjoy this buff in the game!

As for the Mutant PNA, instead of making it account-based, we have a plan to add a system for this in the World server. The idea is to select a mutant type where you can focus on increasing its EXP which will make it more convenient for leveling up mutants.

And lastly, we are considering a new system to improve our current locker features, such as having a way to contain more costumes and options to use set effects.

______________________________________________________________

[h3][b]►Black Market[/b][/h3]
[list][*]How did developers made it possible to implement this (Private Black Market) system and wouldn’t the system still have a lot of drawbacks or is it that developers has some policy changes that this system possible later on in the future?[/*][*]Is there a reason the BM is extended to include private trading instead of updates to direct trading? What is the reasoning for adjusting BM to support direct trades, instead of adjusting private trading to allow for trades of “black market only” items?[/*][*]With the private black market coming, do you plan to remove lower price limits for items?[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]

Thank you for getting back with us regarding the Private Black Market. In our previous Q&A, we mentioned that we cannot receive your personal information due to legal restrictions, which it is still does.

But since this is one of the most requested features from players, we decided to have an alternative way to make it possible in World server. However, to manage this, we need some precautions:

1) The Private Black Market will have more strict regulations
2) We will keep an eye on those accounts with bad records and with the same IP connections
3) We will monitor any malicious activities or other activities that are negatively affecting the gameplay or community

We wanted players to experience trading with more convenience. Therefore, instead of the direct trade which is made with an old system, we will focus on putting more resources to improve the Black Market.

We currently have no plans to remove the lower price limit since the purpose of it is to preserve the item’s value. However, we will keep on monitoring this by collecting feedbacks and see what the best course of action for the given situation would be.

______________________________________________________________

[h3][b]►PVP[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Is there any plans for another arena/pvp balance? is there any chance rattus and future character is playable for pvp?[/*][*]Are there any plan to make all pvp reward better (daily/weekly/crew war) or at least scale better for max lvl player?[/*][*]Is it possible to bring back or remake old 3v3?[/*][*]Is there any plan to bring back team challenge in the future revamp?[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]

We would like to confirm that we have plans and discussions to find an optimal way to improve the current PVP system. We will also include the Team Challenge system during these discussions.

______________________________________________________________

[h3][b]►Healing Skill[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Another thing to consider is giving every character a decent healing skill so they can survive on par with other characters. Characters such as Seha and Yuri doesn’t have any HP healing skills, whereas Violet only has FM2 as her only healing skill, and the heal itself isnt that strong compared to Sylvi’s Magnetic Infusion or Tina’s EX Sharp Shooting[/*][*]Can we get healing skill for every character?[/*][*]Seeing that in raids like Lust King and the soon to come Belphegor where they restrict potion usage and limits resurrection, all characters should have equal opportunities to heal.[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]

Thank you for the suggestions for the healing skill. We understand that it would be useful in situations, but since Closers Online is a genre that requires a lot of hand control and skillful combat, it is crucial to keep the skill only for some intended characters in order to keep the character concept.

However, we will let you all know if in any case there will be further updates about this suggestion.

______________________________________________________________

[h3][b]►N-Coins/Price[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Reduce fort cost from ncoin shop or just make it easier to get.[/*][*]Look into reducing package costs (espc 10k ncoin packages), these packages are pretty expensive and contain items not really fully worth 10k outside of the ss tuner.[/*][*]The prices of outfit pack or pieces are not that satisfying especially packs such as steampunk.[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]

We appreciate each of your feedback regarding the prices of the shop items and packages.

For the fortifiers, we will find more options for players to obtain it in-game.

As for the packages, some users are satisfied with the current packages because it offers items that they need with big discounts, while some of these packages or items that are included may not meet their expectations. We ask for your understanding that these items have individual value, and you can get the most of it during package sales. We will come up with more ideas where we could offer useful items at various price points.

______________________________________________________________

[h3][b]►Platinum Service[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Since the box updated like 2 years ago, can we get the better reward that follows the current content?[/*][*]There are still Hyperclock Equalizers, things that aren’t used much if any as most gears are now Lvl 85++ for most endgame ones.A suggestion to remove that so that the chances to get other items get buffed.[/*][*]Daily Platinum reward and Housing Washing Machine needs an update.[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]

We sincerely appreciate your feedback regarding the Platinum service. We are glad to announce that we will refurbish the daily rewards as a whole. Please stay tuned for further details in our official website once the information is ready.

______________________________________________________________

[h3][b]►Washing Machine[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The accumulative purchase of washing machines, 500 pull for 1 box?[/*][*]The washing machines still offers old outfits, can those be moved in the store?[/*][*]Are there plans to revamp the Washing Machine system? Such as having more team based washing machines or removing some of the less desired items. (Res Caps, Talismans)[/*][*]Will costumes in Washing Machine get only one colour type instead of three colour variations? since it is difficult to get specific colour type and for a specific character with all other items that we do not need are mixed into the gacha pool.[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]

The items that came from the accumulative charge/washing machine purchase rewards are additional item/s that you could get for free along with your actual shop purchase. This is designed as a bonus from what has been spent in the game, and it is a gift of appreciation for your enthusiasm for Closers.

We understand your concerns regarding some of the old outfits in the Washing Machine. After further consideration, we plan to sell some of the old costumes to the in-game shop for direct purchase in our future updates.

As for the Team Washing Machine, we currently have this promotion from time to time. Then recently, we are offering a single type color for new costumes to get the specific type that you wanted more easily.

Furthermore, we also plan to refurbish the contents of the Washing Machine. Please look forward to our future offers too!

______________________________________________________________

[h3][b]►Game Launcher, Login[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Will we ever be able to use other browsers to log in? Example: opera gx.[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]

We ran several tests on logging-in from various web browsers and found no issues, including executing the game launcher.

We also ran a test using an Opera Gx browser and there were no issues encountered in our side. However, if you are experiencing log-in issues or encountered a web error, please contact us via Support, and we’ll help you further.

[url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/b][/url] or email us to: [b]support@closersonline.com[/b]

______________________________________________________________

[h3][b]►Stand-alone Launcher[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Is it possible to add a login-in through the launcher itself instead of opening a default browser?[/*][*]When we will be having a stand-alone client?[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]

I am afraid to say this but currently it is difficult for us to provide a stand-alone launcher, and I am sorry to inform that we have no plans for it at this time. We seek your understanding regarding this.

______________________________________________________________

[h3][b]► Invalid Parameter Handler[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Are you aware of the launcher bug (invalid parameter handler) and if so when will you fix it?[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]

We are currently having a hard time reproducing this error. In order to aid us with our investigation, we needed the Launcher Logs from a player who is receiving this kind of error.

If any user is currently experiencing this issue, please contact us at [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna][b]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna[/b][/url]/ or email us to: [b]support@closersonline.com[/b].

______________________________________________________________

[h3][b]►Craft[/b][/h3]
[list][*]As for fuel earning since with the “demotion” of beelzebub becoming a regular sector instead of a raid which leads to less fuel earned by regular players, I suggest a way to craft fuel with Sea Breeze, as it does not have a use after centum gear is complete.[/*][*]The discount system that KR has for crafting was declined to be implemented. Has there been a change in sentiment since then, or any opportunity that it will still be implemented?[/*][*]I suggest more options to convert bug lumps into area accessory set so players can potentially get the best in slot accessory.[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
As of the moment, we ask for your understanding that we do not have plans to increase the additional use of Essence of the Sea Breeze including the crafting discounts. Rather, we will discuss other designs to make farming more convenient for players.

What we suggest for getting the accessories, is to use dropped items from dungeons starting from the next main story area, White Night Fortress.

______________________________________________________________

[h3][b]►Event & Promotion I[/b][/h3]
[list][*]There should be more event outfit variations and not just yukatas and other outfits that is only available for few characters.[/*][*]Every regular or special promotion outfits in-game should be obtainable in missions or available for 1-time crafting similar with the task force.[/*][*]Do you have any plans to rotate out specific rewards in the Monthly Attendance on a more frequent basis?[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
We will give more opportunities for players to receive costumes as a reward from events. Also, we’ll consider of finding different methods to let others have a chance to receive their own costume.

And as for the monthly attendance, we will renew the item rewards continuously.


[h3][b]►Event & Promotion II[/b][/h3]
[list][*]In the current farming event a lot of the rewards aren’t useful (in particular the SMD for 500 runs) and Global gets the over tuned version of Legion Program where only a few are capable of clearing the whole thing.[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
We appreciate your time to share us your feedback regarding with the current rewards gained through farming and Legion Program.

We will come up with more beneficial events for World server in order to support players to gain essential items and needed materials to get through in dungeons clears.

______________________________________________________________

[h3][b]►Enhancement[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Consider a rework of any aspect of the enhancement process.Any limitation to enhancement caps (i.e +17 max for whole server) or reduction in fever time threshold would be appreciated if it can be looked into[/*][*]The devs could create a more expensive Enhancement Transfer Device from Ncoin shop that doesn’t have enhancement penalty. With this implemented, they can make the regular -1 cheaper.[/*][*]For the buff voucher, I’d suggest for lower fail counts in order to enter fever for certain enhancements. Such as 50 for 16, 100 for 17, and so on.[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
Back then, there were many restrictions. Although there have been improvements, we are aware that there are still difficulties left.

Even though we didn’t have plans to offer a transfer service, we push the idea of creating the Enhancement Transfer system as we wanted to support players in preserving most of their gained assets.

In general, next generation gears are upgraded versions of the previous ones. If we’re transferring the same enhancement level to the next tier gears, there will be a spec-upgrade without investing, which causes the power inflation. Due to this reason, we hope for your understanding if we are unable to make adjustments to the current conditions of this system. Furthermore, we’ll continue to run enhancement events that can be taken advantage of, and to seek plans for improvements of the system.

As for the concerns regarding the buff vouchers, we will examine possibilities on how to improve the Enhancement Buff Fever system.

In relation to this, the Enhancement Buff was revamped, therefore, from 2 hours it is now 30 days. This is a chance for you to enhance your items with enough time.

Also, we are providing Pet Cores which are needed to enhance pets. Players will be able to obtain it through various methods such as from events. We keep on finding ways for players to easily obtain it.

______________________________________________________________

[h3][b]►Enhancement Success Chance for Level cap Expansion[/b][/h3]
[list][*]I suggest for every +2 cap we get for maximum enhancement, the rates should be increased so that the guaranteed success would be half of the current cap.[/*][*]Is it possible to increase the enhancement chance for +11, +12, +13 and +14 since the enhancement cap has already increased to +20.[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
We have increased the default enhancement success chance as the enhancement level cap was expanded. Furthermore, we will continue this kind of update in our future patches.

For further details regarding this adjustment, please visit this site: [url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20210824-enhancement-success-rate-increase/][b]Enhancement Success Rate Increase[/b][/url]

______________________________________________________________

[h3][b]► Trade & Gift I[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Please make Elite tokens untradable, where we can move it to the bank instead of being bound to character.[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
Since Elite Tokens are account-based buff, you may use it from each of your characters. However, we do understand your concern with the inventory space which we will be discussed further.


[h3][b]►Trade & Gift II[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Are there any plans to allow gifting of the premium packages for new characters in the future?[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
We know that Premium Packages are very important to new characters. Therefore, we will take it into consideration of gifting Premium packs during the next character launch.


[h3][b]►Trade & Gift III[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Will there be giftable options to expand inventory space/character slots?[/*][*]Can the “x1 Gear/Consumables/Material Slot Expansion Full Set” package be tradeable permanently without a limit on how many can be bought? Inventory space is a giant issue and it’d be really nice to have some other way to buy this from others.[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
We understand that gifting feature plays an important role of supporting other players in Closers. As for the suggestions to make the inventory and character slots giftable, we will review this for further consideration with a positive note.

Also, we appreciate the suggestion in making the said package tradable and make it as a regular item on sale. To make it more convenient, we will consider making slot expansion items to be sellable, giftable, and tradable among users.


[h3][b]►Trade & Gift  IV[/b][/h3]
[list][*]For the new/returnee support box gears, could it be tradable in the scenario where we would like to level alts using that gear? It’ll make it easier for new players to partially complete their teamwork buff so their TCP could be higher.[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
The Support Box is meant to be used for the New/Returned characters only. We will keep the current setting that we have designed.

However, we understand that some players also wants to catch up using their alt characters. Therefore, we will come up with other ways, such as releasing supporting events or having a system that will help level-up alt characters with ease.


[h3][b]►Trade & Gift V[/b][/h3] 
[list][*]Will there be a way to trade N-Coins between accounts in the future?[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
Sadly, N-Coins trading is not possible and there are currently no plans for it. We hope for your understanding.

______________________________________________________________

[h3][b]►Costume[/b][/h3]
[list][*]I suggest to delegate mixed-type costume set to N-coin shop while type A/C to be retained in washing machine.[/*][*]Is it possible to either allow older pieces to be bought directly for N-coin? Or at least to have more than 2 washers available at the same time.[/*][*]I suggest having outfit packages for characters, since some characters have many options available.[/*][*]I suggest Eye Colors/Contact Lenses to be permanently available, I think more customizations will always be a popular thing, eye colors have always been hard to get.[/*][*]Suggestion to have more task force outfit packages. Like the ones available to Triaina Rebellion characters that are individual pieces rather than an outfit cover that aren’t part of the task force free pass package.[/*][*]Suggestion to have a way to obtain permanent versions character’s job advancement outfits.[/*][*]Any plans to make the Signature Costume – Cybernetics set available to Luna – Lucy ?[/*][*]Update N-coin shop with older outfits that don’t have portrait and has been not seen again for like 1 to 3 years.[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
We truly understand all your sentiments about having difficulties in having costumes or costume types that you specifically wanted. We will try our best to find more desirable ways to offer costumes based on these feedbacks.

Thank you for your suggestions to delegate mixed-type costume set to N-coin shop, permanent eye colors, and character promotion outfits. We are glad to see that players are interested in getting various looks for their characters. We will take these into consideration and hopefully set out stunning costume options.

Regarding the Task Force Outfit, it won’t have the similar function as the Triaina Rebellion. The Triaina Rebellion outfit was designed to have multiple pieces, unlike with how the Task Force outfits were created. We hope for your understanding regarding this matter.

As for the Cybernetics suggestion, it will be difficult to extend its functionality to Lucy. However, we will take into consideration having more new costumes for Lucy.

We know some of you would like to own outfits that we have released in the past. We also wanted others to have a chance to acquire those. Please stay tuned in our official website as we will gradually release sales of these outfits!

We are always open to feedbacks like these in order to understand how the community feels. Please contact us via [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]Website Customer Support[/b][/url] or email us to [b]support@closersonline.com[/b] for any suggestions or feedback.

______________________________________________________________

[h3][b]►Mock Battle[/b][/h3]
[list][*]I have seen how recently mock battle was updated in the KR server to be a race to kill the boss instead of a race to do as much damage in certain time. This greatly concerns me and other players for when it may come to our NA server.[/*][*]Possible to make another type of mock battle that doesn’t rely on the player being “Overgeared” and more of “Skill based on how player utilize the character”?[/*][*]Can we get more rewards for Mock Battle such as Gear Booster Fuels, Gear Booster Fortifier, Equalizer, etc. Since there is no real incentive for players to play it besides the Union Membership Point which is already a small amount.[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
We sincerely appreciate your time for sharing a detailed experience and feedback about the Mock Battle system. We designed the Mock Battle with a fast-paced gameplay where players could easier see the results and can compete under a simpler record.

We ask for your understanding that there’s no plan to add the old system again, however, we will review any feedbacks that we will be receiving then decide what we should adjust for the next season.

The renewal of the Mock Battle and its rewards will be implemented on June. Please do not hesitate to share with us your thoughts during the experience of the renewed system.

______________________________________________________________

[h3][b]►Extra Gear[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Please look into buffing ex gear drop rates proportionally to our playerbase compared to kr[/*][*]Is there any chance that we’ll get drop rate increase for floundering and mfloundering dungeon again?[/*][*]Any plans to disclose the box drop rates or increase the rate for the uncommon items slightly for the server?[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
The default drop chance for Extra gear was substantially buffed considering the number of users in World server. Regarding the drop chance, we will set up a plan to run an event related to this in the future.

______________________________________________________________

[h3][b]►Dungeon I[/b][/h3]
[list][*]I see that you guys already nerfed the story of Black Lambs, Wolf Dog, and Wildhuter so we can leveling faster. But i still see dungeons that excluded from story is still around. Maybe we can call it useless dungeon. Why you don’t remove it instead?[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
Every dungeon is required to be played for the story in order to get immersed in the lore and/or to complete quests.

However, if you could provide us the name of the dungeons that you are referring to, we will review it further with the team.

We kindly request to send it via [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]Support Inquiry[/b][/url] or email us to, [b]support@closersonline.com[/b].


[h3][b]►Dungeon II[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Can we get f2p farming dungeon? I don’t see any reason why you nerfed IF dungeon entry into 3, im sure it killed f2p credit source.[/*][*]For IF dungeon, we could have the same system, but buff the credit/drops rate by 2x once again, seeing that when it went from 6×2 runs to 3×2 runs the drop amount has been doubled, but when it became just 3, no buffs had been applied.[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
We understand your concerns with the IF dungeon entry limit. These were adjusted because the value of farming was too much.

However, items that are dropped from these dungeons can be sold to earn credits starting from the next main story area, White Night Fortress.


[h3][b]►Dungeon III[/b][/h3]
[list][*]About the legion program is too hard for some certain character / class who need proc back atk manually. It is quite unbalanced for these player such as mine (Seha).[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
We are always open to receive feedback and suggestions for issues or concerns related to the character balance.

We kindly suggest to share with us which characters and specific skills that you think that is too strong or weak, then we can have it reviewed.

You may send us a message through our support via website: [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/b] [/url]Or email us to: [b]support@closersonline.com[/b]


[h3][b]►Dungeon IV[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Will there be more mechanic focused bosses in the future? (Something to encourage more teamwork and improvement of their characters)[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
We know that Agents are up for some challenge, and we understand that mechanic-focus bosses would boost the players’ combat capability and to have some exciting dungeon clears.

Since the time that the Machine King update has been released, we are finding ideas to add gimmicks or mechanics to dungeons. Please stay tuned in our website for any updates regarding this matter.


[h3][b]►Dungeon V[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Is there a possibility of adding Gear booster Fortifier to give player more incentives spam 12 man raid after they finish gearing to keep improve there gear[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
Thank you for your suggestion regarding the Gear Booster Fortifier. We are glad to inform that we will run an event to provide this as a reward, however, we ask for your patience since it is not on the schedule yet. Please stay tuned!

______________________________________________________________

[h3][b]►Pet[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Can we have a universal pet skill hotkey?[/*][*]Can you make every character able to equip same pet?[/*][*]Same deal with the Pet Enhancement system, you need to spend a lot of materials just for a minimal boost + a spare copy of said pet. Is there any plans to revamp that too?[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
Thank you for sharing your suggestion for a universal pet skill hotkey. We also believe that it would be easier to utilize the skills of the pet if we have this kind of feature, therefore, we will put it on the table and will consider this idea positively.

However, as for equipping the same pet suggestion, we’re afraid that it is not doable at this time. A character can only equip one pet at a time. We ask for your understanding that we will retain this real-time usage.

We appreciate your feedback regarding the Pet Enhancement system. We are providing Pet Cores which are needed to enhance pets through various channels such as in events. Furthermore, we will keep on finding ways for players to easily obtain it to level pets at ease.
______________________________________________________________

[h3][b]►Localization[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Again this is more regarding localization, are there any plans to improve it for those that enjoy reading the lore?[/*][*]Only suggestion i have is having more clarity in the skill/skill cube tooltips, especially for earlier characters. whether it’s in the skill’s general description or one of its skill cube tooltips, sometimes certain characteristics arent described properly.[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
We will keep making effort for a better localization for players to enjoy and get immersed in the lore.

Thank you for sharing detailed feedback about the character skills and skill cube tooltips. This kind of information is important to us, and we are continuously analyzing the character skills efficiently. We are also happy to let you know that we have a scheduled plan for renewing the Skill Tooltips in June. Please look forward to it!

______________________________________________________________

[h3][b]►World Server Exclusive Features[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Can you tell us what’s the exclusive world server content that you guys planning?[/*][*]Are there any plans to revamp perks of playing on Global?[/*][*]Please share with us on any works in progress to improve World Server (outside of any QoL from Korean server)[/*][/list]
[b][u]Dev Response[/u][/b]
We understand your anticipation for exclusive features in World server. Since the last QnA session, we’ve thoroughly examined different aspects and concluded that it would be better to integrate our resources for the game stability and quality of characters & dungeon. This will be applied to Closers itself and not only to a specific server region. As we continue to manage the World server, we will release more events that aim to be enjoyable for the players.

______________________________________________________________

[h2][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/215830/view/3224024423351246544]Click to continue to Q&A with the Closers World Devs! – Answered (PART 2)[/url][/b][/h2]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

[h1][b]Private Black Market – Creation Duration Updated[/b][/h1]
[i]We heard you and after further consideration, it has been adjusted![/i]

Hello Agents,

After receiving your feedbacks regarding the Private Black Market Conditions, we are pleased to let you know that the duration for the character creation shall be extended. The increase of hours will be an additional measure to prevent malicious activities.

Thank you and we sincerely appreciate your support by sharing with us your concerns that may arise after the release of this feature.

notes.title: Private Black Market Conditions Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e7585605c9199bbc1a7d0357a8343c3362e7a36a.png[/img]

[h1][b]Private Black Market Conditions Update[/b][/h1]
[i]The conditions for the the Private Black Market has been changed and details has been added![/i]

Hello Agents,

We would like to clarify about what we have mentioned in our previous post ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/215830/announcements/detail/3222895988523264052][b]Pre-Notice: Private Black Market Update[/b][/url]). Individual characters in the account must fulfill the conditions in order to try the Black Market Private trade, instead of only having one character fulfill it.

We hope for your understanding and we apologize for the confusion that this has caused. Below is the specific condition that was changed.

[table][tr][td][table][tr][td]

[b]If there is at least one character that meets the said conditions, the rest of the characters in the same account can get access to Private Black Market.[/b]

[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Previous Condition[/b][/td][/tr][/table][/td][td]
➔
[/td][td][table][tr][td]

[b]Before you will be able to use the Private Black Market feature on a character, the character must achieve the conditions.[/b]

 
[/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Updated Condition[/b][/td][/tr][/table][/td][/tr][/table]

Therefore, you should have [b]at least one level 90 character in the account[/b].

Also, an individual character in the same account must be [b]over [strike]168[/strike] 360 hours from the time it was created[/b] (Please refer to this link for this change: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/215830/view/3228526756479766865][b]Private Black Market – Creation Duration Updated[/b][/url]) and have [b]cleared dungeons for 300 times[/b].

If you wish your other characters to have access to the Black Market Private trade, you must achieve the individual conditions.


[h2][b]Updated Private Black Market Conditions[/b][/h2]

[table][tr][td][u][b]Conditions[/b][/u][/td][td][u][b]Details[/b][/u][/td][td][u][b]Limit[/b][/u][/td][/tr][tr][td]

[b]Character Level[/b]

[/td][td][b]The character must be level 90[/b][/td][td][b]At least one character in the account[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]

[b]Creation Duration[/b]

[/td][td]
[b]The character must be over [strike]7[/strike] 15 Days old[/b]
[b]([strike]168[/strike] 360 hours or longer)[/b]
[/td][td]
[b]Any characters in the account is eligible, but, the individual conditions should be met.[/b]
[/td][/tr][tr][td]

[b]Dungeon Clears[/b]

[/td][td][b]The character must have cleared dungeons 300 times[/b][/td][td]
[b]Any characters in the account is eligible, but, the individual conditions should be met.[/b]
[/td][/tr][/table]
A Free Private Sale Ticket will still be provided to your account once per day.

Don’t forget to mark your calendar on [b]May 11, 2022[/b] for this exciting update!

[url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/405a5c180381b9a097bb3967f1419f6ca5985722.jpg[/img][/url]
