notes.title: June 9 Name Reset & Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/6dd6fda065f2740eae13b84d93f745a265c8208e.png[/img]

[h1][b]June 9 Name Reset & Event[/b][/h1]

Hello Agents!

We know that it has been difficult for you to get your desired name or even find a name just to proceed with the character creation. After waiting for so long, it is now time to let go of inactive names for others to start over. It’s a new beginning and a chance for you to get the name that you wanted.

[b]During the server maintenance on June 9, 2021 at 7:00 AM UTC, agents who didn’t logged-in to the game since November 1, 2020 12:00 AM UTC will have their Closers name and character names reset.[/b] For those who were able to successfully migrate their account but didn’t log-in to the game yet, we highly advise you to log-in to the game to keep your names.

Better be quick! A lot of rare Closers names and Character names will be available as soon as the server goes up. Those who register the name in-game the earliest will own it!

To go along with the inactive name reset is an event that all agents will get to enjoy.

[h2][b]Nickname Reset Event[/b][/h2]

To support you in changing your character’s name, a [b]UNION Name Tag[/b] will be provided once you enter the game. Additional support items will also be given the longer you stay in-game.

[b]Event Period[/b]
[list][*]June 9, 2021 maintenance – June 23, 2021 at 9:00 AM UTC[/*][/list]
[table][tr][td][u][b]Hour[/b][/u][/td][td][u][b]Item Name[/b][/u][/td][td][u][b]Amount[/b][/u][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Login[/b][/td][td][b]UNION Name Tag[/b][/td][td][b]1[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]1 hour[/b][/td][td][b]All-in-One Talisman Box (1-Day)[/b][/td][td][b]1[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]2 hours[/b][/td][td][b]Normal D Component: Gear[/b][/td][td][b]2[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]3 hours[/b][/td][td][b]Normal D Component: Costume[/b][/td][td][b]1[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]5 hours[/b][/td][td][b]Gear Booster Fuel I[/b][/td][td][b]10[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]10 hours[/b][/td][td][b]Gear Booster Fortifier[/b][/td][td][b]1[/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]20 hours[/b][/td][td][b]+13 Gear Booster[/b][/td][td][b]1[/b][/td][/tr][/table]

[h2][b]F.A.Q.[/b][/h2]

[b]When will the name reset scheduled to happen?[/b]
[list][*]During the server maintenance of Closers World server on this schedule by timezone:
[list][*]UTC: June 9, 2021 at 07:00 AM – 10:00 AM UTC[/*][*]PDT: June 9, 2021 at 12:00 AM – 3:00 AM PDT[/*][*]GMT+7: June 9, 2021 at 02:00 PM – 5:00 PM GMT +7[/*][/list]

[b]What will happen to my Closers/Character name?[/b]
[list][*][b]If you are an active user or was able to log-in [/b][b]at least[/b][b] once since November 1, 2020 12:00 AM UTC[/b], your Closers name and Character names won’t experience a reset.[/*][/list][list][*][b]If an account was not able to migrate, [/b]the Character names and Closers names will now be available to use after the server maintenance on June 9th. If you want to continue using the name that was registered from your non-migrated account, you can use it again in a new account or character after the server maintenance on June 9, 2021.[/*][/list][list][*][b]If you have migrated your account from En Masse to Naddic but were not able to log-in after November 1, 2020 12:00 AM UTC[/b], your Closers name and character name will be gone. However, if you log-in to the game after the name reset has been completed, you could freely choose a new Closers name or Character name once you log-in to the game again.[/*][/list][list][*]Please be advised that if you want to keep your Character/Closers name we highly suggest that you log-in to the game before the server maintenance on [b]June 9, 2021 at 7:00 AM UTC[/b] as there will be no name appeal after the name reset has been completed.[/*][/list]

[b]I wanted to keep my Closers name and Character name. How can I do that?[/b]
[list][*]Make sure to log-in to the game in Closers World server before the server maintenance on June 9, 2021 at 7:00 AM UTC.[/*][*]If you have successfully migrated before and returning to Closers, you can log-in or retrieve your account by clicking on the [b]“Find Account”[/b] or [b]“Find Password”[/b] section from this site: [url=https://www.closersonline.com/signin/][b]https://www.closersonline.com/signin/[/b][/url][/*][/list]

[b]Why can’t I input or proceed with the name that I choose?[/b]
[list][*]The possible reason is that the name contains a filtered word/character or the name has already been taken. For those who were became inactive after November 1, 2020 12:00 AM UTC, we highly suggest that you log-in to Closers before the server maintenance on June 9th to keep your names before the reset happens.[/*][/list]

[b]I was not able to migrate my Closers account before. Will I be able to save my character name?[/b]
[list][*]Sadly, if you didn’t migrate your Closers account from En Masse to Naddic you won’t be able to access the account anymore. However, you could save your Closers name or Character names to a new account if you wish to keep it.[/*][/list]

[b]I have successfully migrated my account before. What’s the next step to keep my names?[/b]
[list][*]You will need to log-in to your account again and enter the game. You may download Closers World server via website or in Steam.[/*][/list][/*]

[*][url=https://www.closersonline.com/game-download/][b]Click here to go to the Closers World[/b][/url][/*][*][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/215830/Closers/][b]Click here to go to the Closers Steam Version[/b][/url][/*][/list][/*][/list]
[b]I have a concern that is not mentioned here. How can I contact Support?[/b]

[url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/405a5c180381b9a097bb3967f1419f6ca5985722.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: How to Subscribe to Newsletter?
notes.content:
Subscribe to our newsletter by following these simple steps:
[list]
[*] [b]Step 1[/b]. Log in to your game account on the Closers Website ([url=https://www.closersonline.com/signin]https://www.closersonline.com/signin[/url])
[*] [b]Step 2[/b]. Go to ‘My Page’ and activate your Newsletter settings under the ‘Account Information’ section.
[*] [b]Step 3[/b]. Place a check on the “Agree on receiving promotional email!” then select ‘Update’
[list][*] A ‘Success’ notice should appear on the upper right of your web browser.[/list][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f3f5d93c26af07d93cadf34998b1dfcc8854ce6d.png[/img]

Don’t miss out on exclusive updates and offers. Subscribe now and stay connected with us!

notes.title: Name Filter Notice
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8afc118090caeb90def8d353ac32b281d5b98d02.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

During the maintenance, we have applied an update with the banned words filter in-game. You may proceed to update your Closers name or Character name if you have received a pop-up notice in-game.

However, if you feel that your Closers/Character name does not contain a severe bad word, you can choose a temporary name at this time, and on [strike]May 20th[/strike] May 7th (UTC), we will be providing a Closer Name Tag and Union Name Tag to all users if you wish to use the character name again.

Also, please know that we will be having hotfix maintenance to return the previous word filter. For those who haven’t changed their name yet, you can keep your name when you log in after the hotfix maintenance ends.

[list][*] May 7, 2021, at 5:00 AM – 6:00 AM UTC
[*] May 6, 2021 at 10:00 PM – 11:00 PM PDT
[*] May 7, 2021 at 12:00 PM – 1:00 PM GMT +7[/list]
We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your understanding.

[h3][b]Updates[/b][/h3]
[list][*] As of May 7, 2021, 1:30 AM UTC, we would like to give you an update that we will be providing the Closers Name Tag and UNION Name Tag during the hotfix maintenance on May 7, 5:00 AM – 6:00 AM UTC. You will be receiving these items on your first log-in to the game and you can only receive them once per account until May 20th.[/list]

notes.title: Spring Capsule Machine Notice
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8afc118090caeb90def8d353ac32b281d5b98d02.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

We would like to remind you that on May 13, 2021, at 4:00 AM UTC, the Empty Capsule and Capsule Coin from the [b][url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20210407-spring-capsule-machine-event/]Spring Capsule Event[/url] [/b]will be removed.

However, the Capsule Machine will still be visible at that time since the removal of this feature will be on May 19, 2021. We would like to note that since the materials needed for the machine are already unavailable, the machine is not usable until it has been removed in-game.

Thank you for your understanding.

[url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/405a5c180381b9a097bb3967f1419f6ca5985722.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: April 7 Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a3fd256d9ee082238d5880404fe59fe41c8a81ec.png[/img]

[h2][b]Contents & System[/b][/h2]

1 ) [b][url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20210407-mirae-black-hands-promotion/]Mirae Black Hands Update[/url][/b]
[list][*]Mirae’s new Class has been added.[/*][*]Mirae ‘Black Hands’ promotion can be progressed through the ‘Black Hands’ episode in the ‘Fantasy World: Dream Theater’ area[/*][*]A new dungeon only for Rattus team has been added in the ‘Fantasy World: Dream Theater’ area[/*][*]When you clear the Mirae ‘Black Hands’ episode, you will receive a ‘Black Hands Costume Box (3 days)’ item.[/*][*]Exclusive passive skills will be provided when promoting Rattus characters to ‘Black Hands’.[/*][*]Mirae Black Hands skills have been added.[/*][/list][table][tr][td][u][b]Black Hands Queen: Mirae[/b][/u][/td][/tr][tr][td]The state that Mirae has attained in the worst-case “future” scenario.
Originally, Mirae could have never gained such great power, but she was able to obtain it by undergoing trials in Fantasy World. It’s all for the sake to move towards the future, together with her loved ones.
Allows use of [Special Move: Accept Dead Night] skill. Using Messenger Special Move triggers [Queen’s Punishment], which is enhanced by the skill level of [Special Move: Accept Dead Night].
 
* [Queen’s Punishment] triggered by Messenger Special Movecounts as [Air Strike / Back Attack / Chase].[/td][/tr][/table]

[table][tr][td][u][b]Special Move: Accept Dead Night[/b][/u][/td][/tr][tr][td]She swiftly jumps forward and slashes her enemies, then slashes them once more while falling to the ground. Once her series of attacks are done, she performs additional attacks for a set duration. Shadow Vines wind around the enemies nearby and terminate them at once. Becomes [Invincible while using [Special Move: Accept Dead Night, and all hit attacks count as [Critical], [Air Strike / Back Attack / Chase].

“I’ll remember all the nights that have perished, no matter what the future holds.” – Mirae [/td][/tr][/table][list][*]Mirae Black Hands promotion emoticons have been added. [/*][*]Mirae Black Hands visual frame has been added. [/*][*]Mirae character promotion achievements have been expanded. [/*][/list]
2 ) [b][url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20210407-divine-battle-9th-darkness-vs-light/]Divine Battle 9th (Dark vs Light)[/url][/b]

notes.title: Update on Account Suspension
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8afc118090caeb90def8d353ac32b281d5b98d02.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

We would like to inform you that 27 accounts were permanently blocked from the Closers World server. This is due to suspicious and odd activity logs found in their accounts. If you feel this is a mistake, please send us an inquiry through [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/][b]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/b][/url] or send us an email to [url=support@closersonline.com][b]support@closersonline.com[/b][/url].

In general, we would like to warn everyone that using 3rd party hack tool, macro, or exploiting game bugs can lead to a permanent ban of an account or a permanent block from playing on the Closers World server.

Also, if you see any suspicious players or find any critical bugs, please report them immediately to our Customer Support and we will investigate them further.

Thank you for your cooperation and understanding.

notes.title: Steam DLC Issue
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8afc118090caeb90def8d353ac32b281d5b98d02.png[/img]

We have received reports that users are having issues obtaining the DLC package in Steam. After further investigation, the items from the DLC are received but not visible in the account’s delivery box.

A patch fix has already been completed and this will be applied during the maintenance process on [b]March 24th[/b].

Players who purchased DLC from [b]March 10 to 24[/b] should see their items back at their delivery box after the fix has been applied.

Thank you for your patience and understanding.

notes.title: Account or Log-in Issues on the Website
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8afc118090caeb90def8d353ac32b281d5b98d02.png[/img]

[h2]Account or Log-in Issues on the Website[/h2]

If you are having trouble logging in or registering on the Closers website, please send us an email to [u][url=support@closersonline.com][b]support@closersonline.com[/b][/url][/u] with a summary of the issue that you have encountered.

We highly appreciate it if you could also provide your current IP address beforehand for us to review your concern faster.

Once you have access to the website, you may now contact us via Web Support.

[b]How to contact Naddic Support through Web Support:[/b]
[olist]
    [*]Log-in your account to [url=https://www.closersonline.com/]https://www.closersonline.com/[/url]
    [*]Select the [b]"Support"[/b] category then click on [b]"Contact us"[/b]
    [*]Choose the most appropriate category for your concern or inquiry
    [*]Input the required fields and a summary of your concern, then press the [b]"Submit"[/b]button
[/olist]
Updates of your concern will be received at your registered email address.

This does not limit you to contact us about account issues, you can send us an inquiry if you have any questions or if you want help related to Closers.
 
Thank you and don't forget to check out the [b]"[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/215830/discussions/0/3115896179308724810/]Need Help?[/url]"[/b] post for the official web links of the Closers World server.

notes.title: March 10 Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a3fd256d9ee082238d5880404fe59fe41c8a81ec.png[/img]

[h3][b]1) New Dungeon Asmodeus – Ocean King[/b][/h3]

▶ New Dungeon Asmodeus – Ocean King is added[/b]
[list][*]You can find the [Ocean King Asmodeus] dungeon at the [[u]Dream Theater <Reverse> area[/u]][/*][*]The level requirement to enter the [Ocean King Asmodeus] dungeon is level 87[/*][*][Ocean King Asmodeus] dungeon quests have been added[/*][*]You can enter the solo dungeon for quest clear[/*][*]You can enter [Ocean King Asmodeus] dungeon when all quests are cleared.[/*][*]All [Eroding Mist] quests need to be cleared in order to enter the [Ocean King Asmodeus] dungeon.[/*][*]Fly King’s wishes items have been renamed to Legion Commander’s Wishes[/*][/list]
▶ [Legion Commander The Audience: Ocean King Asmodeus] Survey contribution and point rewards have been added.[/b]
[list][*]Contribution points for each part can be acquired by playing with a 12-player investigation team (F~SSS grade)[/*][*]At the end of the raid, a rank is given according to the number of accumulated contribution points, and the rewards will depend on the rank. (Once a day)[/*][/list]
▶ [Ocean King Asmodeus] new items have been added[/b]
[list][*]A new core/module/trinket has been added.[/*][*]The group before the reinforcement of Asmodeus equipment has been added.[/*][*]Asmodeus gear set compatibility has been added.[/*][/list]          ○ TCP(%) Ranking has been added
          ○ Players on the top 50% will receive rewards
          ○ TCP(%) Ranking will be a different ranking than the TCP top 10 ranking

▶ The chain buff system has been added.[/b]
[list][*]A new buff system ‘Chain Buff’ has been added to Asmodeus equipment.[/*][*]Chain Buff’ is a buff system that is applied as different types of buffs are constantly changed.[/*][*]The ‘Chain Buff’ system has the following types, and a probability is applied between each chain.[list][*]Endless chain in the form of A buff → B buff → A buff → B buff[/*][*]A buff → B buff → C buff → buff ends[/*][/list][/*][/list]
▶ New Gear Grade ‘Extra Item’ has been added.[/b]
[list][*]“Extra Item” is the highest grade item.[/*][*]Group before Enhancement of Extra Item has been added.[/*][*]Extra items can be acquired through the [Floundering Holy Place of Ocean King] Dungeon.[/*][/list]
[h3][b]2) Maximum Enhancement Limit has been increased to +20[/b][/h3]

▶ Achievement for Item enhancement has been expanded. 
▶ Enhancement Balance has been modified.[/b]
[list][*]Enhancement Attack Power factor of +14 and above modules has been changed.[/*][*]The success rate is increased when enhancing +10~+12 items.[/*][/list]
[b]3) T3 platinum chip [/b]
[list][*]T3 platinum chip has been unlocked. [/*][*]Maximum Chip Enhancement Limit has increased to +20[/*][/list]
[b]4) [url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20210310-union-membership-point-ump-shop/]Union Membership Point Shop[/url][/b]
[list][*]Union membership point shop has been added.[/*][*]You can access the Union Membership Point from the Union Store[/*][*]Various items are sold on the Union Membership Point Shop which can be purchased using Union Membership Point[/*][*]Shop reset time varies depending on the item. It may reset every day at 04:00 or every Saturday at 04:00 or every 1st day at 04:00.[/*][/list]
[b]5) TCP(%) Ranking[/b]
[list][*]TCP(%) Ranking has been added[/*][*]Players on the top 50% will receive rewards[/*][*]TCP(%) Ranking will be a different ranking than the TCP top 10 ranking[/*][/list]
[b]6. All characters’ skill has been renewed[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/86336b80e9dc90f0d5f23b15f66278092ec97db4.jpg[/img]

[h2]Ocean King Audience Update Celebration Event![/h2]

The most anticipated event has conquered Closers World! Meet the Legion Commander of the Flood Army, Ocean King Asmodeus!

[b]Event Period[/b]
[list][*]March 10, 2021 – April 07, 2021 UTC[/*][/list]

notes.title: Thailand Server Merge Guideline
notes.content:
[h2][b]Thailand Server Merge Guideline[/b][/h2]

Dear Closers Agents from Thailand,

Finally! Migration to the world server has been completed.

There are some things you need to do in order to log in. Please read through our guidelines below:

[h3][b]I. Delete the Original Thailand Server Client (Required)[/b][/h3]

In order to log in to the world server, you must completely delete the Closers Thailand game client from your PC.

[b]How to delete the Thailand Server Game Launcher?[/b]

You can delete the Original Thailand Closers client after entering the ‘Settings’ menu on your computer and selecting an app.

You may visit this link for the steps:

[url=https://closersth.naddic.com/updates/-world-server-279][b]ขอต้อนรับสู่ World Server[/b][/url]

[h3][b]II. Change Password (Required)[/b][/h3]

You must change your password before downloading the World Server Client.

You will not be able to download the World Server’s full client and won’t be able to log-in from the website unless you change your password.

[b]Change Password Steps[/b]

[b]1. Go to the official Closers World website, [url=https://www.closersonline.com/signin/]https://www.closersonline.com/signin/[/url].[/b]

Select the ‘[b]Find Password[/b]‘ button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/0d77109a75dd5142046ad1660217df7b7df76897.png[/img]


[b]2. Enter the email address that you used to sign-up from the Closers Thailand server.[/b]

Complete the verification and select the ‘[b]Send Email[/b]‘ button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/7255659d658ad702745dda2674f39dba440f7725.png[/img]


A notification will appear informing you that a password reset email has been sent to your registered email.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/aa041333b35d4e328cc5c657bb65f2a5d70ab46a.png[/img]


[b]3. Check your inbox and find the email that was sent from Closers.[/b]

Select the ‘[b]Reset Password[/b]‘ button that will direct you to a page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/12b945ff6ebdbf815d70f96ca364d8b5b84c3027.png[/img]


[b]4. Enter your new password following the listed conditions.[/b]

Please do not forget to double-check before proceeding! Once you are sure with your new password, select the ‘[b]Confirm[/b]‘ button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/6731f3cacc85a15a127e7b5c6c73dd8b6d8c8d95.png[/img]


After you completed resetting the password of your Closers Thailand account, you can now proceed to use the account on the official website of the Closers World server.

[h3][b]III. Download World Server Client (Required)[/b][/h3]

After you are done with the steps above, do not forget that downloading the Closers World Server.

[b]Closers World Game Launcher Download[/b]:
[list][*][b][url=https://www.closersonline.com/game-download/]https://www.closersonline.com/game-download/[/url][/b][/*][/list]
*Account log-in is required in order to download the full game client.

Once you have downloaded the game client, select ‘[b]Game Start[/b]‘ found on the upper right corner of the Closers World website.

Finish the patch and you can now enjoy playing Closers World!

[b]Notes and Reminders[/b]

[table][tr][td][b][u]If you have any concerns, you may contact the Closers Customer Support at the link below[/u][/b][/td][/tr][tr][td][b][url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/url][/b]
[/td][/tr][/table][list][*]Kindly provide us information beforehand to resolve your concern sooner.[/*][*]Please make sure that you are logged in to your Closers Thailand account when sending us a CS message for verification purposes.[/*][*]If you sent your message using a different email, the Customer Support representative may require you to log-in to your Closers Thailand account to proceed.[/*][/list]
For players who have the same email address in World and Thailand server, you may contact the [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/]Closers Customer Support[/url] to request updating the email of the Thailand Game account.
[list][*]Follow the reminders stated above to avoid any further delays.[/*][*]Do not forget to provide us a new email address that you wish to change for the Closers Thailand account. (the email should be new and not registered to Closers yet).[/*][*]Once we updated the email of the account, please proceed to reset your password. Please refer to: [b]‘Change Password Steps’[/b].[/*][/list]
Thank you and welcome to Closers World server!

notes.title: Thailand Server Merges to World Server!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8afc118090caeb90def8d353ac32b281d5b98d02.png[/img]

Hello Agents,
 
As you all know, we will be having a server merge with the Thai players soon! Please welcome the new players with warm hearts! New players mean a new addition to our Closers family! The more the merrier, right? Form the biggest crew, share guides, complete challenges, or even compete against! Let's join forces and grow together!
 

สวัสดี เหล่าตัวแทน! ขอต้อนรับท่านสู่เซิร์ฟเวอร์ Closers World!
 
It is our goal to bring you the best gaming experience possible. It’s time to join forces and explore the world together! Here is the long-awaited server merge, bringing players closer than ever. This means you will meet lots of new players that you can form a crew with, trade with, face challenges together, or compete with one another!


Also, we would like to announce that there will be no changes with the current patch and players don't need to prepare for anything before the server merge. We will only be moving the data of the players from the Thailand server to the World server during the merge.
 
Server merge maintenance schedule by timezone:
[list][*] UTC: February 23 9:00 PM to February 24 7:00 AM UTC
[*] PST: February 23 1:00 PM to 11:00 PM PST

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a3fd256d9ee082238d5880404fe59fe41c8a81ec.png[/img]

[h3][b]1) Babel Program[/b][/h3]

[b][url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20210217-new-challenge-content-babel-program/]▶ New Contents [Babel Program] is added.[/url][/b]
[list][*][b][Babel Program][/b] is a new feature that lets you use multiple characters to clear a dungeon of 20 floors.[/*][*]You can find the [b][Babel Program][/b] at the Planar Gate Areas NPC Bitna Dungeon Entrance.[/*][*][b][Babel Program][/b] is a 20floor dungeon that consists of a Normal Stage and a Boss Stage that depends on which floor you are in.[/*][*]Different Buff and DeBuff effects are applied to each floor of the [b][Babel Program][/b].[/*][/list]

[b]▶ [Babel Program] Clear Reward is added.[/b][list][*]You can receive the Clear Reward after clearing the Dungeon for the first time, and it may be Rearranged when the stage is expanded later.[/*][*]You can receive a “[b]Babel Coin[/b]” item on [b][Babel Program][/b] Dungeon Clear.[/*][*]You can craft various items using the Babel Coin item.[/*][/list]
 
[b]▶ [Babel Program] has a limited number of entries and time limit.[/b]
[list][*]You can only enter [b][Babel Program][/b] Dungeon 5x a week and it resets every Saturday at 4:00 AM UTC.[/*][*]You cannot use HP/MP Recovery Potion and Resurrection Capsule in [b][Babel Program][/b] Dungeon. (Nightmare Queens Elixir Item can be used)[/*][*]If the Dungeon is not cleared within the time limit or the character dies, the number of entries will be consumed.[/*][*]You can retry if you failed during the boss stage.[/*][*]On failure in the boss stage, the remaining HP amount of the boss will be maintained in order to clear it more easily when you retry the stage.[/*][/list]
 
[h3][b]2) CMC Material Conversion[/b][/h3]

[b][url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20210217-cmc-cross-material-conversion-is-back/]▶ CMC substance conversion starts.[/url][/b]

[h2][b]Charming Kitsune[/b][/h2]

They got superior intelligence, long life, magical powers, then add it with charm! [b]Charming Kitsune[/b] costumes are now available in Closers.

Get all 7 pieces including the Ears, Tail, and 2 Accessories to receive an Exclusive Illustration.


[h2][b]Sales Period[/b][/h2]
[list]

notes.title: Subscribe to our Promotional Mail!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/327e8bc0ab921bf8d8f6f431feb67bbbf153bb05.jpg[/img]

Hello Agent!

Want to keep yourself updated with the latest offers, upcoming promotions, events, and exclusive perks?

You can easily keep on track with the latest news and updates by just subscribing to the Closers Online Promotional mail!

Simply activate it by following these steps:
[b]Step – 1.[/b] Log-in to your account to the Closers Website (https://www.closersonline.com/signin/)
[b]Step – 2.[/b] Go to ‘[b]My Page[/b]’, select the drop-down menu, and choose “[b]Account information[/b]”
[b]Step – 3.[/b] Place a check on the [b](Optional) Accept “Receive Promotional Information Mail”[/b] then select ‘Save changes’

Starting February 5th, we will be giving out an [b]Alpha Equalizer[/b] if you subscribed to the Promotional Mail!

This promo ends on March 10 and rewards will be sent to the in-game mailbox of your highest level character on March 11 (UTC).

Maintain your subscription to be eligible for this promo so don’t miss out and subscribe now!

*The Alpha Equalizer will be deleted on June 30, 2021 at 9:00 AM UTC

notes.content:

Hello Agents,

We would like to notify you that there are currently two kinds of Zenith Synchro Fiber. The previous version does not work properly while the other one is the updated version that works as intended.

In order to remove the old version of Zenith Synchro Fiber, we will be adding an exchange machine to convert it to the updated version. The exchange machine will be available on the next scheduled maintenance.

Be reminded that the previous version of Zenith Fibers will not be usable and tradeable after the patch update.

Thank you for understanding.

notes.title: Rookie Agent Invasion
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/4e2c2dd71238b107cce5cae0162cbe1d7360708a.jpg[/img]

Let’s spice something up for new players with an exclusive event!

New accounts that were created within the event period can participate in these two awesome events where you could get FREE N-coins and 20% additional N-coins.

[b]Event Period:
[/b]• UTC: January 20, 2021 at 12:00 AM – February 16, 2021 at 11:59 PM UTC
• PST: January 19, 2021 at 04:00 PM – February 16, 2021 at 03:59 PM PST

[b]Event 1 – 1,000 N-Coin for Rookies who achieve Level 86![/b]

Leveling-up will not only experience you new adventures but it could also gain you a surprising reward!

Reach level 86 or higher and get 1,000 N-Coins (that’s worth $10!)

[b]Conditions:[/b]
• Applicable to users who created a new game account within the event period
• Have at least one level 86 or higher level character in the new account

[table][tr][td][u][b]1st Batch[/b][/u][/td][/tr][tr][td][b]Participating Period:
[/b]UTC: January 20, 2021 at 12:00 AM PDT to February 2, 2021 at 11:59 PM UTC
PST: January 19, 2021 at 04:00 PM PDT to February 2, 2021 at 03:59 PM PST

[/b]February 3, 2021 - during regular maintenance

PST: January 19, 2021 at 04:00 PM PDT to February 16, 2021 at 03:59 PM PST

[b]2nd Batch Rewarding:
[/b]February 17, 2021 - during regular maintenance
[/td][/tr][/table]

[b]Event 2 - Additional 20% N-coins for the Rookies[/b]

To give you a kick-start for your adventure, we will be adding up 20% N-coins from your total amount charge during the event period!

[b]Conditions:[/b]
• Newly created accounts in the Closers website within the event period
• Purchased N-coins from the website for the first time within the event period

notes.title: Account Creation and Verification Issue [Resolved]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8afc118090caeb90def8d353ac32b281d5b98d02.png[/img]

Greetings Agents,

We would like to notify some players may experience issues in creating new accounts or retrieve accounts by asking for a password reset email at this time. This is due to issues with account registration and verification email.

We kindly ask for your patience as we are working to fix this as soon as possible.

Please stay tuned to this page for any further updates:
[url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/20210111-account-creation-and-verification-issue/]Account Creation and Verification Issue[/url]

Thank you.

Update:
[list][*]As of January 12, 2021, at 1:52 AM UTC (January 11, 5:52 PM PST), the issues with the Account Creation and Verification has been resolved. You should be able to continue with the account registration without experiencing issues.
[*]If you have any other concerns or still experiencing issues, please do not hesitate to contact us at, [url=https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/]https://www.closersonline.com/support/qna/[/url] or send us an email to support@closersonline.com.
[/list]

notes.title: Account Verification & Password Reset [Resolved]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8afc118090caeb90def8d353ac32b281d5b98d02.png[/img]

It has come to our attention that the account registration, account verification, and password reset e-mail are not sending properly to the player’s registered email address.

We have investigated this issue and as of 2:40 PM UTC (6:40 AM PST), this issue should now be resolved.

New players can now register and verify their accounts. Also, players may now be able to reset their account passwords.

Thank you for your patience regarding this matter.

notes.title: EMP Transfer from En Masse to Naddic
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8afc118090caeb90def8d353ac32b281d5b98d02.png[/img]

Hello Agents, 

As part of the Migration process from En Masse to Naddic, players that have the remaining EMP balance in En Masse will have it transferred to Naddic. We separated the players into two batches: 

Batch 1 - If you accept service transfer by October 27, your EMP will be available on NADDIC servers once they are open.

Batch 2 - If you accept service to transfer between October 28 and December 21, your EMP will be available on Naddic servers on December 22. 

However, due to some changes with the schedule, we ask for your understanding that the [b]EMP transfer for Batch 2 will be moved on January 6, 2021,[/b] during the server maintenance.

notes.title: Shining Star
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/89557f8292b484e8d284441ca448fcebec4d5a91.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a97c1806541239362ca7f0a95c943126a6418c72.jpg[/img]

Let the music take you away. Everyone is born to rock with the Shining Star Costumes!

This is the first Unique Costume that will roll along with our December 17th update.

New Commands when using the Shining Star Costume:
[list][*] Band: /music, /MUSIC, /band, /BAND
[*] Solo: /play, /PLAY, /solo, /SOLO[/list]

[h2]1. Shining Synchro Fiber[/h2]
[list][*] Shining Synchro Fiber is one of the basic items necessary for the Shining Star Costume Conversion.
[*] Converting Shining Synchro Fiber has a chance to acquire a Shining Star Costume.[/list]
[table][tr][td][u][b]Item Name[/b][/u][/td][td][u][b]N-Coin Price[/b][/u][/td][/tr][tr][td]Shining Synchro Fiber[/td][td]290[/td][/tr][tr][td]Shining Synchro Fiber X10[/td][td]2,900[/td][/tr][tr][td]Shining Synchro Fiber X18[/td][td]4,990[/td][/tr][/table]
-No purchase restriction and this item is tradable.

[h2]2. Repackaging Permit [Unique Costume][/h2]
[list][*] An item that can repackage Unique Costume once.
[*] Can be repeated but won’t work if the repackaging count has reached the maximum limit.
[*] The necessary amount of Repackaging Permit [Unique Costume] will depend on the specific Unique Costume.
[*] Repackaging Permit [Unique Costume] can be purchased in the Store with no purchase restriction and it is tradable.[/list]
[table][tr][td][b][u]Item[/u][/b][/td][td][b][u]Amount[/u][/b][/td][td][b][u]Item[/u][/b][/td][td][b][u]Amount[/u][/b][/td][/tr][tr][td]Weapon[/td][td]9[/td][td]Hands[/td][td]9[/td][/tr][tr][td]Chest[/td][td]7[/td][td]Hat[/td][td]5[/td][/tr][tr][td]Feet[/td][td]9[/td][td]Cheeks[/td][td]5[/td][/tr][tr][td]Hair[/td][td]7[/td][td]Back[/td][td]5[/td][/tr][tr][td]Legs[/td][td]7[/td][td]Eye[/td][td]5[/td][/tr][/table]
- Unique Costume is the highest grade costume in Closers.
- It only has 1 Repackage count regardless of where you obtained it and it is applied to both clothes and accessories.

[table][tr][td][u][b]Item Name[/b][/u][/td][td][u][b]N-Coin Price[/b][/u][/td][/tr][tr][td]Repackaging Permit[/td][td]4,900[/td][/tr][tr][td]Repackaging Permit X11[/td][td]48,510[/td][/tr][/table]
- No purchase restriction and Repackaging Permits are tradable.

[h2]3. Exchange Silk[/h2]
[list][*] Exchange Silk can transfer the Tuning Option to a Unique Costume.
[*] Exchange Silk has no purchase restriction and it is NOT tradable.
[*] Available in Matter Mixer with 2000 Splendid Phase Fiber + 100 million Credits (Once per account per week)
[*] The Tuning Option in Rare Costume can be transferred to Unique Costume. (Only 2 Tuning options can be transferred from lower grade costumes to a Unique Costume)
    [*] [b]The third Tuning Option of the Unique Costume will be generated randomly.[/b] [/list]
[table][tr][td][u][b]Item Name[/b][/u][/td][td][u][b]N-Coin Price[/b][/u][/td][/tr][tr][td]Exchange Silk[/td][td]4,990[/td][/tr][/table]

notes.title: Chip Transfer Issue
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8afc118090caeb90def8d353ac32b281d5b98d02.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

An issue has been found in the Chip Transfer system where players are unable to input the complete command in order to proceed with the transfer. It was due to not having enough space for the last letter for the command which it can only input “Chip Transfe” instead of “Chip transfer”.

The team is now reviewing this issue and the fix will be applied on the next scheduled maintenance.

Thank you for your patience and understanding.

notes.title: Steam N-coins Issue [Resolved]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8afc118090caeb90def8d353ac32b281d5b98d02.png[/img]

Hello Agents,

We’ve spent the last few days assessing what’s been going on with the missing N-coins issue, and we really appreciate your patience during this time. It was determined that this happens to Steam users due to the Tax difference between states.

[b]Update[/b]:
[list]
[*] The Steam purchases issue has been fixed on Nov 10th at 11:50 AM UTC (3:50 AM PST). Users should now receive N-coins properly after purchase.
[*] As of Nov 11th at 2:30 AM UTC (Nov 10th, 6:30 PM PST), our Developers were able to find all accounts that were affected by this issue. We are now preparing to distribute the lost N-coins to these players within 24hrs. Due to this inconvenience, we will be giving 10% extra N-coins on top of your purchase as compensation for lost N-coins.
[/list]

notes.title: November 5 Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Game Content[/h1]

[h2]1) New Character[/h2]
[list]
[*] Team Rattus Mirae has been added.
[list]
[*] Mirae starts with Lv.67 when created.
[*] Mirae’s Maximum Level is Lv.83, and it will be expanded through future updates.
[*] Mirae Season 1 scenarios and areas will be opened.
[/list]
[*] Draconian rare costumes can be synthesized with Mirae characters.
[/list]
[h2]2) New Area – Ancient Dragon Historic Site[/h2]
[list]
[*] A new area ‘Ancient Dragon Historic Site’ has been added, and can be entered by characters level 85 or higher.
[*] Existing areas have been deleted due to the reorganization of the Dimensional Ops Center.
[*] New towns, dungeons, bosses, quests, achievements, and items have been added.
[*] The basic difficulty dungeon and the Nightmare difficulty dungeon are opened together.
[list]
[*]In order to enter the Dungeon of Nightmare difficulty by random matching, you must be promoted to Black Lambs, Wolfdogs, Wildhüter Task Force or higher, and Rattus Fixer or higher. (Mirae Fixer will be updated later)
[/list]
[*] Some dungeons can only be entered on certain days of the week.
[list]
[*] Ancient Dragon’s Nightmare: Heart -Mon/Thu/Sat/Sun
[*] Ancient Dragon’s Prison Castle-Tue/Fri/Sat/Sun
[/list][/list]

[h1]System Update[/h1]

[h2]1) Chip Update[/h2]
[list]
[*] The chip system has been completely reorganized.
[list]
[*] Chip has been changed to account sharing.
[*] Gears with chips equipped cannot be traded, and when Equip/Unequip, the basic transaction properties of the gear are followed.
[*] Chip UI has been integrated, and you can proceed with Equip/Unequipped/ Overclock through the chip inventory (shortcut key ‘ ; ’).
[*] The chip protect item is not consumed when removing the chip equipped on the gear.
[*] Chip slots can be created only for gear of level 83 or higher.
[*] You cannot change the slot color or open the slot for gear under level 83 where chip slots were created before reorganization. (Available: Equip/Unequip/Overclock)
[/list]
[*] Chip types and grades have been reorganized.
[list]
[*] The grade of chips has been reorganized by tier. (T1, T2, T3)
[*] Platinum chip is available up to T2 and color chip is available up to T3.
[*] You can collect chips from the lower tier to craft chips from the upper tier.
[*] Dark chip has been changed to white chip.
[*] As the chips were reorganized, the chips and chip boxes held before the update were collectively changed to [Origin Chips]. [[url=https://www.closersonline.com/naddic_news/chip-exchange-ratio/]Go to exchange rate[/url]]
[/list]
[*] A chip overclock system has been added.
[list]
[*] An overclocking system has been added that increases the chip’s stats by using material chips to equipped chips.
[*] The maximum value of overclock is the same as the enhancement level of the gear equipped with the chip.
[*] When the overclocked chip is removed from the gear, the overclock level and experience value are reset.
[/list]
[*] Color driver has been integrated.
[*] A new chip slot has been added to the Shield and Amplifier items. (1 shield, 3 amplifiers)
[/list]
[h2]2) Pet Update[/h2]
[list]
[*] The pet system has been completely reorganized.
[list]
[*] Pet system UI has been reorganized.
[*] Pet can be now shared within the account.
[/list]
[*] A pet rarity system has been added.
[list]
[*] Pet rarity is divided into < [b]Normal [/b]> and < [b]Elite [/b]>.
[/list]
[*] A pet enhancement system has been added.
[list]
[*] Pet enhancement can be performed up to 5 stages, and the quantity of materials used for enhancement varies by stage.
[*] When you equip an enhanced pet, some of the character’s stats increase and are reflected in the overall combat power.
[/list]
[*] A pet disassembly system has been added.
[list]
[*] You can obtain the required for pet enhancement by disassembling the pet.
[/list]
[*] A system for automatic use of pet items has been added.
[list]
[*] You can use the automatic item use system if you upgrade your pet to 3 levels.
[/list]
[*] A pet skin system has been added.
[list]
[*] You can set the appearance of your pet with the pet you currently have through the Pet Details tab.
[/list]
[*] Pet Codex system has been added.
[*] New Pet Mini Syrphid ([b]Elite[/b]) and Mini Bai ([b]Normal[/b]) have been added.
[/list]
[h2]3) Black Market Update[/h2]
[list]
[*] The black market transaction maximum has been changed to 2 billion credits.
[*] A function has been added to re-register items that are not sold.
[*] A function has been added that allows you to receive the sold money to another character in your account.
[*] The restrictions on using the black market have been adjusted.
[list]
[*] Level Limit: Lv.35: Deleted
[*] Maintain condition for 72 hours after character creation
[*] After creating a character, clear the dungeon 20 times to use Black Market.[/list][/list]
[h2]4) Reorganization of Growth Path[/h2]
[list]
[*] The growth path of Black Lambs and Wolfdogs team has been greatly improved.
[*] Skill Manual is also added on Black Lambs, Wolfdogs’ contribution shop
[/list]

[h1]Events[/h1]

[h2]1) Transfer Celebration Special Event:[/h2]
[h3][u]Event Date: 2020-11-05 ~ 2020-12-03[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] A special attendance check event for 10 days is in progress.
[*] To commemorate the direct service, a gift from the development team will be directly given.

[list]

[/list]
[/list]
[h2]2) Mirae Level Up Event[/h2]
[h3][u]Event Date: 2020-11-05 ~ 2020-12-17[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] Mirae level up event
[list]

[/list]
[*] Mirae creation event
[list]

[*] Collect and craft various items including Gear Booster +13.
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]3) Ancient Dragon Historic Site Opening, Chip Update Event[/h2]
[h3][u]Event Date: 2020-11-05 ~ 2020-12-17[/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] Accumulated login event to support settlement on Ancient Dragon Historic Site

[*] New/return events are always operated according to the set criteria.

[/list]
[*] Provides various special consumables when new/returning users achieve a specific level.
[*] In order to support the rapid development of new/returning users, < [b]Growth Support Box [/b]> is provided according to the level.

[h2]4) November Closers Day Event[/h2]
[h3][u]Event Date: November 7th 04:00 ~ November 8th 03:59 (UTC)[/u][/h3]
[list]

notes.title: Who are the Scarlet Scorpions?
notes.content:
WHO ARE THE SCARLET SCORPIONS?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/10371cb5cd2ec159c915fa6686d939136e91c734.png[/img]


[i]‘Hmm… what really happened out there? Was it all a lie?’
[/i]
You’re needed in Busan, Closer. This new mission concerns a past UNION operation shrouded in secrecy. Operation Hermes: The Fate of the Scarlet Scorpions. Follow in the footsteps of a former Closers team and witness events as they originally unfolded. Undertake a special training mission: a simulation that will transport you into Misook’s past in search of answers…

Who were the Scarlet Scorpions?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8c4b041ce127593cd6e7471322b401f105ad9aac.png[/img]

To access this story content, Closers must be at least level 86 and have completed the quest “Ep 17. To Have Faith - A Reward for Trust."

EX Story – Scarlet Scorpion Event Licenses are available from August 3 to August 31 in Busan. Learn of Misook’s dark past. What do the names Erika, James, and Zuxian mean for UNION?

Look in the Event License menu for all available rewards, and purchase the Premium Rewards Tier to get even more loot during the event. This Event License hosts new daily, weekly and unique missions, so make sure to don’t miss a day to score points and rack up rewards.

[b]Scarlet Scorpion Crafting
[/b]Crafting materials can be earned daily for the Scarlet Scorpion crafting event. Playing over 150 minutes each day will earn you a Scarlet Scorpion Support Random Box.

As you uncover the mystery of Operation Hermes, you’ll earn Scarlet Scorpion coins. These coins are used to craft special rewards and can earn your character a full set of Yukata costume pieces!

Check the Busan MatterMixer for new character emote, title, and Scarlet Scorpion crafting recipes!

[b]Transcendence Stones
[/b]Craftable 100% Transcendence Stones have been added to Closers. Use them to transcend your gear with a 100% chance to succeed!

Visit the MatterMixer in Busan. Look in the "Sector Epic Gear" crafting tab for new recipes.

[b]Scarlet Scorpion Packages
[/b]Between August 3 and August 30, the Scarlet Scorpion Package will be available in the EMP Store in three varieties: A Daily Package, a Weekly All-in-One Package, and a Transcendence Package (limit 3 per account).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/ede924976335a21db33dd50db1343764a36824c7.png[/img]

These three packages contain vouchers and materials that will give your gear the boost it needs to investigate the Scarlet Scorpions. Truth comes to those who prepare. See the Closers store for package details and contents.

Packages available from August 3 to August 30.

[b]Scarlet Scorpion Chain Discount
[/b]The Chain Discount system is in full effect for new Scarlet Scorpion bundles. With increasing discounts for each step along the way, you can earn yourself a FREE Pretty Beelzebub Image Armband and Gear Booster +14 Pouch by completing the chain (not to mention you’ll save thousands of EMP in the process)!

The Chain Discount event runs from August 3 to September 29.

[b]Novice Closer Growth Program
[/b]If you’re a Closer still on the path to max level, visit Planar Gate for a new Event Dungeon! This new program has four difficulty modes depending on your level:
[list]
[*] Patrol (Level 30 required)
[*] Skirmish (Level 60)
[*] Assault (Level 80)
[*] Assault (Level 85)
[/list]

Closers can enter twice each day, to earn Growth Badges and Demonstration Pendants. You’ll be able to craft a ton of helpful leveling consumables, gear, and materials. You’ll even have a chance at crafting some unique costumes and a new Novice Closer Growth Program Title Ticket!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/44ae1e84397eb7bbe3c9b601764aa73ff424df4f.png[/img]

Ready to reach the limit? See you at Planar Gate! This event runs from August 3 to August 31.

[b]New Costume Sets
[/b]Two new Washing Machines are making their way to Bitna. One will contain Sunshine Wave Swim Wear and Summer School Swim Suits (with Seth added!). [url=https://closers.enmasse.com/news/posts/bask-in-the-summer-sunshine]Check out the illustration variants in the Bask in the Summer Sunshine! news post.[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/259a9a7d66306f47154a5e716c6c58a6984d6a93.png[/img]

The other will contain new Azure Romance costumes for select Closers. These sets can grant special portraits when fully equipped, and come in multiple color variants. [url=https://closers.enmasse.com/news/posts/azure-romance-awaits-the-bold]Check out the illustration variants in the Azure Romance Awaits the Bold news post.[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/742c209c772e1d2fb0ad67bbe67568597573b08c.png[/img]

Can’t decide which set to aim for? We’ll post item details along with full set visualizers for these costumes in separate news posts so you can get a good look. Keep your grapes peeled for more Closers news!

[b]Cool Summer Event
[/b]Summer rages on with a new login event! Log in and claim your reward every day through the end of August, plus visit the Special Products tab for limited time Cool Summer Packages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/9a1ac72f0795f5b7ce80a2e7ca048df9f2a467e2.png[/img]

These Cool Summer Packages will come in single and specially discounted 5x and 4x bundles (limit one 5x and 4x purchase per account).

This event runs from August 17 06:00 to August 31 22:00 UTC.

[b]Happy Birthday Seth!
[/b]Even Emperors must celebrate their special day!

After escaping the lab, Seth survived on an empty stomach with only Anna to talk to. She never imagined that one day one day she’d have so many friends to keep her company on her birth(?)day!

Ready to celebrate? Let’s all pitch in and get her the biggest birthday cake the world has ever seen! A cake delicious enough to… sacrifice for? Hmm hmm hmm!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/1633771ff9d852f60cd9702705f388a791c90f5f.jpg[/img]

The event runs from August 25 06:00 to August 25 05:59 UTC. Make sure you log in during that time for a special Birthday Celebration Box!

Looking for the Patch Notes? Here you go Closers - [url=https://forums.enmasse.com/closers/discussion/10989/august-3-patch-notes-scarlet-scorpion-update]August 3 Patch Notes - Scarlet Scorpion Update.[/url]

notes.title: Beelzebub, the King of Gluttony
notes.content:
[h2]Beelzebub, the King of Gluttony
[/h2]
Beelzebub, the King of Gluttony and Master of Flies, arrives ready to fight with 4 new dungeons and an extradimensional host of new content.

[url=https://forums.enmasse.com/closers/discussion/10937/june-8-patch-notes-beelzebub-expansion]Check out the Patch Notes on our forums.[/url]

[h2]Glutton King Event and Crafting[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/9ffefde5b3909b3c8439400979610ebd7a22bde7.png[/img]
Log in every day from Monday, June 8 after maintenance until Monday, July 6. Record ten log-ins to collect special items, including a set of King of Gluttony Phase Wings! Complete event sectors to earn Fly King Tokens to craft choice items like the “Meet the Commander” title and Free Pass Boxes, as well as special drops.

[h2]Fusion Phase Wings[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/fddf14dbadd53922fbe8a42e9ed0d4e7e53d7d47.gif[/img]
Beginning Monday, June 8, you can now purchase, combine, and improve a special set of Phase Wings from the Contribution shop. These special wings can be improved up to +10 through a UI window accessible from your character profile, using materials like Splendid Phase Fibers (obtained by salvaging 3-Star costumes), Costume Fusion Fibers (events, Bitna, EMP shop), and Wing Essence, a new material obtained from special events and by salvaging existing 3-star phase wings.

Want more info on this new system? [url=https://forums.enmasse.com/closers/discussion/10934/new-costume-fusion-system-coming-june-8]Check out our Costume Fusion System Update article here.[/url]

[h2]Divine Battle Season 7[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/7b1a6fbda0c88f4c2a82b226e22d70b6a27834e0.png[/img]
Starting Monday, June 8 Divine Battle Season 7, Single Player vs Parties begins a new chapter in this never-ending conflict. Choose either Magra or Dogra, then complete sectors and turn in materials to support your side. The team with the most points at the end of the season will take home some great rewards!

Check the Divine Battle leaderboards to see which players have contributed to your cause—final rewards are distributed based on your ranking!

[h2]Dimension Runner Costume[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e435288185a734349d2f65aa62d02feff2b1d1a0.png[/img]
The new Dimension Runner outfits for Harpy, Tina, Wolfgang, and Soma are available in special washing machines beginning Monday, June 8 after maintenance, and will rotate out on Monday, July 6.

[h2]Enhancement Weekend Packages[/h2]
Starting Saturday, June 13, join us for four weekends full of fun and…fuel? The longer you play each day, the more stuff you’ll earn during our weekend login events. But if you still need more, we also have super deals coming each weekend. Check out the Special Products tab every weekend so you don't miss out on these savings. 

[h2]July Closers Day Celebration[/h2]
Saturday, July 4 (at 0600 UTC) not only kicks off the fourth weekend of our Enhancement Weekend event, it’s also Closers Day! Your first login of the day will earn that character a special Closers Day Celebration box containing a 1-Day Draconian costume set, 10 gear Booster Fuel I, a Costume Fusion Fiber, and a 1-Day, +15 Gluttony Core!

Play for a minimum of 60 minutes before Sunday, July 5 (at 0559 UTC) and you’ll also receive 10 Fly King Tokens!

[h2]CMC Ticket Packs[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/64a199fa73ad77f797ff6f77ab7d82abfb572356.png[/img]
Talk to Bitna in any Hub between Monday, June 8 and Monday, June 22 for another CMC Sale Period event, this time featuring the Leisurely Morning [B] costume. To take full advantage of this event, shop the EMP Store for bundles containing CMC Rearrange Tickets and CMC Transfer Tickets.

Monday, June 22 will also be the last day that Leisurely Morning (B) costumes will be available through CMC, so don’t miss out on this special costume variant!

[h2]Leisurely Morning Costume revival[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/466860e40363c10e4949c921f0b1c8766c3d6ea9.png[/img]
Starting Monday, June 8 and continuing until Monday, July 6, you can purchase washing machines with a chance to contain Leisurely Morning (A) and (C) costumes through Bitna.

[h2]Glutton King Packages and Chain Discount[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/ed6fd996f217d5ec700f4cd9401c3df1dfa4e8c4.png[/img]
To round out Beelzebub’s coming out party, starting Monday, June 8 you can purchase Glutton King packages in the EMP Store.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/1fa3dde8f7b4fe222be3537cc31d217b5dd05ef8.png[/img]
But also check out the new Glutton King Chain Discounts.

We'll see you in game Closers!

[/h2]
Plus Closers Day Packages! Check them out in the EMP Store Special Product tab starting June 6. They will only be available until June 14.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/36917af5979a412a5999060250832729b6bd3bf9.png[/img]

[url=https://forums.enmasse.com/closers/discussion/10926/may-26-patch-notes-busan-z-train]Check out the May 26 Patch Notes - Busan Z-Train.

notes.title: BUSAN CH.2 AND BRANCH UPDATE
notes.content:
Busan Chapter 2 is live! Log in to find out what happens next for our Closers. Also check out the improvements we've made to the character selection and creation process. Oh, and guess what... Bai and Seth are ready for PVP!

[url=https://forums.enmasse.com/closers/discussion/10897/may-11-patch-notes-busan-ch-2-branch-update]For all the details on P26 changes, please review our patch notes on our forums. [/url]

And as a special bonus, during the month of May we’re offering a special, “Stay Home, Stay Safe” weekday buff. Enjoy a 20% increase in additional items and experience when clearing sectors weekdays (Monday through Friday) in May. 

[h2]Busan Leveling Event
[/h2]Busan Chapter 2 increases the level cap for all characters to 88, and we’ve got a fresh new leveling event to help you push your Closers to the top.

Log in with any character level 10 or higher and receive an Untouchable Challenge Box (limit 1 per account) containing special +14 gear designed for leveling. You’ll also gain special rewards at levels 70, 85, and 88, including a +13 Gear Booster!

[h2]Ice Dancer Costume Set
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/097a0232d85ee08123120b80e6a5876643033434.png[/img]

It’s the hottest look on ice, and you’ll want to lace up your skates and slide over to the nearest Washing Machines to get it. With three color variants, four character illustrations, and a special headpiece accessory, you won’t want to miss out on this great costume.

[h2]Mission License Season 3
[/h2]Mission License season 3 starts Monday, May 11, and runs through Monday, June 8. Pick up an Event License and License Boosters in the EMP Store to maximize your rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/4ef936e1acccea6aa9fb21d44621c503e19ea437.png[/img]

[h2]Cross Material Conversion
[/h2]Enjoy special CMC discounts from Monday, May 11 to Monday, June 22, including great savings on Hot items like the Fallen Night and Dark Command sets, and a chance at the new Ice Dancer [B] costume pieces!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f2c68563eee18b16d70950696a1ce03299e04f39.png[/img]

[h2]Busan Chapter 2 special packages and chain discounts
[/h2]Starting Monday, May 11, and continuing until Monday, June 8, enjoy great chain discounts on Busan Knights packages, full to the rim with fantastic items to tune up your characters’ equipment. The more you buy, the more you save!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/ee6880b55568917ebed5e1749179733474c2fc5f.png[/img]

And also in the month of May (Monday, May 11 to Monday May 25), shop the EMP store for Busan Challenger packages full of even more useful items, including CMC tickets and Alpha Equalizers. These great bundles are available in limited quantities for a limited time only, so be sure and pick some up while you can!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/5429fc3a0ec23fb51b97895409bdbb15bcfb3049.png[/img]

[/h2]Join us for cake and presents starting Sunday, May 17 at 06:00 UTC (May 16 at 11:00 PM Pacific) as we celebrate Yuri Seo’s birthday! The birthday celebration only runs for 24 hours so log in before all the cake is gone.

notes.title: The Road to Busan
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/a9631342ddac7ffe410efbcefa0fde58fbf0ddb8.jpg[/img]

[h1]Can you solve the mystery of the Untouchable?[/h1]

On Monday, March 9 after maintenance, the Busan update opens up new zones, challenges, and mysteries for you to explore. With the enigmatic Misook as your guide, the sky is literally the limit to what you can accomplish!

Login in and play our Busan Celebration event and you can earn a +13 Purification Ops Module, and also craft Gear Boosters, Purification Ops and Contamination Hell free passes, Purification Ops trinkets, Demon’s Night trinkets, and more!

And if that wasn’t enough, new and returning players can open up a Welcome Box with must-have items like Gear Boosters, Maid Service and Gardening Vouchers, costumes and Closers Growth Support boxes! Keep playing every day for additional Welcome Boxes, Yakuta costumes, Gifted Cadet costumes, and even a Black Suit Full Set box!

[h1]What is Busan?[/h1]

Across the Korean peninsula from Seoul lies the bucolic coastal city of Busan. Until now, its mayor has resisted UNion’s efforts to place a chapter of Closers there, but a recent incursion of dimensional monsters sends Sylvi and her combined squad flying in to investigate. And you’re invited!

[h1]Misook Cosplay? YES PLEASE![/h1]

Even before you play the Busan story and discover who she really is, you can cosplay Misook’s signature style with Red Scorpion Tracksuit packages. And if you buy one early, you’ll also pick up a limited-edition Iron Pipe Accessory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/5e4572470f4a28ecf4a9bdcb07cfdba0878c4e76.png[/img]

[h2]Down the Rabbit Hole[/h2]

You also won’t want to miss our whimsical In Wonderland washing machines, packed with out-of-this-world costume pieces. Assemble a full set and you’ll enjoy new character illustrations and animations for all Closers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/88e93cad7ba86c9d9d6f482fcb59f259d79c3ffb.png[/img]

[h2]But wait, there’s more![/h2]

You should definitely take advantage of our Busan Commemorative Chain Discount and our Busan Celebration packages!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/aca2e041afb6afa57ecf47a62b7830102b78d64a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/7ba32833c6b60abace61ad993259fc6e91ee75b9.png[/img]

Join either the Science (Dogra) or Liberal Arts (Magra) team, then complete sectors and turn in materials to gain points for your side. The team with the most points at the end of the season will take home some sweet rewards!

Check the Divine Battle leaderboards to see which players contribute the most on each side, and final rewards will be distributed based on your ranking. The more you pitch in, the more you get to take with you at the end!

The Divine Battle starts on Monday, February 24 and continues until Wednesday, March 25.

Looking for a competitive edge? Look no further than the new “Imperial Guard” costume available in the washing machines, plus three new types of packages in the in game EMP store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/df7ce9ef0a0ae6a189821f6e4b4a3241a1b4d0cc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/4a30406558359fb240b437bbd157c16ba1c357c9.png[/img]

notes.title: The Queen of Hearts Finale!
notes.content:

[h1]Test your mettle in the Cybernetic event dungeon—and build your own Cybernetic costume![/h1]

The final chapter of Task Force Queen of Hearts is here, with Harpy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/f7234e5f2e16d0c5641be52de35c7a09b019c59a.gif[/img]

Start by diving into the Cybernetic event dungeon, where you’ll battle fearsome, cybered-up foes in pursuit of the components you’ll need to craft Cybernetic costume components.

In a rush? Drop by the store and shop the Cybernetic costume “re-sale”:

[list]
[*] Cybernetic Synchro Fiber ×1: 150 EMP
[*] Cybernetic Synchro Fiber ×11: 1,490 EMP—a 10% savings!
[*] Cybernetic Super Box: 990 EMP—with a chance to contain a full 10-piece set of the Cybernetic costume, a full set of Cybernetic accessories, gear boosters, pets, gardening or maid services, or other useful consumable items!

[*] Cybernetic Special Package: 9,900 EMP—contains 13 Cybernetic Super Boxes (a 23% savings)

[h2][url=https://closers.enmasse.com/news/posts/the-queen-of-hearts-finale]Click here to see our newspost which includes all available Cybernetics costumes + emotes![/url][/h2]

Cybernetic not your thing? Pick up the Sunday Best costume (not available for Luna, Soma, Bai, or Seth),

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/eec46fda68ca2360814283cee95fef9d38ca11ad.png[/img]

Or how about the Hot Spring costume (now available for Seth)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/d83a486a27beeb48325fda5a5fe7ceff6f249e3f.png[/img]

[h2][url=https://closers.enmasse.com/news/posts/the-queen-of-hearts-finale]Click here to see our newspost which includes all available Hot Springs costumes + emotes![/url][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/1f9855fb165a7b4dc9a01500b63d1653906a29dc.png[/img]

[h1]Valentine Playtime Event[/h1]

If your Valentine’s Day plans include playing Closers (and why not?) we’ve got a special playtime event just for you! All you have to do is log in each day from Monday, February 10 until Monday, February 24, and collect Lovely Conical Chocolates—a new crafting ingredient for making a variety of Valentine-themed items!

You’ll get one chocolate when you log in, two more at 30 minutes of play time, three more at 60 minutes, and so on, up to a maximum reward of fifteen Lovely Conical Chocolates a day for two hours of total play time. Over the course of the event, that’s enough for you to craft everything on the event crafting list—from Heart-Melting Shy Blush emotes to Black Choco Stick weapons to the big enchilada: the Valentine’s Day Event Box!

This is going to be a Valentine’s spectacular—so be sure to log in and play at least two hours every day you can!

notes.title: Task Force Queen of Hearts: Seth is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/3815eaa0d56f41d7abce4a95382308627f7eaab7.jpg[/img]

[h1]TASK FORCE QUEEN OF HEARTS: SETH![/h1]

Get ready to send your favorite Closers into our new Team Challenge system!

Each week, we set up a challenge for each team of Closers (Black Lambs, Wolf Dogs, and Wildhüter). Every challenge you complete earns you points towards rewards and ranking, as well as crafting materials for some amazing event items like a special Challenge Visual Frame and Title, and a new kind of Phase Wings!

But choose your Closers carefully. You can only use each character once per week, and you will receive some fairly hefty benefits when you complete the correct challenge.

Plus, we’ve set up a playtime event to reward you for time spent preparing for, participating in, and enjoying your challenge rewards. Log in and play up to 15 hours to claim rewards such as Lucky Phase Tokens, Super Advanced Evolution Material Capsules, and even three days of elite status!

This update also kicks off a new season of Cross Material Conversion. Check in with Bitna about your available options, but this season includes must-have items like the Fallen Night and Dark Command sets, and the 3-Star Master of Service (B) set that you just can’t get from the washing machines in the store!

To round off our update, Seth joins Task Force Queen of Hearts, just in time for Closers Day (Saturday, February 1 to Sunday, February 2). Don’t forget to use your Queen of Hearts badges to craft her costume and other useful items.

[previewyoutube=6-MyLYTOnME;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Great deals on Washing Machines and Costume bundles in the store.[/h1]

On Wednesday, January 29 after maintenance, get ready to suit up and take the field of…buttle?

Master of Service costumes give you that special touch of class, whether you’re fighting dimensional monsters or serving up high tea.

Shop the in game EMP store for Master of Service Washing Machines or Washing Machine Special packages to obtain your perfect uniform in variants A / C.

If you’re looking for Master of Service B costume pieces, you’ll want to stock up on Cross Material conversion tickets from our new CMC Special packages and CMC Try packages. In addition to the prized B variants, your tickets also have a chance to generate must-have items like the Fallen Night and Dark Command sets. Check in with Bitna about all the available options for this CMC season.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/3304189c19b4e20e304857578b2409ceee28b341.png[/img]

Also new in the store are Seth’s Academy package, and Black Suit packages for both Seth and Bai.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/e78af3beb2ad722178b3fd0269e13c40035dfbc2.png[/img]

And to round out the new store offerings, you can also buy Enhancement Special packages with Guaranteed D and Splendid D components, Costume Tuning packages with D Fabric Treatments, and enhancement transfer devices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/065beef5bed09a6b4580a85f4d436bcf618d7967.png[/img]

notes.title: Task Force Queen of Hearts: Sylvi arrives!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/8656e2f13dfb3069f28b98d243ad5c5829eb3fc6.jpg[/img]

[h1]A new task force is coming, and here’s how to get ready![/h1]

Task Force: Queen of Hearts arrives soon, and we’ve got a preview video all about it. Check it out here:

[previewyoutube=sj0HfEpVqxk;full][/previewyoutube]

Here is the recruitment schedule for Task Force Queen of Hearts:

[b]Sylvi—January 13[/b]
Sylvi is the task force’s long-range support specialist. Her telekinesis lets her convert loose scrap into weapons for enemy suppression and annihilation.

[b]Seth—January 29[/b]
Seth’s brutal claw attacks make him the task force’s key assault player at mid-range. His explosive power plays an important role in every battle.

[b]Harpy—February 10[/b]
Harpy’s fancy—and lethal—dance moves serve her well as the task force’s leader and melee expert. Her amazing skills can suppress all nearby opponents.

You can check out the full details in our [url=https://forums.enmasse.com/closers/discussion/10707/01-13-2020-task-force-queen-of-hearts-sylvi]"Task Force Queen of Hearts: Sylvi" Patch Notes.[/url]

[h1]NEW CONTENT! NEW COSTUMES![/h1]

[h2]High School Gym[/h2]

First up, new casual outfits for all your Closers are available in the in-game EMP Store’s Washing Machine tab. The High School Gym set is the perfect look for a quick stretch of the legs around New Seoul—or wherever your day takes you.

Han High School has been the focus of many dimensional incursions, but after a prolonged period of peace all classes have resumed their normal schedule—including PE!

Earn at least 50 points for a special reward; earn the maximum (5000 points) and you’ll get a sweet Visual Title!

If you’re short on time, but long on ambition, you can purchase Mission License Boosters to complete tasks instantly. And for even more rewards, purchase the Premium Rewards pass from the Mission License UI and unlock a second tier of incredible rewards, including Splendid Dual Chips, a visual frame to go along with your new title, and a Blue Rising Force Box containing the Blue Rising Force effect!

notes.title: Task Force Good Fellas: Misteltein - Beelzebub is here!
notes.content:
[h1]Beelzebub, Tein & Dancing! Do you need KitTeaCup yelling at you? (yes, yes you do)[/h1]

[previewyoutube=iwQoaCGaiaQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Beelzebub is coming after maintenance on Monday, December 23. The mysterious, demonic and powerful Beezlebub, has heard of your dragon smashing ways and it’s war. Fight his children Syrphid, Dermatobia, and Musca boss battles and you could get sweet costumes (and perhaps phase wings) and even sweeter dance moves.

For our most intense agents, we welcome you to Closer’s first 12-person raid where you’ll get the chance to earn Beezlebub gear, the new gear that goes all the way to +17.

And to help you on these brutal journeys, we’re upping the level cap to 86.

Brightly colored Scavengers give you the opportunity to craft Christmas goodies in our special Event Dungeon. In the store, Santa Outfits will be back in stock, and the tailor just finished sewing Bai’s Santa suit.

The new Midnight Crusader costume is available for a limited time only December 23 until maintenance on January 27.

Misteltein joins Task Force Good Fellas. What mind games does the mysterious Count D have in store?

[list]
[*] New Task Force character illustration
[*] New Task Force Rank ID
[*] New Task Force costume
[*] New Task Force Visual Frames
[*] Good Fellas Formation: B and EX variant
[/list]

notes.title: +14 / +15 Gear Boosting Event!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/84d32aeef85c710b6bf72c5648a8024767c51f81.jpg[/img]

December is a huge month for Closers, with two content updates you won’t want to miss: Task Force Good Fellas Levia on Monday, December 9, and Task Force Good Fellas Misteltein on Monday, December 23.

These updates are bringing big changes to the game, including a serious leap forward in character power with new gear—from the upcoming Beelzebub 12-player raid—that can be enhanced to +17!

To get you ready for all this awesome, starting on December 9 you want to log in for three special playtime rewards: GearBooster Fuel I ×100 at login, GearBooster Fortifier × 10 at 100 minutes, and a +14 Gear Booster at 200 minutes of accumulated playtime.

And as a special reward for people who’ve already done the work to get some +15 Purification or Contamination Hell items, you don’t even have to wait that long! After maintenance on December 9, we’ll award your account with Gear Boosters and Enhancement Renewal reward boxes based on how many items you’ve already maxed out.

You can use these enhancement items to fill out the rest of your kit, but it’s a better idea to hold on to them for the next phase of the [url=https://forums.enmasse.com/closers/discussion/10577/new-updates-are-coming-to-closers-on-12-9-p23-branch-update]P23 Enhancement Renewal.[/url] Because during Task Force Good Fellas Misteltein (December 23–January 7), the cost of enhancing any piece of gear drops to just 1 credit!

So get ready for an incredible month of beat-‘em-up, anime action. The world’s not going to save itself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459076/2c62b3bcd19594913a7c07fea0c819d2779803fd.jpg[/img]

notes.title: LAUNCH ANNIVERSARY AND THE ROAD AHEAD!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459076/5c604c970c760a109222c208443aada481af9ec1.jpg[/img]
Greetings, Closers!!

Today marks an exciting and momentous occasion for us – we celebrate one year since we fully released Closers! On behalf of RockyRoad, BearShoes, Smorcerer, and myself I’d like to say congratulations to all of you and to thank you from the bottom of our hearts for your support over this year. (Don’t forget to log in to the game today to get a free Malek Crystal to sell for 300,000 Credits, available until 11:59 p.m. PST tonight!)

Let’s mark this occasion by peering into a crystal ball and seeing what materializes!

Our next update lands next week: Rogue Agents. This kicks off Season 3 of the game, a new story line with twists and turns, and a level cap increase to level 85! [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5xbI-Z0GkTg]Here’s a look at where the Closers have been and where they are headed![/url]

Recently we shared some roadmap information through June 2019 but we have a bit more to share. The story continues this year with more new characters, new Task Force promotions, new events and dungeons, and content to keep the world alive and moving! Chapter 2 of Season 3 will be surrounded by the releases of the anticipated characters Bai and Seth, and new challenges await you all!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459076/c52422ecbef801ec1348008387aec1a306f61a0c.jpg[/img]

There is so much to come this year and we look forward to going even further on this ride together!

A new Closer is joining the Wildhüter team! After our scheduled downtime on Sunday, October 28, at 10 p.m. PDT, you’ll be able to play Soma. Read on for the full update details…

[b]UPDATE FEATURES[/b]

Meet Soma! Soma is a tonfa-wielding member of Wildhüter team, who harbors an intense hatred for dimensional monsters, and attacks them with endless hostility. Obsessed with the approval of others, Soma is driven by her need to see people smile, and lives for receiving praise for good work. Soma has joined the Wildhüters to defend the innocent…and bring the smiles back to their faces.
 
 Upon release, Soma will have a max level of 83 and be able to reach the rank of Official Agent. She will also have access to item transcendence and Great Purification Craft items. Soma's attacks are physical-based. 
 
 Please note that, unlike other characters, Soma will receive Dark Command costume pieces as her signature costume via Synchro Fiber costume combination. The Soma-specific Fleet Commander Washing Machine can award Dark Command Accessories for Soma.

One grand prize winner will win a Razer Blade 15 laptop! Four runners-up will receive an in-game Meister Bundle, containing the following: 
[list][*]Dark Command 10-Piece Costume Set[/*][*]Ivory Icon 6-Piece Costume Set[/*][*]Noble Night 5-Piece Costume Set[/*][*]10,000 EMP[/*][*]Monster Cat Pet[/*][*]Elite Status Voucher (180-Day)[/*][*]Tide Washing Machine ×15[/*][*]Heart Effect (1-Star Wings)[/*][*]Wildhüter Ace Title[/*][*]Midnight Wings (SSS Tuned, 90-Day)[/*][/list]
Enter now! The Closers Launch Giveaway ends on Monday, October 29, at 11:59 p.m. PDT. Winners will be contacted within a week of the contest’s end date by community@enmasse.com to request shipping information for the laptop, or account information for the runner-up prizes. Various contest and entry rules apply, so please review those at the contest landing page to ensure you qualify.

Good luck and thanks for playing Closers!

The next Closers update is almost here! After downtime on Monday, July 2 at 10 p.m. PDT, you can log in and start enjoying all the new features and events, including:

[h1]Violet is Almost Here![/h1]
Violet is nearly here, completing the Wolf Dogs roster. We’ve got a ton of events planned to celebrate!

[h1]Violet Leveling Event[/h1][list]	[*]Level your Violet from 1–80 between the end of maintenance and Tuesday, July 31, and receive special reward boxes, starting with your first login after maintenance! Rewards include crating items, multiple Yukata costumes, and more![/*][/list][h1]Violet Crafting Event[/h1][list][*]Clearing sectors with a Violet character earns you a Violet Token. Collect Violet Tokens to craft a variety of rewards, including a Vulture Corp. Uniform. These materials (and the opportunity to create something with them) expire on August 14, 2018. The items themselves (with the exception of the costume items) expire on January 15, 2019.[/*][/list][h1]Goodbye, Fatigue[/h1]
With this update, we’re removing the fatigue system from the NA and EU versions of Closers. With this, there are some big in-game changes, and an event to celebrate!

[h1]Fatigue Recovery Reward Replacements[/h1]
There are a lot of places in-game where you can earn potions to recover fatigue. We’re going to be replacing all of those.

[h1]Recycle Your Fatigue Recovery[/h1]
Have you stockpiled a lot of fatigue potions? No need to worry – we’ll be offering up ways to change your fatigue items for something else at Mattermixer Allen. But hurry, after the downtime on Monday, July 16, all fatigue recovery items will be deleted. 

[h1]Fatigue Removal Celebration Event[/h1]
The Fatigue system is going away! To celebrate, just log in and play between Tuesday, July 3 and Thursday, July 19 to receive rewards, including a Slot Type Modification Tool and a 7-Day VIP Voucher.

[h1]Special Agent J[/h1]
J can now be promoted to Special Agent.

The Special Agent promotion quest starts at level 67 in the Sky Ship Bridge.

[h1]J Leveling Event[/h1][list][*]Level your J from 1–80 between now and Tuesday, July 31, and receive special reward boxes, starting with your first login after maintenance! If your J has already passed a milestone level, you’ll receive the appropriate rewards with no additional play requirement. Rewards include Elite Status, Maid vouchers, and items to boost your progress to max level![/*][/list][h1]J’s Special Agent Costumes[/h1][list][*]Completing the Special Agent J promotion quest awards the player with a temporary J 1-Star Special Agent costume package.[/*][/list][h1]J Crafting Event[/h1][list][*]Clearing sectors with J earns you a Special Agent Special Agent Certificate. Collect these certificates to craft a variety of rewards. These materials (and the opportunity to create something with them) expire on August 14, 2018. The items themselves (with the exception of the costume items) expire on January 15, 2019.[/*][/list][h1]Nata’s Birthday Event[/h1]
It’s Nata’s birthday! The first time you log in on July 16–17, you’ll receive a Birthday Celebration Box, containing 20 Pieces of Cake and 1 Luck Stabilizer! (Don’t wait to open it, though! The box and its content expire after 24 hours.)

[h1]Closers Sales Events[/h1]
In addition to all the new events, Closers is adding several new items to the store.

[h1]New Items: Violet[/h1]
Violet is getting several new products in the store, including:
[list][*]1-Star Hair[/*][*]Skill Ticket[/*][*]Bear Pajamas[/*][*]Panda Pajamas[/*][/list]
