notes.title: Thanks to Your Feedback…
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459076/c2f1ad2fa6a2e8655ae19fca6bc20ce86656e307.jpg[/img]
Calling all Closers,

We heard you loud and clear. As of July 3, we’ll remove the fatigue system from the NA and EU versions of Closers. We’ve been watching, observing, and listening to all of your comments in regard to this system. It became obvious the system wasn’t good and took away the fun for a majority of players in our regions. Naddic is a very player focused developer and aligns with our En Masse mission to create great Player Experiences. So, we are very happy to announce the implementation of this change in the next update!

—Cochese
[h1]FAQ:[/h1]
[h1]How will the change affect the game economy?[/h1]
[list][*]Most of the main dungeons already have their own entrance restrictions. Naddic previously removed fatigue in Japan and gained experience in ensuring the economy remains healthy. We will also continuously monitor for any needed changes.[/*][/list][h1]What will I be able to do with spare fatigue pots?[/h1]
[list][*]We are still finalizing this. We are leaning towards converting all existing pots into credits via the Matter Mixer. Before we can finalize, we’re doing some research into the economy of fatigue pots and the balance of converting. For now, I would not recommend stock piling these, as they will not give an advantage going forward.[/*][/list][h1]Will stamina pots be removed from starter packs?[/h1]
[list][*]We will replace these with another type of consumable and update our DLC packs with the update.[/*][/list][h1]Will there be any changes to limits on dungeons? Or will it be the same as it was?[/h1]
[list][*]Nothing will be changed for now. We will continue to monitor and adjust to protect the economy, as needed.[/*][/list][h1]Will there be compensation to players that bought packs with Stamina potions in it?[/h1]
[list][*]If you haven’t used them yet, you will be able to convert these when the update arrives. We are also considering a reward to couple with this big change for all players – stay tuned![/*]
[/list][h1]There are some main quest/PvP boxes/achievements that give stamina potions as a reward, will those change?[/h1][list][*]Absolutely! Naddic has already started on these replacements and all pots will be gone with the update.[/*][/list]
[h1]Will we increase the cap limits on items being sold in the Black Market?[/h1][list][*]We will continue monitoring this and it’s a big topic for all regions. We will update as we have more to share here.[/*][/list]

notes.title: We’ve Got a Pile of Free Stuff for You!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459076/c2492c911271514a7822adf89cd4e2ea82195a24.jpg[/img]
Welcome (Back), Closers! We're beginning a series of events to celebrate new, returning, and existing Closers! 

[b]An Event for Everyone[/b]

After we return from maintenance on Tuesday, May 8, we’ll send Closer Coins to each and every Closer just for clearing stages that consume at least 10 Stamina, or clearing stages in the Dimensional Ops Center.

Collect Closer Coins and trade them in for costumes, character effects, accessory boxes, enhancement materials, and more!

[b]Returning Closers[/b]

If you haven't logged in since Tuesday, April 3, 6 a.m. server time, you'll receive a box with a ton of great items just for logging in following the May 8 maintenance. 

Better still, until June 26, you can log in once per day to receive a reward for up to 14 days! Here's what's inside the first box you’ll receive:
[list][*]Dark Command 10-Piece Set Box (7-Day) ×1[/*][*]+11 Gear Booster ×2[/*][*]Elite Status Voucher (3-Day) ×1[/*][*]+12 Core Weapon Box (15-Day) ×1[/*][*]+12 Module Box (15-Day) ×1[/*][*]3-star Mephisto Wings (30-Day) ×1[/*][/list]
The next 14 times you log in until June 26, we’ll send you another box of login rewards, including a Blue Wave / Jade Yukata Box, a +12 Gear Booster, and more!

[b]New Closers[/b]

If you create an account after the May 8 downtime, you'll receive a box with a ton of great items. Then, until June 26, you can log in once per day to receive a reward for up to 14 days! Here's what's inside the first box you’ll receive:
[list][*]Dark Command 10-Piece Set Box (7-Day) ×1[/*][*]+10 Gear Booster ×4[/*][*]Elite Status Voucher (3-Day) ×1[/*][*]3-star Irediscent Wings (30-Day) ×1[/*][/list]
You’ll also receive a New Closer Support Box at every 10-level interval—level 10, 20, 30, 40, and so on—until July 24, at 6 a.m. PDT! New Closer Support Boxes contain items designed to boost your progress throughout the entire game.

notes.title: Harpy Loading Screen Contest!
notes.content:
Greetings, Closers!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459076/32af8572faa95b0812ec448eca981565f0bfeeff.jpg[/img]

We know you are just as excited about the release of Harpy as we are—if not more! To celebrate her arrival, we want to put a little of your talent into the game!  From [b]Friday, May 4 at 9 a.m. PDT until Wednesday, May 16 at 9 a.m. PDT[/b], we would like to invite you to enter our Harpy Loading Screen Contest!
Here are the contest details:[list]  [*]Your submission must be centered around Harpy, the upcoming new Wolf Dog character.[/*]  [*]Submission must be your own original art. (Screenshots are not eligible to win.)[/*]  [*]You can submit multiple (reasonably high-effort) pieces, but are only eligible for one possible prize.[/*]  [*]Your full entry must be received by Wednesday, May 16 at 9 a.m. PDT to be eligible.[/*]  [*]The dimensions for your entry must be [b]2660x1536 pixels[/b].[/*]  [*]To submit your entry, please email [b]fanart@enmasse.com[/b] with the subject line “Harpy Loading Screen Contest Submission,” and include your EME account email, character name, whether you’re on NA or EU servers, and your submission (as an attachment—not a link) in either [b].BMP, .JPG, .PNG, or .PSD format.[/b][/*]  [*]We will announce the winners during the regular Closers [url=http://www.twitch.tv/enmasseentertainment]Twitch stream[/url] on [b]Thursday, May 17 at 10 a.m. PDT.[/b][/*][/list]
Three contest winners will have their art featured in the Harpy update. All entries are appreciated, but only three submissions can win!
[list][*][b]First Place:[/b] 5,000 EMP and your art displayed in the Tiamat’s Abyss Loading Screen[/*][*][b]Second Place:[/b] 3,500 EMP and your art displayed in the Mephisto Raid Loading Screen[/*][*][b]Third Place:[/b] 2,000 EMP and your art displayed in the Vitus Raid Loading Screen[/*][/list]
Help us celebrate the release of Harpy in style!

notes.title: Closers Day Returns!
notes.content:
Attention Closers!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459076/5c604c970c760a109222c208443aada481af9ec1.jpg[/img]

Closers Day returns Saturday, May 12, at 6 a.m. server time and ends at Sunday, May 13, at 6 a.m. server time. Let’s celebrate Closers everywhere! Here's what to watch for:

[b]Closers Day Giveaway[/b]

Logging in on Closers Day will get you one Closers Day Celebration Box per account. Here’s what’s inside:
[list][*]1-Day Dark Command 10-Piece Set ×1[/*][*]1-Day +13 Core Weapon ×1 containing: 1 Station Agile Core IV, 1 Perfected Agile Core IV, 1 Super Lortal Agile Core V, and 1 Crater Brutal Core V[/*][*]Small Plum Soda ×1[/*][/list]
[b]Closers Day Buff[/b]

All Closers get a boost to their power on Closers Day. Throughout the event, you’ll be getting the following power-ups:
[list][*]50 percent EXP bonus[/*][*]50 percent more items[/*][*]50 percent increased credits[/*][*]Increased daily entries into restricted sectors by 1[/*][/list]
[b]Closers Day Play Time Reward[/b]

Playing for at least 100 minutes between 6 a.m. server time on Saturday, May 12, and 6 a.m. Sunday, May 13 will grant you a permanent pair of Heart Sunglasses! You'll be able to track your progress through the new in-game event banner system.

notes.title: Announcing the Closers Weekend Login Event
notes.content:
Would you like a free, permanent UNION Agent or Vulture Corp Operative costume?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459076/2d19874d0676f9b9480361cff3a9e66006b64f9c.gif[/img]

Just log in any time between Friday, May 4, at 12:01 a.m. and Monday, May 7, at 11:59 p.m. PDT, and we’ll send you a box containing the following in-game items:
[list][*]A UNION Agent costume or a Vulture Corp. Operative costume[/*][*]Double Talisman[/*][*]Resurrection Capsule[/*][*]1-Day Elite Status Voucher[/*][/list]
Once you hit “Play,” the box will be sent to your EMP Store Delivery Box. You only get one box, no matter how many times you log in over the weekend, and the costume inside is determined by the character who opens the box. (Black Lambs get the UNION Agent costume, while Wolf Dogs get the Vulture Corp. Operative costume.)

But remember: You’ve only got until Monday night to log in and claim all this good stuff—so don’t put it off!

notes.title: The Renovation Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459076/b04ae065ebaec59c04501101bc0176eb54b6076b.jpg[/img]

Our next Closers update introduces numerous improvements to all aspects of the game, including (but not limited to) leveling curve tweaks designed to get you to max level faster, changes to achievement and crafting, shorter load times, and more. The Renovation Update will release early next week (the week of May 7).

[url=https://forums.enmasse.com/closers/discussion/4310/renovation-update-patch-notes]Read our complete patch notes for more details![/url]

[h1]NEW FEATURES[/h1]
[b]Housing Multi Play[/b]. 

Invite your friends and crew members to visit your room!

[b]Dimensional Gel Conversion.[/b] 

Dimensional Gel Season 1 begins with this update! For each Dimensional Washing Machine you purchase from Bitna, you'll receive one Dimensional Gel (plus a bonus 10 for purchasing 10 machines at once). Each season offers different rare items to craft with this Gel. In the first season, you can craft a new Amethyst Icon costume pieces plus Dark Command Accessories!

[h1]EVENTS[/h1]
[b]Welcome (Back), Closers![/b]

When we return from the Renovation Update maintenance, our Welcome Back event begins to celebrate new and returning Closers with [u]free stuff[/u]! We’ll also be running a crafting event, so be sure to log in every day.

[b]May Attendance Event.[/b]

We also have a special schedule of daily rewards for logging in! You can track your progress and see what's coming in our all new in-game event calendar. 

[h1]EMP SHOP/BITNA[/h1]
[b]Yarg! There Be Pirate Costumes.[/b]

You can now get Pirate costumes in Bitna's Washing Machine shop! When you have the full set equipped, you'll unlock a unique emote.

Right after maintenance, you can purchase 5 Washing Machines for 500 EMP per day per account in the EMP Shop! To increase the speed of collecting the set for your favorite character, you'll only get costume pieces for your current character in this EMP shop pack.

[b]New Tina Costumes.[/b]
 
Tina has a bunch of new costume sets available with this update! She gets all three variants of the Caregiver costume, a Xiao NPC costume, and Domestic costume pieces from Washing Machines.

notes.title: Planar Raid Update
notes.content:
The April 17 Planar Raid Update introduces new challenges at the Planar Gate and increases Tina's level cap to 75!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459076/2f71d35a7d78e77f8fcc857871a857afa55093b7.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW FEATURES:[/h1]
We’ve got two major new features in store for you, Closers:
[list][*]We’ve added Planar Gate Raid quests and stages, providing players of level 73 and above with a new challenge! These encounters introduce new gear, accessory items, achievements, and more. Head to Planar Gate to get started (and we recommend playing with a group).[/*][*]We’ve also increased Tina's level cap to 75, giving her access to the Refit Sky Ship hub and quests.[/*][/list][h1]NEW EVENTS[/h1][list][*]Defeat Mephisto and Vitus; Save the World!—Once per account, upon first login after maintenance, you’ll receive a box full of powerful gear to give you a taste of what you can unlock from the Planar Gate raids. This box contains temporary versions of the Phase Wings earned by challenging Vitus and Mephisto, plus a box of +12 Ultimate Gear, which includes an ultimate core, 2 modules, and 3 trinkets.[/*][*]Complete stages that consume 10 Fatigue or more, and you’ll receive tokens you can use to craft special rewards, including accessories and enhancement material boxes![/*][/list][h1]EMP SHOP/BITNA[/h1][list][*]Head out on patrol with Security Guard costumes![/*]

[*]Tina Academy Packages—The Tina Academy costume bundle will be available in three different colors! And until the May 14 maintenance, each bundle comes with a pair of Half-Rimmed Glasses.
[/*][*]Raid Ready Packages—Until the Monday, April 30 downtime, we'll be offering packages of enhancement materials and temporary accessories to get you raid-ready faster![/*][*]Tina Icon Comes to Bitna—Bitna’s Washing Machines may now produce 2- and 3-Star versions of Tina's Onyx, Ruby, and Sapphire Icon costumes.[/*][/list][h1]SEE YOU TUESDAY, APRIL 17[/h1]
On Monday, April 16, at 10 p.m. PDT, we’ll take the servers down for maintenance, and we expect to be back online with the Tina update on Tuesday, April 17. See you then!

notes.title: Battle Robot Tina Joins the Wolf Dogs
notes.content:
The latest Closers update introduces the newest member of the Wolf Dogs. By popular vote, we present: Tina!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459076/0ca4670458b02658a4d6fac6a3b00791a8df3f66.jpg[/img]

[h1]Tina Has Arrived[/h1]
To celebrate Tina’s arrival, we’ve got three great events planned to benefit players who create a Tina character:
[list][*]Start a new Tina character and you’ll receive a Welcome Box that grants you a Small Plum Soda, a Dark Command 10-Piece Set (1 day), and a set of 3-Star Midnight Wings (1 day)![/*][*]We’ll also send you a special support box (via in-game mail) when you hit levels 30, 40, 50, 60, and 70 with a Tina character! These boxes contain weapon cores, enhancement items, and more! Once Tina's level cap is increased to 75 in the April 16 update, you'll get a box for hitting 75 too![/*][*]Complete stages that consume 10 Fatigue (or more) and you’ll receive tokens to craft special rewards, including accessories and boosts![/*][*]All three events last until Monday, April 30, at 10 p.m. PDT.[/*][/list][h1]Greet Spring in a Yukata Kimono[/h1]
Spring is here, and we know just how to celebrate:
[list][*]Gather Cherry Blossom Petals by clearing 10-Fatigue stages or Dimensional Ops Center stages.[/*][*]Once per day, you can get additional bonus Cherry Blossom Petals by logging in, and playing for 60 and 120 minutes.[/*][*]Trade Cherry Blossom Petals for Cloud and Sapphire Yukata costumes, plus useful consumables![/*][*]Spring events end on Monday, April 16, 10 p.m. PDT.[/*]
[/list][h1]Thank You, Harpy Fans![/h1]
We want to acknowledge and thank everyone who voted in the Tina-versus-Harpy competition—including those of you who voted for Harpy! We hope you all take some solace from knowing she'll join the Wolf Dogs in May.

In the meantime, show your love for Harpy by wearing a Phantom Thief Mask! This mask will be mailed to everyone who logs in after maintenance from Tuesday, April 3 to Monday, April 16, at 10 p.m. PDT.
[h1]Shop Updates[/h1]
Relax in Style, with Spa Costumes!

Spa costumes are now available from Warm Spa Washing Machines! Complete a 6-piece set and you can hang out in a hot tub whenever you like!

Emote Preview: https://www.youtube.com/embed/zkc0zGYAIbc

[h1]Tina Combat Gear[/h1]
Let Tina blend into her surroundings with Forest, Urban, and Winter Combat Gear costumes! Urban and Winter variants can be obtained from Bitna. Forest Combat Gear is available in the EMP Store.
[h1]Tina Premium Starter Pack[/h1]
Until Tuesday, April 17, you can get the exclusive Han High School Top variant and 6-piece Ivory Icon costumes by picking up the Tina Premium Starter Pack! The pack will be around after April 17, but not with the Han High School Top variant.
[h1]Bitna Inventory Updates[/h1]
Several Washing Machines will be rotating out of Bitna’s inventory during maintenance, so make sure to get them while you still can! The following will not be available after the update:

[list][*]Domestic Washing Machines[/*][*]Nata Icon Washing Machines[/*][*]Dark Dragon Breath Washing Machines[/*][/list]

notes.title: Pandimensional Peer Review
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459076/be7a73c9be9945b88ddda7c16ce1244505c1b800.jpg[/img]

A group of pandimensional Closers from another reality have crossed over to our world, determined to prove themselves the best Closers in the entire multiverse. In true bureaucratic style, they're settling the score using the most brutal form of conflict known to man: Tournament-Style Peer Review!

From Tuesday, March 20 at 9:00 a.m. PDT, until Tuesday, April 3 at 9:00 a.m. PDT, Closers will face off in a tournament-style bracket. Players can cast their vote every two days (and also on Twitter and Facebook) and watch how the pairings progress. When the final votes have been cast, we’ll announce Closers’ best boy and best girl.

Learn more at playclosers.com/news

notes.title: Giveaway: Get free stuff for Closers, an anime beat-'em-up on Steam
notes.content:
Update: After Tuesday's giveaway was so popular, En Masse is helping us give away even more keys. The entry link below is now live again.

We're giving away a bunch of stuff for Closers, "an episodic anime action RPG" that released on Steam last month. Closers is free to play, so anyone who's interested in 2.5D beat-'em-ups with co-op, solo play, or PvP can dive right in and redeem the package of items available below. 

This giveaway is first come, first served, but if you're guaranteed a code if you're a member of PC Gamer Club. We'll be sending out codes to PC Gamer Club members all at once in the morning, Friday, March 23. If you need assistance with PC Gamer Club, contact us at help@pcgamer.com.

Enter here

Click the link above to request a code. Codes will be distributed via email automatically until we've run out.

What you get

  • Exclusive PC Gamer in-game poster for your room
  • Yukata Bonsai or Ruby costume
  • (2) Small plum soda 
  • (2) Double Talisman Box (+20% bonus EXP and credit)
  • Gardening Voucher (1 day)
  • Maid Service Voucher (1 day)

How to redeem your Closers code

  1. Download the game: https://closers.enmasse.com/download
  2. Run “Closers” from STEAM or Run the En Masse Launcher
  3. Click “Redeem Code” from the upper left corner in the Launcher
  4. Paste in your code
  5. Items will be delivered in-game via the account claim

notes.title: Changes to the Collector's Edition
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459076/677fa2484e9505326c3b1b1d744a98cecf663faa.png[/img]

Hello Everyone,

We are making some changes to our Collector’s Edition packs, starting right now! These changes are based on your feedback over the past month. We are now offering two editions.

The current Digital Collector’s Edition has been reduced to $49.99 – this pack can be purchased multiple times.

The all new Deluxe Collector’s Edition will be sold at $69.99 (1 redemption per account) and include the following:

-- Nightmare Costume
-- 30 Day Elite 
-- 30 Day Midnight Wings 
-- 2000 EMP
-- 5 Small Plum Sodas
-- 30 Day Gardening Voucher
-- 30 Day Maid Service Voucher

For the early adopters, who’ve already purchased the Collectors pack - we will be sending you all the new items for each purchase (2K EMP, 5 Stamina Pots, Gardening and Maid Vouchers) automatically. You should receive these within 24 hours of this post. If you do not see them after that, please write in to our Support Team and they will get you hooked up.

Thank you for your continued support and passion – you are the best players in the world.

notes.title: Meet the Newest Wolf Dog in the Nata Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459076/86e6398b8c99fca003d3f3ecc31f486f3a16c40f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Levia Joins the Closers
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4459076/cdc5adb3289ec3703ebcde81b460cb1bc374e74b.jpg[/img]

The first of the Wolf Dogs is joining the Closers!

Following the downtime on Monday, December 18, please welcome Levia—a dimensional monster who learned to love peace. Although she was assigned to work with the Wolf Dogs, Levia dislikes fighting...but feels that she must follow orders, and do what she can to help humanity.

The Levia update kicks off leveling events and costume deals to celebrate the newest Closer, but that’s not all. This update also introduces housing to Closers, as well as the winter event stage: Snow Day Operation!

Remember, downtime for the Levia update begins at 10 p.m. PST on Monday, December 18. We expect to be back online within two hours. 

[url=https://closers.enmasse.com/news/posts/levia-joins-the-closers]Get the full update details here![/url]
